Beautifully illustrated and full of the sass you’d expect from Swift’s feline entourage, it’s a sweet gift for young readers and a fun collectible for fans of the pop superstar.
paras.zh: 对于斯威夫特和猫爱好者来说，这本迷人的图画书通过泰勒·斯威夫特三只心爱的猫：梅雷迪斯·格雷、奥利维亚·本森和本杰明·巴顿的眼睛讲述了她的故事。这本书插图精美，充满了斯威夫特猫随行人员的俏皮话，是给年轻读者的一份甜蜜礼物，也是这位流行巨星粉丝的有趣收藏品。

paras.en: Adult Karaoke Machine with 2 Wireless Microphones
paras.zh: 成人卡拉 OK 机带 2 个无线麦克风

paras.en: A bestseller with 2,000 purchases on Amazon in the past month, this karaoke machine features 200W sound, two wireless microphones, pitch correction and Bluetooth 5.3. It also connects to a compatible TV for displaying lyrics and offers up to 24 hours of battery life.
paras.zh: 这款卡拉 OK 机是过去一个月在亚马逊上获得 2,000 次购买的畅销产品，具有 200W 音响、两个无线麦克风、音调校正和蓝牙 5.3。它还可以连接到兼容的电视来显示歌词，并提供长达 24 小时的电池续航时间。

paras.en: Victrola Journey Bluetooth Suitcase Record Player
paras.zh: Victrola Journey 蓝牙手提箱电唱机

paras.en: I own this Victrola record player in black, but it comes in 12 colors. The fact that it looks like a stylish briefcase means it acts as cute home décor too. It plays vinyl at three speeds and doubles as a Bluetooth speaker for streaming music from your phone. Trust me, Adéla’s “Nicole Kidman” sounds especially good through its old-school speaker.
paras.zh: 我拥有这款黑色留声机，但它有 12 种颜色。它看起来像一个时尚的公文包，这意味着它也可以作为可爱的家居装饰品。它以三种速度播放黑胶唱片，并可兼作蓝牙扬声器，用于从手机传输音乐。相信我，Adéla 的“妮可基德曼”通过其老式扬声器听起来特别好。

paras.en: Give your favorite guitar hero a gift that smells as good as it looks. Inspired by Fender guitars, these Voluspa candles feature decorative jars with a distinctive guitar pick on the front. The three-candle set includes Vanilla Voltage, Strawberry Rush and Midnight Leather, though each scent is also available to purchase individually.
paras.zh: 给您最喜欢的吉他英雄一份闻起来和看起来一样美味的礼物。这些 Voluspa 蜡烛的灵感来自 Fender 吉他，配有装饰罐，正面带有独特的吉他拨片。三支蜡烛套装包括 VanillaVoltage、Strawberry Rush 和 Midnight Leather，不过每种香味也可以单独购买。

paras.en: Noise-Canceling Nothing Headphone (1) Pro
paras.zh: 无噪音降噪耳机 (1) Pro

paras.en: Designed for serious listening, Nothing’s Headphone (1) Pro features a triple-driver system, adaptive noise cancellation, and up to 68 hours of playback. BTS’ V and Nothing ambassador modeled the headphones, saying, “Headphone (1) Pro is a design grounded in creative expression, and I look forward to our journey together.” Shop them in black or white.
paras.zh: Nothing’s Headphone (1) Pro 专为认真聆听而设计，具有三驱动系统、自适应降噪和长达 68 小时的播放时间。 BTS 的 V and Nothing 大使为这款耳机进行了建模，他表示：“Headphone (1) Pro 是一个以创意表达为基础的设计，我期待着我们共同的旅程。”购买黑色或白色的产品。

paras.en: Need a budget-friendly set of earphones for someone who’s always listening to music? JLab’s Go Air Pop earbuds deliver more than 32 hours of total playtime, three EQ sound settings and a charging case with a built-in USB cable. They’re sweat-resistant for workouts and available in black, lilac, mint, pink, slate, teal and pony colors.
paras.zh: 需要一款适合经常听音乐的人的经济实惠的耳机吗？ JLab 的 Go Air Pop 耳塞可提供超过 32 小时的总播放时间、三种 EQ 声音设置以及带内置 USB 线的充电盒。它们防汗，适合锻炼，有黑色、淡紫色、薄荷色、粉色、板岩色、青色和小马色可供选择。

paras.en: Fender’s Elie 6 brings the brand’s iconic musical heritage to a portable Bluetooth speaker with 60W of power, spatial audio and four input channels for instruments and microphones. I especially love that it has three listening modes, including Multi-Mode, which connects up to 100 compatible speakers. Available in black or white, it’s built for musicians and music fans alike.
paras.zh: Fender 的 Elie 6 将该品牌标志性的音乐传统带入便携式蓝牙扬声器中，该扬声器具有 60W 功率、空间音频以及用于乐器和麦克风的四个输入通道。我特别喜欢它的三种聆听模式，包括可连接多达 100 个兼容扬声器的多模式。它有黑色或白色可供选择，专为音乐家和音乐迷打造。

paras.en: Loop Switch 2 Adjustable Earplugs – 3 Modes
paras.zh: 循环开关 2 个可调节耳塞 – 3 种模式

paras.en: I swear by my Loop earplugs for concerts and music festivals because I can still hear the music clearly while protecting my eardrums at the same time — nobody’s invincible when it comes to hearing damage. I even wear mine during loud construction work outside my window. The Loop Switch 2 offers three adjustable noise-reduction modes in six colors.
paras.zh: 我在音乐会和音乐节上非常信赖我的 Loop 耳塞，因为我仍然可以清晰地听到音乐，同时还能保护我的耳膜——在听力损伤方面，没有人是无敌的。我什至在窗外喧闹的建筑施工中也戴着它。 Loop Switch 2 提供六种颜色的三种可调节降噪模式。

paras.en: The Unofficial Chappell Roan Coloring Book
paras.zh: 非官方查普尔·罗恩着色书

paras.en: For the Midwest Princess fan who loves a creative outlet, this unofficial Chappell Roan coloring book features more than 20 hand-drawn illustrations celebrating her bold fashion, music and personality. Packed with trivia and fun facts about the pop star, it’s best enjoyed with your brightest gel pens, sparkly supplies and favorite Chappell Roan hits playing in the background.
paras.zh: 对于喜欢创意的中西部公主粉丝来说，这本非官方的 Chappell Roan 涂色书包含 20 多幅手绘插图，颂扬她大胆的时尚、音乐和个性。书中充满了关于这位流行歌星的琐事和有趣的事实，最好用你最亮的中性笔、闪闪发光的用品和背景播放的查普尔·罗恩 (Chappell Roan) 最喜欢的热门歌曲来欣赏。

paras.en: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Press-On Nail Set & Polish
paras.zh: “KPop Demon Hunters”按压式指甲套装和抛光剂

paras.en: Give a HUNTR/X fan the ultimate at-home manicure kit inspired by KPop Demon Hunters. This set includes five styles of gel press-on nails featuring HUNTR/X-inspired colors and logos, three nail care polishes representing Rumi, Mira and Zoey plus a magnetic stick for creating a trendy “cat-eye” or velvet effect. For a more budget-friendly gift, shop the products individually or in duo and trio packs.
paras.zh: 为 HUNTR/X 粉丝提供受 KPop Demon Hunters 启发的终极家用美甲套件。该套装包括五种款式的凝胶按压式指甲，具有 HUNTR/X 风格的颜色和徽标，三种代表 Rumi、Mira 和 Zoey 的指甲护理油，以及用于打造时尚“猫眼”或天鹅绒效果的磁力棒。如需更经济实惠的礼物，请单独购买产品或以两件套或三件套的形式购买产品。

paras.en: I have one of these quirky little players myself, and it’s a dream gift for novelty collectors and music lovers short on space. The compact turntable plays Tiny Vinyl records through built-in stereo speakers or connects to external speakers and headphones. Miniature records are sold separately.
paras.zh: 我自己就有一个这样古怪的小播放器，对于新奇收藏家和空间有限的音乐爱好者来说，这是一份梦想的礼物。紧凑的转盘通过内置立体声扬声器或连接到外部扬声器和耳机播放 Tiny Vinyl 唱片。微型唱片单独出售。

paras.en: With more than 10,000 sold on Amazon each month and over 50 purchased daily at Walmart, Hitster is a popular pick for music lovers. Players scan QR codes to listen to more than 300 iconic hits and guess the year each song was released. Multiple game modes make it a fun option for family game nights or parties with friends.
paras.zh: Hitster 每月在亚马逊上售出超过 10,000 件，每天在沃尔玛购买超过 50 件，是音乐爱好者的热门选择。玩家扫描二维码即可收听 300 多首经典热门歌曲，并猜测每首歌曲的发行年份。多种游戏模式使其成为家庭游戏之夜或与朋友聚会的有趣选择。

paras.en: Audigo Wireless Microphone and Mobile Studio App
paras.zh: Audigo 无线麦克风和 Mobile Studio 应用程序

paras.en: When American Idol winner Hannah Harper records songs for Instagram and TikTok, she uses Audigo, a wireless microphone that fits in the palm of her hand. Available on Amazon for the first time this holiday season, it pairs with a free iOS or Android app to record, mix and sync high-quality audio with video.
paras.zh: 当《美国偶像》冠军汉娜·哈珀 (Hannah Harper) 为 Instagram 和 TikTok 录制歌曲时，她会使用 Audigo，这是一款适合手掌大小的无线麦克风。该产品于今年假期首次在亚马逊上发售，可与免费的 iOS 或 Android 应用程序配合使用，用于录制、混合和同步高质量音频与视频。

paras.en: Incohearent: Guess the Gibberish Party Game
paras.zh: 语无伦次：猜猜胡言乱语的派对游戏

paras.en: I own Incohearent and can confirm it’s hilarious. While not exclusively music themed, its 300 cards span pop culture, party and spicy references, including gibberish song lyrics that are nearly impossible to decipher. Players race to decode phrases before time runs out, making this viral party game a fun pick for adult game nights.
paras.zh: 我拥有 Incohearent 并且可以确认它很搞笑。虽然不完全是音乐主题，但它的 300 张卡片涵盖了流行文化、派对和辛辣的元素，包括几乎无法破译的胡言乱语歌词。玩家们在时间耗尽之前竞相解码短语，使这款病毒式派对游戏成为成人游戏之夜的有趣选择。

paras.en: For the music lover who’d rather make memories than unwrap another thing, a Ticketmaster gift card lets them choose their next live experience. With amounts ranging from $50 to $1,000, it’s suitable for concerts, festivals, theater and more. Choose an e-gift, physical card or print-at-home option for an easy Christmas present.
paras.zh: 对于那些宁愿留下回忆而不是打开其他东西的音乐爱好者来说，Ticketmaster 礼品卡可以让他们选择下一次现场体验。金额从 50 美元到 1,000 美元不等，适合音乐会、节日、戏剧等。选择电子礼品、实体卡片或在家打印选项，轻松获得圣诞礼物。

paras.en: A StubHub gift card is available in amounts from $25 to $200, and can be sent electronically or printed at home. They’re also available in bulk, making them a practical holiday gift for employees. StubHub is a popular alternative for buying cheap concert tickets, so your recipient may be able to enjoy more than one concert from your gift card.
paras.zh: StubHub 礼品卡的金额从 25 美元到 200 美元不等，可以通过电子方式发送或在家打印。它们也可以批量供应，使其成为送给员工的实用节日礼物。 StubHub 是购买廉价音乐会门票的热门选择，因此您的收件人可以使用您的礼品卡欣赏多场音乐会。

paras.en: Shopping Holidays Leading Up to December With the Best Deals
paras.zh: 十二月前的购物假期最优惠

paras.en: The holiday shopping season brings plenty of opportunities to save on gifts. Like Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals in November, knowing when to shop can help you find the best prices without the last-minute stress. Keep an eye on seasonal sales, compare discounts across retailers and shop early for popular items. As December approaches, pay attention to shipping deadlines to ensure gifts arrive in time.
paras.zh: 假日购物季带来了很多节省礼物的机会。就像 11 月的黑色星期五和网络星期一优惠一样，了解何时购物可以帮助您找到最优惠的价格，而无需担心最后一刻的压力。关注季节性销售，比较各个零售商的折扣，并尽早购买热门商品。随着 12 月的临近，请注意发货期限，以确保礼物及时送达。

paras.en: - Nov. 27, Black Friday: Shop by Nov. 27 for the main event deals, with many discounts available earlier in November.
paras.zh: - 11 月 27 日，黑色星期五：在 11 月 27 日之前购买主要活动优惠，11 月初可享受许多折扣。

paras.en: - Nov. 28, Small Business Saturday: Shop by Nov. 28 for participating small-business promotions and limited-stock gifts.
paras.zh: - 11 月 28 日，小型企业周六：在 11 月 28 日之前购买即可参加小型企业促销活动和限量礼品。

paras.en: - Nov. 30, Cyber Monday: Shop by Nov. 30 for the main online deals, which some retailers extend into December.
paras.zh: - 11 月 30 日，网络星期一：在 11 月 30 日之前购买主要在线优惠，一些零售商将优惠延长至 12 月。

paras.en: - Dec. 14, Green Monday: A day historically known for its last-minute shopping rush, shop on Dec. 14 for the main online sales and potential last-minute holiday discounts.
paras.zh: - 12 月 14 日，绿色星期一：这一天历来以最后一刻的购物高峰而闻名，12 月 14 日主要在线销售和潜在的最后一刻假日折扣。

paras.en: - Dec. 19, Super Saturday: As the last Saturday before Christmas Day, shop on Dec. 19 for last-minute deals and gifts.
paras.zh: - 12 月 19 日，超级星期六：作为圣诞节前的最后一个星期六，请在 12 月 19 日购买最后一刻的优惠和礼物。

paras.en: - Dec. 26, Boxing Day: Shop on Dec. 26 for post-Christmas clearance sales, which often continue into January.
paras.zh: - 12 月 26 日，节礼日：12 月 26 日购物可享受圣诞节后的清仓促销，通常会持续到 1 月。

paras.en: Sophie Dunne is an e-commerce writer at Penske Media Corporation, writing across Billboard, The Hollywood Reporter, Rolling Stone, WWD, and Footwear News. Originally from Ireland and based in Los Angeles, she previously worked at Static Media as a writer and editor, covering entertainment, lifestyle, fashion, and travel. Her bylines have appeared in Women’s Health, The List, Women.com, Islands, Grunge, WebMD, and more. Before beginning her writing career in 2019, Sophie lived in Dubai for four years working as an Emirates cabin crew member. Having traveled to 71 countries with the airline, she began writing for an LA-based publication as a travel writer during her final year. Sophie has a degree in Humanities from Carlow College, St. Patrick’s (now South East Technological University) in her native Ireland. She studied English, history, philosophy, and psychology. Sophie mostly reports on entertainment merchandise and celebrity brand partnerships.
paras.zh: Sophie Dunne 是 Penske Media Corporation 的电子商务撰稿人，为 Billboard、The Hollywood Reporter、Rolling Stone、WWD 和 Footwear News 撰稿。她来自爱尔兰，现居洛杉矶，此前曾在 Static Media 担任作家和编辑，内容涉及娱乐、生活方式、时尚和旅行。她的署名曾出现在《Women’s Health》、《The List》、《Women.com》、《Islands》、《Grunge》、《WebMD》等杂志上。在 2019 年开始写作生涯之前，索菲在迪拜生活了四年，担任阿联酋航空机组人员。她曾随该航空公司去过 71 个国家/地区，并在最后一年开始以旅行作家的身份为洛杉矶的一家出版物撰写文章。索菲拥有祖国爱尔兰圣帕特里克卡洛学院（现东南科技大学）的人文学位。她学习英语、历史、哲学和心理学。苏菲主要报道娱乐商品和名人品牌合作伙伴关系。

articles.title: Harry Styles Quietly Reveals He’s Releasing a New Music Video for a Fan-Favorite Song
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: There’s a new Harry Styles music video coming up on Monday (Oct. 26) — for a song many fans have been raving about since they first heard it.
paras.zh: 周一（10 月 26 日）将推出 Harry Styles 的新音乐视频，这首歌自许多歌迷第一次听到以来就一直为之着迷。

paras.en: Styles is releasing a “Coming Up Roses” video.
paras.zh: Styles 正在发布一段“Coming Up Roses”视频。

paras.en: The news comes straight from the star’s lips, live on stage at the famous Madison Square Garden, via an awfully casual and quiet announcement during night 27 of his 30-night concert residency Saturday night (Oct. 24).
paras.zh: 这个消息直接来自这位明星，他在周六晚上（10 月 24 日）为期 30 晚的驻场音乐会的第 27 晚，在著名的麦迪逊广场花园的舞台上现场直播，以极其随意和安静的方式宣布了这一消息。

paras.en: Fan footage captured the moment on video, though one might need to rewatch the clip with the volume turned up high to make sure they’ve heard what they think they heard.
paras.zh: 粉丝的镜头在视频中捕捉到了这一时刻，尽管人们可能需要重新观看该剪辑并将音量调高，以确保他们听到了他们认为听到的内容。

paras.en: “‘Coming Up Roses’ video on Monday,” Styles said nonchalantly while seated at his piano in New York City on Saturday. The under-his-breath comment made the rounds online post-show, and by Sunday, the Spotify Canvas video clip for “Roses” was updated with a short clip of two sets of feet looking hesitantly ready to dance.
paras.zh: “周一发布‘Coming Up Roses’视频，”周六，斯泰尔斯坐在纽约市的钢琴前，若无其事地说。这段低声评论在演出结束后在网上流传，到了周日，Spotify Canvas 上的《玫瑰》视频剪辑更新为一段短片，视频中两双脚看起来犹豫不决地准备跳舞。

paras.en: A “Coming Up Roses” video would be the fourth one to come from the Billboard 200 No. 1 album Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally, following Styles’ visuals for Hot 100 No. 1 “Aperture,” “American Girls” and “Dance No More.”
paras.zh: “Coming Up Roses”视频将是 Billboard 200 排名第一的专辑 Kiss All the Time 中的第四个视频。迪斯科，偶尔会效仿 Styles 为 Hot 100 No. 1 《Aperture》、《American Girls》和《Dance No More》制作的视觉效果。

paras.en: A beloved, poignant piano-with-strings-section ballad with regular placement on Styles’ tour setlist, “Coming Up Roses” was an immediate favorite for many fans upon first listen of Kiss All the Time in March.
paras.zh: 《Coming Up Roses》是一首受人喜爱、辛酸的钢琴弦乐民谣，经常出现在 Styles 的巡演曲目单上，在三月份第一次听到《Kiss All the Time》时，许多歌迷立即就爱上了《Coming Up Roses》。

paras.en: Styles’ historic run at MSG wraps on Halloween; nights 29 and 30, on Oct. 30-31, are dubbed the “Harryween” shows. Last weekend Billboard confirmed that there’s a documentary in the works on the experience, directed by John Wilson (How to With John Wilson, The History of Concrete) and produced by Universal Pictures Content Group, Peanut World Pictures and Styles.
paras.zh: 斯泰尔斯在 MSG 的历史性演出于万圣节结束； 10 月 30 日至 31 日的第 29 晚和第 30 晚被称为“Harryween”演出。上周末《公告牌》证实，一部关于这一经历的纪录片正在制作中，由约翰·威尔逊（《如何与约翰·威尔逊》、《混凝土的历史》）执导，由环球影业内容集团、花生世界影业和风格制作。

paras.en: Future Together, Together tour dates bring Styles to Melbourne, Australia, in November-December, and then back to the U.S. thanks to a tour extension into 2027, when Styles will take the show to Phoenix, Dallas, Los Angeles, Toronto, Atlanta and Chicago in the spring, and then over to Europe in the summer.
paras.zh: Future Together, Together 巡演日期将 Styles 于 11 月至 12 月前往澳大利亚墨尔本，然后由于巡演延期至 2027 年返回美国，届时 Styles 将于春季将演出带到凤凰城、达拉斯、洛杉矶、多伦多、亚特兰大和芝加哥，然后在夏季前往欧洲。

articles.title: Here’s Where to Watch FC Barcelona vs. Real Madrid Match Live Online
articles.author: Rudie Obias

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: One of the biggest and oldest rivalries in sports is FC Barcelona and Real Madrid. The two soccer teams (and fanbases) have been battling each other in various leagues and tournaments since 1902 with an equal share for both.
paras.zh: 体育界最大、最古老的竞争之一是巴塞罗那足球俱乐部和皇家马德里足球俱乐部。自 1902 年以来，两支足球队（以及球迷群体）一直在各种联赛和锦标赛中相互较量，双方的份额均等。

paras.en: Over the last 124 years, Barcelona and Real Madrid played 264 times with an even record of 106 wins each and 52 draws. With the 265th edition of “EL CLÁSICO,” whichever teams win the match on Sunday (Oct. 25) gets the slight edge over their rivals.
paras.zh: 过去124年里，巴萨和皇马交手264次，战绩各为106胜52平。第 265 届“EL CLÁSICO”比赛中，无论哪支球队在周日（10 月 25 日）赢得比赛，都将比对手稍占优势。

paras.en: How to Watch 2026 EL CLÁSICO Live Online, at a Glance:
paras.zh: 如何在线观看 2026 年 EL CLÁSICO 直播，概览：

paras.en: - Network: ABC in English, ESPN Deportes in Spanish
paras.zh: - 网络：英语 ABC，西班牙语 ESPN Deportes

paras.en: - Online Streaming: DirecTV, Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, Sling TV, ESPN Unlimited
paras.zh: - 在线流媒体：DirecTV、Fubo、Hulu + 直播电视、Sling TV、ESPN Unlimited

paras.en: When Does Barcelona vs. Real Madrid Start?
paras.zh: 巴塞罗那对阵皇家马德里什么时候开始？

paras.en: For LaLiga, EL CLÁSICO takes place on Sunday (Oct. 25) with Barcelona (9-0-0; 27 points) taking on Real Madrid (7-0; 21 points) at Spotify Camp Nou in Barcelona, Spain. Kickoff is at 4 p.m. ET/1 p.m. PT.
paras.zh: 西甲联赛将于周日（10 月 25 日）在西班牙巴塞罗那 Spotify 诺坎普球场举行，巴塞罗那队（9-0-0；27 分）迎战皇家马德里队（7-0；21 分）。开赛时间为下午 4 点。东部时间/下午 1 点PT。

paras.en: What TV Network Features Barcelona vs. Real Madrid?
paras.zh: 哪些电视网络会报道巴塞罗那对阵皇家马德里的比赛？

paras.en: The Barcelona-Real Madrid match broadcasts across two networks, ABC in English and ESPN Deportes in Spanish. Meanwhile, it’s available to livestream in both languages on ESPN Unlimited.
paras.zh: 巴塞罗那与皇家马德里的比赛通过两个网络转播：英语版 ABC 和西班牙语版 ESPN Deportes。同时，ESPN Unlimited 还提供两种语言的直播。

paras.en: Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances Barcelona vs. Real Madrid?
paras.zh: 哪些名人会出现在巴塞罗那对阵皇家马德里的比赛中？

paras.en: LaLiga is known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance at the match. Artists who have been known to appear at matches in the past include Barcelona fans Olivia Rodrigo, Shakira, Pau Gasol, Andrea Duro, Nicky Jam and others; Real Madrid fans include Enrique Iglesias, Penélope Cruz, Rafael Nadal and others.
paras.zh: 西甲联赛以名人出镜而闻名，因此很可能会有许多著名演员和唱片艺术家观看比赛。已知曾出现在比赛中的艺术家包括巴塞罗那球迷奥利维亚·罗德里戈、夏奇拉、保罗·加索尔、安德里亚·杜罗、尼基·贾姆等；皇马球迷包括恩里克·伊格莱西亚斯、佩内洛普·克鲁兹、拉斐尔·纳达尔等。

paras.en: Where to Watch Barcelona vs. Real Madrid Online for Free
paras.zh: 哪里可以免费在线观看巴塞罗那对阵皇家马德里的比赛

paras.en: For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch the Barcelona-Real Madrid match if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial, while other streaming services, such as Fubo and Hulu + Live TV, offer free trials, so you can watch the match for free.
paras.zh: 对于掐线者来说，如果您没有有线电视，有几种方法可以观看巴塞罗那与皇家马德里的比赛，特别是如果您想免费观看的话。 DirecTV 有五天的免费试用期，而 Fubo 和 Hulu + Live TV 等其他流媒体服务也提供免费试用，因此您可以免费观看比赛。

paras.en: Sling TV offers the Blue plan, which comes with ABC. With more than 40 channels, the streaming plan goes for $54.99 per month. For ESPN Deportes, you can add Sling Sports Extra to the plan for an extra $11 per month. All plans come with a free cloud DVR and an extra 600 or so free channels too. Please note: Pricing and channel availability vary from market-to-market.
paras.zh: Sling TV 提供 Blue 套餐，该套餐随 ABC 一起提供。流媒体套餐拥有 40 多个频道，每月价格为 54.99 美元。对于 ESPN Deportes，您可以将 Sling Sports Extra 添加到计划中，每月额外支付 11 美元。所有套餐都附带免费的云 DVR 和额外的 600 个左右的免费频道。请注意：定价和渠道可用性因市场而异。

paras.en: Broadcast network ABC is available to watch with Hulu + Live TV. Prices for the cable alternative start at $49.99 per month for the first month of service ($99.99 per month afterward) for more than 100 live channels, while each plan comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited, which features ESPN Deportes, at no additional cost. Hulu + Live TV might be best for those who want all of these streaming services together in one package.
paras.zh: 广播网络 ABC 可通过 Hulu + Live TV 观看。有线电视替代服务的价格从第一个月每月 49.99 美元起（之后每月 99.99 美元），提供超过 100 个直播频道，而每个套餐都附带 Hulu、Disney+ 和 ESPN Unlimited（其中包括 ESPN Deportes），无需额外付费。对于那些希望将所有这些流媒体服务集中在一个包中的人来说，Hulu + 直播电视可能是最好的选择。

paras.en: ESPN Unlimited is the official streaming platform for ESPN. A subscription includes instant access for $31.99 per month. However, you can save almost 17% off by purchasing an annual subscription for $319.99 per year. It features every ESPN network, including ESPN on ABC and ESPN Deportes, as well as ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, SEC Network, ACC Network, ESPN+, SEC Network+ and ACC Network Extra — all in one streaming service.
paras.zh: ESPN Unlimited 是 ESPN 的官方流媒体平台。订阅包括即时访问，每月费用为 31.99 美元。不过，如果您每年支付 319.99 美元购买年度订阅，则可以节省近 17% 的费用。它包含每个 ESPN 网络，包括 ESPN on ABC 和 ESPN Deportes，以及 ESPN、ESPN2、ESPNU、ESPNEWS、SEC Network、ACC Network、ESPN+、SEC Network+ 和 ACC Network Extra — 所有这些都在一个流媒体服务中。

paras.en: In addition to live sports, ESPN Unlimited has original programming to stream on demand. Although the service doesn’t offer a free trial, you can still watch ESPN Unlimited with a clever workaround to watch online for free. Learn more about how to get a free trial to access ESPN Unlimited here.
paras.zh: 除了体育赛事直播外，ESPN Unlimited 还提供原创节目供点播。尽管该服务不提供免费试用，但您仍然可以通过巧妙的解决方法免费在线观看 ESPN Unlimited。在此处了解有关如何免费试用 ESPN Unlimited 的更多信息。

paras.en: On Sunday (Oct. 25), EL CLÁSICO: FC Barcelona vs. Real Madrid broadcast across on ABC in English and ESPN Deportes in Spanish. One of the best ways to watch the match live is with DirecTV.
paras.zh: 周日（10 月 25 日），《EL CLÁSICO：巴塞罗那足球俱乐部对阵皇家马德里》在 ABC 上以英语播出，在 ESPN Deportes 上以西班牙语播出。观看比赛直播的最佳方式之一是使用 DirecTV。

articles.title: Duncan Crabtree-Ireland Upped to CEO of SAG-AFTRA as Guild Extends His Contract
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: SAG-AFTRA is giving its top executive a major vote of confidence.
paras.zh: SAG-AFTRA 向其最高执行官投了重大信任票。

paras.en: The Hollywood guild is giving its national executive director, Duncan Crabtree-Ireland, a contract extension and elevating him to CEO.
paras.zh: 好莱坞协会正在为其全国执行董事邓肯·克拉布特里-爱尔兰提供续约合同，并将其提升为首席执行官。

paras.en: The union says Crabtree-Ireland will serve as CEO through June 2032. His contract was previously set to expire in 2028. He will also continue on as its chief negotiator. His new deal was approved with more than 98 percent of the SAG-AFTRA national board’s support.
paras.zh: 工会表示，克拉布特里-爱尔兰将担任首席执行官至 2032 年 6 月。他的合同此前定于 2028 年到期。他还将继续担任首席谈判代表。他的新协议获得了 SAG-AFTRA 全国委员会 98% 以上的支持。

paras.en: Crabtree-Ireland joined SAG-AFTRA more than 25 years ago, and has been leading the union’s negotiations with the Hollywood studios as well as defending the rights of actors amid a rapidly-changing technology environment.
paras.zh: Crabtree-Ireland 于 25 年前加入 SAG-AFTRA，一直领导工会与好莱坞电影公司的谈判，并在快速变化的技术环境中捍卫演员的权利。

paras.en: “To battle giant global transnational corporations, we need expert leadership with a track record of successful bargaining and significant operational management expertise. That is Duncan,” SAG-AFTRA President Sean Astin said in a statement. “He is a powerful executive who has led our union at the bargaining table, in the halls of congress and in boardrooms and conference rooms across the industry and the world. We are thrilled to have guaranteed Duncan’s continued service to the members of SAG-AFTRA.”
paras.zh: “为了与全球大型跨国公司抗衡，我们需要拥有成功讨价还价记录和重要运营管理专业知识的专家领导。这就是邓肯，”SAG-AFTRA 总裁肖恩·奥斯汀在一份声明中表示。 “他是一位强有力的高管，在整个行业和世界各地的谈判桌上、国会大厅、董事会议室和会议室中领导着我们的工会。我们很高兴能够保证邓肯继续为 SAG-AFTRA 成员提供服务。”

paras.en: “Leading SAG-AFTRA’s staff is the honor of my career, and I’m grateful for the opportunity to keep doing this work,” added Crabtree-Ireland. “As we continue fighting for human creativity, the coming years will be crucial for charting the path forward. I intend to fight alongside our leadership to make sure our members control their image, likeness, voice, and destiny in the workplace, and that they are compensated fairly in the process. I thank President Astin, the national officers, and the National Board for their trust, and our extraordinary staff team for everything they make possible.”
paras.zh: “领导 SAG-AFTRA 的员工是我职业生涯的荣幸，我很感激有机会继续从事这项工作，”克拉布特里-爱尔兰补充道。 “当我们继续为人类创造力而奋斗时，未来几年对于规划前进的道路至关重要。我打算与我们的领导层一起努力，确保我们的成员在工作场所控制自己的形象、肖像、声音和命运，并确保他们在这个过程中得到公平的补偿。我感谢奥斯汀总统、国家官员和国家委员会的信任，感谢我们出色的工作人员团队所做的一切。”

articles.title: ‘Miami Vice ’85’: Man Arrested After Pulling Out Knife During Dispute on Brooklyn Set
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: A man was arrested Friday night after displaying a knife during a confrontation with a crew member on the Brooklyn set of Miami Vice ’85, starring Michael B. Jordan and Austin Butler.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，一名男子在由迈克尔·B·乔丹和奥斯汀·巴特勒主演的《85 年迈阿密风云》布鲁克林片场与一名剧组人员发生冲突时展示了一把刀，随后被捕。

paras.en: The individual, 23-year-old Alex Perez of Brooklyn, was arrested shortly after 11 p.m. in the vicinity of Avenue N and McDonald Avenue, near Washington Cemetery, according to the New York City Police Department. The Hollywood Reporter confirmed that the incident occurred on the Miami Vice ’85 film set.
paras.zh: 这名男子是来自布鲁克林的 23 岁亚历克斯·佩雷斯 (Alex Perez)，他于晚上 11 点刚过不久被捕。据纽约市警察局称，该地点位于 N 大道和麦克唐纳大道附近，靠近华盛顿公墓。 《好莱坞报道》证实，该事件发生在《迈阿密风云》85 年电影片场。

paras.en: A 42-year-old man reported that he had a verbal dispute with an individual who displayed a knife, an NYPD spokesperson told THR.
paras.zh: 纽约警察局发言人告诉《好莱坞报道》，一名 42 岁男子报告称，他与一名展示刀子的人发生了言语争执。

paras.en: Perez was taken into custody without further incident, and the knife was recovered, police said. No injuries were reported. Perez was charged with menacing and criminal possession of a weapon.
paras.zh: 警方称，佩雷斯被拘留，没有发生进一步事件，刀也被找到。没有人员受伤的报道。佩雷斯被指控犯有威胁罪和持有武器罪。

paras.en: In footage obtained by TMZ, Perez is seen being escorted away by a production staffer before pulling a large knife from his sweatshirt. According to TMZ, Perez also has five prior arrests involving alleged gang-related activities, assault with a firearm and burglary, among other offenses.
paras.zh: 在 TMZ 获得的视频中，可以看到佩雷斯被一名制作人员护送离开，然后从他的运动衫上拔出一把大刀。据 TMZ 报道，佩雷斯此前还曾五次被捕，涉及涉嫌帮派相关活动、持枪袭击和入室盗窃等罪行。

paras.en: Universal Pictures released the first-look images of Butler as Sonny Crockett and Jordan as Ricardo Tubbs earlier this month. The actors have since been spotted filming in New Jersey and New York City. Jordan was also seen filming in New York on Friday.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，环球影业发布了巴特勒饰演桑尼·克罗克特和乔丹饰演里卡多·塔布斯的首映照。此后，演员们被发现在新泽西州和纽约市拍摄。周五乔丹也被人看到在纽约拍摄。

paras.en: Miami Vice ’85 is a reimagining of the 1980s NBC crime drama, which starred Don Johnson as Crockett and Philip Michael Thomas as Tubbs. Directed by Joseph Kosinski (Top Gun: Maverick, F1), the film also stars Alden Ehrenreich, Whitney Peak, Camila Morrone, Danny Ramirez, John Leguizamo, Andrew Schulz and Walton Goggins, among others. It is scheduled to hit theaters May 19, 2028.
paras.zh: 《迈阿密风云 ’​​85》是对 1980 年代 NBC 犯罪剧的重新演绎，唐·约翰逊 (Don Johnson) 饰演克罗克特 (Crockett)，菲利普·迈克尔·托马斯 (Philip Michael Thomas) 饰演塔布斯 (Tubbs)。该片由约瑟夫·科辛斯基（《壮志凌云：特立独行》、《F1》）执导，阿尔登·埃伦瑞奇、惠特尼·皮克、卡米拉·莫罗、丹尼·拉米雷斯、约翰·雷吉扎莫、安德鲁·舒尔茨和沃尔顿·戈金斯等主演。该片预计于 2028 年 5 月 19 日上映。

articles.title: Mariana di Girólamo Takes a Ride on the “Wild” Side
articles.author: Lexy Perez

paras.en: A weird thing happened to Mariana di Girólamo while she was working on Wild Horse Nine. The Chilean actress, a native Spanish speaker who had never been on an American production before, started having vivid dreams — in English.
paras.zh: 玛丽安娜·迪·吉罗拉莫在拍摄《野马九号》时发生了一件奇怪的事情。这位智利女演员的母语是西班牙语，以前从未出演过美国作品，她开始做生动的梦——用英语。

paras.en: Di Girólamo labored over her preparation for the role, first perfecting her sides for her audition self-tape and, later, after landing the part, working through the script with both her acting coach and director Martin McDonagh to master the distinctive rhythm of his dialogue. For a native speaker of Chilean Spanish, English required some adjustment — especially the idiosyncratic English in McDonagh’s screenplay about two CIA agents dispatched to a remote Chilean island on the eve of the 1973 coup. “We had to go over every comma,” she jokes.
paras.zh: 迪·吉罗拉莫为这个角色做了大量的准备工作，首先是为了试镜时完善自己的侧面，后来在获得这个角色后，她与表演教练和导演马丁·麦克唐纳一起完成剧本，以掌握他对话的独特节奏。对于以智利西班牙语为母语的人来说，英语需要一些调整——尤其是麦克唐纳剧本中的特殊英语，该剧本讲述了 1973 年政变前夕两名中央情报局特工被派往智利一个偏远岛屿的故事。 “我们必须检查每一个逗号，”她开玩笑说。

paras.en: When she started dreaming in English, she knew something had clicked. “It’s always been a goal of mine to start doing American movies, and now there are things that are actually easier for me to say in English,” she says.
paras.zh: 当她开始用英语做梦时，她知道事情已经发生了。 “开始拍美国电影一直是我的目标，现在有些事情实际上对我来说用英语说起来更容易，”她说。

paras.en: Acting, di Girólamo says, is “in her blood.” Now 35 years old, she was raised among a deeply creative family in Santiago; her parents are artists, and her aunt, Claudia di Girólamo, is one of Chile’s most prominent actresses.
paras.zh: 迪·吉罗拉莫说，表演“融入了她的血液”。现年 35 岁的她在圣地亚哥一个富有创造力的家庭中长大。她的父母都是艺术家，她的姨妈克劳迪娅·迪·吉罗拉莫 (Claudia di Girólamo) 是智利最著名的女演员之一。

paras.en: She initially resisted entering the family business and enrolled in a midwifery program during university, but an elective course in theater changed her mind. “I found I loved everything,” she says, “from learning my lines and working on costumes to that feeling of standing in front of an audience and really feeling it in your heart and your stomach.”
paras.zh: 她最初拒绝进入家族企业，并在大学期间参加了助产士课程，但戏剧选修课改变了她的想法。 “我发现我喜欢一切，”她说，“从学习台词和制作服装，到站在观众面前并在心里和胃里真正感受到它的感觉。”

paras.en: She pivoted to drama school — the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, one of the country’s most prestigious — and then spent a few years doing theater and local television before scoring what she considers her big break, a role in Pablo Larraín’s Ema, in which she starred opposite Gael García Bernal as part of a couple whose adoption goes awry. The film eventually would help lead her to McDonagh. “I fell in love with cinema through this movie,” she says. “I also know that Martin watched it, and he talked with Pablo about me, so it’s something that has been very important for my career.”
paras.zh: 她转向戏剧学校——智利天主教大学，该国最负盛名的大学之一——然后花了几年时间在戏剧和地方电视台工作，然后在巴勃罗·拉雷恩的《埃玛》中出演了她认为自己的重大突破，在片中她与盖尔·加西亚·贝纳尔演对手戏，饰演一对收养失败的夫妇中的一员。这部电影最终帮助她找到了麦克唐纳。 “通过这部电影我爱上了电影，”她说。 “我也知道马丁看了它，他和巴勃罗谈论了我，所以这对我的职业生涯非常重要。”

paras.en: Years before he wrote Wild Horse Nine, McDonagh traveled to the remote Chilean island of Rapa Nui and was so taken by the landscape — more akin to Hawaii than mainland Chile — that he knew he wanted to set a movie there one day. Years later, he came up with a story about two CIA officers dispatched to the island shortly before the 1973 U.S.-backed coup. John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell came on board as the spies, and McDonagh, intent on making the film as authentic as possible, wanted a Chilean actress for the third lead: a leftist student who captures the attention of Malkovich’s character.
paras.zh: 在创作《野马九号》的几年前，麦克唐纳曾前往智利偏远的拉帕努伊岛，被这里的风景深深吸引——与其说是智利大陆，不如说更像是夏威夷——他知道有一天他想在那里拍摄一部电影。多年后，他讲述了 1973 年美国支持的政变前不久，两名中央情报局官员被派往该岛的故事。约翰·马尔科维奇和山姆·洛克威尔加入饰演间谍，麦克唐纳一心想让这部电影尽可能真实，所以想要一位智利女演员担任第三个主角：一位左翼学生，吸引了马尔科维奇这个角色的注意力。

paras.en: After getting cast, di Girólamo flew from South Africa — where she was filming the Mexican series Nadie Nos Vio Partir — to New York, where McDonagh had convened a week of table reads at The Public Theater. Rockwell arrived doing method-lite, donning ’70s garb and eating a lot — just like his onscreen persona — and di Girólamo met the “beautiful and crazy” Parker Posey, who plays Rockwell’s wife in the film. She says she was struck by how much Malkovich knew about Chilean culture and filmography. “And he always had the most beautiful outfits,” she says with a laugh. “He approved one of my jackets, and it had me feeling like, ‘Oh my God, this is important.’ ”
paras.zh: 获得选角后，迪·吉罗拉莫从南非（她在那里拍摄墨西哥连续剧《Nadie Nos Vio Partir》）飞往纽约，麦克唐纳在公共剧院举办了为期一周的读书会。洛克威尔来到这里时，穿着 70 年代的服装，吃得很多——就像他在银幕上的角色一样——迪吉罗拉莫遇到了“美丽而疯狂”的帕克·波西，她在影片中扮演洛克威尔的妻子。她说，马尔科维奇对智利文化和电影作品的了解之多令她震惊。 “他总是穿着最漂亮的衣服，”她笑着说。 “他认可了我的一件夹克，这让我感觉，‘天哪，这很重要。’”

paras.en: Wild Horse Nine won’t hit theaters until Nov. 6, but thanks to its time on the fall festival circuit — it premiered at Venice, Telluride and Toronto — it’s already an Oscar contender.
paras.zh: 《野马九号》要到 11 月 6 日才会上映，但由于它在秋季电影节巡回演出——在威尼斯、特柳赖德和多伦多首映——它已经成为奥斯卡的有力竞争者。

paras.en: “People would start applauding during the middle of the movie — it was really crazy,” di Girólamo says of its Venice debut. The offers have started coming in more and more as the movie approaches release, but she’s trying to be mindful about what she takes on next.
paras.zh: “人们会在电影中段开始鼓掌——这真的很疯狂，”迪吉罗拉莫谈到威尼斯首映时说道。随着电影临近上映，收到的邀请越来越多，但她正努力留意接下来要做什么。

paras.en: “I just keep reminding myself that I never even dreamt of working with someone like Martin,” she says. “This is such a beautiful surprise.”
paras.zh: “我只是不断提醒自己，我从来没有梦想过与像马丁这样的人一起工作，”她说。 “这真是一个美丽的惊喜。”

articles.title: In pictures: Initially peaceful protests across France over inequality again descend into violence

paras.en: Mostly peaceful protests across France over a worsening cost-of-living crisis and growing inequality descended into violence for a second straight weekend.
paras.zh: 法国各地因日益恶化的生活成本危机和日益严重的不平等而举行的基本上是和平的抗议活动连续第二个周末演变成暴力活动。

paras.en: France's Interior Ministry said 410,000 people took part in protests in several major cities, including Paris.
paras.zh: 法国内政部表示，包括巴黎在内的几个主要城市有41万人参加了抗议活动。

paras.en: After rioters set fire to the historic city hall in Limoges and looters smashed supermarkets and luxury boutiques in Lyon last weekend, French authorities greatly stepped up security ahead of Saturday's protests.
paras.zh: 上周末，骚乱者放火烧毁了利摩日历史悠久的市政厅，抢劫者捣毁了里昂的超市和奢侈品精品店，之后法国当局在周六的抗议活动之前大幅加强了安保措施。

paras.en: In Paris on Saturday, riot police fired tear gas and water cannon to disperse a group of around 500 hooded youths who hurled stones at officers, Reuters quoted a security official as saying.
paras.zh: 路透社援引一名安全官员的话说，周六在巴黎，防暴警察发射了催泪瓦斯和水枪，驱散了约 500 名蒙面青年向警察投掷石块的群体。

paras.en: In France's second city, Marseille, youths dragged large metal sheets to block a street, set fire to rubbish bins, and hurled rocks and bottles at riot police. The confrontations continued after sunset, and police said looters raided two jewelry shops, according to a Reuters report.
paras.zh: 在法国第二大城市马赛，年轻人拖着巨大的金属板封锁街道，放火焚烧垃圾箱，并向防暴警察投掷石块和瓶子。据路透社报道，冲突在日落后仍在继续，警方称抢劫者袭击了两家珠宝店。

paras.en: Clashes also flared in Lyon, Bordeaux and Grenoble, while police fired volleys of tear gas at demonstrators in Clermont-Ferrand, Lille, Nantes and Nice, according to the agency.
paras.zh: 据该机构称，里昂、波尔多和格勒诺布尔也爆发了冲突，而克莱蒙费朗、里尔、南特和尼斯的警察向示威者发射了催泪瓦斯。

paras.en: However, the violence was still less intense than a week ago, when looters and vandals went on the rampage in a number of French cities.
paras.zh: 然而，暴力事件仍不如一周前严重，当时抢劫者和破坏者在法国多个城市肆虐。

paras.en: The demonstrations began last month as a group of high school students in suburban Paris lamented poor school conditions, including teacher shortages and unsatisfactory facilities. The demonstrations have since grown and evolved into nationwide protests.
paras.zh: 示威活动于上个月开始，巴黎郊区的一群高中生对学校条件恶劣（包括教师短缺和设施不理想）表示遗憾。此后，示威活动不断发展并演变为全国性的抗议活动。

paras.en: France's economic and political woes have sharply raised the cost of government borrowing. The yield on its 10-year bond rose above 5% for the first time since 2002 this week, settling around 5.03% on Friday.
paras.zh: 法国的经济和政治困境大幅提高了政府借贷成本。本周10年期债券收益率自2002年以来首次升至5%以上，周五稳定在5.03%左右。

paras.en: Some investors fear the country's debt problems could spread to the rest of the euro zone.
paras.zh: 一些投资者担心该国的债务问题可能会蔓延到欧元区其他国家。

articles.title: Venezuela's opposition leader Machado returns after months in exile, as doubts over democracy deepen

paras.en: Opposition leader and Nobel laureate María Corina Machado reappeared in Venezuela Sunday for the first time since December, about a month before the U.S. military deposed the country's then-President Nicolás Maduro.
paras.zh: 周日，反对派领袖、诺贝尔奖获得者玛丽亚·科里娜·马查多再次出现在委内瑞拉，这是去年 12 月以来的首次，大约一个月后，美国军方废黜了该国时任总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗。

paras.en: Machado announced her arrival on social media, writing, "I am here. With you."
paras.zh: 马查多在社交媒体上宣布了她的到来，并写道：“我在这里。和你在一起。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Venezuela's opposition leader Edmundo Gonzalez wrote on X, confirming Machado's arrival and saying he would be next to her "very soon."
paras.zh: 与此同时，委内瑞拉反对派领导人埃德蒙多·冈萨雷斯（Edmundo Gonzalez）在X上发文，确认马查多的到来，并表示他“很快”就会来到她身边。

paras.en: "Today is a very important day for Venezuelans. Our sovereign voice returns with her to lead and guide this process!" he wrote. "You know it, this is until the end."
paras.zh: “今天对委内瑞拉人来说是非常重要的一天。我们主权的声音与她一起回归，领导和指导这一进程！”他写道。 “你知道的，这件事到最后为止。”

paras.en: Machado's homecoming, after more than 10 months in exile, comes as doubts about Venezuela's democratic future — and the U.S.'s role in it — deepen.
paras.zh: 马查多在流亡十多个月后回国之际，人们对委内瑞拉的民主未来以及美国在其中所扮演的角色的疑虑加深。

paras.en: Since Maduro's ouster, acting President Delcy Rodríguez, a longtime Maduro ally who received the Trump administration's blessing to succeed him, has run Venezuela.
paras.zh: 自马杜罗下台以来，代总统德尔西·罗德里格斯（Delcy Rodríguez）执掌委内瑞拉。他是马杜罗的长期盟友，得到了特朗普政府的支持接替他。

paras.en: Rodríguez has exceeded the time she was authorized to serve as acting president following Maduro's capture and no election is scheduled.
paras.zh: 马杜罗被捕后，罗德里格斯已经超过了她被授权担任代理总统的时间，并且没有安排选举。

paras.en: Machado went into hiding in Venezuela for 11 months after being briefly detained following a protest in January 2025. After a clandestine escape, she reappeared in Norway that December, where she was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her peaceful challenge to Maduro's authoritarian government.
paras.zh: 马查多在 2025 年 1 月的一次抗议活动后被短暂拘留后，在委内瑞拉躲藏了 11 个月。秘密越狱后，她于当年 12 月重新出现在挪威，并因和平挑战马杜罗独裁政府而被授予诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: Machado and her allies have been demanding a date for a presidential election in Venezuela, but U.S. officials have emphasized economic stabilization first.
paras.zh: 马查多和她的盟友一直要求委内瑞拉确定总统选举的日期，但美国官员首先强调经济稳定。

articles.title: Audi defends plans for a $4 billion Georgia plant amid VW restructuring, tariffs

paras.en: DETROIT — Audi's CEO defended the carmaker's plans for a new $4 billion plant in Georgia on Sunday, calling it a business decision aimed at growing sales and reducing exposure to U.S. tariffs.
paras.zh: 底特律——周日，奥迪首席执行官为该汽车制造商在佐治亚州投资 40 亿美元新建工厂的计划进行了辩护，称这是一项旨在增加销量并减少美国关税影响的商业决策。

paras.en: The plant, set to be Audi's first in the U.S., was announced Saturday by President Donald Trump during a rally in Georgia, near where the Volkswagen-owned luxury brand plans to build the new SUV-producing facility.
paras.zh: 该工厂将是奥迪在美国的第一家工厂，周六，唐纳德·特朗普总统在佐治亚州的一次集会上宣布了这一消息，大众汽车旗下的豪华品牌计划在该工厂附近建造新的 SUV 生产工厂。

paras.en: "We have significantly greater ambitions for Audi in America," Audi CEO Gernot Dollner said during a media roundtable Sunday. "The United States is the second largest premium market in the world, and today we are not fully exploiting this potential. We are changing that."
paras.zh: 奥迪首席执行官格诺特·多尔纳(Gernot Dollner)在周日的媒体圆桌会议上表示：“我们对奥迪在美国的抱负远大得多。” “美国是世界第二大高端市场，今天我们还没有充分利用这一潜力。我们正在改变这一现状。”

paras.en: The announcement comes amid an intense restructuring of its VW parent company, including plans to cut 50,000 jobs and close four German plants, including an Audi facility, between 2031 and 2034.
paras.zh: 这一消息发布之际，大众母公司正在进行大规模重组，包括计划在 2031 年至 2034 年间裁员 5 万人并关闭包括奥迪工厂在内的四家德国工厂。

paras.en: Dollner, who joined Trump at the rally, said the decision for a plant in the U.S. was years in the making, with more than 70 locations evaluated over "many months" and "intense" negotiations with public officials.
paras.zh: 与特朗普一起参加集会的多尔纳表示，在美国建厂的决定是经过多年的酝酿，经过“数月”以及与公职人员的“激烈”谈判，对 70 多个地点进行了评估。

paras.en: "This is not a decision against Germany. Germany remains the backbone of Audi," Dollner said. "We develop our cars here. Our technologies are created here, and Georgia does not take any task away from us in Germany."
paras.zh: “这不是针对德国的决定。德国仍然是奥迪的支柱，”多尔纳说。 “我们在这里开发我们的汽车。我们的技术在这里创造，格鲁吉亚并没有夺走我们德国的任何任务。”

paras.en: Dollner said localized production is the best decision for the brand, which has struggled in sales this decade amid rising operational costs and Trump's tariffs on vehicles from Germany and other countries into the U.S. Current tariffs on vehicles from Germany are 15%, down from 25%.
paras.zh: 多尔纳表示，本地化生产对该品牌来说是最好的决定。由于运营成本上升以及特朗普对来自德国和其他国家进入美国的汽车征收关税，该品牌近十年来的销售陷入困境。目前对德国汽车的关税为15%，低于25%。

paras.en: Last year, U.S. tariffs cost Audi 1.2 billion euros ($1.4 billion), as it imports all its vehicles for the U.S. market from Europe or Mexico.
paras.zh: 去年，奥迪因美国关税而损失了 12 亿欧元（14 亿美元），因为该公司为美国市场生产的所有车辆均从欧洲或墨西哥进口。

paras.en: Dollner said the Trump administration asked Audi to announce the new plant at the Georgia rally promoting Republicans ahead of Nov. 3 midterm elections.
paras.zh: 多尔纳表示，特朗普政府要求奥迪在 11 月 3 日中期选举之前推动共和党的佐治亚州集会上宣布新工厂的消息。

paras.en: "It was … a three-year project that, at the end, by coincidence, led to that moment yesterday," he said Sunday. "With respect of the office and country, we joined the invitation."
paras.zh: “这是……一个为期三年的项目，最终，巧合的是，导致了昨天的那一刻，”他周日说道。 “出于对办公室和国家的尊重，我们加入了邀请。”

paras.en: Dollner noted Audi is the last major German luxury brand to establish U.S. production after Mercedes-Benz and BMW.
paras.zh: 多尔纳指出，奥迪是继梅赛德斯-奔驰和宝马之后最后一个在美国生产的德国主要豪华品牌。

paras.en: The company said the Georgia plant is expected to begin production of Audi's Q7, Q8 and Q9 in the early 2030s. The plant would have the capacity to produce up to 200,000 vehicles annually, roughly half of which the automaker said will be exported outside the U.S.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，佐治亚工厂预计将于 2030 年代初期开始生产奥迪 Q7、Q8 和 Q9。该工厂每年可生产多达 20 万辆汽车，该汽车制造商表示，其中大约一半将出口到美国以外的地区。

paras.en: "This is to make Audi obviously a significant player here in the U.S. market," said Audi of America President Vito Paladino during the roundtable. He also said additional details on U.S. investments and production are forthcoming.
paras.zh: 奥迪美国总裁维托·帕拉迪诺在圆桌会议上表示：“这将使奥迪明显成为美国市场的重要参与者。”他还表示，有关美国投资和生产的更多细节即将公布。

paras.en: Audi's U.S. deliveries were roughly flat through the third quarter of this year, following a 16% decline from 2024 to 2025.
paras.zh: 奥迪在美国的交付量自 2024 年至 2025 年下降 16% 后，今年第三季度基本持平。

articles.title: Japan’s MMX mission will reveal the origins of weird Martian moons

paras.en: Roaring away on top of a tongue of flame, the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency’s (JAXA’s) ambitious Martian Moons Exploration (MMX) spacecraft launched on its way to Mars on October 19. Its mission: to study the Martian moons Phobos and Deimos, setting down on the surface of the former (along with a small rover) and even returning a 10-gram sample of Phobian material to Earth for later study.
paras.zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构 (JAXA) 雄心勃勃的火星卫星探索 (MMX) 航天器在火焰之上呼啸而过，于 10 月 19 日发射升空，前往火星。它的任务是：研究火星卫星火卫一和火卫二，降落在火卫一的表面（连同一个小型漫游车），甚至将 10 克的火卫一物质样本返回地球供以后研究。

paras.en: The two tiny moons—Phobos is a lumpy space potato that is about 26 kilometers in length, and Deimos is an oddly shaped rock that is about 16 km long—were discovered in 1877 but still hold many mysteries tight. Despite close-up images taken of both by various Mars missions over the decades, there is much we still don’t understand about them, even basics such as how they formed. In fact, this is such a big question that answering it is actually MMX’s primary goal.
paras.zh: 这两颗小卫星——火卫一是一块长约 26 公里的块状太空马铃薯，火卫二是一块形状奇特的岩石，长约 16 公里——于 1877 年被发现，但仍然有许多未解之谜。尽管几十年来各种火星任务拍摄了它们的特写图像，但我们仍然对它们有很多不了解，甚至包括它们如何形成等基础知识。事实上，这是一个很大的问题，回答这个问题实际上是 MMX 的首要目标。

paras.en: I’m excited about this mission! MMX will take a year to voyage to the Red Planet and, once there, will slip into an orbit around Mars that will keep it close to Phobos. It will map Phobos’s surface to measure the moon’s shape and scout for potential landing sites (and will also occasionally observe Deimos from a distance). Once engineers back on Earth choose an appropriate spot on Phobos, MMX will deploy a rover to roam the surface, and soon thereafter, the mission’s main spacecraft will touch down. It will collect a small sample of the surface regolith—the powdery material made from rocks pulverized by meteorite impacts and thermal weathering—and eventually blast off into space once again. The plan is to then fly by Deimos for some close-up observations and to subsequently head back to Earth to return the surface sample in 2031.
paras.zh: 我对这个任务感到很兴奋！ MMX 将花费一年时间航行到这颗红色星球，到达那里后，将滑入围绕火星的轨道，使其靠近火卫一。它将绘制火卫一的表面地图，以测量月球的形状并寻找潜在的着陆点（偶尔也会从远处观察火卫二）。一旦工程师返回地球，在火卫一上选择了合适的地点，MMX 将部署一个漫游车在地表漫游，不久之后，任务的主航天器将着陆。它将收集一小部分表面风化层样本（由陨石撞击和热风化粉碎的岩石制成的粉末状物质），并最终再次飞入太空。计划随后飞越火卫二进行近距离观察，并于 2031 年返回地球返回表面样本。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The rover’s design is pretty clever. It’s a joint effort by France’s National Center for Space Studies (CNES) and the German Aerospace Center (DLR). Called Idefix (after the dog in the French Asterix comic), it has a mass of about 24 kilograms. It’s not much bigger than a large shoebox, although, once the solar panels extend, it will span just more than a meter across.
paras.zh: 火星车的设计非常巧妙。这是法国国家空间研究中心 (CNES) 和德国航空航天中心 (DLR) 的共同努力。它被称为 Idefix（以法国 Asterix 漫画中的狗命名），质量约为 24 公斤。它并不比一个大鞋盒大多少，不过，一旦太阳能电池板延伸，它的跨度将只有一米多。

paras.en: The deployment is pretty gutsy—if successful, it will make Phobos the smallest body ever visited by a wheeled rover. It starts with MMX slowing to a stop about 40 to 100 meters above Phobos and then releasing Idefix. From there, the moon’s weak gravity (only about a thousandth as strong as Earth’s) will pull the rover slowly down; the descent could last several minutes even from such a low height. The impact will be gentle, probably less than one meter per second, roughly human walking speed.
paras.zh: 这次部署相当大胆——如果成功，火卫一将成为轮式漫游车访问过的最小天体。首先，MMX 减速至火卫一上方约 40 至 100 米处停止，然后释放 Idefix。从那里，月球的微弱引力（只有地球引力的千分之一左右）会将火星车缓慢地拉下来；即使从如此低的高度下降也可能持续几分钟。影响将是温和的，可能不到每秒一米，大约是人类行走的速度。

paras.en: After that, the locomotion system is designed to flip the rover upright no matter how it lands, putting the wheels down so it can move. Even that is tricky; Idefix will weigh only about 15 grams, or roughly half an ounce, on Phobos! A house sparrow on Earth weighs twice as much. Idefix is designed to measure the moon’s surface temperature and mineralogy, but it will also snap pictures of its wheel tracks on Phobos to better understand the cohesion strength and size of the regolith grains.
paras.zh: 之后，移动系统的设计目的是，无论漫游车如何着陆，它都会将其翻转直立，将轮子放下，以便它可以移动。即使这样也很棘手；在火卫一上，Idefix 的重量仅为约 15 克，即约半盎司！地球上的麻雀的重量是地球上的两倍。 Idefix 旨在测量月球表面温度和矿物学，但它也会拍摄火卫一上的轮轨照片，以更好地了解风化层颗粒的内聚强度和大小。

paras.en: So why is there interest in the Martian moons? Mostly it’s because their origin story is so baffling.
paras.zh: 那么为什么人们对火星卫星感兴趣呢？主要是因为他们的起源故事太令人费解了。

paras.en: Mars sits on the inner edge of the main asteroid belt, so some scientists have proposed that these wee moons are captured asteroids. One point in this idea’s favor is that the compositions of both moons resemble those of common asteroids.
paras.zh: 火星位于主小行星带的内边缘，因此一些科学家提出这些小卫星是捕获的小行星。支持这一观点的一点是，两颗卫星的成分与常见小行星的成分相似。

paras.en: It’s difficult, however, for a planet to grab a passing rock and keep it; orbital mechanics dictate that an asteroid must shed a lot of velocity in order for Mars to ensnare it. Such an object would have to be on a fantastically lucky trajectory to, say, dip down and drag through the upper Martian atmosphere to slow to just the right speed for capture.
paras.zh: 然而，对于行星来说，抓住并保留经过的岩石是很困难的。轨道力学规定，小行星必须失去很大的速度才能被火星捕获。这样的物体必须处于极其幸运的轨道上，比如说，向下倾斜并拖过火星上层大气层，减速到适合捕获的速度。

paras.en: It’s far easier, though, if the incoming asteroid is binary: two rocks in orbit around each other. In that case, one of the pair falls into orbit while the other is ejected from the system and carries away the excess energy. That means there must have been two separate events to snag both moons; their orbits are very different, with Phobos a mere 6,000 km above the Martian surface and Deimos a little more than 20,000 km up, so they were unlikely to have been captured together.
paras.zh: 不过，如果传入的小行星是双星的：两块岩石在轨道上相互围绕，那就容易得多。在这种情况下，一对中的一个落入轨道，而另一个则从系统中弹出并带走多余的能量。这意味着必须有两个独立的事件才能捕获这两个卫星；它们的轨道非常不同，火卫一距离火星表面仅 6,000 公里，而火卫二距离火星表面略高于 20,000 公里，因此它们不太可能被一起捕获。

paras.en: Also, both moons have circular orbits directly over Mars’s equator, whereas captured asteroids would be expected to fall along more elongated trajectories around the planet. Such highly elliptical orbits could have been circularized via atmospheric drag and tidal forces from Mars acting on the moons. But this process takes so long (billions of years) that it’s not clear that enough time would have elapsed for Deimos to have settled onto its current path that way.
paras.zh: 此外，两颗卫星都有直接越过火星赤道的圆形轨道，而捕获的小行星预计会沿着更细长的轨道落在火星周围。这种高度椭圆的轨道可能是通过火星作用在卫星上的大气阻力和潮汐力而变成圆形的。但这个过程需要很长时间（数十亿年），以至于尚不清楚火卫二是否需要足够的时间才能以这种方式走上目前的道路。

paras.en: Another possibility is that a large asteroid impact on Mars could have thrown material into space that then coalesced as the moons. This mechanism has precedent; our own moon came to be that way when a small planet (about the size of Mars, ironically enough) slammed into Earth not long after the formation of our world,: the impact ejected huge amounts of rock that rapidly condensed to form our faithful companion.
paras.zh: 另一种可能性是，小行星对火星的巨大撞击可能会将物质抛入太空，然后合并成卫星。该机制已有先例；当我们的世界形成后不久，一颗小行星（讽刺的是，大约与火星大小相当）撞击地球时，我们的月球就变成了这样：撞击喷射出大量岩石，这些岩石迅速凝结成我们忠实的伴侣。

paras.en: Indeed, there are hints that, in some ways, the Martian moons’ compositions resemble that of the Red Planet. But if they formed from the same event, why are they in such different orbits? Perhaps many such objects were formed from the event, and the current moons are the only survivors. A more recent hypothesis is that one moon formed (either together with Mars or from a later impact) but was itself blown apart by an impact to create the extant pair; this idea can explain the circular equatorial orbits, as well as the current differences in their orbital heights.
paras.zh: 事实上，有迹象表明，在某些方面，火星卫星的成分与红色星球的成分相似。但如果它们是由同一事件形成的，为什么它们的轨道如此不同呢？也许许多这样的物体是由这次事件形成的，而当前的卫星是唯一的幸存者。最近的一个假设是，一颗卫星形成了（与火星一起形成或由后来的撞击形成），但它本身被撞击炸碎，形成了现存的一对卫星。这个想法可以解释圆形赤道轨道，以及它们当前轨道高度的差异。

paras.en: Phobos is lower-density than expected for a solid rock, so it’s likely to be at least partially a rubble pile, composed of countless smaller rocks held together by their mutual gravity. Many, if not most, smaller asteroids are rubble piles, and we’re still not completely sure how this happens. It almost certainly results from impacts, with the leading candidate being a smashup energetic enough to shatter the asteroid but not quite sufficient to dissipate it. Afterward, the broken pieces fall back together via gravity. If this is true for Phobos, MMX will tell scientists a lot about how it’s changed over time.
paras.zh: 火卫一的密度比固体岩石的预期要低，因此它可能至少部分是碎石堆，由无数较小的岩石通过相互重力结合在一起组成。许多（如果不是大多数）较小的小行星都是碎石堆，我们仍然不完全确定这是如何发生的。它几乎肯定是由撞击造成的，主要候选者是一颗粉碎性的小行星，其能量足以粉碎小行星，但不足以消散它。之后，破碎的碎片通过重力重新聚集在一起。如果火卫一确实如此，MMX 将告诉科学家很多关于它如何随时间变化的信息。

paras.en: There have been previous attempts to send dedicated spacecraft to Phobos (such as the former Soviet Union’s Phobos 1 and 2 missions and the Russian-Chinese mission Phobos-Grunt), but they all failed in different ways to get there. In fact, many missions to Mars have failed, prompting the dark joke in the space community that a monster on Mars called the Great Galactic Ghoul was eating them. Mind you, Phobos and Deimos are named after the minor gods of fear and terror, both sons of Ares!
paras.zh: 此前曾有过向火卫一发送专用航天器的尝试（例如前苏联的火卫一号和火卫二号任务以及俄罗斯和中国的火卫一号任务），但都以不同的方式未能到达那里。事实上，许多火星任务都失败了，这在太空界引发了一个黑色笑话：火星上有一个叫做“银河食尸鬼”的怪物正在吃掉他们。请注意，火卫一和火卫二是以恐惧和恐惧的小神命名的，他们都是阿瑞斯的儿子！

paras.en: I hope MMX has more luck. It’s well past time humanity was successful in sending a dedicated probe to these weird little Martian moons. The images and data will be wonderful, and hopefully many mysteries will be unraveled—as inevitably more will pop up. That’s science, and that’s why we explore. There are always more fun things to discover.
paras.zh: 希望MMX能有更多的运气。人类早就成功地向这些奇怪的小火星卫星发射了专用探测器。图像和数据将是精彩的，希望许多谜团能够被解开——因为不可避免地会有更多的谜团出现。这就是科学，这就是我们探索的原因。总是有更多有趣的事情有待发现。

articles.title: How exposing yourself to your fears can tame your anxiety

paras.en: The first time Kevin MacKenzie scrambled up a slide, a steep stretch of rock exposed by weather and geological forces, in the Adirondack Mountains, he swore he’d never do it again.
paras.zh: 凯文·麦肯齐 (Kevin MacKenzie) 第一次在阿迪朗达克山脉 (Adirondack Mountains) 攀爬滑梯时，他发誓再也不会这么做了。滑梯是一片因天气和地质作用而暴露在外的陡峭岩石。

paras.en: But the 56-year-old did do it again—and again and again. After multiple climbs, he became more comfortable, and today he even helps rescue other climbers who find themselves stranded midway up a rock face.
paras.zh: 但这位 56 岁的老人确实一次又一次地这么做了。经过多次攀登后，他变得更加自在，今天他甚至帮助营救其他发现自己被困在岩壁中途的登山者。

paras.en: What MacKenzie has achieved is similar to a clinical technique called exposure therapy, a research-backed approach to taming a multitude of anxieties by exposing a person to their fears in a controlled way. “My fear never disappears,” MacKenzie says, “but repeated exposure has taught me I will have similar outcomes every time.”
paras.zh: 麦肯齐所取得的成就类似于一种称为暴露疗法的临床技术，这是一种由研究支持的方法，通过以受控的方式让一个人暴露在恐惧之中来抑制多种焦虑。 “我的恐惧永远不会消失，”麦肯齐说，“但反复的接触告诉我，每次都会有类似的结果。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: A DIY approach to exposure can work in some circumstances, says Jordan Conrad, a psychotherapist and director of Lexington Park Psychotherapy in New York City. “If you are clear about your fears and approach it seriously and carefully, you can try it on your own,” he says. “But sometimes a clinician is necessary to understand what’s at the bottom of an anxiety.”
paras.zh: 纽约市列克星敦公园心理治疗中心的心理治疗师兼主任乔丹·康拉德 (Jordan Conrad) 表示，在某些情况下，DIY 的暴露方法可能会奏效。 “如果你清楚自己的恐惧，并认真、仔细地对待它，你可以自己尝试一下，”他说。 “但有时需要临床医生来了解焦虑的根源。”

paras.en: For example, a person could have extreme anxiety about dating and might decide to expose their fears with a constant roster of romantic rendezvous. “But underneath that may be fear of abandonment,” Conrad says, “so that’s a wrong use” of exposure therapy.
paras.zh: 例如，一个人可能对约会极度焦虑，并可能决定通过不断的浪漫约会来暴露自己的恐惧。 “但其背后可能是对被遗弃的恐惧，”康拉德说，“所以这是暴露疗法的错误使用”。

paras.en: Working with a trained therapist can help people to both drill down to the cause of their anxiety or fear and develop mechanisms for calming themselves down.
paras.zh: 与训练有素的治疗师合作可以帮助人们深入了解焦虑或恐惧的原因，并建立让自己平静下来的机制。

paras.en: “We know that what exacerbates anxiety is avoidance,” explains Alissa Jerud, a licensed clinical psychologist and clinical assistant professor at the University of Pennsylvania. “Exposure therapy helps develop new, healthier relationships with your anxieties by breaking the avoidance habit.”
paras.zh: “我们知道，回避会加剧焦虑，”宾夕法尼亚大学临床心理学家兼临床助理教授艾丽莎·杰鲁德 (Alissa Jerud) 解释道。 “暴露疗法可以打破回避习惯，帮助你与焦虑建立新的、更健康的关系。”

paras.en: Traditional models of exposure therapy involve the use of habituation—through repeated exposure—to quell anxiety. Modern exposure therapy takes habituation and adds inhibitory learning, which helps patients rewrite their memory or beliefs about their objects of fear. Rather than completely deleting their fears, patients learn to tamp them down. For instance, if a person has a snake phobia, therapy can teach them that with very rare exceptions, they will likely never encounter a dangerous snake.
paras.zh: 传统的暴露疗法模型涉及通过反复暴露来形成习惯来平息焦虑。现代暴露疗法需要习惯并增加抑制性学习，这有助于患者重写他们对恐惧对象的记忆或信念。患者并没有完全消除恐惧，而是学会压制恐惧。例如，如果一个人有蛇恐惧症，治疗可以告诉他们，除了极少数例外，他们可能永远不会遇到危险的蛇。

paras.en: “If you’re struggling with thoughts that are overwhelming, or if you’ve tried small exposures and your anxiety flares up, you may want to seek therapy,” Jerud says.
paras.zh: 杰鲁德说：“如果你正在与难以承受的想法作斗争，或者如果你尝试过少量的接触，但你的焦虑加剧，你可能需要寻求治疗。”

paras.en: Small, progressive exposures to the people, places, activities or memories that cause anxiety, conducted in a safe, controlled environment, can offer strategies to taming these aversions. In the clinic, a licensed therapist might guide a veteran with post-traumatic stress disorder through imagined exposure or someone afraid of spiders through real exposure—by gradually bringing them physically closer to the arachnids, for example—until they learn they are safe.
paras.zh: 在安全、受控的环境中进行小规模、渐进的接触引起焦虑的人、地方、活动或记忆，可以提供抑制这些厌恶的策略。在诊所里，有执照的治疗师可能会通过想象的暴露来指导患有创伤后应激障碍的退伍军人，或者通过真实的接触来引导害怕蜘蛛的人——例如，逐渐让他们在身体上更接近蜘蛛——直到他们知道自己是安全的。

paras.en: Therapist-led exposure therapy typically requires 15 to 20 sessions, according to Jerud, but every case is different. Patients need to do the “homework” that their therapist prescribes between sessions. “It’s like learning a new language,” Jerud says. “You need to practice outside of your appointments.”
paras.zh: Jerud 表示，治疗师主导的暴露疗法通常需要 15 到 20 次疗程，但每个案例都不同。患者需要在治疗期间完成治疗师规定的“作业”。 “这就像学习一门新语言，”杰鲁德说。 “你需要在预约之外练习。”

paras.en: A single exposure is unlikely to be enough—and as with learning a language, Conrad and Jerud recommend that individuals have “booster sessions” if anxiety flares up.
paras.zh: 一次接触不太可能足够——就像学习语言一样，康拉德和杰鲁德建议，如果焦虑发作，个人可以进行“加强课程”。

paras.en: As MacKenzie has learned on his own, exposure doesn’t eliminate your fear. But it does allow you to skillfully manage it. “Enough time on slides has served as positive reinforcement that I will be okay,” MacKenzie says.
paras.zh: 正如麦肯齐自己所了解到的那样，暴露并不能消除你的恐惧。但它确实可以让你熟练地管理它。 “足够的时间在幻灯片上已经起到了积极的作用，我会没事的，”麦肯齐说。

articles.title: Why partisan politics may be changing people's accents

paras.en: With the midterms fast approaching, communicating just the right message has been top of mind on all sides of the political aisle.
paras.zh: 随着中期选举的临近，传达正确的信息已成为政治各方的首要任务。

paras.en: Whether that message drives home a lack of affordability as gas, food and home prices surge or stokes fears about the rise of communism in the American heartland, Democrats and Republicans are spending a lot of time thinking about what to say.
paras.zh: 无论这一信息是导致汽油、食品和房价飙升导致人们负担能力不足，还是引发人们对美国腹地共产主义崛起的担忧，民主党人和共和党人都花了很多时间思考该说些什么。

paras.en: But as a linguist who studies the impact of accents on the way people are perceived, I believe how politicians and voters say what they say might be just as important as the words they use in understanding the social consequences and linguistic changes resulting from the political divides that are growing between us.
paras.zh: 但作为一名研究口音对人们认知方式影响的语言学家，我相信政治家和选民如何表达他们所说的话可能与他们使用的词语一样重要，以理解我们之间日益增长的政治分歧所造成的社会后果和语言变化。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: If there is one regional American accent that has long endured on the lips of its speakers—as well as in the minds of listeners beyond the region—it’s the Southern accent. From North Carolina through Texas and pretty much all states in between, the so-called Southern drawl has long been emblematic of a distinct culture found in the South.
paras.zh: 如果有一种美国地方口音长期存在于说话者的嘴里以及该地区以外的听众的心中，那就是南方口音。从北卡罗来纳州到德克萨斯州以及其间的几乎所有州，所谓的南方慢音长期以来一直是南方独特文化的象征。

paras.en: Yet, in the urban South, recent linguistic research finds that the drawl’s most salient features are starting to fade on the lips of young speakers. Fewer “pins” are merged with “pens,” and pronunciations such as “far” for “fire” or “say-ud” for “said” are becoming rarer.
paras.zh: 然而，在南方城市，最近的语言研究发现，拖慢语最显着的特征开始在年轻说话者的嘴唇上消失。与“pen”合并的“pin”越来越少，“fire”的“far”或“said”的“say-ud”等发音也变得越来越少。

paras.en: While linguists have been busy trying to understand this trend, political scientists have been measuring how different accents perform on the campaign trail. The verdict? Southern accented candidates are generally heard as more conservative than those without a Southern accent, particularly to Democratic listeners.
paras.zh: 当语言学家一直忙于理解这一趋势时，政治学家一直在衡量不同口音在竞选过程中的表现。判决结果？带有南方口音的候选人通常被认为比那些没有南方口音的候选人更加保守，尤其是对于民主党听众来说。

paras.en: Putting these findings from linguists and political scientists together, alongside a spate of studies examining correlations between voting patterns and vowels, hints, I believe, that the increasing conservative-liberal divide in American politics just might be the key to understanding what’s driving the decline of the drawl in the urban South.
paras.zh: 我认为，将语言学家和政治学家的这些发现放在一起，再加上大量研究投票模式和元音之间相关性的研究，暗示美国政治中日益扩大的保守派与自由派分歧可能是理解是什么推动了南方城市慢吞吞语的减少的关键。

paras.en: The traditional Southern accent has no shortage of stereotypes: From positive, friendly, country and down-home vibes to negative, backward, uneducated and lazy tropes, the accents of William Faulkner, Bill Clinton and the hillbilly Clampetts have weathered it all.
paras.zh: 传统的南方口音不乏刻板印象：从积极、友好、乡村和乡土气息到消极、落后、未受过教育和懒惰的比喻，威廉·福克纳、比尔·克林顿和乡巴佬克拉佩特的口音经受住了这一切。

paras.en: The reality, of course, is that the Southern accent is not some incorrect version of a national standard but instead a historically separate and unique dialect—or, more accurately, set of dialects.
paras.zh: 当然，现实是南方口音并不是国家标准的错误版本，而是历史上独立且独特的方言，或者更准确地说，是一组方言。

paras.en: As explored in my recent book, this dialect formed from linguistic variation that came in with colonial-era settlers from different places and stations. The incipient differences increased after the Civil War intensified hostilities and cultural differences between the North and South.
paras.zh: 正如我在最近的书中所探讨的那样，这种方言是由来自不同地方和车站的殖民时代定居者带来的语言变异形成的。内战后，南北之间的敌对行动和文化差异加剧，这种最初的差异进一步加剧。

paras.en: The association with “countryness” often triggered by a Southern accent grew out of this region’s agricultural past and its related cultural folkways. But what “country” has come to mean relies largely on stereotypes about what a country lifestyle involves. They include things like hunting, gun ownership and less socially progressive views—often arising from media portrayals of and beliefs about the South.
paras.zh: 南方口音常常引发与“乡村”的联系，源于该地区的农业历史及其相关的文化民俗。但“乡村”的含义很大程度上取决于人们对乡村生活方式的刻板印象。其中包括狩猎、拥有枪支和不太社会进步的观点——通常源于媒体对南方的描述和信仰。

paras.en: As the South has become more and more industrialized over the past half-century, these social meanings associated with the accent’s use now highlight a disconnect between its new urban vibe and its older, traditional rural one.
paras.zh: 随着南方在过去的半个世纪中变得越来越工业化，这些与口音的使用相关的社会意义现在凸显了其新的城市氛围与古老的传统乡村氛围之间的脱节。

paras.en: As rural vs. urban ideological and political divides in the U.S. have intensified, so has using symbolic means to signal this opposition.
paras.zh: 随着美国农村与城市意识形态和政治分歧的加剧，使用象征性手段来表达这种对立的声音也在加剧。

paras.en: Pickup trucks emblazoned with American flags and country music have become politicized. The white Southern accent, by virtue of its association with more rural traditional values, has also become emblematic of a conservative political identity not all modern Southerners share.
paras.zh: 印有美国国旗和乡村音乐的皮卡车已经变得政治化。白人南方口音由于与更多农村传统价值观的联系，也成为保守政治身份的象征，但并非所有现代南方人都有这种身份。

paras.en: Recent linguistic research has compared voters in the South who had strong Southern accents to those with weaker ones, mainly measured through their use of a set of unique Southern vowel pronunciations, such as saying “bay-ud” for “bed” or “rawed” for “ride.”
paras.zh: 最近的语言研究将具有浓重南方口音的南方选民与南方口音较弱的选民进行了比较，主要通过他们使用一组独特的南方元音发音来衡量，例如说“bay-ud”代表“bed”或“rawed”代表“ride”。

paras.en: It turns out that those holding more right-leaning positions and voting Republican in previous presidential elections used significantly more Southern vowels than those with more left-leaning positions who voted for Democrats. Three separate studies in Georgia, North Carolina and Tennessee discovered the same relationship between degree of Southern accent and political conservatism or liberalism.
paras.zh: 事实证明，那些在之前的总统选举中持有更多右倾立场并投票给共和党的人使用的南方元音明显多于那些投票支持民主党的左倾立场的人。佐治亚州、北卡罗来纳州和田纳西州的三项独立研究发现，南方口音的程度与政治保守主义或自由主义之间存在同样的关系。

paras.en: The takeaway from these studies is that conservatism itself is embodied in a strong Southern accent.
paras.zh: 这些研究得出的结论是，保守主义本身就带有浓厚的南方口音。

paras.en: The pronunciation of one’s vowels has become a barometer of how one’s beliefs and values fit within the old vs. new South.
paras.zh: 一个人元音的发音已经成为衡量一个人的信仰和价值观是否适合新旧南方的晴雨表。

paras.en: Conservative ideologies and politics have become enmeshed with “country” speech and lifestyles. Young urban Southerners who don’t identify with these traits might be moving not so much away from Southern identity itself but rather specifically from this rural conservative identity it is often associated with.
paras.zh: 保守的意识形态和政治已经与“乡村”言论和生活方式交织在一起。不认同这些特征的年轻城市南方人可能并没有远离南方身份本身，而是特别远离它经常与之相关的农村保守身份。

paras.en: Of course, other factors are also playing a role in the decline of the Southern accent in cities, such as heavy migration by non-Southerners to the region and greater interaction with people from other dialect areas via social media.
paras.zh: 当然，其他因素也在城市南方口音的衰落中发挥了作用，例如非南方人大量迁移到该地区，以及通过社交媒体与其他方言地区的人们进行更多的互动。

paras.en: Outside the South, interestingly, recent research has found a greater embrace of Southern accent features, emerging in particular among those in rural areas where traditional lifestyles and, often, more conservative views are embraced. For instance, in a small, rural town in Ohio, speakers who identified themselves as more drawn to country lifestyles showed use of vowel features—such as saying “baa” for “bye”—more associated with the South.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，最近的研究发现，在南方以外的地区，南方口音特征得到了更多人的接受，尤其是在农村地区，那里的人们接受传统的生活方式，而且往往更保守的观点。例如，在俄亥俄州的一个乡村小镇，那些自认为更喜欢乡村生活方式的说话者表现出元音特征的使用——比如说“baa”表示“再见”——更与南方相关。

paras.en: So, in this circuitous and indirect way, vowels have become the latest players in partisan politics: Democratic Southerners wanting to distance themselves from the ideological and political climate associated with the rural South are moving away from its unique vowels. More “traditional” or conservative-leaning speakers continue to embrace them.
paras.zh: 因此，以这种迂回和间接的方式，元音已经成为党派政治的最新参与者：想要远离与南方农村相关的意识形态和政治气候的民主南方人正在远离其独特的元音。更多“传统”或保守倾向的演讲者继续接受它们。

paras.en: The real casualty in this particular battleground might be the obscuring of a larger culture, practice and community that the Southern accent has long represented for those who are automatically—and often erroneously —assigned a politicized identity just by the sound of their voice.
paras.zh: 在这个特定的战场上，真正的受害者可能是掩盖了更大的文化、实践和社区，南方口音长期以来一直代表着那些仅仅通过声音就自动（而且常常是错误地）被赋予政治化身份的人。

paras.en: This article was first published by The Conversation. Read the original article here.
paras.zh: 本文最初由《对话》发表。在这里阅读原文。

articles.title: AI could turn scientific papers into research assistants
articles.author: Kathryn Hulick

paras.en: Scientific papers may be getting a 21st century update.
paras.zh: 科学论文可能会在 21 世纪得到更新。

paras.en: A system called Paper2Agent lets scientists do more than read a new scientific study. When a paper comes with code, methods and data, the system packages these into a tool set that an AI assistant can use to work with new data, researchers report September 16 in Nature.
paras.zh: 一个名为 Paper2Agent 的系统可以让科学家做的不仅仅是阅读新的科学研究。研究人员于 9 月 16 日在《自然》杂志上报道，当一篇论文附带代码、方法和数据时，系统会将它们打包到一个工具集中，人工智能助手可以使用该工具集来处理新数据。

paras.en: The system is essentially “a virtual author of the paper,” available around the clock, says James Zou, a computer scientist at Stanford University.
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学家 James Zou 表示，该系统本质上是“论文的虚拟作者”，全天候可用。

paras.en: In tests, Zou and colleagues tried to convert 100 computational biology papers into working tool sets and succeeded with 74. The others had obstacles such as missing code or data, or software that wouldn’t run. With the papers that were converted, the Paper2Agent tool set could run analyses of the published work and answer questions about the results. It did so more accurately and also more than twice as fast as the same agent working from the original papers and accompanying code.
paras.zh: 在测试中，Zou 和同事尝试将 100 篇计算生物学论文转换为工作工具集，其中 74 篇成功。其他论文则遇到了一些障碍，例如缺少代码或数据，或者软件无法运行。通过转换后的论文，Paper2Agent 工具集可以对已发表的论文进行分析并回答有关结果的问题。与使用原始论文和随附代码进行工作的同一代理相比，它的准确性更高，速度也快两倍多。

paras.en: Making another scientist’s code usable can take substantial work, says Peter Clark, a senior research director at the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence in Seattle who was not involved in developing Paper2Agent. Researchers already share code on platforms such as GitHub. But Clark says he often has to “grub around” for half a day to figure out how to get it running.
paras.zh: 西雅图艾伦人工智能研究所的高级研究主任彼得·克拉克（Peter Clark）没有参与 Paper2Agent 的开发，他表示，让另一位科学家的代码可用可能需要大量工作。研究人员已经在 GitHub 等平台上共享代码。但克拉克表示，他经常需要“摸索”半天才能弄清楚如何让它运行。

paras.en: A general-purpose AI assistant such as Claude can help, he says, but it typically generates new code on the fly. Paper2Agent instead packages code associated with a paper into reusable tools, tests them against reference outputs and writes step-by-step instructions guiding an AI assistant on which tools to use and in what order. This streamlines and standardizes the process of using AI to interact with scientific research, Clark says. It’s “an exciting step” toward papers that actively help scientists.
paras.zh: 他说，像克劳德这样的通用人工智能助手可以提供帮助，但它通常会动态生成新代码。 Paper2Agent 相反，将与论文相关的代码打包到可重用的工具中，根据参考输出对其进行测试，并编写分步指令，指导人工智能助手使用哪些工具以及按什么顺序使用。克拉克说，这简化并标准化了使用人工智能与科学研究互动的过程。这是朝着积极帮助科学家的论文迈出的“令人兴奋的一步”。

paras.en: To Zou, transforming scientific papers into agents seem like a natural next step for transmitting knowledge. We’ve already moved from stone tablets and papyrus to paper and then to digital formats, he says, and now it’s time to move from passive to active formats for human knowledge. A paper-agent can help one human scientist quickly use another’s code and methods. The tool can also search for paper-agents about similar topics with the aim of alerting their human authors about potential collaborations.
paras.zh: 对于邹来说，将科学论文转化为媒介似乎是传播知识的自然下一步。他说，我们已经从石碑和纸莎草纸转向纸张，然后转向数字格式，现在是人类知识从被动格式转向主动格式的时候了。论文代理可以帮助一位人类科学家快速使用另一位科学家的代码和方法。该工具还可以搜索类似主题的论文代理，目的是提醒人类作者潜在的合作。

paras.en: Zou says his team has already created “over 100 different paper-agents” from their own work and that these have already helped him find other scientists to collaborate with.
paras.zh: Zou 表示，他的团队已经根据自己的工作创建了“100 多种不同的纸质代理”，这些已经帮助他找到了其他科学家进行合作。

paras.en: Clark notes that Paper2Agent specializes in helping scientists reuse methods and code, and not in answering general questions, like a true virtual author should be able to do. Also, he worries about what could happen if millions of low-quality papers get turned into agents capable of pestering scientists. That could make things “worse rather than better,” he says, recalling the days of Clippy, the much-maligned Microsoft Office assistant. But he’d love for a “non-annoying agent” to pop up and tell him about work that he should be paying attention to.
paras.zh: Clark 指出，Paper2Agent 专门帮助科学家重用方法和代码，而不是像真正的虚拟作者那样回答一般问题。此外，他还担心，如果数以百万计的低质量论文变成了能够困扰科学家的媒介，会发生什么。他回忆起饱受诟病的 Microsoft Office 助手 Clippy 的日子时说，这可能会让事情“变得更糟而不是更好”。但他希望有一个“不烦人的代理人”突然出现并告诉他他应该关注的工作。

paras.en: For more open-ended questions about a paper, Clark says he would still want to talk to the people who did the research. “The reason I would write to a corresponding author is for precisely the things they didn’t put in the paper.”
paras.zh: 对于有关论文的更多开放式问题，克拉克表示他仍然想与进行这项研究的人交谈。 “我之所以给通讯作者写信，正是因为他们没有在论文中提到的内容。”

articles.title: Electric stoves could help people with asthma breathe easier
articles.author: Aimee Cunningham

paras.en: For people with asthma, switching from a gas stove to an electric one might be a breath of fresh air. The combustion that creates the flame of a gas stove or oven releases pollutants, including nitrogen dioxide, which can trigger asthma symptoms. After a research-backed electric stove replacement, people reported more symptom relief than is often achieved with asthma medications.
paras.zh: 对于患有哮喘的人来说，从煤气炉换成电炉可能是呼吸新鲜空气。燃气灶或烤箱燃烧产生的火焰会释放污染物，包括二氧化氮，这可能引发哮喘症状。在研究支持的电炉更换后，人们报告症状缓解效果比使用哮喘药物更明显。

paras.en: “We were really surprised at how large the benefit was,” says Ashwini Sehgal, a clinician who studies community health at Case Western Reserve University in Cleveland. With funding from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency during the Biden administration, Sehgal and colleagues spearheaded a project to install electric stoves in Cleveland households that had at least one person with asthma.
paras.zh: “我们对效果之大感到非常惊讶，”克利夫兰凯斯西储大学研究社区健康的临床医生阿什维尼·塞加尔 (Ashwini Sehgal) 说。在拜登执政期间，在美国环境保护署的资助下，塞加尔和同事牵头了一个项目，为克利夫兰至少有一名哮喘患者的家庭安装电炉。

paras.en: Eighty-five participants who had poorly controlled asthma were given a questionnaire a few months after the switch. They reported symptom improvement that was roughly two to three times as large as what’s typical with medication. Those with the worst symptoms saw the biggest improvement. Participants also reported fewer emergency room or hospital visits and said they missed work or school less often.
paras.zh: 转换后几个月，对 85 名哮喘控制不佳的参与者进行了问卷调查。他们报告说，症状改善程度大约是典型药物治疗的两到三倍。那些症状最严重的人看到了最大的改善。参与者还报告说，去急诊室或医院的次数减少了，并且缺勤或缺课的次数也减少了。

paras.en: One 38-year-old woman told Sehgal’s team that whenever she cooked on her gas stove, she felt like her throat was closing. But the sensation disappeared after she switched to electric. Another participant, a 36-year-old man, found it difficult to walk uphill and play with his kids. With the stove swap, “he described how much better he felt as ‘magical,’ ” Sehgal says.
paras.zh: 一位 38 岁的女性告诉 Sehgal 的团队，每当她在煤气灶上做饭时，她都会感觉喉咙发紧。但当她改用电动后，这种感觉就消失了。另一位参与者是一名 36 岁的男子，他发现很难步行上山并与孩子们玩耍。更换炉灶后，“他形容自己感觉‘神奇’了很多，”塞加尔说。

paras.en: While heating, steaming or frying on a gas stovetop, nearby NO2 levels can skyrocket, reaching hundreds of parts per billion. That’s much higher than the EPA’s one-hour outdoor air quality standard of 100 parts per billion. NO2 exposure is linked to increased asthma symptoms. For example, research in children has found the pollutant can boost wheezing, coughing and asthma attacks.
paras.zh: 在燃气灶上加热、蒸或煎炸时，附近的二氧化氮浓度会飙升，达到十亿分之数百。这远高于 EPA 规定的一小时室外空气质量标准（十亿分之一百）。 NO2 暴露与哮喘症状加重有关。例如，针对儿童的研究发现，污染物会加剧喘息、咳嗽和哮喘发作。

paras.en: The project was initially funded to follow 1,200 households for 12 months. But the Trump administration terminated the EPA’s Community Change Grants early, which drastically reduced the number of study participants. Yet even with this small group, the symptom improvement was significant.
paras.zh: 该项目最初的资助是对 1,200 个家庭进行为期 12 个月的跟踪。但特朗普政府提前终止了美国环保局的社区变革拨款，这大大减少了研究参与者的数量。然而，即使对于这一小群人来说，症状的改善也是显着的。

paras.en: The decision to replace a gas stove “depends on how much you are struggling with your own illness,” says environmental epidemiologist Carrie Breton of WashU Bursky School of Public Health in St. Louis. As a trial run, Sehgal suggests using an electric hot plate and a toaster oven to see if keeping the gas stove off helps improve symptoms.
paras.zh: 圣路易斯华盛顿大学伯斯基公共卫生学院的环境流行病学家卡丽·布雷顿（Carrie Breton）表示，更换燃气灶的决定“取决于你与自己的疾病作斗争的程度”。作为试运行，塞加尔建议使用电热板和烤面包机烤箱，看看关闭燃气灶是否有助于改善症状。

paras.en: If a stove swap isn’t in the budget, reducing NO2 exposure is still worthwhile, says pulmonologist Laura Paulin of Dartmouth Health. She recommends using kitchen ventilation, either via an exhaust hood that vents to the outside or an open window. A HEPA filter with a carbon insert can trap NO2 to decrease airborne concentrations. And try to keep children with asthma out of the kitchen when the stove is on, Paulin says. “It is a daunting task to replace a stove, but it doesn’t have to be an all-or-nothing thing.”
paras.zh: 达特茅斯健康中心的肺病学家劳拉·保林表示，如果预算中没有更换炉灶，减少二氧化氮暴露仍然是值得的。她建议使用厨房通风，可以通过通向室外的排气罩或打开的窗户。带有碳插件的 HEPA 过滤器可以捕获二氧化氮，以降低空气中的浓度。波林说，当炉子打开时，尽量让患有哮喘的孩子远离厨房。 “更换炉子是一项艰巨的任务，但不一定是全有或全无的事情。”

paras.en: For researchers, the next step would be to measure lung function before and after a stove switch, Breton says. It would also be helpful to account for more factors, such as seasonal effects. “Many things can trigger people’s asthma,” Paulin says. Researchers could do a randomized trial in which some people get the electric stove right away while others wait for six months, Sehgal says, to allow time for comparison.
paras.zh: 布雷顿说，对于研究人员来说，下一步将是测量炉灶开关前后的肺功能。考虑更多因素（例如季节性影响）也会有所帮助。 “很多事情都会引发人们的哮喘，”保林说。塞加尔说，研究人员可以进行一项随机试验，其中一些人立即使用电炉，而另一些人则等待六个月，以便有时间进行比较。

paras.en: If electric stoves continue to be linked with fewer trips to the emergency room, fewer hospitalizations and better symptom control than medication can provide, “health insurance companies should consider paying for or subsidizing” stove swaps, Sehgal says. “If it truly works this well,” Breton says, “it’s got a bigger bang for your buck.”
paras.zh: 塞加尔说，如果电炉继续与更少的急诊室次数、更少的住院次数和比药物更好的症状控制联系在一起，“健康保险公司应该考虑支付或补贴”炉灶更换。 “如果它真的运作得这么好，”布雷顿说，“那么你的钱就会得到更大的回报。”

articles.title: Eating too much sugar on antibiotics could squash helpful gut bacteria
articles.author: Mariella Careaga

paras.en: While a spoonful of sugar might help us gulp down a bitter-tasting antibiotic, it also may increase the damage that these drugs cause to the gut microbes.
paras.zh: 虽然一勺糖可能会帮助我们吞下苦味抗生素，但它也可能会增加这些药物对肠道微生物造成的损害。

paras.en: In patients being treated for blood cancers, eating sugary items during antibiotic treatment was linked to a greater reduction in gut bacteria diversity than taking the antibiotics alone. The combination was also tied to the growth of gut bacteria associated with hard-to-treat infections, researchers report September 30 in Nature.
paras.zh: 在接受血癌治疗的患者中，与单独服用抗生素相比，在抗生素治疗期间吃含糖食物会导致肠道细菌多样性更大程度的减少。研究人员于 9 月 30 日在《自然》杂志上报道称，这种组合还与肠道细菌的生长有关，这些细菌与难以治疗的感染有关。

paras.en: Cancer patients have lots of variation in their diets and take medications that can damage their microbiome. So, these patients provide a unique opportunity to study dramatic gut changes “that we believe are also relevant in the healthy context,” says Jonas Schluter, a microbiologist at NYU Langone Health.
paras.zh: 癌症患者的饮食有很大差异，并且服用的药物可能会损害他们的微生物组。因此，这些患者提供了一个独特的机会来研究肠道的巨大变化，“我们认为这些变化与健康环境相关，”纽约大学兰格尼健康中心的微生物学家 Jonas Schluter 说。

paras.en: Previous evidence separately suggested that antibiotics and sugars can disrupt the gut microbiome. But their combined effects, particularly in people at greater risk of infection, was unclear.
paras.zh: 先前的证据分别表明抗生素和糖会破坏肠道微生物组。但它们的综合影响，特别是对感染风险较高的人来说，尚不清楚。

paras.en: Researchers closely tracked more than 9,000 meals eaten by 173 people hospitalized in a treatment center to undergo blood-forming stem cell transplants. “Diet records are one of the biggest black boxes in a lot of diet microbiome studies,” since meals are often self-reported, says Tiffany Weir, a microbiologist at Colorado State University in Fort Collins, who was not involved in the research.
paras.zh: 研究人员密切追踪了 173 名在治疗中心接受造血干细胞移植住院治疗的患者所吃的 9000 多顿饭。 “饮食记录是许多饮食微生物组研究中最大的黑匣子之一”，因为膳食通常是自我报告的，科林斯堡科罗拉多州立大学的微生物学家蒂芙尼·威尔（Tiffany Weir）说，她没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: Standardized hospital meals allowed researchers to measure multiple days’ worth of food intake down to the gram, then compare the amounts of various nutrients eaten with bacterial diversity data obtained from stool samples.
paras.zh: 标准化的医院膳食使研究人员能够测量多天的食物摄入量，精确到克，然后将摄入的各种营养素的量与从粪便样本中获得的细菌多样性数据进行比较。

paras.en: For every additional 100 grams of sugar (the equivalent of 2.5 cans of Coke) that patients on antibiotics ate in the two days before sampling, the team found a 24 percent decrease in bacterial diversity. Consuming sweets and sugary beverages during antibiotic treatment was also associated with blooms of Enterococcus bacteria, which can be drug-resistant and are linked to difficult-to-treat infections associated with longer hospital stays and higher mortality.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，服用抗生素的患者在采样前两天每多吃 100 克糖（相当于 2.5 罐可乐），细菌多样性就会减少 24%。在抗生素治疗期间食用甜食和含糖饮料也与肠球菌大量繁殖有关，肠球菌可能具有耐药性，并与难以治疗的感染有关，从而导致住院时间更长和死亡率更高。

paras.en: “Some bacteria, sometimes, survive antibiotics, or perhaps more dangerously, they are resistant to [them],” Schluter says. By giving these bacteria the “universal resource for life, which is simple sugars, we are exacerbating their dominance.
