It’s almost like burning down the rainforest with a lot of fire, and then trying to extinguish the flames by putting in more petrol.”
paras.zh: “有些细菌有时能够在抗生素的作用下存活下来，或者更危险的是，它们对抗生素产生抗药性，”施卢特说。通过为这些细菌提供“生命的通用资源，即单糖，我们正在加剧它们的统治地位。这几乎就像用大量的火烧毁雨林，然后试图通过加入更多的汽油来扑灭火焰。”

paras.en: The researchers also exposed mice on standard or sucrose-rich diets to a single dose of antibiotics. They found that the sugar exacerbated the enterococcal abundance after antibiotic exposure.
paras.zh: 研究人员还让食用标准饮食或富含蔗糖饮食的小鼠接受单剂量的抗生素。他们发现，接触抗生素后，糖会加剧肠球菌的丰度。

paras.en: “Reducing sugar intake could be another way for patients to support their gut microbiome during antibiotic treatment,” says Sarah Berry, a nutrition scientist at King’s College London who was not involved in the study. Still, more research is needed to determine whether the findings apply to anyone on these drugs.
paras.zh: “减少糖的摄入量可能是患者在抗生素治疗期间支持肠道微生物组的另一种方式，”伦敦国王学院的营养科学家莎拉·贝里（Sarah Berry）说，她没有参与这项研究。尽管如此，还需要更多的研究来确定这些发现是否适用于任何服用这些药物的人。

paras.en: Schluter hopes that further studies and clinical trials can help uncover more about the exact relationship between sugar, antibiotics and the gut microbiome.
paras.zh: 施卢特希望进一步的研究和临床试验能够帮助揭示更多关于糖、抗生素和肠道微生物组之间的确切关系。

paras.en: “You need to take antibiotics to fight infections, but you should also be aware that they have side effects to the microbiome,” Schluter says. “Now, we need to find strategies to mitigate this damage.”
paras.zh: “你需要服用抗生素来对抗感染，但你也应该意识到它们对微生物组有副作用，”施鲁特说。 “现在，我们需要找到减轻这种损害的策略。”

articles.title: Too Much RNA Can Actually Starve Cells of Energy, Study Finds
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: RNA, or ribonucleic acid, is one of the most important molecules in keeping the body functioning correctly. One of its main jobs is to turn the information stored in our genetics into actual proteins that build and operate cells, for example.
paras.zh: RNA，即核糖核酸，是维持身体正常运作的最重要的分子之一。例如，它的主要工作之一是将存储在我们遗传学中的信息转化为构建和操作细胞的实际蛋白质。

paras.en: To stay healthy, cells keep RNA production and deletion in a careful balance, but there are ways this balance can be tipped over. Invading viruses tend to produce more RNA, and aging, certain cancers, and neurodegenerative diseases can also cause disruption.
paras.zh: 为了保持健康，细胞使 RNA 的产生和删除保持谨慎的平衡，但有一些方法可以打破这种平衡。入侵的病毒往往会产生更多的 RNA，而衰老、某些癌症和神经退行性疾病也会造成破坏。

paras.en: In a study published in PNAS, researchers outline a newly discovered way that too much RNA can cause harm: It can interfere with tiny power plants called mitochondria inside cells, limiting their energy production capacities.
paras.zh: 在《美国国家科学院院刊》上发表的一项研究中，研究人员概述了一种新发现的过多 RNA 会造成伤害的方式：它会干扰细胞内称为线粒体的微小发电厂，限制其能量生产能力。

paras.en: According to the team behind the study, led by researchers from Texas A&M University, this gives us an important new perspective on age-related diseases, viral infections, and therapies that target or utilize RNA.
paras.zh: 由德克萨斯农工大学研究人员领导的这项研究背后的团队表示，这为我们提供了关于年龄相关疾病、病毒感染以及针对或利用 RNA 的疗法的重要新视角。

paras.en: "Scientists have long known that RNA degradation helps control protein production and remove defective RNA," says virologist Zhilong Yang, from the College of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences (VMBS) at Texas A&M University.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯农工大学兽医与生物医学学院 (VMBS) 的病毒学家杨志龙表示：“科学家们早就知道 RNA 降解有助于控制蛋白质的产生并去除有缺陷的 RNA。”

paras.en: "Our study reveals another important role: It helps cells maintain the energy they need to function properly."
paras.zh: “我们的研究揭示了另一个重要作用：它帮助细胞维持正常运作所需的能量。”

paras.en: The researchers added a vaccinia virus to human cells cultured in the lab, tweaking the chemical setup to drive RNA accumulation – as the virus would normally boost both RNA production and RNA degradation, to survive and to avoid detection.
paras.zh: 研究人员将痘苗病毒添加到实验室培养的人体细胞中，调整化学设置以驱动 RNA 积累——因为该病毒通常会促进 RNA 产生和 RNA 降解，以生存并避免被发现。

paras.en: Further experiments involved direct RNA transfers, without infection, including mRNA (the type that makes proteins), and double-stranded RNA (the type associated with viruses, and which triggers potentially damaging immune responses).
paras.zh: 进一步的实验涉及直接 RNA 转移，无需感染，包括 mRNA（制造蛋白质的类型）和双链 RNA（与病毒相关的类型，会引发潜在的破坏性免疫反应）。

paras.en: Oxygen use by the cells was used as a proxy for mitochondria, enabling the researchers to link RNA amounts with mitochondria health.
paras.zh: 细胞的耗氧量被用作线粒体的代表，使研究人员能够将 RNA 量与线粒体健康联系起来。

paras.en: "When we isolated only the mitochondria and added RNA, we still saw mitochondrial damage," says Djamal Brahim Belhaouari, from VMBS. "That was the moment we realized this could be a previously unknown cellular response to RNA."
paras.zh: “当我们只分离线粒体并添加 RNA 时，我们仍然看到线粒体损伤，”VMBS 的 Djamal Brahim Belhaouari 说。 “就在那时我们意识到这可能是一种以前未知的细胞对 RNA 的反应。”

paras.en: "Too much double-stranded RNA or mRNA that cannot be degraded effectively may contribute to disease processes in some contexts."
paras.zh: “过多的双链 RNA 或 mRNA 无法有效降解，在某些情况下可能会导致疾病进程。”

paras.en: Too much RNA was linked to lower oxygen use and energy output from the cells, and the reaction happened before the immune system had been activated, suggesting that this isn't being caused by the body's standard emergency response.
paras.zh: 过多的 RNA 与细胞的氧气消耗和能量输出较低有关，并且反应发生在免疫系统被激活之前，表明这不是由身体的标准紧急反应引起的。

paras.en: And while double-stranded RNA has been linked to cell damage before – albeit not mitochondria-related – the inclusion of mRNA here too suggests that too much of these molecules in general isn't good for cells.
paras.zh: 虽然双链 RNA 之前已被认为与细胞损伤有关（尽管与线粒体无关），但这里包含的 mRNA 也表明，过多的这些分子通常对细胞不利。

paras.en: "mRNA is a normal component of our cells, but it seems like with many good things, if we get too much, that can become a problem for the cell," says Yang.
paras.zh: “mRNA 是我们细胞的正常组成部分，但似乎有很多好东西，如果我们摄入太多，就会给细胞带来问题，”Yang 说。

paras.en: "When too much RNA builds up, including mRNA, it can damage the mitochondria and interfere with the cell's ability to produce energy."
paras.zh: “当过多的 RNA（包括 mRNA）积累时，它会损害线粒体并干扰细胞产生能量的能力。”

paras.en: The next steps are to work out exactly why this is happening, and confirm the link between an abundance of RNA and mitochondria suffering under the load. Testing these findings in living organisms should also tell us more about the reactions involved.
paras.zh: 接下来的步骤是弄清楚发生这种情况的确切原因，并确认大量 RNA 与承受负荷的线粒体之间的联系。在活生物体中测试这些发现也应该告诉我们更多有关所涉及反应的信息。

paras.en: As RNA is such an important messenger for the body, it's often used in vaccines to create a harmless virus fragment, which then protects against the real virus. Further down the line, these findings could help make those vaccines safer and more effective.
paras.zh: 由于 RNA 是人体如此重要的信使，因此它经常被用于疫苗中，以产生无害的病毒片段，从而抵御真正的病毒。进一步说，这些发现可能有助于使这些疫苗更安全、更有效。

paras.en: RNA therapies are also being developed to attack cells too – specifically, cancer cells. Again, knowing how and why RNA might overload mitochondria will be useful here too, once scientists have confirmed precisely how it works.
paras.zh: RNA疗法也被开发用于攻击细胞——特别是癌细胞。再次强调，一旦科学家们准确地证实了 RNA 的工作原理，了解 RNA 如何以及为何会使线粒体超载也将很有用。

paras.en: "We think the negatively charged RNA may accumulate around mitochondria and disrupt the electrical balance needed for energy production, although how it happens is unknown," says Yang. "This is a new concept that we are continuing to explore."
paras.zh: “我们认为带负电荷的 RNA 可能会在线粒体周围积聚，并破坏能量产生所需的电平衡，尽管它是如何发生的尚不清楚，”杨说。 “这是我们正在继续探索的一个新概念。”

paras.en: "Understanding this mechanism could help researchers design and optimize future RNA-based therapeutics and vaccines by better understanding how cells respond to large amounts of RNA."
paras.zh: “了解这种机制可以帮助研究人员更好地了解细胞如何对大量 RNA 做出反应，从而设计和优化未来基于 RNA 的疗法和疫苗。”

paras.en: The research has been published in PNAS.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。

articles.title: The World's First Corporate Psychopath May Have Just Been Identified
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: There's something about psychopaths that gives them an edge.
paras.zh: 精神病患者身上有一些东西给了他们优势。

paras.en: Research suggests people with the darkest of impulses can be remarkably adept at climbing the corporate ladder, often ending up in places of great power.
paras.zh: 研究表明，具有最黑暗冲动的人可以非常善于攀登公司的阶梯，最终往往会到达权力很大的地方。

paras.en: But how far back does this creepy phenomenon of corporate psychopathy go?
paras.zh: 但这种令人毛骨悚然的企业精神病现象可以追溯到多久以前呢？

paras.en: According to organizational behavior researcher Clive Roland Boddy of Anglia Ruskin University in the UK, the roots of corporate psychopathy can be identified as far back as 400 years ago – to the very dawn of modern corporate capitalism.
paras.zh: 英国安格利亚鲁斯金大学的组织行为研究员克莱夫·罗兰·博迪 (Clive Roland Boddy) 表示，企业精神病的根源可以追溯到 400 年前，即现代企业资本主义的黎明时期。

paras.en: In a new study published in the Asian Journal of Business Ethics, Boddy suggests that Jeronimus Cornelisz – a mutinous merchant shipwrecked off the coast of Australia in 1629 in the infamous Batavia disaster – fits the bill as history's earliest identifiable corporate psychopath.
paras.zh: 在《亚洲商业道德杂志》上发表的一项新研究中，博迪认为杰罗尼姆斯·科内利兹（Jeronimus Cornelisz）——一艘在 1629 年臭名昭著的巴达维亚灾难中在澳大利亚海岸失事的叛乱商船——符合历史上最早可识别的企业精神病患者的标准。

paras.en: "What makes this case remarkable is that when we analyzed Cornelisz using a modern management psychopathy framework, he displayed every major characteristic associated with corporate psychopaths," Boddy says.
paras.zh: “这个案例的引人注目之处在于，当我们使用现代管理精神病患者框架分析科内利斯时，他表现出了与企业精神病患者相关的所有主要特征，”博迪说。

paras.en: "The same playbook we see in toxic workplaces today appears in this case from 1629. He removed opponents, rewarded loyalists, created fear, manipulated followers, and pursued power at any cost."
paras.zh: “我们今天在有毒工作场所看到的同样的剧本也出现在 1629 年的这个案例中。他除掉对手，奖励忠诚者，制造恐惧，操纵追随者，不惜一切代价追求权力。”

paras.en: The Batavia was a ship of the Dutch East India Company, often considered the world's first multinational corporation.
paras.zh: 巴达维亚号是荷兰东印度公司的一艘船，该公司通常被认为是世界上第一家跨国公司。

paras.en: The vessel ran aground on its maiden voyage, striking a coral reef in the Houtman Abrolhos islands, near Western Australia, on 4 June 1629.
paras.zh: 1629 年 6 月 4 日，这艘船在其处女航中搁浅，撞上了西澳大利亚附近豪特曼阿布罗霍斯群岛的珊瑚礁。

paras.en: As many as 250 survivors were stranded in the shipwreck and were ferried to a nearby island that came to be known as Batavia's Graveyard (now called Beacon Island).
paras.zh: 多达 250 名幸存者被困在沉船中，并被送往附近的一个岛屿，该岛后来被称为巴达维亚墓地（现称为灯塔岛）。

paras.en: After Batavia's merchant commander and captain sailed to Indonesia for help, taking with them dozens of senior crew, Cornelisz – who had already planned out a mutinous theft of treasure on the ship prior to the shipwreck – assumed leadership of the remaining survivors, ranking as the most senior corporate executive left behind.
paras.zh: 在巴达维亚号商船指挥官和船长带着数十名高级船员前往印度尼西亚寻求帮助后，科内利兹——在海难发生前就已经策划了一场叛乱，盗窃船上的宝藏——接管了剩余幸存者的领导权，成为留下的最高级的企业高管。

paras.en: As history records, what followed was a chilling series of events that Boddy argues bear all the hallmarks of psychopathic leadership.
paras.zh: 正如历史记载，接下来发生了一系列令人毛骨悚然的事件，博迪认为这些事件具有精神病态领导力的所有特征。

paras.en: This included ordering groups of people onto other islands, ostensibly to find water, but potentially to thin the numbers of survivors competing for limited resources.
paras.zh: 这包括命令一群人前往其他岛屿，表面上是为了寻找水源，但可能是为了减少争夺有限资源的幸存者数量。

paras.en: Cornelisz also replaced lawful council members with his own hand-picked colluders, making them sign oaths of allegiance.
paras.zh: 科内利斯还用自己精心挑选的共谋者取代了合法的议会成员，让他们签署效忠誓言。

paras.en: "Thereafter, Cornelisz's group gradually revealed themselves as mutineers and callous murderers, and gathered the treasure, water and remaining supplies from the shipwrecked boat, within Cornelisz's tent, aiming to keep it for themselves and become pirates," Boddy writes.
paras.zh: 博迪写道：“此后，科内利兹的团队逐渐暴露出自己是叛乱者和冷酷的杀人犯，并从失事的船上收集了财宝、水和剩余的补给品，并将其藏在科内利兹的帐篷内，旨在将其据为己有，并成为海盗。”

paras.en: Later, the self-styled 'Captain General' Jeronimus Cornelisz is thought to have orchestrated the systematic murder of roughly 100 of the remaining survivors, in a cold bid to diminish the number of people who needed to be fed and watered, and to maximize his control over those who still lived. Women were also subjected to rape and sexual enslavement.
paras.zh: 后来，自封的“总队长”杰罗尼姆斯·科内利斯被认为策划了对大约 100 名剩余幸存者的系统性谋杀，目的是冷酷地减少需要食物和水的人数，并最大限度地控制那些仍然活着的人。妇女还遭受强奸和性奴役。

paras.en: After a series of battles between the mutineers and soldiers, Cornelisz was ultimately captured and tried. He, along with his fellow ringleaders, confessed to murder, rape, and mutiny. As punishment, their hands were severed, and they were executed by hanging.
paras.zh: 经过叛变者和士兵之间的一系列战斗，科内利什最终被抓获并受审。他和他的同伙头目承认谋杀、强奸和叛变。作为惩罚，他们的双手被砍断，并被处以绞刑。

paras.en: It's a gruesome, violent episode of history. In many ways, a story of shipwrecked villainy that feels distant to today's world.
paras.zh: 这是历史上一段可怕而暴力的事件。从很多方面来说，这是一个与当今世界相去甚远的海难邪恶故事。

paras.en: And yet Boddy says Cornelisz basically exemplifies all the worst tendencies of psychopathic leaders in the modern era.
paras.zh: 然而博迪说，科内利兹基本上体现了现代精神变态领导者所有最糟糕的倾向。

paras.en: "Corporate psychopaths are found to exhibit a common modus operandi involving the establishment of control, a cowed workforce, and the formation of a climate of fear, marked by abuse, bullying and yelling," he writes.
paras.zh: 他写道：“人们发现，企业精神病患者表现出一种常见的作案手法，包括建立控制、畏缩的员工队伍以及形成以虐待、欺凌和大喊大叫为特征的恐惧气氛。”

paras.en: "Cornelisz exhibited all of these in extremity. Cornelisz also utilized the tactics and strategies that are still used by corporate psychopaths, including presenting a grandiose image, replacing boards of directors with personal appointees, using divide-and-conquer techniques to divide and confuse potential opposition, and using fear and dark humor as a means of control."
paras.zh: “科内利斯将所有这些都表现到了极端。科内利斯还利用了企业精神病患者仍在使用的战术和策略，包括呈现浮夸的形象、用个人任命的人取代董事会、使用分而治之的技巧来划分和迷惑潜在的反对派，以及使用恐惧和黑色幽默作为控制手段。”

paras.en: According to Boddy's own research into corporate psychopathy, founded on the theories of American psychiatrist Hervey Cleckley, Cornelisz demonstrated all 10 characteristics of corporate psychopathy.
paras.zh: 根据博迪自己对企业精神病态的研究（建立在美国精神病学家赫维·克莱克利的理论基础上），科内利斯展示了企业精神病态的所有 10 个特征。

paras.en: These are: superficial charm and apparent intelligence; untruthfulness and insincerity; cheating personality; extreme egocentrism; lack of remorse; emotional shallowness; unresponsiveness to personal interactions; irresponsibility and refusal to accept responsibility; calm, poised and apparently rational behavior; lack of self-blame and self-insight.
paras.zh: 它们是：肤浅的魅力和表面的智慧；不诚实和不诚实；作弊的性格；极端的自我中心主义；缺乏悔恨；感情浅薄；对个人互动反应迟钝；不负责任和拒绝承担责任；冷静、镇定且明显理性的行为；缺乏自责和自我洞察力。

paras.en: More than just a history lesson, the case of Cornelisz demonstrates that corporate psychopaths have been with us since modern capitalism was invented, Boddy argues.
paras.zh: 博迪认为，科内利兹的案例不仅仅是一堂历史课，它表明自现代资本主义发明以来，企业精神病患者就一直伴随着我们。

paras.en: And while the world might have changed since the dark days of the Batavia, psychopaths haven't.
paras.zh: 尽管自巴达维亚的黑暗时代以来世界可能已经发生了变化，但精神病患者却没有改变。

paras.en: "They utilize a similar modus operandi across the centuries and are motivated by greed, self-aggrandizement, and the desire to hurt, dominate, and control others," he writes.
paras.zh: 他写道：“几个世纪以来，他们都采用类似的作案手法，其动机是贪婪、自我扩张以及伤害、支配和控制他人的欲望。”

paras.en: "They adopt a strategy involving their ascension to power, the removal of potential opposition, the ruthless treatment of others, and the establishment of a climate of fear to quell potential opposition.
paras.zh: “他们采取的策略包括夺取权力、消除潜在反对派、残酷对待他人以及建立恐惧气氛以平息潜在反对派。

paras.en: "Destruction follows in their wake, and they negatively impact the careers, lives, and fortunes of those around them, including investors, colleagues, subordinates, and other leaders."
paras.zh: “破坏随之而来，并对周围人的职业、生活和财富产生负面影响，包括投资者、同事、下属和其他领导者。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in the Asian Journal of Business Ethics.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《亚洲商业道德杂志》上。

articles.title: Scientists Found One of The 'Chunkiest' Squid-Like Creatures Ever Known
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: Paleontologists have identified an entirely new Jurassic squid-like creature from a pair of fossils retrieved from the bed of an ancient inland sea in Wyoming.
paras.zh: 古生物学家从怀俄明州古代内海海底取出的一对化石中发现了一种全新的侏罗纪鱿鱼状生物。

paras.en: They say it's one of the "chunkiest known species" of its prehistoric group.
paras.zh: 他们说它是史前类群中“已知最粗的物种”之一。

paras.en: Wyoteuthis linsterorum is the species name, in recognition of seasoned fossil collector Cliff Linster, who discovered one of the fossils, but passed away earlier this year. It's the only Wyoteuthis species so far.
paras.zh: Wyote​​uthis linsterorum 是该物种的名称，以纪念经验丰富的化石收藏家克里夫·林斯特 (Cliff Linster)，他发现了其中一块化石，但于今年早些时候去世。这是迄今为止唯一的 Wyote​​uthis 物种。

paras.en: The species has made its scientific debut in the journal Papers in Palaeontology.
paras.zh: 该物种已在《古生物学论文》杂志上首次亮相。

paras.en: Wyoteuthis is a member of an extinct order of cephalopods, belemnites, that proliferated during the Jurassic. Their living relatives include octopuses and squids.
paras.zh: Wyote​​uthis 是一种已灭绝的头足类动物箭石目的成员，这种动物在侏罗纪时期大量繁殖。它们的近亲包括章鱼和鱿鱼。

paras.en: Like modern-day squids, belemnites had 10 appendages, but they also had a cone-shaped internal shell. Part of the shell was made of aragonite, like that of living cephalopods. You might've seen the buoyant, foam-like bone of a cuttlefish wash up on the beach: that's aragonite.
paras.zh: 与现代鱿鱼一样，箭石有 10 个附肢，但它们也有一个锥形内壳。外壳的一部分是文石制成的，就像现存的头足类动物一样。您可能见过被冲上海滩的乌贼的有浮力的、泡沫状的骨头：那是霰石。

paras.en: But the other part of a belemnite's internal structure – known as the guard, or rostrum – is made of calcite.
paras.zh: 但箭石内部结构的另一部分（称为防护罩或讲台）是由方解石制成的。

paras.en: It's those calcitic structures that are scattered through the Sundance Formation and other fossil deposits across the world, evidence that belemnites were once plentiful in Jurassic seas. The Wyoteuthis fossils are around 160 million years old.
paras.zh: 正是这些方解石结构散布在圣丹斯组和世界各地的其他化石矿床中，证明侏罗纪海洋中曾经存在丰富的箭石。 Wyote​​uthis 化石距今约 1.6 亿年。

paras.en: But Wyoteuthis is like no other belemnite the experts have ever seen, with a rostrum so rotund that even the scientists have literally described it as "one of the chunkiest known species in the paleontological history of the group".
paras.zh: 但怀奥特乌斯与专家们见过的其他箭石不同，它的喙部如此圆润，甚至科学家们也将其描述为“该类群古生物学史上已知的最矮胖的物种之一”。

paras.en: Wyoming paleontologist Bill Wahl, who has been combing Wyoming for fossils for much of his career, says the species "stuck out like a sore thumb".
paras.zh: 怀俄明州古生物学家比尔·瓦尔（Bill Wahl）在其职业生涯的大部分时间里一直在怀俄明州寻找化石，他说这个物种“像个大拇指酸痛的人一样突出”。

paras.en: Most belemnite fossils found in Wyoming (and there are masses of them) are about 500–100 mm (2–4 inches) long and 10–20 mm wide.
paras.zh: 在怀俄明州发现的大多数箭石化石（而且数量较多）长约 500-100 毫米（2-4 英寸），宽约 10-20 毫米。

paras.en: "With a diameter reaching ~60 mm at the anterior end, these rostra are the thickest known for belemnites so far," writes belemnite expert Alexey Ippolitov and his colleagues.
paras.zh: “前端直径达到约 60 毫米，这些喙是迄今为止已知的箭石中最厚的，”箭石专家 Alexey Ippolitov 和他的同事写道。

paras.en: The specimens are a bit broken, but based on what remains, the researchers estimate Wyoteuthis' rostrum was around 160–175 mm long.
paras.zh: 这些标本有点破损，但根据残留物，研究人员估计 Wyote​​uthis 的喙长约 160-175 毫米。

paras.en: "In other words, Wyoteuthis was a 'chunky' but rather short squid," the team writes.
paras.zh: “换句话说，Wyote​​uthis 是一种‘粗壮’但相当短的鱿鱼，”该团队写道。

paras.en: Existing methods for calculating the full length of a belemnite, arms and all, suggest Wyoteuthis was about 55–60 cm (22–24 inches) long, from the tip of its mantle to the end of its arms.
paras.zh: 计算箭石、臂和所有部分全长的现有方法表明，Wyote​​uthis 从地幔尖端到臂末端的长度约为 55-60 厘米（22-24 英寸）。

paras.en: But, the researchers add, "the rostrum size does not automatically indicate a large size of animal and a high position in the trophic pyramid."
paras.zh: 但是，研究人员补充说，“讲台的大小并不自动表明动物体型较大，并且在营养金字塔中的位置较高。”

paras.en: The researchers think its rarity could be the result of a narrow ecological specialization: Perhaps it was picky about its prey, or the kind of habitat it lived in.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，它的稀有性可能是狭窄的生态专业化的结果：也许它对猎物或其居住的栖息地很挑剔。

paras.en: "Wyoteuthis linsterorum is a thick and peculiar belemnite, only rarely seen in the Redwater Shale Member of the Sundance Formation," they note.
paras.zh: “Wyote​​uthis linsterorum 是一种厚而奇特的箭石，在圣丹斯地层的红水页岩层中很少见到，”他们指出。

paras.en: It was part of the family Megateuthididae – which includes Megateuthis, the largest known belemnite – a group that had a really good run in the wake of the Toarcian extinction event, when the ocean lost massive amounts of oxygen.
paras.zh: 它是Megateuthididae科的一部分，该科包括已知最大的箭石Megateuthis，该类群在托阿尔西亚灭绝事件（当时海洋失去大量氧气）之后表现非常出色。

paras.en: Creatures that are more resilient to change can thrive under these circumstances, and cephalopods are especially known for such a knack.
paras.zh: 更能适应变化的生物可以在这种情况下繁衍生息，头足类动物尤其以这种本领而闻名。

paras.en: But then, in the Middle Jurassic, most megateuthidid lineages went extinct, overtaken by other belemnites.
paras.zh: 但随后，在侏罗纪中期，大多数巨型石榴石谱系都灭绝了，并被其他箭石所取代。

paras.en: The researchers say Wyoteuthis is most likely "a portly survivor of a lineage otherwise lost in the depths of geological time".
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，怀特乌斯很可能是“一个在地质年代深处消失的血统的肥胖幸存者”。

paras.en: The research has been published in Papers in Palaeontology.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《古生物学论文》上。

articles.title: Three giant black holes discovered in a galaxy from the dawn of time

paras.en: Three giant black holes discovered in a galaxy from the dawn of time
paras.zh: 从远古时代起就在星系中发现了三个巨大的黑洞

paras.en: - Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics, Garching
paras.zh: - 马克斯·普朗克地外物理研究所，加兴

paras.en: - Astronomers have discovered three actively feeding black holes inside a single galaxy more than 12.5 billion light-years away, revealing a remarkable scene from the universeâs infancy. Two of the black holes are separated by just 620 light-years and are expected to eventually merge, while a third lurks farther away. One weighs an astonishing 80 million suns, and another is growing faster than conventional theories predict.
paras.zh: - 天文学家在距离我们超过 125 亿光年的单个星系内发现了三个活跃的黑洞，揭示了宇宙婴儿期的非凡景象。其中两个黑洞相距仅 620 光年，预计最终会合并，而第三个黑洞则潜伏在更远的地方。其中一颗的重量相当于 8000 万个太阳的重量，而另一颗的生长速度比传统理论预测的要快。

paras.en: Astronomers have discovered three actively feeding supermassive black holes in a single galaxy more than 12.5 billion light-years from Earth. The finding, made by an international research team led by the Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics (MPE), offers a rare glimpse of how enormous black holes grew and interacted during the universe's earliest stages.
paras.zh: 天文学家在距离地球超过 125 亿光年的单个星系中发现了三个活跃的超大质量黑洞。这一发现是由马克斯·普朗克地外物理研究所（MPE）领导的一个国际研究小组做出的，它让我们难得一睹巨大黑洞在宇宙最初阶段如何生长和相互作用。

paras.en: The black holes are located in a galaxy known as J0148-4214. All three are actively accumulating matter, which spirals toward them through surrounding disks of gas and other material. Because the galaxy is so distant, its light has traveled through space for approximately 12.5 billion years before reaching Earth. This means astronomers are observing it as it existed just 1.2 billion years after the Big Bang.
paras.zh: 这些黑洞位于一个名为 J0148-4214 的星系中。这三者都在积极积累物质，物质通过周围的气体和其他物质盘螺旋向它们飞来。由于星系距离很远，它的光在到达地球之前已经穿过太空大约 125 亿年。这意味着天文学家正在观测它，因为它在大爆炸后仅 12 亿年就已存在。

paras.en: Over such vast distances, the expansion of the universe stretches light to longer, redder wavelengths. Astronomers measure this effect through a property called redshift. For J0148-4214, the researchers measured a redshift of z=5.02, allowing them to determine its remarkable distance.
paras.zh: 在如此遥远的距离上，宇宙的膨胀将光延伸到更长、更红的波长。天文学家通过一种称为红移的特性来测量这种效应。对于 J0148-4214，研究人员测量了 z=5.02 的红移，使他们能够确定其显着的距离。

paras.en: "This is the first evidence of three active black holes in a single galaxy in the distant Universe," says Hannah Übler, research group leader at MPE and lead author of the study.
paras.zh: MPE 研究组组长、该研究的主要作者 Hannah Übler 表示：“这是遥远宇宙中单个星系中存在三个活跃黑洞的第一个证据。”

paras.en: Two of the black holes lie near the galaxy's center, separated by a projected distance of just 620 light-years. The third is much farther out, approximately 5,500 light-years from the center.
paras.zh: 其中两个黑洞位于星系中心附近，投影距离仅为 620 光年。第三个距离中心更远，距中心约 5,500 光年。

paras.en: The discovery provides important evidence about how massive black holes came together in the young universe.
paras.zh: 这一发现提供了关于大质量黑洞如何在年轻宇宙中聚集在一起的重要证据。

paras.en: "It suggests that processes in the early Universe were efficient at bringing massive black holes together, setting the stage for the massive black hole mergers we expect to detect with future gravitational wave observatories," says Übler.
paras.zh: 于伯勒说：“这表明早期宇宙中的过程能够有效地将大质量黑洞聚集在一起，为我们期望通过未来引力波天文台探测到的大质量黑洞合并奠定基础。”

paras.en: Astronomers believe that galaxy collisions and mergers were common during the universe's early history. As galaxies combined, their central black holes could also move closer together and eventually merge. These mergers would produce increasingly massive black holes at the centers of the newly formed galaxies, potentially helping explain how some grew to enormous sizes so soon after the Big Bang.
paras.zh: 天文学家认为，星系碰撞和合并在宇宙的早期历史中很常见。当星系合并时，它们的中心黑洞也可能靠得更近并最终合并。这些合并将在新形成的星系中心产生越来越大的黑洞，这可能有助于解释为什么有些黑洞在大爆炸后很快就变得巨大。

paras.en: How Astronomers Detected the Hidden Black Holes
paras.zh: 天文学家如何探测隐藏的黑洞

paras.en: The researchers identified the three black holes by examining distinctive patterns in the light emitted by hydrogen gas. Near a black hole, powerful gravitational forces cause gas to move at extremely high speeds. These movements leave recognizable signatures in the spectrum of light, allowing astronomers to detect black hole activity even when the objects themselves cannot be seen directly.
paras.zh: 研究人员通过检查氢气发出的光的独特模式来识别这三个黑洞。在黑洞附近，强大的引力导致气体以极高的速度移动。这些运动在光谱中留下了可识别的特征，使天文学家即使在无法直接看到物体本身的情况下也能检测到黑洞活动。

paras.en: In the center of J0148-4214, the team found a particularly complicated hydrogen emission pattern. The best explanation was the presence of two closely spaced black holes rather than a single source.
paras.zh: 在J0148-4214的中心，研究小组发现了一个特别复杂的氢排放模式。最好的解释是存在两个间隔很近的黑洞而不是单一来源。

paras.en: To distinguish between them, the scientists used a precise measurement technique called spectro-astrometry. By tracking subtle changes in the positions of spectral emissions across the galaxy, they were able to identify the locations of both central black holes, even though the telescope could not resolve them as two separate points of light.
paras.zh: 为了区分它们，科学家们使用了一种称为光谱天体测量学的精确测量技术。通过跟踪整个星系光谱发射位置的微妙变化，他们能够识别两个中心黑洞的位置，尽管望远镜无法将它们解析为两个独立的光点。

paras.en: The observations also revealed the third active black hole in the galaxy's outer region.
paras.zh: 观测结果还揭示了星系外部区域的第三个活跃黑洞。

paras.en: Three Black Holes With Remarkably Different Masses
paras.zh: 三个质量截然不同的黑洞

paras.en: The three black holes vary dramatically in size. According to the researchers' calculations, their masses are approximately 80 million, 600,000, and 2 million times that of the Sun.
paras.zh: The three black holes vary dramatically in size.根据研究人员的计算，它们的质量分别约为太阳的8000万、60万和200万倍。

paras.en: Surprisingly, the largest black hole is not the one feeding most aggressively. Its smaller neighbor, with a mass of roughly 600,000 suns, is accumulating matter at a much higher rate. In fact, its estimated feeding rate exceeds the maximum predicted by basic models of black hole growth (the Eddington limit).
paras.zh: 令人惊讶的是，最大的黑洞并不是进食最活跃的黑洞。它的较小邻居的质量约为 600,000 个太阳，正在以更高的速度积累物质。事实上，其估计的进食速率超过了黑洞生长基本模型预测的最大值（爱丁顿极限）。

paras.en: This unusually rapid growth may offer clues to how some black holes became extraordinarily massive during the relatively short time available in the early universe.
paras.zh: 这种异常快速的增长可能为一些黑洞如何在早期宇宙相对较短的时间内变得异常巨大提供线索。

paras.en: "The JWST data allowed us not only to identify the three black holes, but also to estimate their masses, accretion rates, and the stellar mass of the galaxy," says Dr. Giovanni Mazzolari, second author of the study and researcher at MPE. "We find a total stellar mass of about 1.3 billion suns, and the black holes represent a significant fraction of that."
paras.zh: 该研究的第二作者、MPE 研究员乔瓦尼·马佐拉里 (Giovanni Mazzolari) 博士表示：“JWST 数据不仅使我们能够识别这三个黑洞，还能够估计它们的质量、吸积率和星系的恒星质量。” “我们发现恒星总质量约为 13 亿个太阳，黑洞占其中的很大一部分。”

paras.en: An Ancient Black Hole Merger in the Making
paras.zh: 正在形成的古老黑洞合并

paras.en: The two black holes near the galaxy's center are expected to merge within the next few hundred million years. Their eventual collision could help produce an even more massive black hole, illustrating a process that may have been essential to the growth of the universe's earliest cosmic giants.
paras.zh: 银河系中心附近的两个黑洞预计将在未来几亿年内合并。它们最终的碰撞可能有助于产生一个更大的黑洞，这说明了一个对于宇宙最早的宇宙巨星的生长可能至关重要的过程。

paras.en: "These results are extremely exciting," adds Roberto Maiolino, professor at the University of Cambridge and co-author of the study. "They suggest that black hole merging may be an additional, fast route for their rapid growth in the early Universe."
paras.zh: “这些结果非常令人兴奋，”剑桥大学教授、该研究的合著者 Roberto Maiolino 补充道。 “他们认为黑洞合并可能是它们在早期宇宙中快速增长的一条额外的快速途径。”

paras.en: The third black hole presents another intriguing puzzle. Located well outside the galaxy's center, it could be a remnant of an earlier merger that was pushed outward by a powerful gravitational recoil. Such a kick can occur when merging black holes emit gravitational waves unevenly, sending the resulting black hole in the opposite direction.
paras.zh: 第三个黑洞提出了另一个有趣的谜题。它位于星系中心之外，可能是早期合并的残余物，被强大的引力反冲力向外推。当合并的黑洞不均匀地发射引力波，将产生的黑洞向相反的方向发送时，就会发生这种踢动。

paras.en: Another possibility is that the third black hole is gradually moving toward the galaxy's center, where it may eventually interact with the other two.
paras.zh: 另一种可能性是，第三个黑洞正在逐渐向星系中心移动，最终可能与另外两个黑洞相互作用。

paras.en: James Webb Reveals Black Holes That Might Otherwise Remain Hidden
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯揭示了原本可能隐藏的黑洞

paras.en: The discovery highlights the remarkable capabilities of the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) for studying black holes in distant galaxies.
paras.zh: 这一发现凸显了詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）在研究遥远星系黑洞方面的卓越能力。

paras.en: In particular, the findings demonstrate the importance of integral field spectroscopy, which allows astronomers to examine how light and its spectral signatures vary across different parts of a galaxy.
paras.zh: 特别是，这些发现证明了积分场光谱的重要性，它使天文学家能够检查光及其光谱特征在星系不同部分的变化。

paras.en: Using Webb's Near Infrared Spectrograph in its integral field spectroscopy mode (NIRSpec-IFS), the researchers were able to separate signals that would otherwise have appeared to come from a single black hole.
paras.zh: 使用韦伯近红外光谱仪的积分场光谱模式（NIRSpec-IFS），研究人员能够分离出看似来自单个黑洞的信号。

paras.en: Without that detailed spatial information, astronomers likely would have identified only one of the galaxy's three active black holes.
paras.zh: 如果没有这些详细的空间信息，天文学家可能只能识别出银河系三个活跃黑洞之一。

paras.en: The results suggest that other distant galaxies may contain multiple growing black holes that have gone undetected. Finding more of these hidden systems could help scientists reconstruct the history of black hole mergers and better understand how the universe produced its most massive black holes so early in cosmic history.
paras.zh: 结果表明，其他遥远的星系可能包含多个未被发现的正在生长的黑洞。找到更多这些隐藏系统可以帮助科学家重建黑洞合并的历史，并更好地了解宇宙如何在宇宙历史的早期产生最大质量的黑洞。

paras.en: Materials provided by Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics, Garching. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由加兴马克斯·普朗克地外物理研究所提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Just two drinks a day may be far riskier than you think

paras.en: Just two drinks a day may be far riskier than you think
paras.zh: 每天只喝两杯可能比你想象的危险得多

paras.en: - Journal of Studies on Alcohol and Drugs
paras.zh: - 酒精和毒品研究杂志

paras.en: - A major new study reveals that drinking just two alcoholic beverages a day is associated with a 1 in 25 lifetime risk of death from alcohol-related causes, challenging the idea that moderate drinking is harmless. Researchers also found no significant overall health benefits from alcohol, with risks rising as consumption increases.
paras.zh: - 一项重要的新研究表明，每天只喝两杯酒精饮料，一生中因酒精相关原因死亡的风险为二十五分之一，这对适度饮酒无害的观点提出了挑战。研究人员还发现，酒精并没有显着的整体健康益处，随着饮酒量的增加，风险也会增加。

paras.en: Even alcohol consumption that many Americans would describe as moderate may carry significant health risks, including a greater likelihood of premature death, disability, cancer, and heart disease. That is the conclusion of a new study published in the Journal of Studies on Alcohol and Drugs, a journal published at Rutgers University.
paras.zh: 即使许多美国人认为适量饮酒也可能带来重大健康风险，包括过早死亡、残疾、癌症和心脏病的可能性更大。这是罗格斯大学出版的《酒精与毒品研究杂志》上发表的一项新研究的结论。

paras.en: The research, known as the Alcohol Intake and Health Study, was originally commissioned by the U.S. federal government to help shape updated national dietary recommendations. Researchers estimated that people who consume an average of 14 alcoholic drinks per week face a 1 in 25 lifetime risk of dying from alcohol-related causes. By comparison, consuming up to seven drinks weekly was linked to only small increases in risk for most health conditions.
paras.zh: 这项名为“酒精摄入与健康研究”的研究最初是由美国联邦政府委托进行的，旨在帮助制定更新的国家饮食建议。研究人员估计，平均每周饮用 14 杯酒精饮料的人，一生中 25 人中就有 1 人死于与酒精相关的原因。相比之下，每周喝七杯饮料只会导致大多数健康状况的风险略有增加。

paras.en: "Even low levels of alcohol use come with health risks," says lead study author Kevin Shield, Ph.D., an associate professor at the University of Toronto and a senior scientist who leads the World Health Organization (WHO)/Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) Collaborating Centre in Addiction and Mental Health. "And that risk continues to increase the more someone drinks."
paras.zh: 该研究的主要作者、多伦多大学副教授、世界卫生组织 (WHO)/泛美卫生组织 (PAHO) 成瘾与心理健康合作中心的资深科学家凯文·希尔德 (Kevin Shield) 博士表示：“即使少量饮酒也会带来健康风险。” “喝得越多，这种风险就会继续增加。”

paras.en: How Scientists Measured the Health Risks of Alcohol
paras.zh: 科学家如何测量酒精对健康的风险

paras.en: To better understand the long-term consequences of drinking, Shield and his colleagues in the United States and Canada investigated how alcohol consumption over a lifetime contributes to disease and premature death among Americans.
paras.zh: 为了更好地了解饮酒的长期后果，希尔德和他在美国和加拿大的同事调查了一生中饮酒如何导致美国人患病和过早死亡。

paras.en: Medical experts first examined more than 7,200 scientific publications covering illnesses and injuries associated with alcohol. Using this evidence, they estimated the risks for individual health conditions and combined those findings with large national health data sets. Statistical models then allowed the team to calculate how different levels of alcohol consumption affect the likelihood of developing serious health problems or dying prematurely.
paras.zh: 医学专家首先检查了 7,200 多篇涉及与酒精相关疾病和伤害的科学出版物。利用这些证据，他们估计了个人健康状况的风险，并将这些发现与大型国家健康数据集相结合。然后，统计模型使研究小组能够计算不同的饮酒水平如何影响出现严重健康问题或过早死亡的可能性。

paras.en: The findings provide specific estimates that are missing from the latest U.S. Dietary Guidelines. The updated recommendations simply encourage Americans to "limit alcoholic beverages" without identifying a particular consumption threshold. Earlier versions advised men to drink no more than two alcoholic beverages per day and women no more than one.
paras.zh: 研究结果提供了最新美国膳食指南中缺少的具体估计。更新后的建议只是鼓励美国人“限制酒精饮料”，但没有确定特定的消费阈值。早期版本建议男性每天喝的酒精饮料不超过两杯，女性每天不超过一杯。

paras.en: "While the new U.S. Dietary Guidelines contain a useful 'less-is-best' message, they provide no quantitative framework. Our study was designed to do just that across the drinking spectrum," says study co-author Timothy Naimi, M.D., M.P.H., director of the University of Victoria's Canadian Institute for Substance Use Research and an adjunct professor at Boston University.
paras.zh: “虽然新的美国饮食指南包含有用的‘少即是最好’的信息，但它们没有提供定量框架。我们的研究旨在在整个饮酒范围内做到这一点，”该研究的合著者、维多利亚大学加拿大药物使用研究所所长、波士顿大学兼职教授蒂莫西·奈米（Timothy Naimi）说。

paras.en: "It turns out that two drinks per day, which might be considered 'moderate' from a social standpoint, is associated with a substantially elevated risk of a premature death caused by alcohol," explains Naimi.
paras.zh: 奈米解释说：“事实证明，从社会角度来看，每天喝两杯酒可能被认为是‘适量’，但实际上却与酒精导致过早死亡的风险大幅升高有关。”

paras.en: Moderate Drinking Offers No Significant Overall Health Benefits
paras.zh: 适量饮酒不会带来显着的整体健康益处

paras.en: The researchers looked beyond the risk of premature death to examine alcohol's connection to a wide range of immediate and long-term health problems. These included cancers (e.g., esophageal, oral, and breast), cardiovascular disease, liver disease, and injuries.
paras.zh: 研究人员不仅关注过早死亡的风险，还研究了酒精与各种近期和长期健康问题的关系。这些包括癌症（例如食管癌、口腔癌和乳腺癌）、心血管疾病、肝病和损伤。

paras.en: One of the study's most important findings challenges the longstanding belief that consuming small amounts of alcohol can improve health, particularly heart health.
paras.zh: 该研究最重要的发现之一挑战了长期以来的信念，即少量饮酒可以改善健康，特别是心脏健康。

paras.en: "We did not observe a significant protective effect of alcohol on health at any level of consumption," says Shield. "At low levels, alcohol may be associated with a reduced risk of ischemic heart disease and stroke. But when you look across the full range of health outcomes, including cancer and other chronic diseases, those potential benefits are outweighed by the risks even at 7 drinks per week."
paras.zh: “我们没有观察到任何饮酒水平的酒精对健康都有显着的保护作用，”希尔德说。 “少量饮酒可能会降低患缺血性心脏病和中风的风险。但是，当你审视包括癌症和其他慢性疾病在内的所有健康结果时，你会发现，即使每周喝 7 杯酒，这些潜在的好处也会被风险所抵消。”

paras.en: In other words, while some studies have suggested that light drinking may benefit certain aspects of cardiovascular health, those possible advantages do not translate into an overall health benefit once alcohol's links to cancer and other diseases are taken into account.
paras.zh: 换句话说，虽然一些研究表明少量饮酒可能有益于心血管健康的某些方面，但一旦考虑到酒精与癌症和其他疾病的联系，这些可能的优势并不会转化为整体健康益处。

paras.en: Although the analysis drew on extensive scientific evidence, the researchers emphasize that its estimates describe risks across populations rather than predicting precisely what will happen to any particular person.
paras.zh: 尽管该分析借鉴了广泛的科学证据，但研究人员强调，其估计描述的是整个人群的风险，而不是准确预测任何特定人会发生什么。

paras.en: Shield says the statistical calculations relied on "the best possible data." However, he cautions that individual circumstances can substantially influence the results.
paras.zh: 希尔德表示，统计计算依赖于“尽可能最好的数据”。然而，他警告说，个人情况会对结果产生重大影响。

paras.en: "However, we can't assume that means one person's individual health risk is the same as what is reported here -- that depends on other factors like lifestyle, genetics, drinking patterns, and other choices that differ person to person."
paras.zh: “然而，我们不能假设这意味着一个人的个人健康风险与这里报告的相同——这取决于其他因素，如生活方式、遗传、饮酒模式以及因人而异的其他选择。”

paras.en: To estimate alcohol's overall impact, the researchers calculated risks for health conditions already known to be caused by alcohol and combined them into a broader assessment. However, scientists are continuing to investigate additional possible consequences of drinking, including emerging evidence connecting alcohol consumption to pancreatic cancer.
paras.zh: 为了估计酒精的总体影响，研究人员计算了已知由酒精引起的健康状况的风险，并将其合并到更广泛的评估中。然而，科学家们正在继续研究饮酒可能产生的其他后果，包括新出现的证据表明饮酒与胰腺癌有关。

paras.en: "Understanding those relationships, and how much alcohol contributes to those risks, is an area that still needs further work," says Shield.
paras.zh: “了解这些关系，以及酒精对这些风险的影响程度，是一个仍需要进一步研究的领域，”希尔德说。

paras.en: What the Findings Mean for U.S. Drinking Guidelines
paras.zh: 研究结果对美国饮酒指南意味着什么

paras.en: The results suggest that alcohol-related health risks become more pronounced when consumption exceeds one drink per day, regardless of whether the person is male or female. This provides a more specific reference point for people trying to understand how their drinking habits might affect their long-term health.
paras.zh: 结果表明，当每天饮酒超过一杯时，无论男性还是女性，与酒精相关的健康风险都会变得更加明显。这为试图了解饮酒习惯如何影响长期健康的人们提供了更具体的参考点。

paras.en: Rather than suggesting that any particular amount is completely safe, the findings show how risks increase with greater consumption and why drinking less generally reduces exposure to alcohol-related harm.
paras.zh: 研究结果并没有表明任何特定的量都是完全安全的，而是表明了风险如何随着饮酒量的增加而增加，以及为什么减少饮酒通常会减少与酒精相关的危害。

paras.en: "Having a clearer threshold helps people better understand what level of drinking is associated with increased risk and make more informed decisions when drinking," says Shield.
paras.zh: “拥有更清晰的阈值可以帮助人们更好地了解什么程度的饮酒与风险增加相关，并在饮酒时做出更明智的决定，”希尔德说。

paras.en: The study has also raised questions about how scientific evidence was incorporated into federal dietary recommendations.
paras.zh: 该研究还提出了如何将科学证据纳入联邦饮食建议的问题。

paras.en: In an accompanying editorial, Robert M. Vincent, a former Associate Administrator for the U.S. Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration, offers his perspective on the circumstances surrounding the research and its role in the development of national guidance.
paras.zh: 在随附的社论中，美国药物滥用和心理健康服务管理局前副局长罗伯特·文森特 (Robert M. Vincent) 就该研究的情况及其在制定国家指南中的作用提出了自己的看法。

paras.en: "The Alcohol Intake and Health report was explicitly invited to inform alcohol guidance during development of the Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2025-2030," he writes. "Despite the study's adherence to its mandate, its findings were sidelined."
paras.zh: 他写道：“在制定《2025-2030 年美国人膳食指南》期间，明确邀请酒精摄入和健康报告为酒精指导提供信息。” “尽管这项研究遵守了其使命，但其研究结果却被搁置了。”

paras.en: Materials provided by Journal of Studies on Alcohol and Drugs. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由《酒精和毒品研究杂志》提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Scientists reveal the hidden danger of missing blood pressure medication

paras.en: Scientists reveal the hidden danger of missing blood pressure medication
paras.zh: 科学家揭示漏服降压药的隐患

paras.en: - Missing blood pressure medication could mean losing much of its protection against heart attacks and strokes, according to an analysis of more than 91,000 people. Patients who consistently took their medication experienced an 11% reduction in major cardiovascular events, while those who missed too many doses saw little or no measurable benefit.
paras.zh: - 根据对超过 91,000 人的分析，缺少降血压药物可能意味着失去对心脏病和中风的大部分保护作用。坚持服药的患者主要心血管事件减少了 11%，而错过服药次数过多的患者几乎没有看到任何明显的益处。

paras.en: Missing doses of blood pressure medication could significantly reduce its ability to protect against heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular problems, according to findings presented at ESC Congress 2026.
paras.zh: 根据 2026 年 ESC 大会上公布的研究结果，缺少剂量的降压药物可能会显着降低其预防心脏病、中风和其他严重心血管问题的能力。

paras.en: An estimated 1.4 billion adults worldwide between the ages of 30 and 79 have high blood pressure (hypertension), a major contributor to illness and death. Although medications that lower blood pressure are proven to reduce the risk of cardiovascular complications, approximately half of patients do not take their prescriptions as directed.
paras.zh: 据估计，全球有 14 亿 30 岁至 79 岁的成年人患有高血压，这是导致疾病和死亡的主要原因。尽管降低血压的药物已被证明可以降低心血管并发症的风险，但大约一半的患者没有按照指示服用处方。

paras.en: "We have evidence that poor adherence to antihypertensive medication is associated with worse outcomes," explained presenter, Miss Qianqian Yang from the University of Oxford, UK. "However, previous data has come from observational studies and could be confounded by other factors. We undertook an analysis of randomized trial data to assess the true impact of adherence on the benefits of antihypertensive treatment."
paras.zh: “我们有证据表明，抗高血压药物依从性差会导致更差的结果，”演讲者、英国牛津大学的杨倩倩女士解释道。 “然而，之前的数据来自观察性研究，可能会受到其他因素的干扰。我们对随机试验数据进行了分析，以评估坚持治疗对抗高血压治疗益处的真正影响。”

paras.en: Major Study Examines the Impact of Missed Blood Pressure Medication
paras.zh: 主要研究探讨了错过服用血压药物的影响

paras.en: To better understand how consistently taking medication affects its benefits, researchers analyzed individual patient data from 91,339 participants across nine clinical trials. Each trial compared a blood pressure treatment (intervention group) with an alternative approach (comparator group: either placebo or a less-intensive regimen).
paras.zh: 为了更好地了解持续服用药物对其益处有何影响，研究人员分析了 9 项临床试验中 91,339 名参与者的个体患者数据。每项试验都将血压治疗（干预组）与替代方法（比较组：安慰剂或强度较低的治疗方案）进行比较。

paras.en: The researchers divided participants into two categories based on how closely they followed their prescribed treatment. Those who took at least 80% of their assigned medication were considered to have higher adherence, while those who took less than 80% were placed in the lower adherence group.
paras.zh: 研究人员根据参与者遵循规定治疗的程度将他们分为两类。服用至少 80% 指定药物的患者被认为具有较高的依从性，而服用少于 80% 的患者则被归为依从性较低的组。

paras.en: Even with the regular monitoring and structured conditions of clinical trials, patients became less consistent about taking their medication as time passed.
paras.zh: 即使有定期监测和临床试验的结构化条件，随着时间的推移，患者服药的一致性也越来越差。

paras.en: "A decline in adherence over time was apparent, even in the structured setting of trials," noted Miss Yang. Overall, 88% of participants met the higher adherence threshold during the first year, but that figure had dropped to just 79% by the fifth year.
paras.zh: “即使是在结构化的试验中，随着时间的推移，依从性的下降也是显而易见的，”杨女士指出。总体而言，88% 的参与者在第一年达到了较高的遵守门槛，但到第五年这一数字已降至 79%。

paras.en: Skipping Blood Pressure Pills Reduces Treatment Benefits
paras.zh: 不服用降压药会降低治疗效果

paras.en: The difference in medication adherence was reflected in how much patients' blood pressure improved.
paras.zh: 药物依从性的差异反映在患者血压改善的程度上。

paras.en: Among participants with higher adherence, systolic blood pressure, the top number in a blood pressure reading, was 5.2 mmHg lower in the intervention group than in the comparator group. For those with lower adherence, the difference was considerably smaller at just 3.0 mmHg.
paras.zh: 在依从性较高的参与者中，干预组的收缩压（血压读数中最高的数字）比对照组低 5.2 mmHg。对于那些依从性较低的人来说，差异要小得多，仅为 3.0 毫米汞柱。

paras.en: Researchers then examined whether these differences translated into protection against major cardiovascular problems. The outcomes included strokes, heart attacks (myocardial infarction), ischemic heart disease, and heart failure that resulted in hospitalization or death.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后检查了这些差异是否可以转化为针对主要心血管问题的保护作用。结果包括中风、心脏病（心肌梗死）、缺血性心脏病和导致住院或死亡的心力衰竭。

paras.en: The findings revealed a striking contrast. Among patients who consistently followed their treatment plans, the intervention group experienced an 11% lower incidence of major cardiovascular events compared with the comparator group. However, among patients with lower adherence, there was no statistically significant reduction in these events.
paras.zh: 研究结果揭示了鲜明的对比。在坚持遵循治疗计划的患者中，干预组的主要心血管事件发生率比对照组低 11%。然而，在依从性较低的患者中，这些事件的发生没有统计学上的显着减少。

paras.en: "Notably, our results reinforce the saying that 'drugs don't work in patients who don't take them.' Patients with lower adherence derived little or no cardiovascular benefit, whereas those with higher adherence had greater reductions in blood pressure and prevention of cardiovascular events," said Miss Yang.
paras.zh: “值得注意的是，我们的研究结果证实了‘药物对不服用药物的患者不起作用’这一说法。依从性较低的患者几乎没有心血管获益，而依从性较高的患者则可以更大程度地降低血压并预防心血管事件，”杨女士说。

paras.en: Helping Patients Get Lifesaving Heart Protection
paras.zh: 帮助患者获得挽救生命的心脏保护

paras.en: The researchers believe that helping people take their medication consistently should become a greater priority in the treatment of high blood pressure. They recommend more routine assessments of medication adherence, along with better patient education and practical strategies to make treatment easier to follow.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，帮助人们坚持服药应该成为治疗高血压的首要任务。他们建议对药物依从性进行更多常规评估，以及更好的患者教育和实用策略，以使治疗更容易遵循。

paras.en: Possible approaches include simplifying medication schedules, combining multiple treatments into a single pill, and prescribing longer-acting drugs that can help limit the consequences of an occasional missed dose.
paras.zh: 可能的方法包括简化用药时间表、将多种治疗方法合并到单一药丸中，以及开出长效药物以帮助限制偶尔漏服剂量的后果。

paras.en: Professor Felix Mahfoud, Chair of the ESC Communication Committee, emphasized that missed medication has received too little attention as a contributor to poorly controlled blood pressure.
paras.zh: ESC 沟通委员会主席 Felix Mahfoud 教授强调，漏服药作为导致血压控制不良的一个因素而受到的关注太少。

paras.en: "For years, we have neglected non-adherence to medication as a cause for uncontrolled hypertension. Assessment of adherence should become a routine part of hypertension care so patients do not miss out on life-saving benefits. As healthcare providers, we are here to have open, non-judgmental conversations with our patients about any barriers they may have to taking medication, to help improve adherence."
paras.zh: “多年来，我们一直忽视不坚持服药是高血压失控的一个原因。对服药依从性的评估应该成为高血压护理的常规部分，这样患者就不会错过挽救生命的好处。作为医疗保健提供者，我们在这里与患者进行开诚布公、非评判性的对话，了解他们服用药物可能遇到的任何障碍，以帮助提高依从性。”

paras.en: Materials provided by European Society of Cardiology. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由欧洲心脏病学会提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Never finishing the fight: Where did Xbox go wrong with Halo?
articles.author: Fran Ruiz

paras.en: Halo: Campaign Evolved was Xbox’s second attempt at refreshing the 2001 sci-fi FPS classic, and it is perfectly fine. A cromulent remake, if ever there was one, but it’s hardly a franchise-saver, especially as Xbox looks to rethink its studio structure and approach to renowned IPs like Halo or Gears of War.
paras.zh: 《光环：战役进化》是 Xbox 对 2001 年科幻 FPS 经典的第二次尝试，它非常出色。如果有的话，这是一部全面的重制版，但它很难成为特许经营权的保护者，特别是当 Xbox 寻求重新考虑其工作室结构和对《光环》或《战争机器》等著名 IP 的处理方法时。

paras.en: Halo hasn’t been the same since original developer Bungie — now owned by Sony and working on Destiny and Marathon — departed, leaving 343 Industries (now Halo Studios) to guide the franchise.
paras.zh: 自从最初的开发商 Bungie（现为索尼所有，负责《命运》和《马拉松》的开发）离开后，《光环》就不再一样了，留下了 343 Industries（现在的光环工作室）来指导该系列。

paras.en: Neither Halo 4 nor 5 meaningfully evolved the gameplay formula or overarching narrative. Halo Infinite found more success by reheating what “old Halo felt like” and sticking it into a half-baked open world, but it still felt far from the series’ glory days.
paras.zh: 《光环 4》和《光环 5》都没有对游戏玩法或总体叙事进行有意义的改进。 《光环：无限》通过重新加热“旧光环的感觉”并将其融入半生不熟的开放世界中获得了更大的成功，但它仍然与该系列的辉煌岁月相去甚远。

paras.en: This year’s full remake of Combat Evolved's campaign delivered exactly what it promised: a shiny, 2026 version of the game that made audiences fall in love with the franchise. It was a clear attempt to reignite faith in 343’s vision, but how is a faithful, shinier remake proof of anything?
paras.zh: 今年对 Combat Evolved 战役的全面重制完全兑现了其承诺：闪亮的 2026 年版本游戏让观众爱上了该系列。这显然是为了重新点燃人们对 343 愿景的信心，但忠实、闪亮的翻拍作品如何证明一切呢？

paras.en: It might not even matter anymore, as the new Xbox leadership has rocked the ship again, leaving Master Chief and the universe’s future cloudier than ever before. Now, with rumors of a reboot being considered at new steward Activision, is there hope for the Spartans, or will Xbox run into another dead end?
paras.zh: 这可能已经不再重要了，因为新的 Xbox 领导层再次撼动了这艘船，让士官长和宇宙的未来比以往任何时候都更加阴云密布。现在，有传言称动视公司正在考虑重新启动，斯巴达人队还有希望吗？或者 Xbox 会陷入另一个死胡同吗？

paras.en: Rebooted or not, Halo needs to leave Master Chief behind
paras.zh: 无论是否重启，光环都需要将士官长抛在身后

paras.en: It looks like the ‘Halo Studios’ moniker only lasted a single (remade) game, as Xbox has recently announced that Call of Duty maker and publisher Activision — which houses many FPS-oriented studios — is taking over development, essentially leaving the 343 veterans as a minor support studio, which translates into more layoffs.
paras.zh: 看起来“光环工作室”这个绰号只持续了一款（重制）游戏，因为 Xbox 最近宣布，《使命召唤》制作商和发行商动视公司（拥有许多面向 FPS 的工作室）将接管开发工作，基本上让 343 老兵成为一个次要的支持工作室，这意味着更多的裁员。

paras.en: If we put aside the human and institutional cost of this whole back-and-forth over the years (a big ask in today’s climate), there are reasons to be optimistic about the quality of an Activision-developed Halo. Regardless of what you think about the Call of Duty IP in 2026 and the publisher’s overall vision for it, it’s clear there’s plenty of talent holding everything together and, more importantly, enough experience to iterate on what Halo’s multiplayer side needs to shine bright again.
paras.zh: 如果我们抛开多年来整个来回的人力和机构成本（在当今的环境下这是一个很大的要求），我们有理由对动视开发的光环的质量感到乐观。无论你如何看待 2026 年的《使命召唤》IP 以及发行商对其的整体愿景，很明显有大量人才将一切整合在一起，更重要的是，有足够的经验来迭代《光环》的多人游戏方面需要再次闪耀光芒。

paras.en: But this won’t fix the larger issue with Halo, which is that Master Chief should’ve been left behind long ago. Like it or not, it’s difficult to deny Halo’s “golden era” ended with Halo: Reach (Bungie’s swansong under Xbox) and the Halo Wars spinoffs, which took the series into the real-time strategy genre. These games were wildly different, but they had one core thing in common: they made the sci-fi setting feel bigger instead of smaller, offering the perfect blueprint to build upon in a post-Halo 3 world.
paras.zh: 但这并不能解决《光环》中更大的问题，那就是士官长早就应该被抛在后面了。不管你喜欢与否，很难否认《光环》的“黄金时代”以《光环：致远星》（Bungie 在 Xbox 下的绝唱）和《光环战争》衍生作品结束，后者将该系列带入了即时战略类型。这些游戏截然不同，但它们有一个核心共同点：它们让科幻场景感觉更大而不是更小，为后光环 3 世界提供了完美的蓝图。

paras.en: There’s nothing inherently wrong with the Master Chief. Franchises can be built around iconic characters like Mario or Lara Croft. But in the post-Bungie era, his role changed from an extremely competent Spartan soldier to a space messiah. Halo 4, 5, and Infinite used sci-fi nonsense to transform him into this larger-than-life figure, rendering the rest of the UNSC largely powerless in the process.
paras.zh: 士官长本身并没有什么问题。特许经营权可以围绕马里奥或劳拉·克劳馥等标志性角色打造。但在后Bungie时代，他的角色从一个极其能干的斯巴达士兵变成了太空救世主。 《光环 4》、《光环 5》和《无限》使用了科幻小说中的废话将他变成了这个具有传奇色彩的人物，而在这个过程中，联合国安理会的其他成员基本上无能为力。

paras.en: It’s the same mistake ID Software made with Doomguy, centering the story on how super special he is, and not on the world he inhabits. Now rumours are rumbling that Activision’s reboot might focus on Chief’s origins; that's the last thing Halo needs.
paras.zh: ID Software 在《毁灭战士》中也犯了同样的错误，将故事的重点放在了他的超级特别上，而不是他所居住的世界。现在有传言称动视暴雪的重启可能会聚焦于酋长的起源。这是 Halo 最不需要的东西。

paras.en: Forgetting Activision’s next Halo for a second, we were teased with (even if there wasn’t an official confirmation from Xbox) at least a Halo 2 remake via Halo: Campaign Evolved’s alternative ending.
paras.zh: 暂时忘记动视的下一款光环吧，我们被嘲笑（即使 Xbox 没有官方确认）至少会通过《光环：战役进化》的另类结局重制光环 2。

paras.en: Back in May 2026, renowned insider Rebs Gaming confidently reported that Halo 2 and 3 remakes were in development. But can fans realistically expect them after new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma’s latest shakeup?
paras.zh: 早在 2026 年 5 月，著名内部人士 Rebs Gaming 就自信地报道称，《光环 2》和《光环 3》的重制版正在开发中。但在 Xbox 新任首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 进行最新改组后，粉丝们真的能期待他们的表现吗？

paras.en: Halo Studios could have done a "fine" job with safe remakes of the two original Halo sequels while Activision handles new projects. It’s hard to reject that approach, especially after Xbox finding success with Bethesda’s The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered and confirming two Fallout remasters are in the works. It seems like money waiting to be made, but the remakes could be cooked too.
paras.zh: 光环工作室本可以在动视公司处理新项目的同时，安全地重拍两部原版光环续作，从而完成“出色”的工作。很难拒绝这种做法，尤其是在 Xbox 凭借 Bethesda 的《上古卷轴 IV：湮没重制版》获得成功并确认两款《辐射》重制版正在制作中之后。看起来像是有钱等着赚，但翻拍也可以做。

paras.en: Xbox and 343/Halo Studios have made plenty of mistakes with Halo, but the killer has always been their lack of conviction in their ideas. And look, nostalgia shouldn’t be the driving force behind a franchise in dire need of reinvention, but I’m far more annoyed by the creative rollbacks, flip-flopping, and now the loss of knowledge and talent accompanying the gutting of Halo Studios.
paras.zh: Xbox 和 343/Halo Studios 在《光环》中犯了很多错误，但致命的问题始终是他们对自己的想法缺乏信心。看，怀旧不应该成为急需重塑的系列背后的驱动力，但我更恼火的是创意的倒退、反复无常，以及现在伴随着光环工作室的破产而造成的知识和人才的流失。

paras.en: We haven’t even touched on the mess that was the live-action Halo show. It lasted only two seasons, had John-117 walking around outside the Mjolnir armor for most of its runtime, and was cancelled just as the story finally got to the titular Halo. Why would you stray so far from the source material, and how do you miss the mark so badly?
paras.zh: 我们甚至还没有触及真人光环秀中的混乱局面。它只持续了两季，约翰-117在大部分时间里都在雷神锤盔甲外走动，就在故事最终到达标题光环时被取消了。为什么你会偏离源材料这么远，你怎么会如此严重地偏离目标？

paras.en: In many ways, it perfectly encapsulated what’s been wrong with Halo as a whole for so many years. The powers that be can’t decide what they really want from it, and thus it’s stuck, unable to leave the past behind or convincingly establish a new horizon for itself. Other franchises have run into the same issues — looking at you, Star Wars — but Halo has been stuck in this purgatory for 15+ years, as Xbox leaders and strategy shifts come and go.
paras.zh: 从很多方面来说，它完美地概括了《光环》多年来的整体问题。当权者无法决定他们真正想要从中得到什么，因此它陷入了困境，无法将过去抛在脑后，也无法令人信服地为自己建立一个新的视野。其他系列也遇到了同样的问题——比如《星球大战》——但随着 Xbox 领导者和战略的更迭，《光环》已经在这个炼狱中深陷了 15 年以上。

paras.en: Could Xbox’s newly-formed XP division deliver the focused big-screen adaptation the series has always deserved? I’m sure that’s the plan, but even a cursory glance back at Xbox’s handling of the franchise for the past decade or so says no.
paras.zh: Xbox 新成立的 XP 部门能否提供该系列一直应有的集中大屏幕改编？我确信这就是计划，但即使是粗略地回顾一下 Xbox 在过去十年左右的时间里对特许经营权的处理，你也会发现答案并非如此。

paras.en: Halo’s deep problems won’t be fixed overnight, and throwing a bunch of hard-working developers to the curb certainly won’t help. Halo’s current struggles didn’t come from Halo Studios or 343 Industries; they came from impatient and incompetent leadership calling the property-defining shots. I’ve seen nothing to suggest that’s changed.
paras.zh: Halo 的深层问题不会在一夜之间得到解决，将一群辛勤工作的开发人员扔到路边肯定无济于事。 Halo 当前的困境并非来自 Halo Studios 或 343 Industries；而是来自 Halo Studios。他们来自不耐烦和无能的领导层，他们对财产做出了决定。我没有看到任何迹象表明情况发生了变化。

paras.en: Fran Ruiz is our resident Star Wars guy. His hunger for movies and TV series is only matched by his love for video games. He got a BA of English Studies, focusing on English Literature, from the University of Malaga, in Spain, as well as a Master's Degree in English Studies, Multilingual and Intercultural Communication. On top of writing features and other longform articles for Space.com since 2021, he is a frequent collaborator of VG247 and other gaming sites. He also serves as associate editor over at Star Wars News Net and its sister site, Movie News Net.
paras.zh: 弗兰·鲁伊斯是我们的星球大战常驻人员。他对电影和电视剧的渴望与他对电子游戏的热爱相匹配。他在西班牙马拉加大学获得英语研究学士学位，主修英国文学，以及英语研究、多语言和跨文化交流硕士学位。自 2021 年以来，他除了为 Space.com 撰写专题文章和其他长篇文章外，还经常与 VG247 和其他游戏网站合作。他还担任星球大战新闻网及其姊妹网站电影新闻网的副编辑。

articles.title: October's 'Hunter's Moon' stalks into the autumn sky tonight: Here's what you need to know
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: The October full moon rises tonight! Here's everything you need to know about the "Hunter's Moon," including where to see it, how it got its name and other tricks of the light and mind that could conspire to create a truly spectacular lunar light show.
paras.zh: 十月的满月今晚升起！以下是您需要了解的有关“猎人之月”的所有信息，包括在哪里可以看到它、它的名字如何得名，以及光和心灵的其他技巧，这些技巧可以共同创造出真正壮观的月球灯光秀。

paras.en: October's moon reaches 100% illumination at 12:12 a.m. EDT (0412 GMT) on Oct. 26, as the lunar disk shines opposite the sun in Earth's sky. The shadowy terminator that separates the day and night side of the moon is conspicuously absent around this time, as are the shadows that throw craters into spectacular relief during the waxing and waning lunar phases.
paras.zh: 10 月 26 日美国东部时间中午 12 点 12 分（格林威治标准时间 0412），十月的月亮达到 100% 光照，此时月盘在地球天空中与太阳相对照耀。分隔月球白天和黑夜的阴影明暗界线在这个时候明显消失了，在月盈和亏月期间将陨石坑投射到壮观的浮雕上的阴影也明显消失了。

paras.en: Instead, it's a perfect time to explore the dark lunar "seas" that cover the moon's surface where lava flooded impact basins billions of years ago, before hardening to create enormous basaltic plains. Streaks of reflective material can also be spotted streaking away from bright young craters, where material from the lunar subsurface was excavated and cast across the moon's surface during brutal asteroid impacts.
paras.zh: 相反，现在是探索覆盖月球表面的黑暗月球“海洋”的最佳时机，数十亿年前，熔岩淹没了冲击盆地，然后硬化形成了巨大的玄武岩平原。还可以在明亮的年轻陨石坑中发现反射物质的条纹，这些物质是在残酷的小行星撞击期间从月球地下挖掘出来并投射到月球表面的。

paras.en: Where and when to see the October full moon.
paras.zh: 何时何地可以看到十月的满月。

paras.en: Stargazers in the U.S. will get their first view of the full moon as it climbs into the eastern sky at sunset on Oct. 25. Be sure to check out Time and Date's moonrise tracker to discover the exact timings for your location.
paras.zh: 美国的观星者将在 10 月 25 日日落时首次看到满月，届时满月将爬上东方天空。请务必查看 Time and Date 的月出追踪器，了解您所在位置的准确时间。

paras.en: The moon often appears particularly large while close to the horizon, thanks to a phenomenon called the "Moon Effect," wherein our brains trick us into thinking that the lunar disk is larger while in close visual proximity to the ground than it is when overhead.
paras.zh: 由于一种称为“月亮效应”的现象，月亮在靠近地平线时通常显得特别大，其中我们的大脑欺骗我们，认为月盘在视觉上接近地面时比在头顶上时更大。

paras.en: The moon can also take on a spectacular yellow-orange color in the hour after moonrise, as blue wavelengths of its reflected light — the shortest in the visible spectrum — are scattered during its oblique passage through Earth's atmosphere.
paras.zh: 月亮在月出后的一小时内也会呈现出壮观的黄橙色，因为其反射光的蓝色波长（可见光谱中最短的波长）在倾斜穿过地球大气层时被散射。

paras.en: Why is the October full moon called the "Hunter's Moon"?
paras.zh: 为什么十月的满月被称为“猎人之月”？

paras.en: October's full moon is commonly known as the Hunter's Moon in the Northern Hemisphere because it rises soon after farmers have cleared away the summer's harvest, leaving the fields bare for hunters to catch their prey and prepare it as food for the winter, according to the Old Farmer's Almanac.
paras.zh: 根据《老农年鉴》，十月的满月在北半球通常被称为“猎人之月”，因为它在农民清理完夏季收成后不久就会升起，使田野空旷，让猎人捕捉猎物并将其作为冬季食物。

paras.en: It's also called the "Migrating Moon" by the North American Cree people, in reference to the birds that travel to warmer climates around the time of its rising. The Ojibwe and the Haida know it asthe "Freezing Moon," to reflect the drop in temperature that occurs in autumn.
paras.zh: 它也被北美克里人称为“迁徙的月亮”，指的是在它升起时前往气候温暖地区的鸟类。奥及布威人和海达人将其称为“冻月”，以反映秋季气温的下降。

paras.en: Want to make the most of the October full moon? Then be sure to check out our guide to observing the moon and photographing the lunar disk, along with our picks of the best cameras and lenses for astrophotography.
paras.zh: 想充分利用十月的满月吗？然后，请务必查看我们的观测月球和拍摄月盘指南，以及我们精选的用于天文摄影的最佳相机和镜头。

paras.en: Editor's Note: If you would like to share your photos of the October full moon with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s), comments, and your name and location to spacephotos@space.com.
paras.zh: 编者注：如果您想与 Space.com 的读者分享十月满月的照片，请将您的照片、评论以及您的姓名和位置发送至 spacephotos@space.com。

paras.en: Anthony Wood joined Space.com in April 2025 after contributing articles to outlets including IGN, New Atlas and Gizmodo. He has a passion for the night sky, science, Hideo Kojima, and human space exploration, and can’t wait for the day when astronauts once again set foot on the moon.
paras.zh: 安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 向 IGN、New Atlas 和 Gizmodo 等媒体投稿后于 2025 年 4 月加入 Space.com。他热爱夜空、科学、小岛秀夫和人类太空探索，迫不及待地等待宇航员再次踏上月球的那一天。

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 25, 1671: Astronomer Giovanni Cassini discovers Iapetus, Saturn's 'yin-yang' moon
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Oct. 25, 1671, the Italian astronomer Giovanni Cassini discovered a new moon at Saturn! Iapetus was the second moon anyone had ever found orbiting Saturn, and it was the first of four moons Cassini would discover at the ringed planet.
paras.zh: 1671年10月25日，意大利天文学家乔瓦尼·卡西尼在土星发现了一颗新月！土卫八是人们发现的第二颗绕土星运行的卫星，也是卡西尼号在土星上发现的四颗卫星中的第一颗。

paras.en: The Dutch astronomer Christiaan Huygens had discovered Titan, the largest of Saturn's moons, about six years earlier. After Cassini found Iapetus, he also found the moons Rhea, Tethys and Dione.
paras.zh: 大约六年前，荷兰天文学家克里斯蒂安·惠更斯发现了土星最大的卫星泰坦。卡西尼号发现土卫八后，他还发现了土卫五、特提斯和土卫四等卫星。

paras.en: When Cassini first saw Iapetus, the moon looked like a tiny speck on the west side of Saturn. He calculated its orbit and thought he would be able to see it again on the east side of Saturn 39 days later, but it was nowhere to be seen. When it reappeared on the west side again, Cassini realized that Iapetus must be darker on one side than the other, which made it harder to see when the dark side was facing Earth.
paras.zh: 当卡西尼号第一次看到土卫八时，它看起来就像土星西侧的一个小斑点。他计算了它的轨道，以为39天后就能在土星东侧再次看到它，但却不见踪影。当它再次出现在西侧时，卡西尼号意识到土卫八的一侧一定比另一侧更暗，这使得当其黑暗面面向地球时更难看到。

paras.en: More than 300 years later, NASA sent a spacecraft named Cassini to Saturn, and that Cassini took some pretty awesome photos of Iapetus. Realizing Iapetus kind of resembled a yin-yang, it has since been nicknamed the "yin-yang moon."
paras.zh: 300 多年后，美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 向土星发射了一艘名为卡西尼号的宇宙飞船，卡西尼号拍摄了一些非常棒的土卫八照片。意识到土卫八有点像阴阳，它被昵称为“阴阳月亮”。

paras.en: The discovery of Iapetus, with its yin-yang bright and dark hemispheres, has added to our understanding of how moons form.
paras.zh: 具有阴阳明半球和暗半球的土卫八的发现增加了我们对卫星如何形成的理解。

paras.en: "Using the computer simulations, the researchers concluded ... the inner moons of Saturn and its gorgeous rings are all relatively young. The more distant moons Titan and Iapetus would not have been formed at the same time."
paras.zh: “通过计算机模拟，研究人员得出结论……土星的内卫星及其华丽的光环都相对年轻。更遥远的卫星泰坦和土卫八不会同时形成。”

paras.en: "Our best guess is that Saturn had a similar collection of moons before, but their orbits were disturbed by a special kind of orbital resonance involving Saturn's motion around the sun. Eventually, the orbits of neighboring moons crossed, and these objects collided. From this rubble, the present set of moons and rings formed."
paras.zh: “我们最好的猜测是，土星以前也有类似的卫星群，但它们的轨道受到一种特殊的轨道共振的干扰，这种共振涉及土星绕太阳的运动。最终，邻近卫星的轨道交叉，这些物体发生碰撞。从这些碎石中，形成了现在的卫星群和环。”

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Space Nuclear Power Corporation Awarded DARPA Agreement for Ground Test of Autonomous Nuclear Reactor Controller
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M. — October 21, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes) announced today that the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has awarded the company an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under the Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program. Managed by Dr. Tabitha Dodson in DARPA’s Defense Sciences Office, the Fat Cat program seeks to advance autonomous reactor operation for national security missions. The contract supports development and ground testing of advanced reactor control technologies that extend the demonstrated capability of American nuclear power.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯 — 2026 年 10 月 21 日 — 太空核电公司 (SpaceNukes) 今天宣布，国防高级研究计划局 (DARPA) 已根据快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划授予该公司一份其他交易协议 (OTA)。 Fat Cat 项目由 DARPA 国防科学办公室的 Tabitha Dodson 博士管理，旨在推进国家安全任务的自主反应堆运行。该合同支持先进反应堆控制技术的开发和地面测试，以扩展美国核电的展示能力。

paras.en: The award extends a continuous line of nuclear power development and builds directly on SpaceNukes’ successful nuclear power demonstration heritage. In 2018, key members of the SpaceNukes team, while employed by Los Alamos National Laboratory and NASA, performed the foundational Kilopower Reactor Using Stirling Technology (KRUSTY) work — conducting the only full-power ground test of a new American space reactor in five decades. Under the current agreement, SpaceNukes and Los Alamos National Laboratory will design, build, and conduct a follow-on nuclear ground test of a Kilopower reactor incorporating active control rod operation—an advancement beyond the passively controlled architecture demonstrated in the 2018 KRUSTY test.
paras.zh: 该奖项延伸了核电开发的连续路线，并直接建立在 SpaceNukes 成功的核电示范遗产之上。 2018 年，SpaceNukes 团队的主要成员在受雇于洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室和 NASA 的同时，进行了使用斯特林技术的千功率反应堆 (KRUSTY) 的基础工作——对美国新型太空反应堆进行了 5 年来唯一的全功率地面测试。根据目前的协议，SpaceNukes 和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室将设计、建造并进行后续的 Kilopower 反应堆核地面测试，该反应堆采用主动控制棒操作，这是超越 2018 年 KRUSTY 测试中展示的被动控制架构的进步。

paras.en: “This award recognizes the maturity and continuity of the team that designed, built, and tested KRUSTY in 2018,” said Patrick McClure, COO of SpaceNukes. “We are proud to work alongside Dr. Dodson and Los Alamos National Laboratory to deliver the next demonstrated step in American nuclear power.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席运营官帕特里克·麦克卢尔 (Patrick McClure) 表示：“该奖项是对 2018 年设计、建造和测试 KRUSTY 团队的成熟度和连续性的认可。” “我们很自豪能够与多德森博士和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室合作，在美国核电领域迈出下一步。”

paras.en: The phased program structure includes design, procurement, and integration gates leading to the ground demonstration, producing both nuclear-tested hardware and the engineering basis for autonomous, actively-controlled reactor operation. Integration work will be conducted at SpaceNukes’ workshop in Medina, Ohio, led by Chief Engineer Marc Gibson. The work positions American industry to provide reliable nuclear power across a broader range of mission profiles, including those requiring dynamic power management and rapid response under varying operational conditions.
paras.zh: 分阶段的计划结构包括设计、采购和集成，直至地面演示，生产经过核测试的硬件和自主、主动控制反应堆运行的工程基础。集成工作将在 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的车间进行，由总工程师 Marc Gibson 领导。这项工作使美国工业界能够在更广泛的任务范围内提供可靠的核电，包括那些需要动态电力管理和在不同操作条件下快速响应的任务。

paras.en: “There is no substitute for demonstrated technology when American national security objectives are at stake,” said Andy Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “This award lets us advance the work begun in the KRUSTY program and bring another tested capability forward for the nation.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安迪·菲尔普斯 (Andy Phelps) 表示：“当美国国家安全目标受到威胁时，已证实的技术是无可替代的。” “这个奖项让我们能够推进 KRUSTY 计划中开始的工作，并为国家带来另一种经过考验的能力。”

paras.en: About Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes)
paras.zh: 关于太空核电公司（SpaceNukes）

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corporation was founded on the belief that nuclear power is essential to our future, both on Earth and in space. The company’s goal is to enable the successful deployment of fission reactors in space. SpaceNukes brings together the core engineering and program management team behind the foundational KRUSTY demonstration in 2018. David Poston (CTO) and Patrick McClure (COO) performed this work at Los Alamos National Laboratory; Marc Gibson (Chief Engineer) led the program at NASA Glenn Research Center. The team is joined by Omar Mireles (formerly NASA Marshall Space Flight Center) and Andy Phelps (CEO). SpaceNukes holds a license from Los Alamos National Laboratory for the Kilopower technology and operates from headquarters in Los Alamos, New Mexico, and workshops in Los Alamos with additive 3D printing and in Medina, Ohio, with thermal and vacuum capabilities.
paras.zh: 太空核电公司的成立基于这样的信念：核电对我们的未来至关重要，无论是在地球上还是在太空中。该公司的目标是在太空成功部署裂变反应堆。 SpaceNukes 汇集了 2018 年 KRUSTY 基础演示背后的核心工程和项目管理团队。David Poston（首席技术官）和 Patrick McClure（首席运营官）在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室执行了这项工作；马克·吉布森（首席工程师）在美国宇航局格伦研究中心领导了该项目。该团队由 Omar Mireles（前 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心）和 Andy Phelps（首席执行官）加入。 SpaceNukes 持有洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室的 Kilopower 技术许可证，总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，在洛斯阿拉莫斯设有增材 3D 打印车间，在俄亥俄州麦地那设有热力和真空能力的车间。

articles.title: Global Satcom Services Revenues to Reach $145 Billion by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | October 2026 – Global satellite services revenues are forecast to grow 44% to reach $145 billion by 2035, according to the 33rd edition of Novaspace’s Satellite Connectivity and Video Market report. The next decade will mark a fundamental shift in the industry as data services become the dominant growth engine, driving revenues to nearly $100 billion by 2035.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 10 月——根据 Novaspace 第 33 版卫星连接和视频市场报告，全球卫星服务收入预计将增长 44%，到 2035 年达到 1,450 亿美元。随着数据服务成为主要的增长引擎，到 2035 年收入将接近 1000 亿美元，未来十年将标志着该行业的根本性转变。

paras.en: Data services are expected to increase their share of total satellite services revenues from 26% to 68% over the decade, as demand for connectivity accelerates across consumer, defense, government, and enterprise markets.
paras.zh: 随着消费者、国防、政府和企业市场对连接的需求加速增长，数据服务在卫星服务总收入中的份额预计将在十年内从 26% 增加到 68%。

paras.en: While video remains the industry’s largest revenue segment today, future growth will be driven by connectivity. Consumer Broadband, Milsatcom, and Enterprise Networks are forecast to lead market expansion, adding $22.6 billion, $19.2 billion, and $17.2 billion in revenues, respectively, over the next decade.
paras.zh: 虽然视频仍然是当今行业最大的收入领域，但未来的增长将由连接性推动。消费者宽带、军事卫星通信和企业网络预计将引领市场扩张，在未来十年内分别增加 226 亿美元、192 亿美元和 172 亿美元的收入。

paras.en: Milsatcom is emerging as a particularly important growth engine, fueled by rising defense spending and broader adoption of satcom-enabled operational concepts across military forces. At the same time, NGSO constellations are becoming an increasingly important source of resilient capacity for government and defense users.
paras.zh: 在国防支出不断增加以及军队更广泛采用卫星通信作战概念的推动下，军事卫星通信正在成为一个特别重要的增长引擎。与此同时，NGSO 星座正成为政府和国防用户日益重要的弹性能力来源。

paras.en: “Satellite connectivity is moving firmly into the mainstream,” said Dimitri Buchs, Project Manager and Editor of the report. “The rapid expansion of NGSO capacity, declining bandwidth costs, and growing demand for resilient, always-available connectivity are fundamentally changing where and how satellite communications compete.”
paras.zh: “卫星连接正在坚定地成为主流，”项目经理兼报告编辑 Dimitri Buchs 说道。 “NGSO 容量的快速扩张、带宽成本的下降以及对弹性、始终可用连接的需求不断增长，正在从根本上改变卫星通信的竞争地点和方式。”

paras.en: The satellite capacity market is forecast to exceed $46 billion by 2035, more than tripling from 2025 levels. Video Distribution, the largest capacity segment in 2025, is expected to account for just 3% of capacity revenues by 2035. Consumer Broadband and Milsatcom, meanwhile, are projected to represent more than half of total capacity revenues.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，卫星容量市场将超过 460 亿美元，比 2025 年的水平增加两倍多。视频分发是 2025 年最大的容量部分，预计到 2035 年将仅占容量收入的 3%。与此同时，消费者宽带和军事卫星通信预计将占总容量收入的一半以上。

paras.en: Declining bandwidth costs, driven by HTS systems and a growing number of NGSO projects, are accelerating satellite connectivity’s expansion into mass-market applications. Providers such as Starlink are increasingly competing with terrestrial broadband on price, strengthening satellite broadband’s position as a viable alternative to fiber and wireless connectivity in a growing range of markets.
paras.zh: 在 HTS 系统和越来越多的 NGSO 项目的推动下，带宽成本不断下降，正在加速卫星连接向大众市场应用的扩展。 Starlink 等提供商在价格上与地面宽带的竞争日益激烈，从而巩固了卫星宽带在越来越多的市场中作为光纤和无线连接的可行替代方案的地位。

paras.en: The transformation is also reshaping the role of GEO operators. Following a low of six commercial GEO orders in 2024, the market rebounded to 10 orders in 2025, with another 14 recorded by mid-September 2026. The renewed activity reflects evolving multi-orbit strategies and continued demand for GEO capabilities alongside rapidly expanding NGSO systems.
paras.zh: 这一转变也正在重塑 GEO 运营商的角色。继 2024 年 6 个商业 GEO 订单的低点之后，市场在 2025 年反弹至 10 个订单，到 2026 年 9 月中旬又记录了 14 个订单。新的活动反映了不断发展的多轨道战略以及对 GEO 能力的持续需求以及快速扩展的 NGSO 系统。

paras.en: “This is not a return to the traditional GEO model,” Buchs added. “Software-defined satellites, more flexible commercial models, sovereign requirements, and growing multi-orbit strategies are redefining GEO’s role. The future of satellite communications will not be GEO or NGSO—it will increasingly be an ecosystem in which each architecture serves distinct and complementary requirements.”
paras.zh: “这并不是对传统 GEO 模式的回归，”布克斯补充道。 “软件定义的卫星、更灵活的商业模式、主权要求和不断增长的多轨道战略正在重新定义 GEO 的角色。卫星通信的未来将不再是 GEO 或 NGSO，而是越来越成为一个生态系统，其中每种架构都满足不同且互补的需求。”

paras.en: The 33rd edition of Satellite Connectivity and Video Market provides a comprehensive assessment of global satellite service revenues, capacity demand, pricing trends, competitive dynamics, and operator strategies across video, broadband, enterprise, mobility, government, and defense markets through 2035.
paras.zh: 第 33 版《卫星连接和视频市场》对 2035 年之前的视频、宽带、企业、移动、政府和国防市场的全球卫星服务收入、容量需求、定价趋势、竞争动态以及运营商战略进行了全面评估。

paras.en: This edition introduces a granular bottom-up model for Enterprise Networks Back-up terminals, providing greater visibility into market demand and deployment trends. It also features a revised commercial Milsatcom model with deeper analysis by region, frequency band, and infrastructure type.
paras.zh: 该版本引入了企业网络备份终端的细粒度自下而上模型，提供了对市场需求和部署趋势的更深入的了解。它还具有修订后的商业军事卫星通信模型，可按地区、频段和基础设施类型进行更深入的分析。

paras.en: The report also provides an updated assessment of major developments shaping the satellite communications market, including the evolution of NGSO constellations, emerging Q/V frequency bands and other regulatory developments, government and defense spending trends, and the changing competitive dynamics between satellite and terrestrial connectivity.
paras.zh: 该报告还对塑造卫星通信市场的主要发展进行了最新评估，包括NGSO星座的演变、新兴的Q/V频段和其他监管发展、政府和国防支出趋势，以及卫星和地面连接之间不断变化的竞争动态。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球运营，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。
