paras.en: “Starlink remains critical to the defense of Ukraine, as it is the only system that cannot be jammed or blown up, at least for now,” Musk said. “Were Starlink to be turned off, the Ukrainian front line would collapse immediately. This is NOT a threat, it is simply a statement of fact.”
paras.zh: 马斯克表示：“星链对于乌克兰的防御仍然至关重要，因为它是唯一不会被干扰或炸毁的系统，至少目前如此。” “如果星链被关闭，乌克兰前线将立即崩溃。这不是威胁，这只是事实的陈述。”

paras.en: In a series of posts and replies, he called his critics “bloodthirsty warmongers” who “want the war to continue until every last man in Ukraine has died in a ditch.”
paras.zh: 在一系列帖子和回复中，他称批评者是“嗜血的战争贩子”，“希望战争继续下去，直到乌克兰的每一个人都死在沟里”。

paras.en: Hours later, responding to an X user comment that said “Zelensky needs to go,” Musk responded: “Yes.”
paras.zh: 几个小时后，在回复 X 用户评论“泽伦斯基需要下台”时，马斯克回答说：“是的。”

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Starlink speeds started returning to normal on Saturday night. Ukraine’s defense ministry said Saturday that the connection remained stable at over 250 mph. The Ukrainian military does not disclose the systems’ maximum operating speeds.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，星链速度已于周六晚开始恢复正常。乌克兰国防部周六表示，连接速度稳定在 250 英里/小时以上。乌克兰军方没有透露该系统的最大运行速度。

paras.en: Russia has barraged Ukraine over the past week, Zelenskyy said on Sunday, though he did not draw any direct link to the limitations.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周日表示，俄罗斯在过去一周对乌克兰进行了猛烈攻击，但他没有将其与这些限制联系起来。

paras.en: “This past week alone, Russia has launched around 1,600 guided aerial bombs, 48 missiles of various types, including ballistic missiles, and nearly 2,300 attack drones against Ukraine. Unfortunately, almost every day, these brutal strikes leave people killed and injured,” he said in a post on X.
paras.zh: “仅过去一周，俄罗斯就向乌克兰发射了约 1,600 枚制导炸弹、48 枚各种类型的导弹，包括弹道导弹，以及近 2,300 架攻击无人机。不幸的是，这些残酷的袭击几乎每天都会造成人员伤亡，”他在 X 上发帖称。

paras.en: The restrictions on Starlink services last week came amid a souring of relations between the White House and Ukraine, after President Donald Trump agreed to a diesel deal with Russia, waived sweeping sanctions, and called for Ukraine to get a new president.
paras.zh: 上周对星链服务的限制是在唐纳德·特朗普总统同意与俄罗斯达成柴油协议、放弃全面制裁并呼吁乌克兰选出新总统之后，白宫和乌克兰之间的关系恶化。

paras.en: The disruption to the service also coincided with what Ukrainian officials described as a temporary interruption to U.S. intelligence warnings about incoming Russian attacks.
paras.zh: 服务中断也恰逢乌克兰官员称美国情报部门对俄罗斯即将发动的袭击的警告暂时中断。

paras.en: In a response to Musk on Sunday, Ukrainian presidential adviser Serhiy Beskrestnov said: “It’s very strange that Elon Musk doesn’t know about the restrictions on Starlink in Ukraine.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统顾问谢尔盖·别斯克雷斯诺夫 (Serhiy Beskrestnov) 周日在回应马斯克时表示：“埃隆·马斯克不知道乌克兰对星链的限制，这很奇怪。”

paras.en: “Starlink does not work over Russian territory,” he said in a post on Telegram. “So we PHYSICALLY CANNOT USE COMMERCIAL STARLINK for deep strikes and mid-range strikes.”
paras.zh: “星链在俄罗斯领土上不起作用，”他在 Telegram 上发帖称。 “因此，我们实际上无法使用商业星链进行纵深打击和中程打击。”

paras.en: Serhii Sternenko, a former drone adviser to Ukraine’s defense ministry, said that using a civilian Starlink service for drone missions like Musk had described was “technically impossible.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰国防部前无人机顾问谢尔希·斯特年科(Serhii Sternenko)表示，像马斯克所描述的那样，使用民用星链服务执行无人机任务“在技术上是不可能的”。

paras.en: “For any satellite terminal to work while on the move, it had to be added to a special list and connected to the military Starshield system,” he posted on X. “All drone missions that required satellite communication could only be carried out using Starshield.”
paras.zh: 他在 X 上发帖称：“任何卫星终端要想在移动中工作，就必须将其添加到特殊列表中并连接到军用 Starshield 系统。所有需要卫星通信的无人机任务都只能使用 Starshield 来执行。”

paras.en: “We are very grateful to the United States and SpaceX for access to critically important satellite communications. Ukraine did not violate the terms of use,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们非常感谢美国和 SpaceX 获得至关重要的卫星通信。乌克兰没有违反使用条款，”他补充道。

paras.en: Ukrainian drone strikes deep within Russia have continued over the past week despite the Starlink issues.
paras.zh: 尽管存在星链问题，乌克兰无人机在过去一周仍在俄罗斯境内继续发动袭击。

paras.en: Asked whether he thought Trump or Musk had directly made the decision to limit Starlink, Zelenskyy told NBC News’ “Meet the Press” last week he did not know but thought “both” were involved. He said that if Trump decided tomorrow to lift the restriction, “it will immediately work as it was before.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否认为特朗普或马斯克直接做出了限制星链的决定时，泽连斯基上周在 NBC 新闻节目“会见媒体”节目中表示，他不知道，但认为“两人”都参与其中。他说，如果特朗普明天决定取消限制，“它将立即像以前一样发挥作用。”

paras.en: Asked whether he spoke to Musk on Thursday, Trump said: “I don’t want to comment on it, whether I called or whether somebody else called, doesn’t make any difference, I guess. The bottom line — he put it back.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他周四是否与马斯克通话时，特朗普表示：“我不想对此发表评论，我想无论是我打电话还是其他人打电话，都没有任何区别。最重要的是，他把电话放了回去。”

paras.en: Amid the dispute, there have been signs that Ukraine is keen for more control over its communications.
paras.zh: 在这场争端中，有迹象表明乌克兰渴望对其通讯加强控制。

paras.en: Last week, the country’s defense ministry announced a partnership with Nokia and Finnish satellite imagery firm ICEYE to develop a “sovereign satellite communications” system, with the two firms already working on building a Starlink-style satellite internet system “built on trusted European technology.”
paras.zh: 上周，该国国防部宣布与诺基亚和芬兰卫星图像公司 ICEYE 合作开发“主权卫星通信”系统，两家公司已经致力于构建“基于可信欧洲技术”的星链式卫星互联网系统。

paras.en: “Modern warfare has proven that reliable communications are a matter of national security,” Zelenskyy said of the deal at the time. “We must all rely on capabilities that we can control.”
paras.zh: “现代战争已经证明，可靠的通信关系到国家安全，”泽伦斯基当时谈到这笔交易时说道。 “我们都必须依赖我们可以控制的能力。”

paras.en: Musk’s ability to limit Starlink provides him “enormous leverage,” said Moritz Brake, a senior fellow at the Center for Advanced Security.
paras.zh: 高级安全中心高级研究员莫里茨·布雷克表示，马斯克限制星链的能力为他提供了“巨大的影响力”。

paras.en: “This is indeed one of the reasons why the European Union is pursuing independent space infrastructure capabilities, military capabilities, communication capabilities,” he told NBC News.
paras.zh: “这确实是欧盟追求独立太空基础设施能力、军事能力、通信能力的原因之一，”他告诉美国全国广播公司新闻。

paras.en: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius announced plans in 2025 to spend $39 billion in Germany’s defense space capabilities, but Brake said Europe still had plenty of ground to cover to match “the need for space assets in peace and war.”
paras.zh: 德国国防部长鲍里斯·皮斯托利斯宣布计划在 2025 年斥资 390 亿美元用于德国国防太空能力，但布雷克表示，欧洲仍有足够的空间来满足“和平与战争时期对太空资产的需求”。

paras.en: “This is something Ukraine is now experiencing on the sharp end,” Brake added.
paras.zh: “这就是乌克兰现在正在经历的最尖锐的事情，”布雷克补充道。

paras.en: There have been concerns about potential interference with Ukraine’s Starlink connection before, with a September 2022 interruption occurring during a pivotal push by Ukraine to retake territory from Russia.
paras.zh: 此前，人们一直担心乌克兰的星链连接可能受到干扰，2022 年 9 月，乌克兰在从俄罗斯手中夺回领土的关键行动中发生了一次中断。

paras.en: A Reuters report in 2025 cited three sources who alleged that Musk gave an order that disrupted the counteroffensive, triggering a communication blackout and leaving long-range artillery units reliant on Starlink struggling to hit their targets.
paras.zh: 路透社 2025 年的一篇报道援引三位消息人士的话称，马斯克下达的命令扰乱了反攻，引发了通讯中断，导致依赖星链的远程炮兵部队难以击中目标。

paras.en: A SpaceX spokesperson called the news agency’s reporting “inaccurate.”
paras.zh: SpaceX 发言人称该通讯社的报道“不准确”。

articles.title: Kangaroos escape with World Cup win after Fiji threatens upset
articles.author: Jon Healy

paras.en: Fri, 11 Sept, 7:50 pm, Final score, Rabbitohs 10, Knights 20
paras.zh: 9 月 11 日星期五，晚上 7:50，最终比分，Rabbitohs 10，Knights 20

paras.en: Kangaroos avoid Rugby League World Cup upset, beating Fiji 36-22 at Lang Park
paras.zh: 袋鼠避免橄榄球联盟世界杯爆冷，在郎公园以36-22击败斐济

paras.en: The Kangaroos have locked in their semifinal spot at the Rugby League World Cup, beating Fiji 36-22 after receiving an almighty scare in Brisbane.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队在布里斯班遭遇巨大恐慌后，以 36-22 击败斐济，锁定橄榄球联盟世界杯半决赛席位。

paras.en: Tom Trbojevic's second-half hat-trick helped Australia over the line after the Bati twice took the lead either side of half-time at Lang Park.
paras.zh: 汤姆·特尔博耶维奇下半场的帽子戏法帮助澳大利亚队在朗公园球场的半场比赛中两次取得领先。

paras.en: Fijian five-eighth Kurt Donoghoe was rightly named player of the match after laying on three tries and dictating terms for much of the game.
paras.zh: 斐济五八分之一库尔特·多诺霍（Kurt Donoghoe）在比赛的大部分时间里进行了三次尝试并规定了条款，理所当然地被评为本场比赛的最佳球员。

paras.en: "I think we need more from everyone," Kangaroos coach Kevin Walters said after the game.
paras.zh: “我认为我们需要每个人提供更多，”袋鼠队教练凯文·沃尔特斯赛后说道。

paras.en: "We know we can play better but let's give Fiji a lot of credit. At times it seemed like we were getting on top and they pulled themselves back into the game."
paras.zh: “我们知道我们可以打得更好，但让我们给予斐济很大的信任。有时，我们似乎已经处于领先地位，而他们又重新回到了比赛中。”

paras.en: Despite coming into the game as 50-1 outsiders, making three early errors and conceding the first try of the night, Fiji hit back through Semi Valemei and Taane Milne to lead 10-6 after half an hour.
paras.zh: 尽管斐济队以50-1的局外人身份进入比赛，早早犯了三个错误，并在当晚的第一次尝试中失利，但斐济队在半小时后通过塞米·瓦莱梅和塔恩·米尔恩进行反击，以10-6领先。

paras.en: For the second straight game, Kevin Walters's side looked vulnerable in defence and struggled with their last-tackle options, but still led at half-time after some James Tedesco brilliance led to a try for Sam Walker on debut.
paras.zh: 连续第二场比赛，凯文·沃尔特斯的球队在防守上显得脆弱，并在最后的铲球选择上苦苦挣扎，但在詹姆斯·特德斯科的一些才华导致萨姆·沃克首次亮相后，半场结束时仍然领先。

paras.en: But again the Fijians hit back, with Valemei's second retaking the lead for the underdogs just after the break and Solomone Saukuru appearing to extend soon after, only for the bunker to rule a line-ball obstruction.
paras.zh: 但斐济队再次发起反击，中场休息后瓦莱梅的第二个进球为弱旅重新取得领先，所罗门·索库鲁似乎很快就延长了球速，结果沙坑出现了直线球障碍。

paras.en: The Kangaroos immediately went up the other end and Tom Trbojevic dove in for his first of three straight tries to snuff out the Fijian challenge.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队立即冲上另一端，汤姆·特尔博耶维奇（Tom Trbojevic）投入了连续三场尝试中的第一次，以消灭斐济队的挑战。

paras.en: Valemei completed his hat-trick late on before Jacob Preston added Australia's sixth shortly before full-time to lock in their semifinal berth, playing a double-header with the similarly undefeated Jillaroos at the Sydney Football Stadium next Sunday.
paras.zh: 瓦莱梅在晚些时候完成了他的帽子戏法，随后雅各布·普雷斯顿在比赛结束前不久为澳大利亚队打入第六球，锁定了半决赛席位，并于下周日在悉尼足球场与同样保持不败的吉拉鲁斯队进行了两场比赛。

paras.en: Fiji will have a chance to push for a surprise final-four spot if it can pull off an upset win over New Zealand next week, which suddenly does not seem so far-fetched.
paras.zh: 如果斐济能在下周爆冷击败新西兰，那么他们将有机会出人意料地进入四强，而这突然显得不再那么牵强。

paras.en: Look back at all the action in our live blog below.
paras.zh: 回顾一下下面我们实时博客中的所有操作。

paras.en: Live scores: Kangaroos vs Fiji at Lang Park
paras.zh: 现场比分：袋鼠 vs 斐济 在 Lang Park

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: Well, after a weekend of absolutely demolition derbies, what a finale that turned out to be.
paras.zh: 好吧，在经历了一个周末的绝对毁灭性的德比之后，结果是多么精彩的结局啊。

paras.en: Credit to the Kangaroos for pulling out another victory to move to 2-0, but the performance of Fiji surely put the rest of the tournament on notice.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队再次取得胜利，将比分追至2-0，这值得称赞，但斐济队的表现无疑让本届赛事的其余比赛备受瞩目。

paras.en: It will be very interesting to see how the final round of pool games plays out.
paras.zh: 看看最后一轮台球比赛的结果将会非常有趣。

paras.en: Api Koroisau sees no reason Fiji can't push for the semis
paras.zh: 阿皮·科罗伊绍认为斐济没有理由不能晋级半决赛

paras.en: Fiji captain Api Koroisau says the Bati know they can press the best, and they knew it before this performance.
paras.zh: 斐济队队长阿皮·科罗伊绍 (Api Koroisau) 表示，巴蒂队知道他们可以发挥出最好的水平，他们在这场比赛之前就知道这一点。

paras.en: The Kiwis are next up, with a victory and a semifinal berth not seeming so crazy.
paras.zh: 新西兰队紧随其后，他们取得了胜利并进入了半决赛，看起来并不那么疯狂。

paras.en: "Even before the game we had a lot of belief and we showed that the way we played. That belief's only grown going into this game against New Zealand."
paras.zh: “甚至在比赛之前，我们就抱有很大的信念，并且我们通过比赛方式展示了这一点。这种信念在对阵新西兰的比赛中只会增强。”

paras.en: He says during the game they felt a historic night was within reach, but it didn't weight them down.
paras.zh: 他说，在比赛期间，他们感觉历史性的夜晚即将到来，但这并没有让他们感到沮丧。

paras.en: "We were feeling really good. I don't think we were that far off. It was definitely there but I don't think it hindered us at all. They just took their moments."
paras.zh: “我们感觉非常好。我不认为我们离得那么远。它确实在那里，但我认为它根本没有阻碍我们。他们只是抓住了时机。”

paras.en: Coach Kevin Walters says world-class players in Fiji and the slippery conditions helped level the playing field tonight, but admits the Kangaroos need to improve.
paras.zh: 教练凯文·沃尔特斯表示，斐济的世界级球员和湿滑的条件帮助今晚的比赛环境变得公平，但他也承认袋鼠队需要改进。

paras.en: "I think we need more from everyone. We know we can play better.
paras.zh: “我认为我们需要每个人提供更多。我们知道我们可以打得更好。

paras.en: "But let's give Fiji a lot of credit. At times it seemed like we were getting on top and they pulled themselves back into the game."
paras.zh: “但是，让我们给予斐济很大的信任。有时，我们似乎已经取得了领先，但他们又重新回到了比赛中。”

paras.en: Walters has used the first two games to give everyone a run, but now it's about finding his best gameday squad.
paras.zh: 沃尔特斯在前两场比赛中为每个人提供了机会，但现在的重点是找到他最好的比赛日阵容。

paras.en: "[The team is] not set. I've never been set on next week or the week after or the week after that. We'll have a good chat.
paras.zh: “[团队]还没有确定。我从来没有确定过下周或下周或下下周。我们会好好聊一聊。

paras.en: "I'm happy with every one of the players in the squad. Individually every one can get better and as a group we can get better."
paras.zh: “我对球队中的每一位球员都很满意。每个人个人都可以变得更好，作为一个团队，我们也可以变得更好。”

paras.en: Walters is giving no hints as to whether he will lean towards James Tedesco or Reece Walsh at fullback. And the halves are also a question with Cameron Munster expected to come back in, leaving Tom Dearden and Sam Walker as the candidates for halfback.
paras.zh: 沃尔特斯没有暗示他是否会倾向于詹姆斯·特德斯科或里斯·沃尔什担任后卫。半场也是一个问题，卡梅伦·蒙斯特预计会回归，汤姆·迪尔登和萨姆·沃克成为中卫的候选人。

paras.en: Bradman Best on boxing great Jeff Fenech's health battle
paras.zh: 布拉德曼·贝斯特谈拳击巨星杰夫·费内奇的健康之战

paras.en: Kangaroos centre Bradman Best is engaged to Jeff Fenech's daughter, Kayla.
paras.zh: 袋鼠中锋布拉德曼·贝斯特与杰夫·费内奇的女儿凯拉订婚了。

paras.en: Fenech is in hospital awaiting heart surgery after viral infection and Best said he spoke to him earlier today.
paras.zh: 费内奇因病毒感染而在医院等待心脏手术，贝斯特说他今天早些时候与他进行了交谈。

paras.en: "He's gone through a lot. He's had heart surgery before and for him to be back there, it's hard to sum up in words," Best tells ABC Sport.
paras.zh: “他经历了很多事情。他之前接受过心脏手术，对于他能回到那里，很难用语言来概括，”贝斯特告诉美国广播公司体育频道。

paras.en: "I'm so inspired by him, what he's done, he's always helping me and I know the whole Fenech family is doing it tough right now.
paras.zh: “他所做的一切让我深受启发，他总是帮助我，我知道整个费内奇家族现在都在艰难地度过。

paras.en: "I was definitely wanting to do him proud tonight."
paras.zh: “今晚我绝对想让他感到骄傲。”

paras.en: Fenech says he wants to walk his daughter down the aisle in a couple of weeks' time.
paras.zh: 费内奇说，他想在几周后陪女儿走上红毯。

paras.en: "He loves his daughter so he doesn't want to miss it. It's a special thing to do."
paras.zh: “他爱他的女儿，所以他不想错过这个机会。这是一件很特别的事情。”

paras.en: Australia's World Cup semifinals locked in
paras.zh: 澳大利亚世界杯半决赛锁定胜局

paras.en: With the win tonight, the Kangaroos lock in their semifinal spot and we now know when they'll be playing.
paras.zh: 随着今晚的胜利，袋鼠队锁定了半决赛席位，我们现在知道他们什么时候比赛。

paras.en: The Kangaroos and Jillaroos will play a double header at the Sydney Football Stadium on Sunday, November 8.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队和 Jillaroos 队将于 11 月 8 日星期日在悉尼足球场进行一场双赛。

paras.en: The men's game will be played at 8:05pm AEDT, after the Jillaroos' game from 5:45pm AEDT.
paras.zh: 男子比赛将于澳大利亚东部夏令时间下午 8:05 进行，Jillaroos 的比赛将于澳大利亚东部夏令时间下午 5:45 举行。

paras.en: The Bati and the Kangaroos are joined in a huge huddle.
paras.zh: 巴蒂和袋鼠聚集在一起。

paras.en: One of the Fijian trainers is leading the group in a prayer and both teams are clapping as the Fijian boys sing. It's really nice moment.
paras.zh: 一名斐济教练正在带领大家祈祷，斐济男孩们唱歌时，两队都在鼓掌。这真是美好的时刻。

paras.en: I feel a little sorry for Tom Trbojevic, who swapped jerseys with Manly teammate Caleb Navale and then had to do an interview with host broadcaster Channel Seven, so he missed out on that moment.
paras.zh: 我为汤姆·特尔博耶维奇感到有点遗憾，他与曼利队队友凯莱布·纳瓦莱交换了球衣，然后不得不接受主持人广播公司第七频道的采访，所以他错过了那一刻。

paras.en: After the prayer, James Tedesco thanks the Fijians.
paras.zh: 祈祷结束后，詹姆斯·特德斯科感谢斐济人。

paras.en: "You did yourselves and your country proud. Love and respect."
paras.zh: “你们为自己和国家感到骄傲。爱和尊重。”

paras.en: Kurt Donoghoe is player of the match in a losing side
paras.zh: 库尔特·多诺霍 (Kurt Donoghoe) 在失败的球队中获得本场比赛最佳球员

paras.en: That's a remarkable effort by the Dolphins utility in a losing side against a Kangaroos unit full of superstars.
paras.zh: 这是海豚队在输给充满超级巨星的袋鼠队的情况下做出的非凡努力。

paras.en: But I can't say it was the wrong call. He was excellent out there, running powerfully through the middle and throwing the final pass for three tries.
paras.zh: 但我不能说这是错误的决定。他在场上表现出色，在中场有力地跑动，并三度传出最后一传。

paras.en: FULL-TIME: The Kangaroos escape Fiji with a 36-22 win
paras.zh: 全场比赛：袋鼠队以 36-22 战胜斐济

paras.en: The siren sounds as Taane Milne makes a goose of himself by farting around in a tackle with Sam Walker, and no-one seems to appreciate his antics all that much.
paras.zh: 塔恩·米尔恩 (Taane Milne) 在与萨姆·沃克 (Sam Walker) 铲球时放屁，大笑不止，但似乎没有人欣赏他的滑稽动作。

paras.en: In the end, Australia escapes with a 14-point win and it really does feel like an escape after the effort from Fiji tonight.
paras.zh: 最终，澳大利亚队以 14 分的优势逃脱了困境，在今晚斐济队的努力之后，这确实感觉像是一场逃脱。

paras.en: The Kangaroos pack a scrum on their 10m line and should end the game with the ball in hand.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队在 10m 线上进行争抢，应该以控球结束比赛。

paras.en: Credit the Bati for not throwing in the towel.
paras.zh: 感谢巴蒂没有认输。

paras.en: A penalty once again puts Australia in Fijian territory and Jacob Preston does what he does best, storming onto a short ball from Tom Dearden and bursting through the gap to score.
paras.zh: 点球再次让澳大利亚队进入斐济领土，雅各布·普雷斯顿做了他最擅长的事情，接住汤姆·迪尔登的短球，突破空档得分。

paras.en: 75' The boos ring out as Gerard Sutton spoils the party
paras.zh: 75' 杰拉德·萨顿破坏了聚会，嘘声响起

paras.en: Jack Bostock marks in the in-goal and takes off for the 20m tap, but in his haste he's tapped about a metre too far forward.
paras.zh: 杰克·博斯托克 (Jack Bostock) 进球后，起身准备 20m 的射门，但由于过于匆忙，他的射门距离太远了约一米。

paras.en: Bostock unleashes Tom Trbojevic for a 70m effort and what looks like his fourth try, but Gerard Sutton calls Bostock back for his tap.
paras.zh: 博斯托克释放了汤姆·特博耶维奇 (Tom Trbojevic) 70m 的努力，这似乎是他的第四次尝试，但杰拉德·萨顿 (Gerard Sutton) 叫来博斯托克回击。

paras.en: Great placement by Brandon Wakeham forces Bradman Best to mark in front of his line, and he's bundled back over the dead-ball line.
paras.zh: 布兰登·韦克汉姆 (Brandon Wakeham) 的出色定位迫使布拉德曼·贝斯特 (Bradman Best) 在他的防线前面盯防，然后他又回到了死球线。

paras.en: A couple of penalties help them up field and gets them a fresh set.
paras.zh: 一些点球帮助他们在场上取得了新的成绩。

paras.en: They line up out the left and once again Kurt Donoghoe catches Tome Trbojevic in no man's land and sends Semi Valemei over for his third try of the night.
paras.zh: 他们在左侧排成一列，库尔特·多诺霍再次在无人区接住托梅·特尔博耶维奇，并派出塞米·瓦莱梅进行当晚的第三次尝试。

paras.en: Brandon Wakeham converts and Fiji trails by just eight. 30-22.
paras.zh: 布兰登·韦克汉姆 (Brandon Wakeham) 转变态度，而斐济仅落后 8 分。 30-22。

paras.en: Credit to Brisbane for 41,108 people turning out to this game after a weekend full of games that were effectively no-contest events.
paras.zh: 感谢布里斯班，在经历了一个实际上是无比赛项目的周末比赛后，有 41,108 人观看了这场比赛。

paras.en: Uh oh. Tom Trbojevic is in a mood all of a sudden, floating from the right wing and creating extra numbers on the left.
paras.zh: 呃哦。汤姆·特尔博耶维奇（Tom Trbojevic）突然心情大好，从右翼飘过，在左翼创造了额外的机会。

paras.en: The Fijian scrambles to deny him and Sam Walker rolls in a grubber, with prop Mitchell Priest knocking the ball out of the reach of James Tedesco.
paras.zh: 斐济人争先恐后地挡出球门，山姆·沃克（Sam Walker）在地面上翻滚，而支持者米切尔·普里斯特（Mitchell Priest）则将球击出詹姆斯·特德斯科（James Tedesco）够不到的地方。

paras.en: A break down the left by Jack Bostock and Bradman Best gets the Kangaroos rolling and they simply put it through the hands to send Tom Trbojevic over on the right for his third try of the night.
paras.zh: 杰克·博斯托克（Jack Bostock）和布拉德曼·贝斯特（Bradman Best）在左路突破，让袋鼠队滚滚向前，他们简单地将球传给右路的汤姆·特尔博耶维奇（Tom Trbojevic），这是他当晚的第三次尝试。

paras.en: Brandon Wakeham's short-side kick is high and reeled in by ... Kurt Donoghoe?
paras.zh: 布兰登·韦克汉姆 (Brandon Wakeham) 的短边踢球很高，被……库尔特·多诺霍 (Kurt Donoghoe) 卷入？

paras.en: He tries to catch and ground it all in one motion but can't quite pull it off.
paras.zh: 他试图用一个动作接住所有球并落地，但没能完全成功。

paras.en: 60' An untimely knock-on by Bradman Best
paras.zh: 60' 布拉德曼·贝斯特不合时宜的敲门

paras.en: The Kangaroos go within centimetres of the touch line on the left, then Blayke Brailey finds some space from dummy half and hits Bradman Best. But the debutant centre knocks on as the defence blindsides him.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队在距离左侧边线几厘米的范围内移动，然后布莱克·布莱利从假人半场找到了一些空间，击中了布拉德曼·贝斯特。但这位首次亮相的中锋在防守时却出其不意。

paras.en: Fiji takes the ball back 60 metres from the tryline.
paras.zh: 斐济在距试线线 60 米处将球带回。

paras.en: James Tedesco continues his man-of-the-match campaign with a grubber that takes a deflection and ends up in the path of Tom Trbojevic to scoop up and dive over.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·特德斯科 (James Tedesco) 继续他的全场最佳球员征战，他的一记抓地球发生偏转，最终停在汤姆·特博耶维奇 (Tom Trbojevic) 的路径上，被铲起并扑过去。

paras.en: That's a bit lucky for the Kangaroos who were in that field position after Kurt Donoghoe knocked a pass down.
paras.zh: 对于在库尔特·多诺霍传球后处于该位置的袋鼠队来说有点幸运。

paras.en: It would be a shame if this turns into a blowout from here. Fiji deserves better than that.
paras.zh: 如果从这里变成井喷，那就太可惜了。斐济值得更好的。

paras.en: Fiji has been doing this without Api Koroisau. Surely the Bati hooker will come back on soon to make a real impact.
paras.zh: 斐济在没有 Api Koroisau 的情况下一直在这样做。当然，巴蒂妓女很快就会回归并产生真正的影响。

paras.en: Fiji is penalised for a late shot on Blayke Brailey and the Kangaroos will take a shot at goal from 20 metres back, 19 in from touch.
paras.zh: 斐济因布雷克·布雷利 (Blayke Brailey) 最后时刻的射门受到处罚，袋鼠队将从 20 米后、距离触球 19 英寸的位置射门。

paras.en: Walker slots it and the Kangaroos lead 18-16 with 25 minutes left.
paras.zh: 沃克打进一球，袋鼠队在还剩 25 分钟时以 18-16 领先。

paras.en: The Aussie halfback is penalised for a high shot on a rampaging Sunia Turuva and he quickly turns around and blows up deluxe.
paras.zh: 这位澳大利亚中卫因对狂暴的苏尼亚·图鲁瓦的高射门而受到处罚，他很快转身并炸毁了豪华队。

paras.en: I think he's asking for his forwards to help him out in defence, and he's not wrong. Your halfback shouldn't be getting isolated in that situation.
paras.zh: 我认为他要求前锋帮助他防守，他没有错。在这种情况下，你的中卫不应该被孤立。

paras.en: Hey Jon it’s me georgie. The vibes are off here at Lang park. Thought we had it in the bag. Need Bostock to play like last week.
paras.zh: 嘿乔恩，我是乔吉。朗公园的气氛十分热闹。以为我们已经把它放在包里了。需要博斯托克像上周一样发挥。

paras.en: Obviously there will be questions asked about whether the Kangaroos took Fiji lightly after this performance, and some in the peanut gallery feel like the fans came to the ground with the same energy.
paras.zh: 显然会有人问袋鼠队在这场表演后是否轻视了斐济队，花生画廊里的一些人感觉球迷们带着同样的能量来到了地面。

paras.en: It's a two-try swing as Australia goes over
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队过去了，这是两次尝试

paras.en: On the back of the penalty for obstruction at one end, Blayke Brailey skips out of dummy half and shows the defence the ball before passing to Sam Walker. He finds James Tedesco, who fires a brilliant cut-out ball to Tom Trbojevic to dive over on the right wing.
paras.zh: 在一端因阻碍而受到罚球的情况下，布莱克·布莱利跳出假人半场，向防守队员展示球，然后传给萨姆·沃克。他找到了詹姆斯·特德斯科，后者将一记精彩的空切球传给汤姆·特尔博耶维奇，后者飞向右翼。

paras.en: What a turnaround from the no try at the other end.
paras.zh: 与另一端的“不尝试”相比，这是多么大的转变啊。

paras.en: 47' Fiji are in again, but it's rule no try on the field
paras.zh: 47' 斐济再次晋级，但规则是不能上场尝试

paras.en: Solomone Saukuru bursts through a hole off another Kurt Donoghoe ball, but Gerard Sutton says no try on the field.
paras.zh: 所罗门·索库鲁 (Solomon Saukuru) 用库尔特·多诺霍 (Kurt Donoghoe) 的另一个球冲破了一个洞，但杰拉德·萨顿 (Gerard Sutton) 表示不要在球场上尝试。

paras.en: And the bunker upholds the call as Elijah Keung is found to have impeded David Fifita.
paras.zh: 由于 Elijah Keung 被发现阻碍了 David Fifita，因此沙坑维持了这一决定。

paras.en: Fiji goes left and once again Tom Trbojevic is in no man's land, beaten by a superb cut-out pass by Kurt Donoghoe to Semi Valemei to dive over for his second of the night.
paras.zh: 斐济队向左进攻，汤姆·特尔博耶维奇再次陷入无人区，库尔特·多诺霍向塞米·瓦莱梅的一记精彩的空切传球击败了他，这是他当晚的第二个进球。

paras.en: Brandon Wakeham converts and the Bati are back in front 16-12.
paras.zh: 布兰登·韦克汉姆 (Brandon Wakeham) 转变，巴蒂队以 16-12 重新领先。

paras.en: 42' Bostock is outleapt and Fiji will get the first chance of the half
paras.zh: 42' 博斯托克出局，斐济获得半场第一次机会

paras.en: The kick goes out right and Ronald Philitoga beats Jack Bostock in the air to come down with the ball.
paras.zh: 球从右侧传出，罗纳德·菲利托加在空中击败了杰克·博斯托克，将球落下。

paras.en: He offloads and Fiji look certain to score, but Bradman Best knocks the ball down.
paras.zh: 他卸下了重担，斐济看起来肯定会得分，但布拉德曼·贝斯特将球击倒。

paras.en: Reuben Cotter picks it up in an offside position, but it's just called a knock-on.
paras.zh: 鲁本·科特 (Reuben Cotter) 在越位位置接球，但这只是所谓的连锁反应。

paras.en: It's a wobbly old one and fielded by Tom Dearden, who finds Pat Carrigan to barrel into a shuddering defence.
paras.zh: 这是一支摇摇欲坠的老球队，由汤姆·迪尔登（Tom Dearden）派出，他发现帕特·卡里根（Pat Carrigan）冲进了令人颤抖的防守。

paras.en: Fiji's forward pack is dominating through the middle and the trio of Api Koroisau, Brandon Wakeham and Kurt Donoghoe - effectively all hookers - is keeping the momentum rolling, then icing chances once they get into the red zone.
paras.zh: 斐济队的前锋在中路占据主导地位，阿皮·科罗伊索、布兰登·韦克汉姆和库尔特·多诺霍三人组——实际上都是妓女——正在保持势头，一旦进入红区，就会给机会带来机会。

paras.en: Australia's defence is looking really flimsy through the middle and on the edges. Tom Trbojevic is looking very much like a man not used to playing on the wing.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚的防守从中间到边缘看起来都很脆弱。汤姆·特尔博耶维奇看起来很像一个不习惯打边路的人。

paras.en: One concern for Fiji is the loss of fullback Bayleigh Bentley-Hape, but Sunia Turuva is an able deputy back there and Ronald Philitoga has brought some much-needed energy off the right wing.
paras.zh: 斐济队的一个担忧是失去后卫贝利·本特利-哈普，但苏尼亚·图鲁瓦是一名能干的副后卫，而罗纳德·菲利托加则为右翼带来了一些急需的能量。

paras.en: HALF-TIME: Australia leads Fiji 12-10 at the break
paras.zh: 半场结束：澳大利亚12-10领先斐济

paras.en: Jack Bostock leaps over Ronald Philitoga right on the siren, but loses the ball in the air (Gerard Sutton called it a knock-on but I don't think it was).
paras.zh: 杰克·博斯托克 (Jack Bostock) 在警报响起时跳过了罗纳德·菲利托加 (Ronald Philitoga)，但在空中丢了球（杰拉德·萨顿 (Gerard Sutton) 称其为连锁攻击，但我认为并非如此）。

paras.en: In the end, there's no time for a captain's challenge and the teams head to half-time with the Kangaroos suddenly in a real tussle.
paras.zh: 最后，没有时间向队长发起挑战，球队进入中场休息时，袋鼠队突然陷入了一场真正的混战。

paras.en: Tom Dearden and Sam Walker aren't making great last-tackle plays at the moment and there's another one as Dearden runs it and, instead of going through the hands out to the left, tries the long ball and puts Bradman Best in the firing line of winger Ronald Philitoga.
paras.zh: 汤姆·迪尔登和萨姆·沃克目前在最后的铲球表现不佳，迪尔登跑动时还有另一次进攻，他没有向左传球，而是尝试长传，将布拉德曼·贝斯特放在边锋罗纳德·菲利托加的火线上。

paras.en: Best offloads and Jacob Preston manufactures a decentish chip, but the Kangaroos definitely look out of sorts.
paras.zh: 最好的卸载和雅各布·普雷斯顿制造了一个不错的芯片，但袋鼠看起来肯定不太好。

paras.en: The Kangaroos are tackled on the fifth right on halfway and James Tedesco skips out of dummy half. It's a risky move, but the returning skipper finds the space in behind the ruck and gets through the line.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队在中场右侧第五区被拦截，詹姆斯·特德斯科跳出了假人半区。这是一个冒险的举动，但返回的船长找到了拉克后面的空间并穿过了防线。

paras.en: He pops a ball to Sam Walker, who finds Tom Trbojevic. The defence shuts him down, but Walker comes again and gleefully accepts the offload to score under the posts.
paras.zh: 他将球传给萨姆·沃克，后者找到了汤姆·特博耶维奇。防守限制了他，但沃克再次上来，高兴地接受分担，在门柱下得分。

paras.en: Cameron Murray, Keaon Koloamatangi and Lindsay Smith leave the field.
paras.zh: 卡梅伦·穆雷、基昂·科洛阿马唐吉和林赛·史密斯离场。

paras.en: Pat Carrigan, Tino Fa'asuamaleaui and Jacob Preston replace them.
paras.zh: 帕特·卡里根 (Pat Carrigan)、蒂诺·法阿苏玛莱伊 (Tino Fa'asuamaleaui) 和雅各布·普雷斯顿 (Jacob Preston) 接替了他们。

paras.en: So Reuben Cotter will shift into the middle. Kevin Walters will hope the changes can restore some order.
paras.zh: 所以鲁本·科特（Reuben Cotter）将移到中间。凯文·沃尔特斯希望这些改变能够恢复一些秩序。

paras.en: The Bati have been the better team so far tonight and it at last shows on the scoreboard as Brandon Wakeham rolls in a grubber for Taane Milne to dive in.
paras.zh: 今晚到目前为止，巴蒂队是一支更好的球队，当布兰登·韦克汉姆 (Brandon Wakeham) 为塔恩·米尔恩 (Taane Milne) 投球时，这一点终于出现在记分牌上。

paras.en: That comes on the back of a shocking kick from Tom Dearden that gifted Sunia Turuva, completely beaten for size by Jack Bostock, a mark deep in his in-goal.
paras.zh: 汤姆·迪尔登 (Tom Dearden) 的一记令人震惊的踢球给了苏尼亚·图鲁瓦 (Sunia Turuva)，后者在尺寸上完全被杰克·博斯托克 (Jack Bostock) 击败，在他的球门深处打进了一记进球。

paras.en: Then they gave away a penalty in the ruck, and the defence on the line looks completely out of sync every time Fiji gets close.
paras.zh: 然后他们在比赛中罚丢了一个点球，每次斐济逼近时，防线上的防守看起来都完全不同步。

paras.en: Fiji almost breaks through the middle via Waqa Blake but it's called back for an obstruction by Mitchell Priest, who was standing in the line impeding Blayke Brailey.
paras.zh: 斐济几乎通过瓦卡·布莱克（Waqa Blake）突破中线，但由于米​​切尔·普里斯特（Mitchell Priest）的阻挡而被召回，米切尔·普里斯特站在队伍中阻碍布莱克·布雷利（Blayke Brailey）。

paras.en: Even so, the defence from the Kangaroos was caught napping, with Keaon Koloamatangi not filling in the gap from the left after the ball went right. So when the ball came back the other way there was room under the posts.
paras.zh: 即便如此，袋鼠队的防守还是打瞌睡，球传到右边后，基昂·科洛阿马坦吉（Keaon Koloamatangi）没有填补左侧的空缺。因此，当球从另一个方向返回时，门柱下方就有空间。

paras.en: We saw two Kangaroos intercept tries last week and Kotoni Staggs tries to nab one himself here as Fiji fires it left.
paras.zh: 上周我们看到了两起袋鼠拦截尝试，当斐济向左开火时，科托尼·斯塔格斯试图亲自拦截其中一只。

paras.en: In the end, the leaping Aussie centre can only get one hand to it as he sticks his mitt out, probably saving a try on the overlap.
paras.zh: 最后，这位跳跃的澳大利亚中锋在伸出手套时只能用一只手触球，可能会节省一次重叠的尝试。

paras.en: Kitione Kautoga makes good metres down the left and has a chance for a quick play-the-ball but Blayke Brailey hangs on too long and is pinged for a penalty.
paras.zh: 基蒂内·考托加（Kitione Kaautoga）在左路取得不错的传球机会，并有机会快速传球，但布莱克·布莱利（Blayke Brailey）坚持得太久，被罚点球。

paras.en: Fiji will get into Australian territory again and look to take the lead.
paras.zh: 斐济将再次进入澳大利亚领土，并有望占据领先地位。

paras.en: What a ball by Donoghoe and Valemei is over for Fiji!
paras.zh: 多诺霍和瓦莱梅为斐济举办的一场精彩的舞会结束了！

paras.en: Fiji wastes no time after packing the scrum and gets into the red zone.
paras.zh: 斐济在收拾好scrum后立即进入红色区域。

paras.en: First real chance they get and five-eighth Kurt Donoghoe spots Tom Trbojevic in off his wing, firing a bullet pass out to winger Semi Valemei, who dives in for Fiji's first of the night.
paras.zh: 他们获得了第一个真正的机会，八分之五的库尔特·多诺霍（Kurt Donoghoe）发现汤姆·特尔博耶维奇（Tom Trbojevic）从他的侧翼射门，向边锋塞米·瓦莱梅（Semi Valemei）开枪，塞米·瓦莱梅（Semi Valemei）为斐济当晚的第一个进球。

paras.en: The Fijian defence is rushing and frustrating the Aussies, and a gang tackle forces the ball out of Tom Trbojevic's grasp on the 40m line.
paras.zh: 斐济队的防守非常猛烈，令澳大利亚队感到沮丧，在 40m 线上，一次铲球迫使汤姆·特博耶维奇 (Tom Trbojevic) 抓不住球。

paras.en: Here comes the Bati's best chance so far.
paras.zh: 巴蒂迄今为止最好的机会来了。

paras.en: It looked like there might have been an obstruction as the Kangaroos shifted left, but lucky for the Aussies they didn't score, so the bunker couldn't get involved.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队向左移动时，看起来可能有障碍物，但幸运的是，澳大利亚队没有得分，所以沙坑无法介入。

paras.en: Instead they spun it right and Sam Walker thought he saw space in behind, but his grubber was quickly snaffled up by Bayleigh Bentley-Hape.
paras.zh: 相反，他们向右旋转，萨姆·沃克以为他看到了后面的空间，但他的抓斗很快就被贝利·本特利·哈普抓住了。

paras.en: You might need to hit a refresh, Phillip.
paras.zh: 你可能需要刷新一下，菲利普。

paras.en: James Tedesco, welcome back to international rugby league
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·特德斯科，欢迎回到国际橄榄球联盟

paras.en: The Kangaroos get into shape for a right-side shift and David Fifita is out the back as James Tedesco goes to the line. But the fullback hits Kotoni Staggs with a perfect short ball to send him through a yawning gap and over the tryline on his home patch.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队已经做好了向右移动的准备，大卫·菲菲塔（David Fifita）在后场，詹姆斯·特德斯科（James Tedesco）走上罚球线。但这位后卫用一记完美的短球击中了科托尼·斯塔格斯，让他穿过了一个巨大的差距，越过了主场的尝试线。

paras.en: The Kangaroos look certain to score down the left before Daniel Saifiti arrives out of nowhere to cut down Tom Dearden 3 metres short. Then Waqa Blake makes a flying catch to intercept the bouncing ball.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队看起来肯定会从左路得分，但丹尼尔·赛菲蒂突然到来，将汤姆·迪尔登 (Tom Dearden) 砍下 3 米。然后瓦卡·布莱克（Waqa Blake）飞身接球拦截弹跳的球。

paras.en: But Fiji knocks on again! Giving the Kangaroos yet another chance.
paras.zh: 但斐济又来了！又给了袋鼠一次机会。

paras.en: Fiji gets a set restart and a quick play-the-ball, and Api Koroisau looks to exploit from dummy half, but his no-look pass is out in front of Waqa Blake and he can't handle.
paras.zh: 斐济队重新开始并快速传球，阿皮·科罗伊索（Api Koroisau）希望从假半场利用球权，但他的无视传球在瓦卡·布莱克（Waqa Blake）面前，他无法处理。

paras.en: 3' Early error by the Bati (and the referee)
paras.zh: 3' 巴蒂（和裁判）早期失误

paras.en: Sam Walker's first kick is long and straight to winger Semi Valemei and he drops it cold.
paras.zh: 萨姆·沃克的第一脚长而直，踢向边锋塞米·瓦莱梅，但他冷冷地踢了出去。

paras.en: It's definitely gone backwards, as evidenced by him making contact in front of the 20m line and the ball bouncing behind it, but referee Gerard Sutton calls a knock-on.
paras.zh: 这肯定是倒退了，从他在 20m 线前面接触到球在后面弹起就可以证明这一点，但裁判杰拉德·萨顿 (Gerard Sutton) 判定为碰撞。

paras.en: The Fijians spin it right early in their first set and fullback Bayleigh Bentley-Hape shows great speed to poke his nose through, but is eventually reined in by Bradman Best on debut.
paras.zh: 斐济队在第一盘一开始就扭转了局面，后卫贝利·本特利-哈普展现出了极快的速度，但最终在首秀中被布拉德曼·贝斯特控制住。

paras.en: James Tedesco sends the kick-off deep to Kurt Donoghoe to resume his international career.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·特德斯科将开球传给库尔特·多诺霍，以恢复他的国家队生涯。

paras.en: The Fijians' Noqu Masu prayer has been sung and the Kangaroos are in position to kick off.
paras.zh: 斐济人的 Noqu Masu 祷文已经唱完，袋鼠队已准备好开球。

paras.en: Let's hope everyone shows the appropriate reverence lest they be pilloried by certain members of the media.
paras.zh: 希望大家给予适当的尊重，以免遭到某些媒体的嘲笑。

paras.en: The lyrics are on the big screens at either end of the stadium, which is a nice touch for any neutrals.
paras.zh: 歌词显示在体育场两端的大屏幕上，这对任何中立者来说都是一个很好的接触。

paras.en: Kevin Walters is trialling some new combinations this week, with Tom Dearden and Sam Walker auditioning to be the new halfback to replace the injured Mitchell Moses going forward.
paras.zh: 凯文·沃尔特斯本周正在尝试一些新的组合，汤姆·迪尔登和萨姆·沃克正在试镜成为新的中卫，以取代受伤的米切尔·摩西。

paras.en: James Tedesco replaces Reece Walsh at fullback and is named captain for his first Test since 2023.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·特德斯科 (James Tedesco) 取代里斯·沃尔什 (Reece Walsh) 出任后卫，并被任命为队长，这是他自 2023 年以来的首次测试。

paras.en: Walters obviously wants to give a few of his big names a rest, so it will be interesting to see who out of Pat Carrigan, Cameron Munster, Latrell Mitchell and Harry Grant stays on the bench tonight. It's not expected to be a particularly taxing affair, but injuries can come out of nowhere.
paras.zh: 沃尔特斯显然想让他的一些大牌球员休息一下，所以看看帕特·卡里根、卡梅伦·蒙斯特、拉特里尔·米切尔和哈里·格兰特今晚谁留在替补席上将会很有趣。预计这不会是一件特别费力的事情，但受伤可能会突然发生。

paras.en: A lot of people say they've dreamed of playing for Australia since they were a kid, but no everyone has proof.
paras.zh: 很多人说他们从小就梦想为澳大利亚效力，但并不是每个人都有证据。

paras.en: Bradman Best does, and tonight he makes good on that pledge.
paras.zh: 布拉德曼·贝斯特做到了，今晚他兑现了这一承诺。

paras.en: A lopsided weekend of World Cup 'contests'
paras.zh: 世界杯“竞赛”的不平衡周末

paras.en: The moment the draw came out, this second round was highlighted as one without many genuine contests in it with clear favourites in every game.
paras.zh: 抽签结果一出，第二轮就被认为是一场没有太多真正比赛的比赛，每场比赛都有明显的热门。

paras.en: So far the closest games of the past three days have been Tonga vs Lebanon in the men's and Fiji vs PNG in the women's, and both of those were 36-point blowouts.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，过去三天最接近的比赛是男子组汤加对阵黎巴嫩，女子组斐济对阵巴布亚新几内亚，两场比赛都是36分大胜。

paras.en: All told, with Australia-Fiji still to come tonight, the overall scoreline reads a ridiculous 550-26 (that's 264-22 in the men's and 286-4 for the women).
paras.zh: 总而言之，由于今晚澳大利亚队与斐济队的比赛即将到来，总比分是荒谬的 550-26（男子队为 264-22，女子队为 286-4）。

paras.en: New Zealand's Kiwi Ferns just had the biggest win of the tournament with their 92-0 victory over France in Christchurch and I don't see that getting topped, although the Jillaroos will surely give it a shake against Wales next Sunday.
paras.zh: 新西兰的 Kiwi Ferns 队刚刚在基督城以 92-0 战胜了法国队，取得了本届赛事最大的一场胜利，我不认为他们能超越，尽管 Jillaroos 队下周日对阵威尔士队肯定会给他们带来震撼。

paras.en: France was also the victim of the biggest blowout on the men's side, with an 82-0 to England yesterday.
paras.zh: 法国队也是男队最大惨败的受害者，昨天法国队以82-0大胜英格兰队。

paras.en: Pretty wild for an event that kicked off with a two-point thriller between the Kangaroos and Kiwis.
paras.zh: 对于一场以袋鼠队和新西兰队之间的两分惊心动魄的比赛拉开帷幕的赛事来说，这真是太疯狂了。

paras.en: If there was ever any doubt about the Jillaroos' overwhelming favouritism to retain their Women's World Cup crown after slower-than-expected start, there certainly aren't any now.
paras.zh: 如果有人对吉拉鲁队在开局慢于预期后保住女足世界杯冠军的压倒性优势有任何疑问，那么现在肯定没有任何疑问了。

paras.en: The 78-0 hammering of England proved a point, but did cost the Australians one of their biggest stars.
paras.zh: 78-0 击败英格兰队证明了这一点，但也让澳大利亚队失去了他们最伟大的球星之一。

paras.en: Kiwis re-establish dominance after early Cook Islands scare
paras.zh: 在库克群岛早期恐慌之后，新西兰人重新确立了统治地位

paras.en: For a moment it looked like Cook Islands might be up for the greatest of World Cup upsets.
paras.zh: 有一段时间，库克群岛看起来可能会遭遇世界杯最大的冷门。

paras.en: After New Zealand jumped out to a 12-0 lead, the Islanders roared back with three straight tries to Brisbane Tigers winger Esom Ioka — two off intercepts and one off a perfectly weighted cross-field kick.
paras.zh: 新西兰队以 12-0 领先后，岛民队连续 3 次尝试向布里斯班老虎队边锋埃索姆·伊奥卡 (Esom Ioka) 发起反击——两次拦截，一次完美加重的跨场踢球。

paras.en: The Kiwis followed up with 12 unanswered tries to run home 82-16 winners to continue the weekend of routs.
paras.zh: 新西兰队随后连续 12 次尝试未果，最终以 82-16 获胜，继续周末的溃败。

paras.en: Earlier, the New Zealand women never looked troubled as they walloped France 92-0. In 70 minutes no less.
paras.zh: 早些时候，新西兰女足以 92-0 横扫法国队时，看上去并没有表现出任何困扰。 70分钟内不少于。

paras.en: All told, Kiwi Ferns fullback Apii Nicholls took the title of the most prolific try-scorer of the day (so far) with four.
paras.zh: 总而言之，新西兰蕨队后卫阿皮·尼科尔斯 (Apii Nicholls) 凭借四次尝试获得了当天（迄今为止）最多产的尝试得分手的称号。

paras.en: We also saw hat-tricks for Mele Hufanga, Stacey Waaka and Jamayne Isaako, while Tenika Willison, Raecene McGregor, Mackenzie Wiki, Tanner Stowers-Smith, Casey McLean and Ronaldo Mulitalo all doubled up.
paras.zh: 我们还看到梅勒·胡方加 (Mele Hufanga)、史黛西·瓦卡 (Stacey Waaka) 和杰梅尼·伊萨科 (Jamayne Isaako) 上演帽子戏法，而泰尼卡·威利森 (Tenika Willison)、雷塞恩·麦格雷戈 (Raecene McGregor)、麦肯齐·维基 (Mackenzie Wiki)、坦纳·斯托尔斯·史密斯 (Tanner Stowers-Smith)、凯西·麦克莱恩 (Casey McLean) 和罗纳尔多·穆利塔洛 (Ronaldo Mulitalo) 都上演了帽子戏法。

paras.en: Hello and welcome to ABC Sport's live coverage of the Rugby League World Cup as Australia's Kangaroos take on the Fiji Bati to close out round two at Lang Park.
paras.zh: 大家好，欢迎收看美国广播公司体育频道 (ABC Sport) 对橄榄球联盟世界杯的现场报道，澳大利亚袋鼠队 (Kangaroos) 对阵斐济巴蒂队 (Fiji Bati)，将在郎公园 (Lang Park) 结束第二轮比赛。

paras.en: It's been a weekend of demolitions across three countries in both the men's and women's tournaments, so Kevin Walters's men will definitely be hoping to continue the trend here in Brisbane.
paras.zh: 这是一个在三个国家的男子和女子比赛中都大获全胜的周末，因此凯文沃尔特斯的男人们肯定希望在布里斯班继续这一趋势。

articles.title: Iran says resumption of war with US would not change its mind

paras.en: A potential resumption of Iran's war with Israel and the United States would not change Tehran's position, according to Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi.
paras.zh: 外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇表示，伊朗与以色列和美国恢复战争的可能性不会改变德黑兰的立场。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump says Washington "may do another little Epic Fury," referring to the campaign on Iran that began in February.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，华盛顿“可能会再次发起一场史诗般的愤怒”，他指的是二月份开始的针对伊朗的行动。

paras.en: Iran wants a return to the memorandum of understanding that the US agreed to in June.
paras.zh: 伊朗希望重返美国六月同意的谅解备忘录。

paras.en: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says a potential resumption of war with Israel and the United States would not change his country's positions.
paras.zh: 伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇表示，与以色列和美国恢复战争的可能性不会改变伊朗的立场。

paras.en: The remarks on Sunday came amid mounting US and Israeli threats of renewed attacks on Iran.
paras.zh: 周日发表上述言论之际，美国和以色列威胁要重新袭击伊朗。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that Washington "may do another little Epic Fury," referring to the US-Israeli campaign on Iran that began on February 28.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周五表示，华盛顿“可能会再做一次小小的史诗般的愤怒”，指的是2月28日开始的美以针对伊朗的行动。

paras.en: Mr Araghchi said a fresh attack would not yield a different outcome.
paras.zh: 阿拉格奇表示，新的袭击不会产生不同的结果。

paras.en: "Recently, there has been talk of a new war, but I am already thinking about the post-war period. Whether there is war or not, our policies remain the same," Mr Araghchi said during a televised event in Tehran.
paras.zh: “最近，有人谈论新的战争，但我已经在考虑战后时期。无论是否有战争，我们的政策都保持不变，”阿拉格奇在德黑兰的一次电视转播活动中表示。

paras.en: "They have already done so twice and have seen the results. If they want to try again, they know they will achieve no different outcome from those of the past."
paras.zh: “他们已经这样做了两次，并看到了结果。如果他们想再试一次，他们知道他们不会取得与过去不同的结果。”

paras.en: An April 8 ceasefire between Iran and the US put an end to the most intense fighting, apart from sporadic exchanges of fire in and around the strategic Strait of Hormuz, a key route for global energy supplies.
paras.zh: 4月8日，伊朗和美国之间的停火结束了最激烈的战斗，除了全球能源供应的关键战略霍尔木兹海峡及其周围发生零星交火之外。

paras.en: These military flare-ups have lulled in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 最近几周，这些军事冲突已经平息。

paras.en: Iran has claimed control over the strait since the outbreak of the war and has regularly targeted vessels that attempt crossing without its authorisation, moves strongly opposed by Washington and countries in the region.
paras.zh: 自战争爆发以来，伊朗声称控制该海峡，并定期针对未经其授权试图穿越该海峡的船只，此举遭到华盛顿和该地区国家的强烈反对。

paras.en: In response, the US has been maintaining a naval counter-blockade on Iranian ports.
paras.zh: 作为回应，美国一直维持对伊朗港口的海上反封锁。

paras.en: In June, Iran agreed with the US to a memorandum of understanding laying out a pathway to a permanent settlement of the conflict, only for the deal to later unravel as each side accused the other of violating it.
paras.zh: 6月，伊朗与美国达成了一份谅解备忘录，为永久解决冲突奠定了基础，但该协议后来因双方都指责对方违反而破裂。

paras.en: Tehran has since called for a return to the accord to end the conflict.
paras.zh: 此后，德黑兰呼吁重返该协议以结束冲突。

paras.en: "The current war has changed everything," Mr Araghchi said.
paras.zh: “当前的战争改变了一切，”阿拉格奇先生说。

paras.en: "We must accept that new realities are taking hold. Shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz will no longer be the same, and the management of the strait will no longer be the same.
paras.zh: “我们必须接受新的现实正在发生。穿过霍尔木兹海峡的航运路线将不再相同，该海峡的管理也将不再相同。

paras.en: "To achieve peace and stability, our region must move towards the complete absence of foreign forces."
paras.zh: “为了实现和平与稳定，我们地区必须走向完全没有外国势力的方向。”

paras.en: Ten ballistic missiles intercepted over Riyadh
paras.zh: 利雅得上空拦截十枚弹道导弹

paras.en: Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia intercepted drones and missiles over its capital Riyadh and southern areas on Sunday, the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said, as fighting with the Iran-aligned Houthis persisted.
paras.zh: 与此同时，沙特领导的也门联军表示，由于与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装的战斗仍在持续，沙特阿拉伯周日在其首都利雅得和南部地区拦截了无人机和导弹。

paras.en: The conflict has become an increasingly destabilising front in the US-Israeli offensive against Iran, turning US ally Saudi Arabia into a pressure point in the wider war.
paras.zh: 这场冲突已成为美以对伊朗进攻中日益不稳定的前线，使美国的盟友沙特阿拉伯成为更广泛战争中的压力点。

paras.en: On Sunday, Saudi civil defence authorities issued emergency alerts for Riyadh, Abha and Khamis Mushait, before announcing minutes later that the danger had passed.
paras.zh: 周日，沙特民防当局向利雅得、艾卜哈和海米斯穆谢特发出紧急警报，几分钟后宣布危险已经过去。

paras.en: The coalition said two drones and a ballistic missile were launched towards Riyadh, and a cruise missile towards the southern city of Khamis Mushait.
paras.zh: 该联盟表示，向利雅得发射了两架无人机和一枚弹道导弹，并向南部城市海米斯穆谢特发射了一枚巡航导弹。

paras.en: It later said it intercepted 10 ballistic missiles fired towards southern Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 它后来表示，它拦截了 10 枚射向沙特阿拉伯南部的弹道导弹。

paras.en: The Houthis warned they could again target Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, which resumed operations at two terminals on Sunday after a deadly attack earlier this month.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装警告称，他们可能再次袭击利雅得哈立德国王国际机场。该机场在本月早些时候发生致命袭击后，于周日恢复了两个航站楼的运营。

paras.en: The Houthis said they attacked the airport and Saudi oil facilities on Saturday. Saudi authorities did not comment directly on the Houthi statements.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们周六袭击了机场和沙特石油设施。沙特当局没有直接对胡塞武装的声明发表评论。

paras.en: Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said the airport remained a "military target" and warned all airlines, airport staffers and travellers against using it.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装发言人叶海亚·萨里表示，该机场仍然是“军事目标”，并警告所有航空公司、机场工作人员和旅客不要使用该机场。

articles.title: Donald Trump labels Obama 'incompetent' in post rally retaliation

paras.en: Donald Trump retaliated after Barack Obama delivered scathing criticisms of the incumbent during Democratic rallies in Ohio and Michigan.
paras.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马在俄亥俄州和密歇根州的民主党集会上对现任总统提出严厉批评后，唐纳德·特朗普进行了报复。

paras.en: Mr Trump labelled Mr Obama "grossly incompetent" and falsley claimed Democrat candidate, Abdul El-Sayed is a "Jihadist"
paras.zh: 特朗普称奥巴马“非常无能”，福斯利则声称民主党候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德是“圣战分子”

paras.en: Nationally, polls suggest the Democrats could regain control of the House of Representatives, but face more competition in the Senate.
paras.zh: 在全国范围内，民意调查显示民主党可能重新获得众议院的控制权，但在参议院面临更多竞争。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has retaliated after his Democratic predecessor, Barack Obama delivered scathing criticisms of the incumbent during rallies in Ohio and Michigan.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对其民主党前任巴拉克·奥巴马在俄亥俄州和密歇根州的集会上对现任总统提出严厉批评后进行了报复。

paras.en: Mr Trump labelled the former leader "incompetent" during his own rally in Michigan, which came one day after Mr Obama campaigned alongside Democratic Party candidate Abdul El-Sayed in the same state.
paras.zh: 特朗普在密歇根州的集会上称这位前领导人“无能”，一天前，奥巴马与民主党候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德在密歇根州一起竞选。

paras.en: "Obama was a grossly incompetent President! He paid off Iran with $Billions, and gave them a road to a Nuclear Weapon." Mr Trump wrote in a post on social media.
paras.zh: “奥巴马是一位非常无能的总统！他向伊朗支付了数十亿美元，并为他们提供了一条获得核武器的道路。”特朗普在社交媒体上发帖写道。

paras.en: The US president also slammed Mr Obama for supporting US Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed.
paras.zh: 美国总统还抨击奥巴马支持美国参议院候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德。

paras.en: The hit at Mr El-Sayed comes after Mr Trump and Republican candidate Mike Rogers have repeatedly tried to tie Mr El-Sayed to the Muslim Brotherhood, falsely branding the Democrat a "jihadist."
paras.zh: 在特朗普和共和党候选人迈克·罗杰斯多次试图将埃尔·赛义德与穆斯林兄弟会联系起来，错误地将民主党称为“圣战分子”之后，埃尔·赛义德受到了打击。

paras.en: In the same post on social media, Mr Trump called Mr El-Sayed a "Fake Doctor, who runs what is considered to be the WORST CLINIC IN AMERICA."
paras.zh: 在社交媒体上的同一篇帖子中，特朗普先生称埃尔赛义德先生是“假医生，他经营着被认为是美国最糟糕的诊所”。

paras.en: "Michigan doesn't want an arrogant, Open Borders, Fake Doctor, Jihadist, whose reputation will only get worse as more information is revealed."
paras.zh: “密歇根州不想要一个傲慢的、开放边界的、假医生、圣战分子，随着更多信息的披露，他的名声只会变得更糟。”

paras.en: Mr Trump has been telling voters to view the midterm elections as if he were on the ballot, and on Saturday Mr Obama did just that.
paras.zh: 特朗普先生一直告诉选民要像他本人一样看待中期选举，周六奥巴马先生也确实这样做了。

paras.en: Ten days out from the November 3 elections that will determine control of the closely divided Congress, Barack Obama took to the campaign trail to accuse the Republican president of corruption.
paras.zh: 距离 11 月 3 日选举将决定分歧严重的国会的控制权还有十天，巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 在竞选活动中指责这位共和党总统腐败。

paras.en: Mr Obama spared no mercy when it came to criticism surrounding Mr Trump's strategy for Iran, and skewered the gilded aesthetic he has applied to White House renovations.
paras.zh: 当谈到围绕特朗普的伊朗战略的批评时，奥巴马毫不留情，并批评了他在白宫翻修中所采用的镀金美学。

paras.en: Taking aim at new renovation projects across the US capital, including the National Mall's Reflecting Pool and the construction of a White House Ballroom.
paras.zh: 针对美国首都的新改造项目，包括国家广场的倒影池和白宫宴会厅的建设。

paras.en: The decorations added to the Oval Office during Mr Trumps second tenure were also not safe from critique.
paras.zh: 特朗普第二任期间为椭圆形办公室增添的装饰也难免受到批评。

paras.en: "He's got the White House looking like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory,"
paras.zh: “他让白宫看起来就像萨达姆侯赛因开了一家芝士蛋糕工厂一样，”

paras.en: The former president has retained considerable popularity among the Democratic base, which he is keen to leverage to support his party's candidates.
paras.zh: 这位前总统在民主党选民中保留了相当大的声望，他热衷于利用这些选民来支持本党候选人。

paras.en: In both states, Mr Obama blamed the Trump administration for the rising cost of living, one of the top voter concerns.
paras.zh: 在这两个州，奥巴马都将生活成本上升归咎于特朗普政府，这是选民最关心的问题之一。

paras.en: "The current president chose to make a series of bad decisions," Mr Obama said in Cleveland, Ohio, where he rallied in support of former Democratic senator Sherrod Brown.
paras.zh: “现任总统选择做出一系列错误的决定，”奥巴马在俄亥俄州克利夫兰表示，他在那里集会支持前民主党参议员谢罗德·布朗。

paras.en: "Most importantly, he decided to start an unnecessary war that nobody asked for."
paras.zh: “最重要的是，他决定发动一场没有人要求的不必要的战争。”

paras.en: The war on Iran has sent oil prices soaring as Tehran effectively blocked the Strait of Hormuz after being attacked.
paras.zh: 对伊朗的战争导致油价飙升，因为德黑兰在遭到袭击后实际上封锁了霍尔木兹海峡。

paras.en: "After two years of chaos and cruelty and corruption and incompetence, the likes of which we have not seen in the modern era, you get a chance to say, enough is enough," Mr Obama said.
paras.zh: 奥巴马表示：“在经历了两年的混乱、残酷、腐败和无能之后，我们在现代时代从未见过类似的情况，现在你有机会说，我们已经受够了。”

paras.en: Later, in Michigan he campaigned for Abdul El-Sayed, from the party's left wing, who is in a close race with Republican Mike Rogers for the US Senate.
paras.zh: 后来，他在密歇根州为党内左翼人士阿卜杜勒·赛义德竞选，后者正在与共和党人迈克·罗杰斯争夺美国参议院席位。

paras.en: "Imagine the power duo of Abdul and Elissa," Mr Obama said, referring to the incumbent Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin, who is not up for election this year.
paras.zh: “想象一下阿卜杜勒和艾丽莎的权力二人组，”奥巴马说，他指的是现任民主党参议员艾丽莎·斯洛特金，她今年不参加竞选。

paras.en: "You got a Muslim man, you got a Jewish woman fighting for you in the United States Senate. That's something, Michigan, you can be proud of."
paras.zh: “你有一个穆斯林男人，你有一个犹太女人在美国参议院为你而战。密歇根州，这是你可以自豪的事情。”

paras.en: The former president also urged voters to cast their ballots as soon as possible since early voting is already open in both states.
paras.zh: 这位前总统还敦促选民尽快投票，因为这两个州已经开放提前投票。

paras.en: "Don't procrastinate, don't equivocate," Mr Obama said.
paras.zh: “不要拖延，不要含糊其辞，”奥巴马说。

paras.en: Polls in Ohio give Democrats a slight lead in both races, but results are expected to be close.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州的民意调查显示，民主党在两场竞选中都略微领先，但预计结果将很接近。

paras.en: Nationally, polls also suggest that Democrats could regain control of the House of Representatives but face a much more competitive contest for the Senate.
paras.zh: 在全国范围内，民意调查还表明民主党可能重新获得众议院的控制权，但在参议院面临着更加激烈的竞争。

articles.title: Netanyahu 'fighting for his political life' in 1st Israeli vote since Oct. 7. He might still survive
articles.author: Margaret Evans

paras.en: Netanyahu 'fighting for his political life' in 1st Israeli vote since Oct. 7. He might still survive
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在自 10 月 7 日以来的第一次以色列投票中“为自己的政治生命而战”。他可能仍然生存

paras.en: PM still hawking himself as security candidate of choice in Tuesday's election
paras.zh: 总理仍将自己标榜为周二选举中的安全候选人

paras.en: On the cusp of Israel's first election since Benjamin Netanyahu presided over the most devastating security failure in the country's history, the Israeli prime minister is still hawking himself as the security candidate of choice and counting on it to work.
paras.zh: 自本杰明·内塔尼亚胡主持该国历史上最具破坏性的安全失败以来，以色列即将举行首次选举，而以色列总理仍然将自己视为首选的安全候选人，并指望其发挥作用。

paras.en: And it might. There are few Israeli analysts willing to write off the country's longest-serving prime minister in Tuesday's vote, despite the catastrophic impact of the Hamas-led attacks on Israel on Oct. 7, 2023, that killed about 1,200 people and led to 251 being taken hostage.
paras.zh: 也有可能。尽管哈马斯领导的2023年10月7日对以色列的袭击造成了灾难性影响，造成约1,200人死亡，并导致251人被扣为人质，但很少有以色列分析人士愿意在周二的投票中否定该国任职时间最长的总理。

paras.en: In an election already short-handed in terms of pro- and anti-Netanyahu blocs, opinion polls in the weeks ahead of the vote have consistently suggested neither side will win the 61 seats needed to form a majority in the Israeli Knesset.
paras.zh: 在支持内塔尼亚胡和反对内塔尼亚胡的阵营都已经人手不足的情况下，投票前几周的民意调查一致表明，双方都无法赢得在以色列议会中形成多数席位所需的 61 个席位。

paras.en: "We are back to where we were Oct. 6 [2023] in terms of the fact that the nation is split almost in the middle, electorally speaking," Tamar Hermann, a senior research fellow at the Israel Democracy Institute (IDI) in Jerusalem, said in an interview with CBC News.
paras.zh: 耶路撒冷以色列民主研究所 (IDI) 高级研究员塔玛·赫尔曼 (Tamar Hermann) 在接受 CBC 新闻采访时表示：“从选举角度来看，我们又回到了 2023 年 10 月 6 日的情况，因为国家几乎处于中间分裂状态。”

paras.en: "This means that we might come out with indecisive results. We may also have a minority government, but [then] the question, if there is a minority government, how long will it last?"
paras.zh: “这意味着我们可能会得出优柔寡断的结果。我们也可能有一个少数派政府，但问题是，如果有一个少数派政府，它会持续多久？”

paras.en: Netanyahu greets supporters in Jerusalem. The deaths of more than 74,000 Palestinians in Israel’s war against Hamas — a figure from health officials in Gaza — have not been the subject of much debate in the mainstream of Israel's election campaign. (Nico Hameon/CBC)
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在耶路撒冷向支持者致意。超过 74,000 名巴勒斯坦人在以色列对哈马斯的战争中丧生（来自加沙卫生官员的数字）并没有成为以色列竞选主流中争论的话题。 （尼科·哈蒙/CBC）

paras.en: It could also mean a lengthy period of coalition building, during which Netanyahu would serve as a caretaker prime minister.
paras.zh: 这也可能意味着长期的联盟建设，在此期间内塔尼亚胡将担任看守总理。

paras.en: "Israel has moved to the right ever since Oct. 7, and maybe that is part of the answer to why the current government in the polls hasn't collapsed completely," political scientist Reuven Hazan of the Hebrew University of Jerusalem said in an interview earlier this month.
paras.zh: 耶路撒冷希伯来大学政治学家鲁文·哈赞本月早些时候接受采访时表示：“自 10 月 7 日以来，以色列已经向右转，这也许是当前政府在民意调查中尚未完全垮台的部分原因。”

paras.en: Hazan doesn't believe that Netanyahu, 77, and his far-right coalition partners will ultimately regain power, but he also said that "they should be doing a heck of a lot worse in the polls than they are."
paras.zh: 哈赞不相信 77 岁的内塔尼亚胡和他的极右翼联盟伙伴最终会重新掌权，但他也表示，“他们在民意调查中的表现应该比现在糟糕得多。”

paras.en: Well-documented allegations that Netanyahu was repeatedly warned by regional allies and members of his own intelligence services that Hamas was planning a major operation against Israel but ignored them have filled newspaper columns and media broadcasts in Israel and abroad.
paras.zh: 有据可查的指控称，地区盟友和情报机构成员多次警告内塔尼亚胡，哈马斯正计划对以色列采取重大行动，但内塔尼亚胡对此置若罔闻，这一指控充斥着以色列国内外的报纸专栏和媒体广播。

paras.en: The repeated pleas to Netanyahu by families and friends of Israeli hostages held in Gaza to agree to a deal with Hamas for their early release rather than insisting on "total victory" first have left Israel with some of its deepest scars.
paras.zh: 被扣押在加沙的以色列人质的家人和朋友一再恳求内塔尼亚胡同意与哈马斯达成协议，早日释放人质，而不是坚持首先取得“全面胜利”，这给以色列留下了一些最深的伤痕。

paras.en: The deaths of more than 74,000 Palestinians in Israel’s war against Hamas — a figure from health officials in Gaza — have not been the subject of much debate in the mainstream of Israel's election campaign. But the country's increasing isolation on the world stage has.
paras.zh: 超过 74,000 名巴勒斯坦人在以色列对哈马斯的战争中丧生（来自加沙卫生官员的数字）并没有成为以色列竞选主流中争论的话题。但该国在世界舞台上日益孤立。

paras.en: Israeli lawyer and longtime peace campaigner Daniel Seidemann said it's as surprising to many Israelis as it is to outsiders that Netanyahu might stand a chance of returning to office given the allegations stacked up against him.
paras.zh: 以色列律师兼长期和平活动家丹尼尔·塞德曼表示，鉴于内塔尼亚胡受到的指控层出不穷，内塔尼亚胡可能有机会重返办公室，这让许多以色列人和局外人都感到惊讶。

paras.en: Daniel Seidemann, an Israeli lawyer and longtime peace campaigner, estimates Netanyahu still has strong, core support of about 30 per cent of the population. (CBC)
paras.zh: 以色列律师兼长期和平活动家丹尼尔·赛德曼 (Daniel Seidemann) 估计，内塔尼亚胡仍然拥有约 30% 人口的强大核心支持。 （加拿大广播公司）

paras.en: "It's a function of a number of things," he said in an interview from his Jerusalem office. "Number one, Netanyahu's hard-core supporters have to be described as a cult."
paras.zh: “这是多种因素共同作用的结果，”他在耶路撒冷办公室接受采访时表示。 “第一，内塔尼亚胡的铁杆支持者必须被描述为邪教。”

paras.en: "Absolutely nothing that can be discovered about Netanyahu will pierce the armour of their devotion to the cult leader. That is probably about 30 per cent of Israel."
paras.zh: “关于内塔尼亚胡的任何发现绝对不会刺穿他们对邪教领袖的忠诚。这可能是以色列的 30% 左右。”

paras.en: Netanyahu is currently being tried on allegations of corruption, including fraud, bribery and breach of trust. And he's steadfastly refused to appoint a commission of inquiry into the failings of Oct. 7, despite public pressure.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡目前因腐败指控受到审判，包括欺诈、贿赂和违反信任。尽管面临公众压力，他仍坚决拒绝任命一个委员会来调查 10 月 7 日的失误。

paras.en: Some question reliability of Oct. 7 warnings
paras.zh: 一些人质疑 10 月 7 日警告的可靠性

paras.en: The IDI's Hermann said Netanyahu supporters contend that any leader could have made similar mistakes. In polling done by the institute, she said, 43 to 46 per cent of Jewish Israelis questioned whether the warnings delivered to Netanyahu were reliable.
paras.zh: IDI 的赫尔曼表示，内塔尼亚胡的支持者认为任何领导人都可能犯类似的错误。她说，在该研究所进行的民意调查中，43％至46％的犹太以色列人质疑向内塔尼亚胡发出的警告是否可靠。

paras.en: Hermann said 60 per cent of those surveyed about what the prime minister did or didn't know believe the allegations have surfaced close to the election as part of an agenda to topple him.
paras.zh: 赫尔曼表示，在接受关于总理所做或不知道的调查的人中，60%的人认为这些指控是在选举临近时浮出水面的，是推翻他议程的一部分。

paras.en: "He is honest," Monel Bercovich said at a campaign event in Jerusalem on Friday, when asked why she backs Netanyahu.
paras.zh: “他很诚实，”莫内尔·贝尔科维奇周五在耶路撒冷的一次竞选活动中被问及为什么支持内塔尼亚胡时说道。

paras.en: Monel Bercovich says she's backing Netanyahu in the election because he's 'honest' and has taken a tough stance on Iran. (CBC)
paras.zh: 莫内尔·贝尔科维奇表示，她在选举中支持内塔尼亚胡，因为他“诚实”并且对伊朗采取了强硬立场。 （加拿大广播公司）

paras.en: She also mentioned his tough stand on Iran amid speculation that Israel might launch another round of strikes against it.
paras.zh: 她还提到了他对伊朗的强硬立场，因为人们猜测以色列可能会对伊朗发动新一轮打击。

paras.en: "To go to Iran and to do all the wars and all the things with [U.S. President Donald] Trump."
paras.zh: “去伊朗，与[美国总统唐纳德]特朗普一起进行所有战争和所有事情。”

paras.en: Hermann agrees with Seidemann that Netanyahu — nicknamed Bibi by those both for and against him — enjoys an unusual relationship with core supporters.
paras.zh: 赫尔曼同意塞德曼的观点，即内塔尼亚胡——被支持者和反对者昵称为“比比”——与核心支持者有着不寻常的关系。

paras.en: "Some of Netanyahu's voters actually love him," she said. "I mean it is something that comes from their stomach or their heart if you wish. [It's] a phenomenon which we don't have on the centre and left."
paras.zh: “内塔尼亚胡的一些选民实际上很爱他，”她说。 “我的意思是，如果你愿意的话，这是来自他们的胃或心脏的东西。[这是]我们在中间和左边没有的现象。”

paras.en: There's very little of a "left" left in Israeli politics, and much of the anti-Netanyahu side — or "change bloc," as it's known — arrayed against him would be described as centre-right and right.
paras.zh: 以色列政治中几乎没有什么“左派”了，而反对内塔尼亚胡的大部分人——或者众所周知的“变革集团”——可以被描述为中右翼和右翼。

paras.en: Netanyahu's strongest challenger in the general election is former Israel Defence Forces chief of staff Gadi Eisenkot, whose political party is called Yashar, which means "straight" or "honest" in Hebrew.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在大选中最强劲的挑战者是前以色列国防军参谋长加迪·艾森科特，他的政党名为“Yashar”，希伯来语的意思是“正直”或“诚实”。

paras.en: Hazan, of Hebrew University, said Eisenkot's military background will appeal to voters concerned about security, particularly in the face of what many Israelis view as an existential threat posed by Iran.
paras.zh: 希伯来大学的哈赞表示，艾森科特的军事背景将吸引关心安全的选民，特别是在许多以色列人认为伊朗构成生存威胁的情况下。

paras.en: "In other words: the security of this country, keep us safe in our homes. That's what they're looking for. But essentially, his entire campaign has not been on security issues. It's been on social issues, that this country is hemorrhaging, that we need to unite."
paras.zh: “换句话来说：这个国家的安全，确保我们在家中的安全。这就是他们所寻求的。但本质上，他的整个竞选活动并不是围绕安全问题。而是围绕社会问题，这个国家正在流血，我们需要团结起来。”

paras.en: Gadi Eisenkot, centre, leader of the Yashar party and a former Israeli military chief, visits the Western Wall in Jerusalem's Old City on Thursday. (Ronen Zvulun/Reuters)
paras.zh: 加迪·艾森科特（中）是亚沙尔党领导人、以色列前军事首长，周四参观了耶路撒冷老城的西墙。 （罗南·兹沃伦/路透社）

paras.en: Eisenkot, 66, joined Netanyahu's unity government in the days immediately after Oct. 7, but resigned eight months later.
paras.zh: 66 岁的艾森科特于 10 月 7 日之后立即加入内塔尼亚胡的联合政府，但八个月后辞职。

paras.en: His youngest son, a master sergeant in the Israeli military, was killed in Gaza during the war, and, unlike Netanyahu, he has pledged to create an Oct. 7 commission of inquiry if elected.
paras.zh: 他最小的儿子是以色列军队的一名军士长，在战争期间在加沙被杀。与内塔尼亚胡不同的是，他承诺如果当选，将在 10 月 7 日成立一个调查委员会。

paras.en: Eisenkot has also distinguished himself from Netanyahu by making compulsory conscription for Israel's sizable ultra-Orthodox community a campaign issue.
paras.zh: 艾森科特还通过将以色列规模庞大的极端正统派社区的强制征兵作为竞选议题，将自己与内塔尼亚胡区分开来。

paras.en: Military service is mandatory in Israel for Jewish men and women once they reach 18. Until recently, the ultra-Orthodox — or Haredi — community enjoyed an exemption dating back to the founding of the state in 1948.
paras.zh: 在以色列，犹太男女一旦年满 18 岁，就必须服兵役。直到最近，极端正统派（或称正统派）社区自 1948 年建国以来一直享有豁免。

paras.en: Israel’s Supreme Court refused to extend the exemption two years ago, despite Netanyahu's efforts. He's relied on the support of ultra-Orthodox coalition partners to stay in power over the years, and their vote will be key next week.
paras.zh: 尽管内塔尼亚胡做出了努力，但以色列最高法院两年前拒绝延长豁免期限。多年来，他依靠极端正统派联盟伙伴的支持来维持权力，下周他们的投票将至关重要。

paras.en: But the exemption is a much harder sell for the rest of the country in the wake of Oct. 7.
paras.zh: 但 10 月 7 日之后，该豁免对于该国其他地区来说就更难接受了。

paras.en: "I think for the last few years, we saw how tough it is and how our security situation is not as secure as we thought," said 27-year-old Yonatan Lambert, who was sent to serve in Gaza and will not vote for Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 27 岁的约纳坦·兰伯特 (Yonatan Lambert) 被派往加沙，不会投票给内塔尼亚胡，他说：“我认为在过去几年里，我们看到了情况有多么艰难，我们的安全局势并不像我们想象的那么安全。”

paras.en: "If you decide that you want or don't wanna be part of the army — or part of the country — you shouldn't get anything from the country," Lambert said, a reference to subsidies paid by the Israeli government to yeshivas, where ultra-Orthodox men study full time.
paras.zh: 兰伯特说：“如果你决定想要或不想成为军队的一部分，或者国家的一部分，你就不应该从这个国家得到任何东西。”他指的是以色列政府向犹太学院提供的补贴，极端正统派男子在那里进行全日制学习。

paras.en: "[The ultra-Orthodox] know that they will never have it so good as they do under Netanyahu," said lawyer and peace campaigner Seidemann, a view he shares of Netanyahu's other coalition partners: hardline Jewish nationalists underpinning Israel's settlement expansion in the Israeli-occupied territories.
paras.zh: 律师兼和平运动人士塞德曼表示：“[极端正统派]知道，他们永远不会像内塔尼亚胡领导下那样过得那么好。”他也认同内塔尼亚胡的其他联盟伙伴的观点：强硬的犹太民族主义者支持以色列在以色列占领的领土上扩建定居点。

paras.en: Military exemptions for the ultra-Orthodox — or Haredi — community are a much harder sell for the rest of the country in the wake of Oct. 7. (CBC)
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日之后，向极端正统派（或称正统派）群体提供军事豁免对该国其他地区来说就更难了。 (CBC)

paras.en: 'Total devotion of the right-wing settler base'
paras.zh: “右翼定居者基地的全力投入”

paras.en: Israeli settlements, including in the occupied West Bank, are considered illegal under international law.
paras.zh: 根据国际法，以色列定居点，包括被占领的约旦河西岸，都被视为非法。

paras.en: Images of increased violence by Israeli settlers attacking Palestinians and their property as they seek to bring in their annual olive harvest have horrified onlookers and increased Israel’s isolation internationally.
paras.zh: 以色列定居者在寻求一年一度的橄榄收获时袭击巴勒斯坦人及其财产的暴力画面令旁观者感到震惊，并加剧了以色列在国际上的孤立。

paras.en: "In the past, Netanyahu, with all of his bluster, was risk averse," Seidemann said. "He was attentive to international engagement in ways that he did not usually disclose, but he was capable of exhibiting restraint.
paras.zh: 塞德曼说：“过去，内塔尼亚胡尽管咆哮，却厌恶风险。” “他以他通常不公开的方式关注国际事务，但他能够表现出克制。

paras.en: "That's not the Netanyahu that we have now. He is in a semi-messianic disgruntled mode. He is fighting for his political life, and he has decided that the way he can survive politically is by having the total devotion of the right-wing settler base."
paras.zh: “这不是我们现在的内塔尼亚胡。他处于一种半弥赛亚式的不满模式。他正在为自己的政治生命而战，他已经决定，他能够在政治上生存的方式就是得到右翼定居者基地的全力支持。”

paras.en: A campaign poster for Itamar Ben-Gvir, Israel's national security minister, shows him superimposed over the images of shackled Palestinian prisoners on their knees. (CBC)
paras.zh: 以色列国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔的竞选海报上，他的照片叠加在跪着脚镣的巴勒斯坦囚犯的图像上。 （加拿大广播公司）

paras.en: That base includes Itamar Ben-Gvir, a Jewish settler from Hebron convicted in the past of incitement to racism and support for a terrorist organization.
paras.zh: 该基地包括伊塔马尔·本·格维尔 (Itamar Ben-Gvir)，他是一名来自希伯伦的犹太定居者，曾因煽动种族主义和支持恐怖组织而被定罪。

paras.en: Appointed by Netanyahu as the country's national security minister, Ben-Gvir's campaign posters show him superimposed over the images of shackled Palestinian prisoners on their knees.
paras.zh: 本-格维尔被内塔尼亚胡任命为该国国家安全部长，他的竞选海报上叠加了他跪在脚镣上的巴勒斯坦囚犯的图像。

paras.en: Seidemann likens the increase in land appropriation and settler attacks in the West Bank over the past month to an "end-of-season fire sale" ahead of the election.
paras.zh: 塞德曼将过去一个月西岸土地占用和定居者袭击的增加比作选举前的“季末甩卖”。

paras.en: "There's a sense that ... let's do whatever we can now, because it's an opportunity that may not repeat itself," he said. Then again, depending on Tuesday's results, it might.
paras.zh: “有一种感觉……让我们现在就尽我们所能，因为这是一个可能不会重演的机会，”他说。不过，根据周二的结果，也有可能。

articles.title: Israeli military conducts massive West Bank operation, days before Israel election

paras.en: Israeli military conducts massive West Bank operation, days before Israel election
paras.zh: 以色列大选前几天，以色列军队进行大规模西岸行动

paras.en: The operation displaced more than 2,200 people, including nearly 300 children, according to Hebron officials
paras.zh: 据希伯伦官员称，此次行动导致 2,200 多人流离失所，其中包括近 300 名儿童

paras.en: The Israeli military continued a massive military operation in the occupied West Bank on Sunday, displacing hundreds of Palestinians and placing major restrictions on movement in response to a gun attack that killed two Israeli soldiers and wounded three others in Hebron on Friday.
paras.zh: 周日，以色列军方继续在被占领的约旦河西岸开展大规模军事行动，导致数百名巴勒斯坦人流离失所，并对行动实施重大限制，以应对周五在希伯伦发生的枪击事件，造成两名以色列士兵死亡、三人受伤。

paras.en: The operation comes as Israel enters the final days before a tense election, which is largely seen as a referendum on current Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership and security policies during the past three years of war.
paras.zh: 这次行动是在以色列进入紧张选举前的最后几天进行的，这次选举在很大程度上被视为对现任总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在过去三年战争期间的领导和安全政策的公投。

paras.en: Most Palestinian workers with permits will not be allowed to enter Israeli settlements for work in the occupied West Bank on Sunday and Monday, and crossings into Israel will remain closed until after Israel's elections on Tuesday, the Israeli military said.
paras.zh: 以色列军方表示，周日和周一，大多数持有许可证的巴勒斯坦工人将不被允许进入以色列定居点在被占领的约旦河西岸工作，进入以色列的过境点将继续关闭，直到周二以色列选举之后。

paras.en: The military said it operated in more than 400 different locations over the weekend and arrested 40 Palestinians it claimed were affiliated with Hamas or Palestinian Islamic Jihad. It said the operation is continuing at the same intensity on Sunday.
paras.zh: 军方表示，周末在 400 多个不同地点开展行动，逮捕了 40 名据称与哈马斯或巴勒斯坦伊斯兰圣战组织有关联的巴勒斯坦人。据称，周日的行动仍以同样的强度进行。

paras.en: Thousands of Palestinians displaced from Hebron
paras.zh: 数以千计的巴勒斯坦人从希伯伦流离失所

paras.en: The Hebron municipality said the operation displaced more than 2,200 people, including nearly 300 children under the age of 18.
paras.zh: 希伯伦市政府表示，此次行动导致 2,200 多人流离失所，其中包括近 300 名 18 岁以下的儿童。

paras.en: The military said that troops were conducting searches in the area where the gunmen operated and warned residents to evacuate Deir Bahha, the suspected gunmen's neighbourhood. After Friday's attack, Israel's military said it found weapons in the gunmen's car and that they were likely planning to attack Israeli civilians before being stopped at the checkpoint.
paras.zh: 军方表示，部队正在枪手活动的地区进行搜查，并警告居民撤离可疑枪手所在的代尔巴哈社区。周五袭击事件发生后，以色列军方表示，他们在枪手的车里发现了武器，他们很可能计划在检查站被拦下之前袭击以色列平民。

paras.en: All entrances and exits to the city remained sealed, with the epicentre of the operation in Deir Bahha and another part of the city called Al-Jalda, according to Hebron Mayor Yousef Zuhair Al-Jabari.
paras.zh: 希伯伦市长尤瑟夫·祖海尔·贾巴里 (Yousef Zuhair Al-Jabari) 表示，该市的所有出入口仍然处于封锁状态，行动的中心位于代尔巴哈 (Deir Bahha) 和该市另一个名为阿尔贾尔达 (Al-Jalda) 的地区。

paras.en: "People cannot reach or enter the city, and they cannot leave it. The blockade has affected every aspect of life," Al-Jabari said. He added that the blockade is forcing businesses to close and has also shuttered a mosque.
paras.zh: “人们无法到达或进入这座城市，也无法离开它。封锁影响了生活的方方面面，”贾巴里说。他补充说，封锁迫使企业关门，一座清真寺也被关闭。

paras.en: "The army told us that this area would be closed for 12 days. Now they're saying 12 days, but maybe they'll leave the area after two or three days," said Shadi al-Qawasmi, a Hebron resident who was displaced with his family. "This may be because of the elections or some political matter; no one knows except God Almighty."
paras.zh: “军队告诉我们，这个地区将关闭 12 天。现在他们说是 12 天，但也许他们会在两三天后离开该地区，”与家人一起流离失所的希伯伦居民沙迪·卡瓦斯米 (Shadi al-Qawasmi) 说。 “这可能是因为选举或某些政治问题；除了全能的上帝，没有人知道。”

paras.en: The operation forced some families to navigate crossings on foot in order to leave Hebron after the roads were closed to traffic. At some military gates, people passed sacks of flour and gas canisters through the gates, while an elderly man pushed his wife in a wheelchair through an opening beside one of them. Another family attempted to navigate the gate to access medical appointments.
paras.zh: 这次行动迫使一些家庭在道路交通封闭后步行穿过十字路口才能离开希伯伦。在一些军事大门，人们将一袋袋面粉和煤气罐从大门传递出去，而一名老人推着坐在轮椅上的妻子穿过其中一个大门旁边的一个开口。另一个家庭试图穿过大门去看医生。

paras.en: Netanyahu vows a strong response as elections loom
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡誓言在选举临近之际做出强有力的回应

paras.en: Hebron municipal officials said families had been displaced from nearly 500 apartments in Deir Bahha and surrounding neighbourhoods.
paras.zh: 希伯伦市政官员表示，代尔巴哈及周边社区近 500 套公寓中的家庭已经流离失所。

paras.en: Six Israelis have been killed this year in attacks in the West Bank, which is experiencing a surge of violence. During the same period, 112 Palestinians have been killed, including the suspected gunmen, according to the Ramallah-based Palestinian Health Ministry.
paras.zh: 今年，六名以色列人在约旦河西岸的袭击中丧生，该地区的暴力事件正在激增。据位于拉马拉的巴勒斯坦卫生部称，同一时期有 112 名巴勒斯坦人被杀，其中包括疑似枪手。

paras.en: A Palestinian man stands next to Israeli soldiers during an army operation in the West Bank city of Hebron on Saturday. The military said it operated in more than 400 different locations over the weekend. (Mahmoud Illean/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周六，在约旦河西岸城市希伯伦的一次军队行动中，一名巴勒斯坦男子站在以色列士兵旁边。军方表示周末在 400 多个不同地点开展了行动。 （马哈茂德·伊利安/美联社）

paras.en: Friday's attack sparked outrage in Israel, with Netanyahu and three members of his right-wing government giving statements from the site of the attack on Friday afternoon, vowing to respond forcefully. "We warned a few weeks ago about attempts by our enemies to harm us, our citizens and our soldiers ahead of the election," Netanyahu said. "We will act to destroy this place."
paras.zh: 周五的袭击引发了以色列的愤怒，内塔尼亚胡和他的右翼政府的三名成员周五下午在袭击现场发表声明，誓言要采取强有力的回应。内塔尼亚胡说：“几周前，我们警告我们的敌人企图在选举前伤害我们、我们的公民和我们的士兵。” “我们将采取行动摧毁这个地方。”

paras.en: Netanyahu is under pressure to demonstrate a strong show of force against Palestinian attackers to bolster his image for Israelis concerned with security.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡面临压力，必须对巴勒斯坦袭击者展示强有力的武力，以提升他在关心安全的以色列人心目中的形象。

paras.en: Roughly three million Palestinians and 540,000 Israeli settlers live in the West Bank, which Israel occupied in the 1967 Mideast war. Hebron is one of its most tense cities and the only place where Jewish settlers live in the heart of a densely populated Palestinian area under Israeli military protection.
paras.zh: 大约 300 万巴勒斯坦人和 54 万以色列定居者居住在以色列在 1967 年中东战争中占领的约旦河西岸。希伯伦是局势最紧张的城市之一，也是以色列军事保护下人口稠密的巴勒斯坦地区中心唯一有犹太定居者居住的地方。

articles.title: Venezuela's opposition leader Machado returns after months in exile

paras.en: Venezuela's opposition leader Machado returns after months in exile
paras.zh: 委内瑞拉反对派领袖马查多流亡数月后返回

paras.en: Machado went into hiding in Venezuela for 11 months after being briefly detained following protest
paras.zh: 马查多在抗议后被短暂拘留后，在委内瑞拉躲藏了 11 个月

paras.en: Opposition leader and Nobel laureate María Corina Machado reappeared in Venezuela on Sunday for the first time since December, about a month before the U.S. military deposed the country's then-president Nicolás Maduro.
paras.zh: 周日，反对派领袖、诺贝尔奖获得者玛丽亚·科里娜·马查多再次出现在委内瑞拉，这是去年 12 月以来的首次，大约一个月前，美国军方废黜了该国时任总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗。

paras.en: Machado announced her arrival on social media, writing: "I am here. With you."
paras.zh: 马查多在社交媒体上宣布了她的到来，并写道：“我在这里。和你在一起。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Venezuela's opposition leader Edmundo Gonzalez wrote on X confirming that Machado had arrived and that he would be next to her "very soon."
paras.zh: 与此同时，委内瑞拉反对派领导人埃德蒙多·冈萨雷斯（Edmundo Gonzalez）在 X 上写道，确认马查多已经抵达，并且“很快”就会出现在她身边。

paras.en: "Today is a very important day for Venezuelans. Our sovereign voice returns with her to lead and guide this process!" he wrote. "You know it, this is until the end."
paras.zh: “今天对委内瑞拉人来说是非常重要的一天。我们主权的声音与她一起回归，领导和指导这一进程！”他写道。 “你知道的，这件事到最后为止。”

paras.en: Machado's homecoming after more than 10 months in exile took place as doubts over Venezuela's democratic future — and the U.S.'s role in it — deepen.
paras.zh: 马查多在流亡十多个月后回国之际，人们对委内瑞拉的民主未来以及美国在其中所扮演的角色的疑虑加深。

paras.en: Since Maduro's ouster, Venezuela has been run by interim President Delcy Rodríguez, a longtime Maduro ally who received the Trump administration's blessing to succeed him.
paras.zh: 自马杜罗下台以来，委内瑞拉一直由临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯领导，他是马杜罗的长期盟友，得到了特朗普政府的批准接替他。

paras.en: Rodríguez has exceeded the time she was authorized to serve as acting president following Maduro's capture, and no election is scheduled.
paras.zh: 马杜罗被捕后，罗德里格斯已超过了她被授权担任代总统的时间，因此没有安排选举。

paras.en: Machado went into hiding in Venezuela for 11 months after being briefly detained following a protest in January 2025.
paras.zh: 马查多在 2025 年 1 月的一次抗议活动后被短暂拘留后，在委内瑞拉躲藏了 11 个月。

paras.en: After leaving the country in a clandestine escape, she reappeared that December in Norway, where she was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her peaceful challenge to Maduro's authoritarian government.
paras.zh: 在秘密逃亡后，她于当年 12 月再次出现在挪威，并因对马杜罗独裁政府的和平挑战而被授予诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: Machado and her allies have been demanding a date for a presidential election in Venezuela, but U.S. officials have emphasized economic stabilization first.
paras.zh: 马查多和她的盟友一直要求委内瑞拉确定总统选举的日期，但美国官员首先强调经济稳定。

articles.title: Prague honours Roma resistance fighters against Hitler

paras.en: For more than half a million Roma in Czechia and Slovakia, October 15, 2026, marks an important milestone.
paras.zh: 对于捷克和斯洛伐克超过 50 万的罗姆人来说，2026 年 10 月 15 日是一个重要的里程碑。

paras.en: That day, an exhibition on a largely forgotten chapter of Czech history opened at the Museum of the Romani National Revival in Prague. The exhibit explores the role of Czech and Slovak Romani resistance fighters during the Nazi German occupation and the dismantling of Czechoslovakia from 1938 to 1945.
paras.zh: 那天，一场关于捷克历史上被遗忘的章节的展览在布拉格罗姆民族复兴博物馆开幕。该展览探讨了 1938 年至 1945 年纳粹德国占领和捷克斯洛伐克解体期间捷克和斯洛伐克罗姆人抵抗战士的作用。

paras.en: Until now, Czech and Slovak Roma appeared in the history of World War II almost exclusively as victims of the Holocaust against Roma and Sinti. In the so-called Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia, Nazi Germany murdered approximately 90% of the Czech Roma during World War II.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，捷克和斯洛伐克的罗姆人在二战历史上几乎都是作为针对罗姆人和辛提人的大屠杀的受害者出现的。在所谓的波西米亚和摩拉维亚保护国，纳粹德国在第二次世界大战期间杀害了大约 90% 的捷克罗姆人。

paras.en: However, what is less well known is that a large number of Czech and Slovak Roma fought against the German occupiers as partisans in resistance groups and as soldiers in the Czechoslovak Underground Army, or Defense of the Nation, ON.
paras.zh: 然而，鲜为人知的是，大量捷克和斯洛伐克罗姆人作为抵抗组织的游击队员和捷克斯洛伐克地下军（或称“保卫国家”）的士兵与德国占领者作战。

paras.en: The exhibition at the Museum of the Roma National Movement therefore marks a turning point in how the Roma are viewed during World War II. At least that is the hope of museum director Emil Scuka, a lawyer, former prosecutor and one of the best-known Czech Roma activists.
paras.zh: 因此，罗姆人民族运动博物馆的展览标志着二战期间如何看待罗姆人的转折点。至少这是博物馆馆长埃米尔·斯卡卡（Emil Scuka）的希望，他是一名律师、前检察官，也是捷克最著名的罗姆活动家之一。

paras.en: "We were not only victims; we were also heroes," Scuka said in his speech to several hundred attendees at the exhibition opening, most of whom were Roma from Czechia and Slovakia. "Many people, not even among the Roma themselves, are aware that we Roma fought against Nazism," he noted. In his view, "organizing and opening the exhibition was something my generation owed to these Roma heroes and today we are repaying that debt."
paras.zh: “我们不仅是受害者；我们也是英雄，”斯卡在展览开幕式上向数百名与会者发表讲话时说，其中大多数是来自捷克和斯洛伐克的罗姆人。 “许多人，甚至罗姆人自己都不知道，我们罗姆人曾与纳粹主义作斗争，”他指出。在他看来，“组织和举办这次展览是我们这一代人对这些罗马英雄的感谢，今天我们正在偿还这笔债务。”

paras.en: Scuka called on those present: "Bring your children and grandchildren here so they can see for themselves and realize that the Roma have heroes too!"
paras.zh: 斯卡呼吁在场的人：“带你的孩子和孙子来这里，让他们亲眼目睹并认识到罗姆人也有英雄！”

paras.en: He also pointed out that this topic had been completely marginalized in Czech and Slovak historical writing for decades and that the Roma had therefore decided on their own to document the fates of their war heroes.
paras.zh: 他还指出，几十年来，这个话题在捷克和斯洛伐克的历史写作中完全被边缘化，因此罗姆人决定自己决定记录他们的战争英雄的命运。

paras.en: The exhibition presents the detailed life stories of 100 of the most significant Roma partisans and Roma soldiers from the Czech underground army and resistance groups who fought against the Nazis.
paras.zh: 该展览详细介绍了来自捷克地下军和抵抗组织的 100 名最重要的罗姆游击队员和罗姆士兵与纳粹作战的生活故事。

paras.en: "We found over 1,400 Romani fighters in the archives. From among them, we selected the 100 most interesting stories for this exhibition," said exhibition curator Radoslav Scuka at the opening.
paras.zh: 展览策展人拉多斯拉夫·斯卡 (Radoslav Scuka) 在开幕式上表示：“我们在档案中发现了超过 1,400 名罗姆战士。我们从其中挑选了 100 个最有趣的故事来举办这次展览。”

paras.en: Groundbreaking research on Roma resistance fighters
paras.zh: 对罗姆抵抗战士的开创性研究

paras.en: Among these figures is Anton Facuna, a sergeant in the American intelligence agency Office of Strategic Services (OSS), who was flown to Slovakia in October 1944 on a secret mission. Slovakia had been a puppet state of Hitler from 1939 to 1945.
paras.zh: 这些人物中包括美国情报机构战略服务办公室 (OSS) 的中士安东·法库纳 (Anton Facuna)，他于 1944 年 10 月飞往斯洛伐克执行一项秘密任务。 1939年至1945年，斯洛伐克一直是希特勒的傀儡国家。

paras.en: Another is Josef Serinek, known by the nickname "Black Partisan from Vysocina," who managed to escape from the Nazi concentration camp for Roma in Lety and subsequently founded and commanded the large Capajev-Cerny partisan unit in the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands.
paras.zh: 另一位是约瑟夫·塞里内克（Josef Serinek），绰号“来自维索西纳的黑人游击队”，他成功逃离莱蒂的罗姆人纳粹集中营，随后在波西米亚-摩拉维亚高地建立并指挥了大型卡帕耶夫-塞尔尼游击队。

paras.en: In 2022, Czech President Milos Zeman posthumously awarded him the Medal for Heroism. Toward the end of his life, Serinek shared his memories with historian Jan Tesar, who later wrote the three-volume book "Ceska cikanska rapsodie", which translates to Czech Gypsy Rhapsody.
paras.zh: 2022年，捷克总统米洛斯·泽曼追授他英雄主义勋章。在塞里内克生命的最后阶段，塞里内克与历史学家扬·泰萨尔分享了他的记忆，后者后来写了三卷本《Ceska cikanska rapsodie》，翻译过来就是捷克吉普赛狂想曲。

paras.en: Except for Tesar's book, the history of Roma resistance against Nazism has not been researched by Czech and Slovak historians to this day. "I am not aware of any scholarly historical work that deals with Roma resistance against Nazism," Prokop Tomek, a historian at the Military History Institute in Prague, told DW.
paras.zh: 除了特萨尔的书之外，捷克和斯洛伐克的历史学家至今还没有研究过罗姆人抵抗纳粹主义的历史。布拉格军事历史研究所历史学家普罗科普·托梅克 (Prokop Tomek) 告诉德国之声：“我不知道有任何学术历史著作涉及罗姆人反抗纳粹主义的问题。”

paras.en: "The number of 1,400 Roma who took part in the fight against Nazism as members of the resistance or in the foreign army does not strike me as an exaggeration and corresponds to the proportion of the Roma population in Czechoslovakia," Tomek said, adding that the "exhibition on the Roma resistance against Nazism during the war is undoubtedly groundbreaking."
