paras.zh: 托梅克说：“在我看来，作为抵抗组织成员或外国军队参加反纳粹斗争的罗姆人有 1,400 人，这一数字并不夸张，这与捷克斯洛伐克罗姆人人口的比例相当。”他补充说，“关于罗姆人在战争期间抵抗纳粹主义的展览无疑是开创性的。”

paras.en: To this day, many Roma in Czechia and Slovakia do not publicly acknowledge their ethnic identity. This is partly due to experiences with the Holocaust during the Nazi era that have been passed down through generations. Czech historians and politicians continue to debate the extent to which the Czech authorities of the Protectorate were complicit in the extermination of the Czech Roma.
paras.zh: 直到今天，捷克和斯洛伐克的许多罗姆人还没有公开承认他们的民族身份。部分原因是纳粹时代代代相传的大屠杀经历。捷克历史学家和政治家继续争论捷克保护国当局在多大程度上参与了灭绝捷克罗姆人的活动。

paras.en: However, one thing is certain: the police registration of all Roma, which had been enshrined in law in Czechoslovakia since 1927, facilitated the extermination of the Roma by the German Nazis.
paras.zh: 然而，有一件事是肯定的：自 1927 年以来，捷克斯洛伐克对所有罗姆人进行警察登记已成为法律，这促进了德国纳粹对罗姆人的灭绝。

paras.en: According to estimates by the Czech government, approximately 250,000 Roma live in the country today. In the 2021 census, however, only 21,000 people identified as Roma.
paras.zh: 据捷克政府估计，目前约有 25 万罗姆人居住在该国。然而，在 2021 年人口普查中，只有 21,000 人被认定为罗姆人。

paras.en: Of all ethnic groups in Czechia, which has a population of 10 million, the Roma are among the three largest ethnic minorities in terms of numbers. However, they are the most socially disadvantaged, have very little political representation, and are therefore scarcely present in Czech politics.
paras.zh: 在拥有1000万人口的捷克各民族中，罗姆人是人口数量最多的三个少数民族之一。然而，他们在社会上处于最不利的地位，几乎没有政治代表性，因此很少出现在捷克政治中。

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Gadi Eisenkot campaigns on Moroccan roots in challenge to Netanyahu

paras.en: Campaign posters with various slogans promote the right-wing Likud and the far-right Otzma Yehudit parties. However, one poster is seen more than any others: that of the liberal Yashar party.
paras.zh: 带有各种口号的竞选海报宣传右翼利库德集团和极右翼奥兹马·耶胡迪特政党。然而，有一张海报比其他海报出现得最多：自由派亚沙尔党的海报。

paras.en: Its slogan, "Rosh Memshala Dialna," combines the terms "prime minister" in Hebrew and the words "of our own" in Moroccan Arabic.
paras.zh: 其口号“Rosh Memshala Dialna”结合了希伯来语中的“总理”和摩洛哥阿拉伯语中的“我们自己的”一词。

paras.en: And there is a good reason why Eisenkot's campaign in Sderot and other cities on Israel's sociopolitical periphery focuses on his Moroccan roots.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在斯德洛特和以色列社会政治边缘其他城市的竞选活动重点关注他的摩洛哥根源，这是有充分理由的。

paras.en: Sderot — located in the Negev desert, about 75 kilometers (45 miles) to Tel Aviv's south and just a kilometer away from the Gaza border — is a city with a large Moroccan Jewish community. In recent decades, the city has become symbolic of Moroccan-Jewish culture in Israel, finding its expression in music, cinema and state politics.
paras.zh: 斯德洛特位于内盖夫沙漠，距特拉维夫南部约 75 公里（45 英里），距加沙边境仅一公里，是一座拥有大型摩洛哥犹太人社区的城市。近几十年来，这座城市已成为以色列摩洛哥犹太文化的象征，在音乐、电影和国家政治中都有体现。

paras.en: Historically, Sderot is considered a bastion of the Israeli right, and especially a stronghold of Prime MinisterBenjamin Netanyahu's Likud. In 2022, Likud received more than 40% of the votes in Sderot, compared with 23% nationwide. Other members of Israel's far-right coalition received a lot of support there in the last election.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，斯德洛特被认为是以色列右翼的堡垒，尤其是总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团的据点。 2022 年，利库德集团在斯德洛特获得超过 40% 的选票，而全国这一比例为 23%。以色列极右翼联盟的其他成员在上次选举中获得了很多支持。

paras.en: This pattern reflects deeper historical divisions in Israel between Ashkenazim, or Jews of European origin, and Mizrahim, or Jews mostly from Middle Eastern and North African backgrounds. According to estimates, half of Israel's Jewish population is of Mizrahi origin, amounting to about 4 million people.
paras.zh: 这种模式反映了以色列在德系犹太人（欧洲血统的犹太人）和米兹拉希姆（主要来自中东和北非背景的犹太人）之间更深层次的历史分歧。据估计，以色列犹太人口中有一半是米兹拉希裔，约400万人。

paras.en: Mizrahi Jews have faced discrimination and neglect since the early days of the Israeli state. This inequality still shapes the economic and social reality in Israel ― and its political discourse.
paras.zh: 自以色列建国初期以来，米兹拉希犹太人就一直面临歧视和忽视。这种不平等仍然影响着以色列的经济和社会现实及其政治话语。

paras.en: The issue has received special attention in the 2026 campaign. Eisenkot, Netanyahu's major challenger, is of Moroccan origin and grew up in Eilat, a city with a large North African Jewish population. Eisenkot's Yashar party accused Likud of sidelining its Mizrahi politicians. The campaign slogan, "Netanyahu: Let the Mizrahim give interviews,” mocked that omission.
paras.zh: 这个问题在2026年的竞选活动中受到了特别关注。内塔尼亚胡的主要挑战者艾森科特有摩洛哥血统，在埃拉特长大，埃拉特是一个拥有大量北非犹太人口的城市。艾森科特领导的亚沙尔党指责利库德集团排挤其米兹拉希政客。竞选口号“内塔尼亚胡：让米兹拉希姆接受采访”嘲笑了这一遗漏。

paras.en: On live television, the right-wing journalist Yinon Magal — one of Netanyahu's most vocal supporters — claimed that Eisenkot was being controlled by elitist Ashkenazim and called him a "monkey."
paras.zh: 在电视直播中，右翼记者伊农·马加尔（内塔尼亚胡最直言不讳的支持者之一）声称艾森科特受到精英主义德系人士的控制，并称他为“猴子”。

paras.en: Netanyahu, who is of European origin, condemned the remark.
paras.zh: 欧洲裔内塔尼亚胡谴责了这一言论。

paras.en: Morocco-born Daniel Ben-Simon, an award-winning Israeli journalist and a former member of parliament, told DW that Eisenkot's embrace of his roots might have been forced upon him by Magal's comments — but it has historical value nevertheless.
paras.zh: 出生于摩洛哥的丹尼尔·本·西蒙 (Daniel Ben-Simon) 是一位屡获殊荣的以色列记者、前议会议员，他告诉德国之声，艾森科特可能是因为马加尔的言论而被迫接受自己的根源，但这仍然具有历史价值。

paras.en: "People don't use terms like 'Dialna' with pride," Ben-Simon said, referring to Eisenkot's embrace of the Arabic term "of our own" in campaign posters. He said Israeli society had long tried to erase the Arab identities of North African Jews.
paras.zh: “人们不会自豪地使用‘Dialna’这样的术语，”本-西蒙说，他指的是艾森科特在竞选海报中使用的阿拉伯语术语“我们自己的”。他说，以色列社会长期以来一直试图消除北非犹太人的阿拉伯身份。

paras.en: Eisenkot's embrace of his identity serves as a way of "leaving the frame" set by society. "By using such a term, you're creating a new identity: an Israeli-Moroccan identity," Ben-Simon said. "Eisenkot is the first to allow this double identity to be expressed and still feel at home."
paras.zh: 艾森科特对自己身份的接受是“脱离社会设定的框架”的一种方式。 “通过使用这样的术语，你正在创造一个新的身份：以色列-摩洛哥身份，”本-西蒙说。 “Eisenkot 是第一个允许表达这种双重身份并且仍然有宾至如归的感觉的人。”

paras.en: After Israel's founding, the ruling socialist party, Mapai, whose leadership was largely Ashkenazi, pursued discriminatory policies against Mizrahim. Mizrahim were often expected to "Europeanize” rather than preserve their own culture, heritage, or Arabic language.
paras.zh: 以色列建国后，执政的社会党马派（其领导层主要是阿什肯纳兹人）对米兹拉希姆实行歧视性政策。人们常常期望米兹拉希姆“欧洲化”，而不是保留自己的文化、遗产或阿拉伯语言。

paras.en: These inequalities also took a material form. In the state's early decades, while European immigrants often received better housing and jobs, many Jews from Arab-speaking countries were sent to Ma'abarot, or temporary transit camps, often in remote areas with little infrastructure. Many later became "development towns,” which remained underfunded compared with Israel's central regions. That in turn resulted in poverty. Sderot, in the south, is one of the best-known development towns.
paras.zh: 这些不平等也表现为物质形式。在该州成立的最初几十年，虽然欧洲移民往往能获得更好的住房和工作，但许多来自阿拉伯语国家的犹太人被送往马巴罗特（Ma'abarot）或临时中转营，这些营地通常位于基础设施匮乏的偏远地区。许多后来成为“发展城镇”，与以色列中部地区相比，这些城镇仍然资金不足。这反过来又导致了贫困。南部的斯德洛特是最著名的开发城镇之一。

paras.en: For many Mizrahim, limited access to jobs, education and infrastructure symbolized long-standing exclusion by the Mapai establishment. Likud, founded as a right-wing alliance in 1973, used this frustration effectively under Menachem Begin. Mizrahi support for Begin helped produce the Mahapach, or upheaval, when Likud first defeated the socialist camp and took power. Since then, Mizrahim have often been associated with Likud, even though the party has never had a Mizrahi leader.
paras.zh: 对于许多米兹拉希姆人来说，获得就业、教育和基础设施的机会有限象征着马派机构长期的排斥。 1973 年作为右翼联盟成立的利库德集团在梅纳赫姆·贝京的领导下有效地利用了这种挫败感。当利库德集团首次击败社会主义阵营并掌权时，米兹拉希对贝京的支持促成了马哈帕赫（Mahapach）或剧变。从那时起，米兹拉希姆经常与利库德集团联系在一起，尽管该党从未有过米兹拉希姆领导人。

paras.en: Over the past two decades, Sderot's proximity to Gaza has made the city a frequent target of rocket attacks launched by the militant group Hamas. During the Hamas-led terrorist attacks on October 7, 2023, the city of Sderot was hit especially hard. More than 50 people were killed. In the three years since the attack, the city's population has grown by about 5,000 people, bringing it to 40,000, with many young families making the town their home, both as a result of idealism and government benefits.
paras.zh: 在过去的二十年里，斯德洛特靠近加沙，使得该市经常成为激进组织哈马斯发动火箭袭击的目标。 2023年10月7日哈马斯领导的恐怖袭击中，斯德洛特市受到的打击尤其严重。超过50人被杀。袭击发生后的三年里，该市人口增加了约 5,000 人，达到 40,000 人，许多年轻家庭在该镇安家落户，这既是理想主义的结果​​，也是政府福利的结果。

paras.en: Walking around the town, it's hard not to notice that the so-called national-religious community is becoming increasingly dominant. This community tends to vote for Bezalel Smotrich's far-right Religious Zionism party, a main member of Netanyahu's coalition. Though votes for Smotrich and his party are de facto votes for Netanyahu's bloc, the prime minister's Likud party itself could suffer losses in Sderot.
paras.zh: 走在镇上，很难不注意到所谓的民族宗教团体正变得越来越占主导地位。这个社区倾向于投票支持贝扎雷尔·斯莫特里奇领导的极右宗教犹太复国主义党，该党是内塔尼亚胡联盟的主要成员。尽管斯莫特里奇及其政党的选票实际上是内塔尼亚胡集团的选票，但总理所在的利库德集团本身可能会在斯德洛特遭受损失。

paras.en: Regardless of the election's results, the perception of Sderot as a city of Moroccan Jews is not bound to change anytime soon. Ben-Simon said Eisenkot's election could serve as an opportunity for reshaping Moroccan Jews' future identity in Israel.
paras.zh: 无论选举结果如何，斯德洛特作为摩洛哥犹太人城市的看法不会很快改变。本-西蒙表示，艾森科特的当选可能成为重塑摩洛哥犹太人未来在以色列身份的机会。

paras.en: "The connection cities like Sderot have to their Moroccan roots would grow stronger as a result of an Eisenkot win," Ben-Simon said.
paras.zh: 本-西蒙表示：“艾森科特获胜后，像斯德洛特这样的城市与其摩洛哥根源之间的联系将会更加紧密。”

articles.title: Protein shakes for teenagers: Good or bad idea?

paras.en: You can take it as a powdered drink, or in a snack bar. Puddings and certain breads are also promoted as "sources of protein," and protein-enriched products like Kindershake and Teen Balance are specifically designed to appeal to a young people — and it appears to be working.
paras.zh: 您可以将其作为粉末饮料饮用，或在小吃店中饮用。布丁和某些面包也被宣传为“蛋白质来源”，Kindershake 和 Teen Balance 等富含蛋白质的产品是专门为吸引年轻人而设计的——而且它似乎很有效。

paras.en: In a representative survey of almost 1,000 parents by the University of Michigan in 2024, just under half said their children, who were aged 13 to 17, had consumed protein products over the previous year. The survey found that boys were more likely to do so than girls, especially in connection with sport, or to build muscle. Girls took them to balance their diet, and to lose weight.
paras.zh: 密歇根大学 2024 年对近 1,000 名家长进行的一项代表性调查显示，不到一半的家长表示，他们 13 至 17 岁的孩子在过去一年中食用了蛋白质产品。调查发现，男孩比女孩更有可能这样做，特别是在运动或锻炼肌肉方面。女孩们用它们来平衡饮食和减肥。

paras.en: According to the statistics portal Statista, between March 2024 and March 2025 the fitness protein product market in Germany recorded a huge jump of around 25% in retail revenue.
paras.zh: 根据统计门户网站 Statista 的数据，2024 年 3 月至 2025 年 3 月期间，德国健身蛋白产品市场的零售收入大幅增长约 25%。

paras.en: Proteins are key building blocks for our metabolism. They play an important role in building up and repairing tissue in our muscles, skin and organs. Proteins are the basis for the formation of enzymes that regulate chemical reactions in the body, and of antibodies that are vital for our immune system.
paras.zh: 蛋白质是我们新陈代谢的关键组成部分。它们在构建和修复我们的肌肉、皮肤和器官组织方面发挥着重要作用。蛋白质是形成调节体内化学反应的酶和对我们的免疫系统至关重要的抗体的基础。

paras.en: According to the German Nutrition Society (DGE), healthy adults should consume 0.8 grams of protein daily per kilogram of body weight. A woman weighing 65 kilos should eat 52 grams of protein per day, for example.
paras.zh: 根据德国营养学会（DGE）的建议，健康成年人每天每公斤体重应摄入0.8克蛋白质。例如，体重 65 公斤的女性每天应摄入 52 克蛋白质。

paras.en: But they can do this without special protein products. A portion of oat flakes with an almond drink for breakfast, a baked potato with curd cheese for lunch, and two slices of wholemeal bread with peanut butter in the evening — objective achieved.
paras.zh: 但他们不需要特殊的蛋白质产品就能做到这一点。早餐吃一份燕麦片加杏仁饮料，午餐吃一份烤土豆加凝乳干酪，晚上吃两片加花生酱的全麦面包——目标达到了。

paras.en: Young people should consume a little more, as they are still growing. For them, the formula is 0.9 grams of protein per kilo of body weight. A teenager weighing 45 kilos should therefore eat 40.5 grams of protein per day. People over 65 and children aged one to four should have a little more: one gram of protein per kilo of body weight.
paras.zh: 年轻人应该多吃一点，因为他们还在成长。对于他们来说，配方是每公斤体重 0.9 克蛋白质。因此，体重 45 公斤的青少年每天应摄入 40.5 克蛋白质。 65岁以上的人和1至4岁的儿童应该多吃一点：每公斤体重一克蛋白质。

paras.en: Older people tend to eat too little protein, often because their appetite decreases. But a study done in Germany between 2015 and 2017 showed that children and young people there often consume too much. Around half of six- to 17-year-olds ate more than double the recommended daily amount of protein.
paras.zh: 老年人往往吃得太少的蛋白质，通常是因为他们的食欲下降。但 2015 年至 2017 年在德国进行的一项研究表明，那里的儿童和年轻人往往消费过多。大约一半的 6 至 17 岁儿童摄入的蛋白质是每日建议摄入量的两倍以上。

paras.en: Too much protein can be harmful in the long term, according to the DGE. Various studies show that children who eat too much protein, particularly animal protein, often become overweight. Some enter puberty early.
paras.zh: DGE 表示，从长远来看，过多的蛋白质可能有害。各种研究表明，摄入过多蛋白质（尤其是动物蛋白）的儿童往往会变得超重。有些人提前进入青春期。

paras.en: Above all, too much protein can put excessive strain on the kidneys, causing damage. The kidneys have to convert the amino acids that constitute the building blocks of proteins into urea before they are excreted in urine. Damage is particularly likely if a person doesn't drink enough fluids, or has pre-existing kidney damage — but adolescents are also at greater risk.
paras.zh: 最重要的是，过多的蛋白质会给肾脏带来过度的压力，造成损害。肾脏必须将构成蛋白质的氨基酸转化为尿素，然后再通过尿液排出体外。如果一个人没有喝足够的液体，或者已有肾脏损伤，那么损伤的可能性特别大，但青少年也面临更大的风险。

paras.en: Protein helps build muscle and shed weight
paras.zh: 蛋白质有助于增强肌肉和减轻体重

paras.en: A person's protein requirement is greater if they are very physically active. Among other things, according to a DGE position paper, proteins can help maintain or build up muscular mass and strength, and support recovery after strain.
paras.zh: 如果一个人的体力活动非常活跃，那么他对蛋白质的需求量就会更大。除其他外，根据 DGE 立场文件，蛋白质可以帮助维持或增强肌肉质量和力量，并支持拉伤后的恢复。

paras.en: The paper states that, depending on physical condition and what they are training for, sportspeople should consume between 1.2 and 2 grams of protein per kilo of body weight, divided into several portions throughout the day. These recommendations only apply to people who train for more than five hours a day.
paras.zh: 该论文指出，根据身体状况和训练目的，运动员每公斤体重应摄入 1.2 至 2 克蛋白质，一天中分几次摄入。这些建议仅适用于每天训练超过五个小时的人。

paras.en: Proteins are of interest to people who want to lose weight because they are good at satisfying hunger. People usually lose more weight by following a protein-rich diet rather than another. Long-term, though, the most important thing to look at is: How many calories am I consuming, and how many am I burning?
paras.zh: 蛋白质之所以引起想要减肥的人的兴趣，是因为它们善于充饥。人们通常通过富含蛋白质的饮食而不是其他饮食来减轻体重。但从长远来看，最重要的是：我消耗了多少卡路里，燃烧了多少卡路里？

paras.en: Is animal protein better than plant protein?
paras.zh: 动物蛋白比植物蛋白好吗？

paras.en: Overall, plant proteins usually contain somewhat fewer essential amino acids than animal protein. "Essential" because the body cannot make them by itself – it has to take them in as food.
paras.zh: 总体而言，植物蛋白含有的必需氨基酸通常比动物蛋白少一些。 “必需”是因为身体无法自行制造它们，必须将它们作为食物摄入。

paras.en: However, wholegrain products, pulses, or nuts are also higher in fiber, vitamins, and unsaturated fats – all of which are healthy. The DGE therefore advises that protein intake should be increased primarily with sources of plant protein.
paras.zh: 然而，全麦产品、豆类或坚果的纤维、维生素和不饱和脂肪含量也较高——所有这些都是健康的。因此，DGE 建议增加蛋白质摄入量应主要通过植物蛋白来源。

paras.en: What is the criticism leveled against protein products?
paras.zh: 针对蛋白质产品的批评是什么？

paras.en: Protein powders and bars are often enriched not only with vitamins and minerals but also with unhelpful ingredients like sweeteners, sugar, additives and flavorings. The German Sport University in Cologne even found doping substances in protein products that were praised for building muscle.
paras.zh: 蛋白粉和蛋白棒通常不仅富含维生素和矿物质，还富含甜味剂、糖、添加剂和调味剂等无用成分。科隆的德国体育大学甚至在被誉为增强肌肉的蛋白质产品中发现了兴奋剂。

paras.en: Adolescents in particular might experience an unpleasant side-effect of consuming protein powders. These usually consist of milk proteins. There are various ways in which milk proteins can increase the skin's production of sebum, and this can trigger or exacerbate acne, although a direct link between milk protein products and acne has not been definitively proven.
paras.zh: 尤其是青少年可能会因食用蛋白粉而出现令人不快的副作用。这些通常由牛奶蛋白组成。牛奶蛋白可以通过多种方式增加皮肤皮脂的产生，这可能引发或加剧痤疮，尽管牛奶蛋白产品与痤疮之间的直接联系尚未得到明确证明。

paras.en: Specialists are also skeptical about protein shakes, fearing that they could lead to young people eating fewer normal meals, and thus consuming less fiber, micronutrients, and healthy fats.
paras.zh: 专家们也对蛋白质奶昔持怀疑态度，担心它们可能会导致年轻人减少正常膳食，从而摄入更少的纤维、微量营养素和健康脂肪。

paras.en: Protein-enriched foods are usually expensive. In a 2022 study, consumer organizations also found that foods that are naturally high in protein, such as cheese, curds, or soya drinks, often cost more if the protein content has been highlighted by the manufacturer.
paras.zh: 富含蛋白质的食物通常很昂贵。在 2022 年的一项研究中，消费者组织还发现，如果制造商强调了蛋白质含量，那么天然富含蛋白质的食品（例如奶酪、凝乳或大豆饮料）通常会花费更高。

paras.en: Not even sportspeople with a high protein requirement need to supplement their diet with special protein products. The DGE advises that they should aim to satisfy their requirements by optimizing their diet, and says there is no scientific evidence that our bodies require protein-enriched food supplements when put under strain.
paras.zh: 即使是蛋白质需求量高的运动员也不需要用特殊的蛋白质产品来补充饮食。 DGE 建议他们应该通过优化饮食来满足自己的需求，并表示没有科学证据表明我们的身体在承受压力时需要富含蛋白质的食品补充剂。

paras.en: However, the experts do say that it may make sense for people to use protein preparations if they have allergies, problems with digestion, chewing, or swallowing, or if their appetite is very low.
paras.zh: 然而，专家确实表示，如果人们有过敏、消化、咀嚼或吞咽问题，或者食欲很低，那么使用蛋白质制剂可能是有意义的。

paras.en: This article has been translated from German.
paras.zh: 本文是从德文翻译而来。

articles.title: Murder in Malaysia’s Beverly Hills | True Crime Reports

paras.en: A young woman is abducted, shot twice, and blown up in the jungle. Who wanted Altantuya dead – and who covered it up?
paras.zh: 一名年轻女子在丛林中被绑架、中枪两次并被炸死。谁想要阿旦杜亚死——又是谁掩盖了这一切？

paras.en: A young Mongolian woman is abducted from an affluent neighbourhood in Kuala Lumpur in 2006, driven into the jungle, shot twice, and blown up with explosives. Her murder became one of Malaysia’s most notorious unsolved political scandals. But who wanted Altantuya Shaariibuu dead, and how far does the cover-up go?
paras.zh: 2006 年，一名年轻的蒙古妇女在吉隆坡的一个富裕社区被绑架，被赶进丛林，遭到两次枪击，并被炸药炸死。她的谋杀案成为马来西亚最臭名昭著的未解决政治丑闻之一。但谁想要阿旦杜亚·沙里布死？到底掩盖到了什么程度呢？

paras.en: The illustrations in this video have been created by artists aided by AI-powered software.
paras.zh: 该视频中的插图是由艺术家在人工智能软件的帮助下创作的。

paras.zh: - Mary Ann Jolley (@jolleyma)，半岛电视台高级记者

Our executive producer is Ney Alvarez. Our senior producers are Fahrinisa Campana and Marthe van der Wolf. Leo Danczak, is the producer and Catherine Nouhan is the assistant producer. articles.title: Thousands mourn victims of deadly Jordan church attack

paras.en: Thousands of mourners have gathered for the funerals of eight of the victims of a deadly attack on a church in southern Jordan, with Prime Minister Jafar Hassan also in attendance.
paras.zh: 数千名哀悼者聚集在约旦南部一座教堂发生致命袭击事件的八名遇难者的葬礼上，总理贾法尔·哈桑也出席了葬礼。

paras.en: The burials on Sunday were beside St George’s Greek Orthodox Church in the village of Hamoud, southwest of the capital, Amman, two days after attackers opened fire during another funeral there.
paras.zh: 周日的葬礼在首都安曼西南部哈穆德村的圣乔治希腊东正教教堂旁举行，两天前，袭击者在当地另一场葬礼上开枪。

paras.en: Nine people were killed and dozens wounded in a rare attack on Jordan’s Christian minority, prompting three days of national mourning.
paras.zh: 约旦基督徒少数群体遭遇罕见袭击，造成九人死亡、数十人受伤，引发全国哀悼三天。

paras.en: The ninth victim, Mohammed al-Qasous, is due to be buried on Monday, his family told the AFP news agency.
paras.zh: 第九名受害者穆罕默德·卡苏斯的家人告诉法新社，他将于周一下葬。

paras.en: Coffins wrapped in Jordanian flags were carried through crowds gathered around the church in Karak province, as priests led prayers and security personnel stood guard.
paras.zh: 裹着约旦国旗的棺材被抬着穿过聚集在卡拉克省教堂周围的人群，神父们主持祈祷，保安人员站岗。

paras.en: Prime Minister Hassan attended the service alongside government ministers and senior military and civilian officials, according to Jordan’s state news agency, Petra.
paras.zh: 据约旦国家通讯社佩特拉报道，哈桑总理与政府部长以及高级军事和文职官员一起出席了仪式。

paras.en: Thousands of citizens also participated in the funeral procession, Petra said.
paras.zh: 佩特拉说，数千名公民也参加了送葬队伍。

paras.en: Among those caught in Friday’s shooting was Sahar al-Halsa, who told the Reuters news agency from her nearby home that she sheltered behind a pillar as gunfire erupted and people screamed.
paras.zh: 萨哈尔·哈尔萨（Sahar al-Halsa）是周五枪击事件中被捕的人之一，她在附近的家中告诉路透社，当枪声爆发和人们尖叫时，她躲在一根柱子后面。

paras.en: When she rushed outside, she found her cousin Assem lying wounded.
paras.zh: 当她冲出去时，发现她的表弟阿塞姆受伤倒地。

paras.en: “Assem, Assem, my darling, answer me,” she recalled calling to him. He briefly opened his eyes before dying, she said.
paras.zh: “阿塞姆，阿塞姆，我亲爱的，回答我，”她回忆道。她说，他死前短暂地睁开了眼睛。

paras.en: Father Yohanna Hamati told AFP that about 170 to 200 people were at the church for Friday’s funeral when firing began outside.
paras.zh: 约翰娜·哈马蒂 (Yohanna Hamati) 神父告诉法新社，大约有 170 至 200 人在教堂参加周五的葬礼，当时教堂外开始发生枪击事件。

paras.en: The mourners initially struggled to understand what was happening, he said, before people began rushing into the church to escape.
paras.zh: 他说，哀悼者最初很难理解发生了什么，然后人们开始冲进教堂逃跑。

paras.en: By Saturday, bullet holes remained in the walls and wooden pews, and windows had been shattered.
paras.zh: 到了周六，墙壁和木制长椅上仍留有弹孔，窗户也被打碎。

paras.en: Church workers were cleaning away blood as villagers prepared to bury the dead. Jordanian authorities have described the attack as “extremist terrorism”.
paras.zh: 当村民准备埋葬死者时，教堂工作人员正在清理血迹。约旦当局将这次袭击描述为“极端主义恐怖主义”。

paras.en: King Abdullah, who visited some of the wounded in hospital on Friday, has promised a forceful response and the assailants are still being sought.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜拉国王周五在医院探望了一些伤者，他承诺将采取强有力的回应，目前仍在寻找袭击者。

paras.en: Officials say they have not established whether the attackers were connected to an armed group and no organisation has claimed responsibility.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，他们尚未确定袭击者是否与武装团体有联系，也没有组织声称对此负责。

paras.en: The violence has also drawn expressions of solidarity across religious lines. Christians account for about 3 percent of Jordan’s largely Muslim population and AFP reported that Muslims were among those wounded.
paras.zh: 暴力事件还引发了跨宗教界线的声援。约旦人口以穆斯林为主，基督徒约占 3%，法新社报道称，受伤者中有穆斯林。

paras.en: Young volunteers visited a hospital in Karak with flowers and a message reading, “Our loss is one”.
paras.zh: 年轻志愿者带着鲜花和写着“我们的损失是一个”的信息参观了卡拉克的一家医院。

paras.en: The mourning reached Washington, DC, on Sunday, where members of the Jordanian community lit candles outside their country’s embassy.
paras.zh: 周日，哀悼活动传至华盛顿特区，约旦社区成员在本国大使馆外点燃蜡烛。

paras.en: Jordan’s ambassador to the US, Dina Kawar, told those gathered that efforts to stir religious division were “bound to fail”. Back in Hamoud, Father Hamati appealed for unity, stressing that Muslims had also suffered in the attack.
paras.zh: 约旦驻美国大使迪娜·卡瓦尔告诉与会者，煽动宗教分裂的努力“注定会失败”。回到哈穆德，哈马蒂神父呼吁团结，强调穆斯林也在袭击中遭受了苦难。

paras.en: “We make no distinction between Muslim and Christian,” he told AFP.
paras.zh: “我们不区分穆斯林和基督徒，”他告诉法新社。

articles.title: Seven killed in Gaza as Israel targets university campus and other sites

paras.en: At least seven Palestinians have been killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza, including one that targeted a university campus in Gaza City.
paras.zh: 至少七名巴勒斯坦人在以色列对加沙各地的袭击中丧生，其中包括针对加沙城一所大学校园的袭击。

paras.en: Three security guards were killed in an Israeli air strike on the Islamic University campus on Sunday, the second attack that targeted the institution in the space of a few hours.
paras.zh: 周日，以色列对伊斯兰大学校园发动空袭，造成三名保安死亡，这是几小时内第二次针对该机构的袭击。

paras.en: Reporting from the scene immediately after the attack, Al Jazeera’s Hani Mahmoud said, “The aftermath was massive.”
paras.zh: 半岛电视台记者哈尼·马哈茂德在袭击发生后立即从现场报道说：“后果是巨大的。”

paras.en: “The bloodstains, the pieces of flesh of the bodies that were torn apart were on the ground; the smell of the acrid, burning concrete mixed with the flesh and the blood,” Mahmoud added, saying that the Al Jazeera team had just finished filming on site and greeted the three security guards before the strike killed them.
paras.zh: 马哈茂德补充道：“地上有血迹、尸体被撕裂的肉块；刺鼻的、燃烧的混凝土的气味与血肉混合在一起。”他说，半岛电视台团队刚刚完成现场拍摄，在袭击杀死三名保安之前向他们打招呼。

paras.en: “We could hear the hissing sound of flying shrapnel everywhere to the point we thought we were going to be hit,” our correspondent said.
paras.zh: “我们可以听到到处都是弹片飞舞的嘶嘶声，我们以为自己会被击中，”我们的记者说。

paras.en: In the earlier drone strike on the campus, seven female students were injured by flying shrapnel.
paras.zh: 在早些时候校园内的无人机袭击中，七名女学生被飞溅的弹片炸伤。

paras.en: “One of them was seriously injured and was transferred to a nearby field hospital,” Mahmoud said.
paras.zh: 马哈茂德说：“其中一人受重伤，被转移到附近的野战医院。”

paras.en: Separately, in southern Gaza, the Nasser Medical Complex reported that two people were killed as a result of Israeli shelling in al-Mawasi in Khan Younis. Several people were also wounded, including a child.
paras.zh: 另外，在加沙南部，纳赛尔医疗中心报告称，以色列炮击汗尤尼斯省的马瓦西，造成两人死亡。多人受伤，其中包括一名儿童。

paras.en: A person was also killed in an Israeli drone strike east of Deir el-Balah in central Gaza, and another person was killed, and several others wounded, in an attack on al-Rashid Street, near Hamad Hospital in the northern Gaza Strip, the Palestinian Wafa news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据巴勒斯坦瓦法通讯社报道，以色列无人机在加沙中部代尔巴拉赫以东的一次袭击中造成一人死亡，在加沙地带北部哈马德医院附近的拉希德街的一次袭击中，另一人死亡，多人受伤。

paras.en: The Popular Resistance Committees in Palestine condemned the university attacks, calling on mediators and international guarantors to step in to stop Israeli violations.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦人民抵抗委员会谴责大学袭击事件，呼吁调解人和国际担保人介入，制止以色列的侵犯行为。

paras.en: According to the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, UNESCO, nearly 95 percent of Gaza’s higher education campuses have been destroyed or damaged since Israel’s genocidal war began in October 2023.
paras.zh: 据联合国教育、科学及文化组织 (UNESCO) 统计，自 2023 年 10 月以色列种族灭绝战争开始以来，加沙近 95% 的高等教育校园已被摧毁或损坏。

paras.en: Mahmoud noted that the majority of buildings at the Islamic University were already destroyed before Sunday’s attacks. “Only a couple of these buildings are partially standing,” he said.
paras.zh: 马哈茂德指出，伊斯兰大学的大部分建筑在周日的袭击之前已经被毁。 “这些建筑物中只有几座是部分矗立的，”他说。

paras.en: The incident is “a reminder that a sense of security is painfully out of reach, even inside the place where students are supposed to be learning without the fear of these attacks”, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这一事件“提醒我们，即使在学生本应不用担心这些袭击而学习的地方，安全感也是遥不可及的”。

paras.en: The latest figures released by the Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza show that at least 1,551 people have been killed since the “ceasefire” began in October 2025, and 5,573 have been injured.
paras.zh: 加沙巴勒斯坦卫生部公布的最新数据显示，自2025年10月“停火”开始以来，至少有1551人死亡，5573人受伤。

paras.en: The total death toll from Israel’s genocidal war on the Gaza Strip is 74,544, with at least 175,692 people wounded since October 2023.
paras.zh: 自2023年10月以来，以色列在加沙地带的种族灭绝战争造成的总死亡人数为74,544人，至少有175,692人受伤。

paras.en: Israel also continues to occupy more and more land inside the Strip, with almost two-thirds of Gaza now under Israel’s military control or subject to its restrictions.
paras.zh: 以色列还继续占领加沙地带内越来越多的土地，近三分之二的加沙地带现在处于以色列的军事控制或限制之下。

paras.en: Palestinians there are also experiencing an escalating food crisis as a result of ongoing Israeli crossing closures and reduced international funding for assistance.
paras.zh: 由于以色列持续关闭过境点和国际援助资金减少，那里的巴勒斯坦人也正在经历不断升级的粮食危机。

articles.title: The College of Magic turns ordinary kids into confident, top-hat wearing magicians
articles.author: Julie Bourdin

paras.en: This College of Magic turns ordinary kids into cool magicians
paras.zh: 这所魔法学院将普通孩子变成酷炫的魔术师

paras.en: Dressed in a sharp black three-piece suit and a dapper yellow bow tie, Lubelo Mthenjana stands alone on a dark stage, taking in the last few seconds of quiet before the curtain opens. He takes a deep breath as his name is announced. Then he opens his arms wide and flashes a bright smile.
paras.zh: 卢贝洛·姆森贾纳 (Lubelo Mthenjana) 身着鲜明的黑色三件套，系着整洁的黄色领结，独自站在黑暗的舞台上，享受着幕布打开前的最后几秒钟的安静。当他的名字被宣布时，他深吸了一口气。然后他张开双臂，露出灿烂的笑容。

paras.en: "Hello everyone! My name is Lubelo Mthenjana, and I will be performing for you … some magic!"
paras.zh: “大家好！我的名字是 Lubelo Mthenjana，我将为你们表演……一些魔术！”

paras.en: The audience of about 30 children and parents is spellbound. They laugh out loud as he makes a string of paper clips vanish into a plastic cup and gasp with surprise as the clips reappear inside a matchbox. Then comes his best trick: He conjures sweets out of thin air and tosses them into the crowd. The room erupts. As Lubelo takes his final bow to thunderous applause, his mom beams a proud smile at the 11-year-old apprentice magician.
paras.zh: 大约30名孩子和家长的观众都被迷住了。当他让一串回形针消失在塑料杯中时，他们大声笑起来；当回形针重新出现在火柴盒里时，他们惊讶地喘息着。然后是他最绝妙的把戏：他凭空变出糖果，然后把它们扔到人群中。房间里爆发了。当卢贝洛在雷鸣般的掌声中最后鞠躬时，他的妈妈对这位 11 岁的魔术师学徒露出了自豪的微笑。

paras.en: On this cloudy Saturday morning in September, Cape Town's College of Magic is buzzing with energy as dozens of students are competing in the annual junior magic contest. Heading to their classrooms, children in top hats, crisp white shirts and ties dash up and down a staircase decorated with a riot of brightly colored posters. On every floor, display cabinets overflow with magic wands, sparkly hats, silk scarves, handcuffs, dice, Rubik's Cubes, toys, photographs and dozens of trophies earned by students in competitions all over the world.
paras.zh: 九月这个阴天的星期六早晨，开普敦魔法学院充满活力，数十名学生正在参加一年一度的初级魔法大赛。孩子们戴着礼帽，穿着干净的白衬衫，系着领带，在通往教室的路上在贴满色彩鲜艳海报的楼梯上跑上跑下。每层楼的展示柜里都摆满了魔法棒、闪闪发光的帽子、丝巾、手铐、骰子、魔方、玩具、照片以及学生在世界各地比赛中获得的数十个奖杯。

paras.en: Outside the old red-brick Victorian mansion, framed by palm trees, two teenage boys zip around the car park on unicycles. Balls, clubs and diabolos shoot up into the air as a handful of kids practice juggling on the porch.
paras.zh: 在棕榈树环绕的古老红砖维多利亚式宅邸外，两个十几岁的男孩骑着独轮车在停车场里疾驰。几个孩子在门廊上练习杂耍，球、球棒和空竹飞向空中。

paras.en: Tucked away in a peaceful suburb, this extraordinary school is a real-world Hogwarts: Africa's only school for youthful stage magicians and illusionists. Every Saturday morning, about 190 starry-eyed students ages 10 to 18 attend classes in everything from puppetry, mime and clowning to juggling, card tricks, illusions, mentalism, stage magic, theater production and escapology. "All the skills that will make a good magician," sums up David Gore, the school's founder.
paras.zh: 这所非凡的学校坐落在宁静的郊区，是现实世界中的霍格沃茨：非洲唯一一所为年轻舞台魔术师和魔术师开设的学校。每周六早上，约有 190 名 10 至 18 岁的乐观学生参加各种课程，从木偶、哑剧、小丑到杂耍、纸牌戏法、幻术、唯心论、舞台魔术、戏剧制作和逃脱术。 “成为一名优秀魔术师的所有技能，”学校创始人大卫·戈尔总结道。

paras.en: In 1980, Gore was studying law and paying his way by performing at private magic shows when he and a friend came up with the idea of starting a magic school.
paras.zh: 1980年，戈尔正在学习法律并通过在私人魔术表演中表演来维持生计，这时他和一位朋友想到了开办一所魔术学校的想法。

paras.en: "We walked into our local newspaper house with our top hats and tails, told our story about how we were starting the College of Magic, did magic for the journalists in the newsroom, and they published an article," he recalls. "From that article, we had 34 young people who started attending formal weekly classes studying magic."
paras.zh: “我们戴着大礼帽、穿着燕尾服走进当地的报社，讲述了我们如何创办魔法学院的故事，为新闻编辑室的记者们表演了魔术，然后他们发表了一篇文章，”他回忆道。 “从那篇文章开始，我们有 34 名年轻人开始每周参加正式的魔法课程。”

paras.en: At the time, South Africa was still in the grip of apartheid, a brutal system of racial segregation that dictated almost every aspect of daily life. State schools were strictly segregated. Students of different races could not even share park benches, some building entrances or take the same public transport to school. Yet the College of Magic was multiracial from day one.
paras.zh: 当时，南非仍处于种族隔离制度之下，这是一种残酷的种族隔离制度，几乎决定了日常生活的方方面面。公立学校实行严格隔离。不同种族的学生甚至无法共用公园长椅、一些建筑入口或乘坐相同的公共交通工具去学校。然而魔法学院从第一天起就是多种族的。

paras.en: "When we started out, our organization was illegal," says Gore, referring to its no-segregation policy. "This was an opportunity for young people from all backgrounds to come together around a common interest in magic, to learn about each other and understand each other."
paras.zh: “当我们刚成立时，我们的组织是非法的，”戈尔在谈到其无种族隔离政策时说道。 “这是一个机会，让来自不同背景的年轻人围绕对魔术的共同兴趣聚集在一起，互相了解和理解。”

paras.en: Nearly 50 years later, the school continues to stand out in a city still deeply divided along racial and economic lines.
paras.zh: 近 50 年后，这所学校在一个种族和经济分歧依然严重的城市中继续脱颖而出。

paras.en: "Many of our young people remain siloed in their socioeconomic groups, very often along either language or racial lines," Gore explains. "Some arrive in very fancy cars, others have taken an hour in a collective taxi to get here. But when they're here, they work with the same equipment, the same classes, the same stages and get the same food."
paras.zh: “我们的许多年轻人仍然被孤立在他们的社会经济群体中，通常是按照语言或种族界限，”戈尔解释道。 “有些人乘坐非常豪华的汽车到达这里，其他人则乘坐集体出租车花了一个小时才到达这里。但当他们来到这里时，他们使用相同的设备、相同的课程、相同的阶段并获得相同的食物。”

paras.en: Though the six-year course costs a fee, about 80% of the students cannot afford to pay and are sponsored, mostly through private donations.
paras.zh: 尽管六年制课程需要收费，但大约 80% 的学生无力支付费用，只能通过私人捐款获得赞助。

paras.en: "Magic is such a wonderful companion for our young people here in South Africa," says Gore. "They're able to carry it in their pockets, into the communities and the marginalized areas where most of our students come from. It's an art form that can be performed without being wealthy or needing very expensive instruments."
paras.zh: “对于我们南非的年轻人来说，魔术是一个很好的伴侣，”戈尔说。 “他们能够把它装在口袋里，走进我们大多数学生来自的社区和边缘化地区。这是一种不需要富有或不需要非常昂贵的乐器就可以表演的艺术形式。”

paras.en: Multiple studies have found that learning magic can help children develop self-esteem, curiosity, lateral thinking, fine motor skills and problem-solving abilities. A 2021 study conducted by researchers at the Universities of Hertfordshire and Edinburgh found that children who learned and performed a magic trick showed greater improvements in creative fluency and originality than those who completed a similar art activity.
paras.zh: 多项研究发现，学习魔术可以帮助孩子培养自尊、好奇心、横向思维、精细运动技能和解决问题的能力。赫特福德郡大学和爱丁堡大学的研究人员在 2021 年进行的一项研究发现，学习并表演魔术的孩子比完成类似艺术活动的孩子在创作流畅性和原创性方面表现出更大的进步。

paras.en: Even watching a magic trick can challenge our assumptions about the world and stimulate more original thinking. In another study, researchers found that it stimulated areas of the brain associated with cognitive flexibility and processing unconventional information.
paras.zh: 即使观看魔术表演也可以挑战我们对世界的假设并激发更多原创思维。在另一项研究中，研究人员发现它刺激了与认知灵活性和处理非常规信息相关的大脑区域。

paras.en: "Many of our graduates don't become performers or magicians. But one of the skills that this young generation is most going to need for their careers is creativity," adds Gore. "That is what's so fantastic about magic: Nothing's impossible for us."
paras.zh: “我们的许多毕业生并没有成为表演者或魔术师。但年轻一代在职业生涯中最需要的技能之一就是创造力，”戈尔补充道。 “这就是魔法的奇妙之处：对我们来说没有什么是不可能的。”

paras.en: For 11-year-old Lubelo, magic has "opened up a new world." After watching a family friend perform a trick, he was determined to join the College of Magic. He had to wait until he turned 10 to enroll. Now, he's hooked.
paras.zh: 对于 11 岁的卢贝洛来说，魔法“打开了一个新世界”。在观看了家人朋友表演的魔术后，他决定加入魔法学院。他必须等到10岁才能入学。现在，他上瘾了。

paras.en: At home in Makhaza township, about 40 minutes from the college, Lubelo spends his free time watching magic shows online and practicing tricks on his brothers and parents. He keeps his props, tools and other secrets in a box hidden away in his room. He's even chosen a stage name: Spade Boy — after his favorite card suit.
paras.zh: 卢贝洛位于马哈扎镇的家中，距离大学约 40 分钟路程，他利用业余时间在线观看魔术表演，并向他的兄弟和父母练习魔术。他将道具、工具和其他秘密藏在房间里的一个盒子里。他甚至选择了一个艺名：黑桃男孩——以他最喜欢的纸牌套装命名。

paras.en: "If my mom is cooking and asks me to pass the potatoes, I'll start juggling with them," he says mischievously.
paras.zh: “如果我妈妈做饭时让我把土豆递过来，我就会开始玩弄它们，”他调皮地说。

paras.en: Lubelo has also persuaded several friends to join the school, becoming something of an ambassador in a community where magic is often frowned upon and associated with witchcraft.
paras.zh: 卢贝洛还说服了几位朋友加入学校，成为这个社区的大使，在这个社区里，魔法常常被人鄙视，并与巫术联系在一起。

paras.en: "Many people are afraid of magic. But at the College of Magic, we don't do dark magic," he explains. "We just do the kind of magic that makes somebody smile, makes them happy and takes the stress away."
paras.zh: “很多人害怕魔法。但在魔法学院，我们不使用黑魔法，”他解释道。 “我们只是做那种让人们微笑、让他们快乐并消除压力的魔法。”

paras.en: Sometimes, he says, other children ask whether he can turn people into pigs. "Then I just say: 'Let me start with you!' and they run away," he laughs.
paras.zh: 他说，有时其他孩子会问他能否把人变成猪。 “然后我就说：‘让我从你开始吧！’然后他们就逃跑了，”他笑着说。

paras.en: Lubelo's mother, Yandiswa, says the magic lessons have boosted her son's confidence. They have brought another kind of relief, too. "It keeps him occupied and away from this environment and everything that's happening outside," she says.
paras.zh: 卢贝洛的母亲扬迪斯瓦 (Yandiswa) 表示，魔法课增强了她儿子的信心。他们也带来了另一种缓解。 “这让他忙碌起来，远离这个环境和外面发生的一切，”她说。

paras.en: With nearly 60 murders per day, South Africa has one of the world's highest crime rates, and several of Cape Town's townships are among the areas hardest hit by violent crime. From his home in Makhaza, Lubelo often hears gunshots. He says boys his age are drawn into using and selling drugs.
paras.zh: 南非每天发生近 60 起谋杀案，是世界上犯罪率最高的国家之一，开普敦的几个乡镇是暴力犯罪最严重的地区之一。卢贝洛在马哈扎的家中经常听到枪声。他说，他这个年纪的男孩容易吸毒和贩卖毒品。

paras.en: The magic community hasn't been spared. Just a few weeks before our visit, the school held a memorial service for Duma Mgqoki, a promising young magician, former student and volunteer teacher who was killed in a shooting in July. He was 22.
paras.zh: 魔法界也未能幸免。就在我们访问的前几周，学校为 Duma Mgqoki 举行了追悼会，Duma Mgqoki 是一位很有前途的年轻魔术师、前学生和志愿者教师，他在 7 月份的一次枪击事件中丧生。那年他22岁。

paras.en: "On a weekly basis, some of our young people come to us saying they've experienced crime on a firsthand basis," says David Gore. "These things need to change, and we're very hopeful that the younger generation of today are going to be the force of change to bring about the society which we all would like to live in."
paras.zh: “每周，我们的一些年轻人都会来找我们，说他们亲身经历过犯罪，”大卫·戈尔说。 “这些事情需要改变，我们非常希望今天的年轻一代将成为变革的力量，以实现我们所有人都想生活在其中的社会。”

paras.en: Back at the college, after finishing his show, Lubelo steps off the stage to a chorus of fist bumps and backslaps from his excited friends.
paras.zh: 回到大学，表演结束后，卢贝洛走下舞台，兴奋的朋友们齐声击拳、拍背。

paras.en: "He was so good! We're swimming in happiness!" one teenager beams. Without skipping a beat, the boys run outside, pick up colorful leather balls and launch into a juggling competition.
paras.zh: “他太棒了！我们沉浸在幸福之中！”一名少年笑容满面。男孩们毫不犹豫地跑到外面，捡起彩色的皮球，开始进行杂耍比赛。

paras.en: By now, a light drizzle has set in, but the two unicyclists are still making their rounds in the car park, seemingly undeterred. "Even when the storm comes, even when the world ends, I'll never stop unicycling," declares 14-year-old Joshua Clyde as he whizzes past.
paras.zh: 现在已经下起了毛毛细雨，但两名独轮车骑手仍在停车场里转来转去，似乎没有被吓倒。 “即使暴风雨来临时，即使世界末日来临，我也永远不会停止骑独轮车，”14 岁的约书亚·克莱德 (Joshua Clyde) 在疾驰而过时说道。

paras.en: Inside the cafeteria, a wide-eyed crowd has gathered around a teacher showing off a magic trick. With a snap of his fingers and what seems like a touch of superhuman power, he makes a coin disappear from a student's closed fist. It reappears beneath the student's watch.
paras.zh: 自助餐厅内，一群人睁大了眼睛，围着一位正在表演魔术的老师。他打了个响指，似乎有超人的力量，让一枚硬币从学生紧握的拳头上消失了。它重新出现在学生的手表下方。

paras.en: Others have opted for the puppeteering class, upstairs, where pairs of students are taught to bring their humanoid puppets to life.
paras.zh: 其他人则选择了楼上的木偶表演班，在那里，一对对的学生被教导如何将他们的人形木偶变成现实。

paras.en: Footsteps drum up and down the staircase as the remaining performers in this Saturday competition rehearse their routines, nerves and excitement mounting. "Why am I so nervous? I've got this!" says bubbly Kungentando Ndenetya, 12, repeating the mantra to herself.
paras.zh: 当周六比赛的剩余表演者排练他们的表演时，楼梯上的脚步声响起，紧张和兴奋不断增加。 “我为什么这么紧张？我有这个了！” 12 岁的昆根坦多·恩德内蒂亚 (Kungentando Ndenetya) 活泼开朗地对自己重复着这句咒语。

paras.en: Once every child has performed, the jury retires to a quiet office to deliberate. All four judges are former students or teachers at the College of Magic. Twenty-five-year-old Caitlin Hutchison, who comes from "a long line of magicians," says the school taught her "resilience training." Monica Nyakatya graduated in 2009 and now works in logistics but has remained close to the institution that, she says, "shaped" her.
paras.zh: 一旦每个孩子都表演完毕，评审团就会退到安静的办公室进行商议。所有四位评委都是魔法学院的前学生或老师。 25 岁的凯特琳·哈奇森 (Caitlin Hutchison) 出身于“魔术师世家”，她说学校教给她“复原力训练”。莫妮卡·尼亚卡蒂亚 (Monica Nyakatya) 于 2009 年毕业，现在从事物流工作，但仍与她说“塑造”了她的机构保持着密切关系。

paras.en: The deliberations are strictly confidential. When the judges return, everyone gathers in the small theater. The young magicians hold hands, waiting anxiously as the results are announced. Then comes Lubelo's age group.
paras.zh: 审议结果是严格保密的。评委回来后，大家都聚集在小剧场里。年轻的魔术师们手拉着手，焦急地等待着结果的公布。然后是卢贝洛的年龄组。

paras.en: Beaming, he strides onto the stage to shake each judge's hand — then runs into his mother's arms.
paras.zh: 他满面笑容地走上舞台，与每位评委握手，然后跑进母亲的怀里。

paras.en: As soon as he gets home, he will practice his newest tricks.
paras.zh: 一回到家，他就会练习最新的技巧。

paras.en: Julie Bourdin is a freelance journalist based in South Africa and France. She covers human rights and climate-related stories across Africa and beyond.
paras.zh: Julie Bourdin 是一位驻南非和法国的自由记者。她报道非洲及其他地区的人权和气候相关故事。

paras.en: Tommy Trenchard is an independent photojournalist based in Cape Town, South Africa. He has previously contributed photos and stories to NPR on the Mozambique cyclone of 2019, Indonesian death rituals and illegal miners in abandoned South African diamond mines and won a World Press Photo prize for the images in his story for NPR on clashes between elephants and people in Zambia.
paras.zh: 汤米·特伦查德 (Tommy Trenchard) 是一位驻南非开普敦的独立摄影记者。他此前曾向 NPR 提供过关于 2019 年莫桑比克飓风、印度尼西亚死亡仪式和废弃南非钻石矿中非法采矿者的照片和故事，并因其在 NPR 故事中关于赞比亚大象与人之间冲突的图像而获得了世界新闻摄影奖。

articles.title: Israelis have changed. Will they change their leadership?
articles.author: Daniel Estrin

paras.en: Israelis have changed. Will they change their leadership?
paras.zh: 以色列人已经改变了。他们会改变领导层吗？

paras.en: TEL AVIV, Israel — Israelis are convinced that elections scheduled for Tuesday are the most pivotal in their nation's history.
paras.zh: 以色列特拉维夫——以色列人相信，定于周二举行的选举是他们国家历史上最关键的一次。

paras.en: Will they vote out Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu — and his coalition of far-right, ultranationalist and religious political parties — because he failed to prevent the Hamas attacks on Oct. 7, 2023, the deadliest day for Jews since the Holocaust?
paras.zh: 他们是否会因为总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）及其极右翼、极端民族主义和宗教政党联盟未能阻止哈马斯在 2023 年 10 月 7 日（大屠杀以来犹太人死亡最严重的一天）的袭击而投票将其赶下台？

paras.en: Or will they reelect him to continue his campaign of retaliation, waging wars that aim to reshape the Middle East? His main challenger, former military chief of staff Gadi Eisenkot, leads a center-right opposition promising more diplomacy and less extremism.
paras.zh: 或者他们会再次选举他继续他的报复行动，发动旨在重塑中东的战争？他的主要挑战者、前军事参谋长加迪·艾森科特领导的中右翼反对派承诺采取更多外交手段，减少极端主义。

paras.en: It is Israel's first vote after these years of battle and bloodshed. Israelis are so concerned about their country's future that tens of thousands of expats are expected to fly back to cast ballots, since Israel does not allow absentee voting.
paras.zh: 这是以色列在这些年的战斗和流血之后进行的第一次投票。以色列人非常关心自己国家的未来，由于以色列不允许缺席投票，预计数以万计的侨民将飞回投票。

paras.en: "We almost could have been destroyed on Oct. 7," said Israeli lawyer Shoula Romano-Horing, who flew in from Kansas City, Mo., to vote. "This is why I'm voting for Netanyahu, to make Israel so secure and so safe."
paras.zh: 从密苏里州堪萨斯城飞来投票的以色列律师舒拉·罗马诺-霍林 (Shoula Romano-Horing) 说：“10 月 7 日，我们差点就被摧毁了。” “这就是为什么我投票给内塔尼亚胡，让以色列如此安全。”

paras.en: In the opposite corner are those Israelis distressed by the global backlash to the wars Netanyahu's government has waged.
paras.zh: 另一边则是那些因全球对内塔尼亚胡政府发动的战争的强烈抵制而感到痛苦的以色列人。

paras.en: "The actions of this government cause Israelis in general and Jews in general to be tagged as, you know, mass killers," said Yochai Ben-Haim, who works in renewable energy in California and is flying home to Israel for 36 hours just to vote. "This government is led by extremists that do not represent who we are, and we need to change it."
paras.zh: “这个政府的行为导致以色列人和犹太人被贴上大规模杀手的标签，”在加州从事可再生能源工作的尤柴·本·哈伊姆 (Yochai Ben-Haim) 说，他要飞 36 个小时飞回以色列，只是为了投票。 “这个政府由极端分子领导，他们不代表我们是谁，我们需要改变它。”

paras.en: In conversations with dozens of Israelis over the last few weeks, a portrait has emerged of who Israelis are today.
paras.zh: 在过去几周与数十名以色列人的对话中，一幅今天的以色列人的肖像浮出水面。

paras.en: They are a people defiant, but also weary after three years of incessant war. They are enraged at their enemies, but also at their leaders.
paras.zh: 他们是一个反抗的民族，但在经历了三年不间断的战争之后也感到疲惫不堪。他们对敌人感到愤怒，但也对他们的领导人感到愤怒。

paras.en: Many are impervious to the pain of their Palestinian neighbors, but traumatized from the war they have wrought. They are resistant to Palestinian independence, but also revolted by the Israeli settlers pushing Palestinians off their land.
paras.zh: 许多人对巴勒斯坦邻国的痛苦无动于衷，但却因他们发动的战争而受到创伤。他们抵制巴勒斯坦独立，但也对以色列定居者将巴勒斯坦人赶出他们的土地感到反抗。

paras.en: They are fed up with the world's rebuke over the Gaza war, but also fearful of their growing global isolation. They are a people in a tug-of-war with themselves.
paras.zh: 他们厌倦了世界对加沙战争的谴责，但也担心自己在全球日益孤立。他们是一个与自己进行拉锯战的民族。

paras.en: "Israelis want to be feared and to be loved," said Israeli author Micah Goodman. "The problem is that you have two reputations you need to protect, but you can't."
paras.zh: “以色列人希望被人敬畏，也希望被人爱戴，”以色列作家迈卡·古德曼说。 “问题是你有两个声誉需要保护，但你不能。”

paras.en: As elections near, Israelis are learning more about what led up to Oct. 7, 2023.
paras.zh: 随着选举临近，以色列人正在更多地了解导致 2023 年 10 月 7 日发生的事情。

paras.en: Throughout that year, as Israelis poured into the streets to protest Netanyahu's far-right government and its plan to weaken the judiciary, Netanyahu's security chiefs warned that regional enemies could take advantage of the turmoil to attack.
paras.zh: 那一年，当以色列人涌上街头抗议内塔尼亚胡的极右翼政府及其削弱司法机构的计划时，内塔尼亚胡的安全负责人警告说，地区敌人可能会利用骚乱发动袭击。

paras.en: Behind the scenes, Israel received direct warnings that Hamas was planning something big. Israel and Hamas had been holding secret talks for more than a year, Palestinian mediator Sufian Abu Zaida said. When the talks stalled, Hamas' leader in Gaza had Abu Zaida relay a message threatening an "earthquake."
paras.zh: 在幕后，以色列收到了哈马斯正在策划大事的直接警告。巴勒斯坦调解人苏菲安·阿布·扎伊达表示，以色列和哈马斯已经举行秘密会谈一年多了。当谈判陷入僵局时，加沙哈马斯领导人让阿布扎伊达转达威胁要发生“地震”的信息。

paras.en: What kind of earthquake was unclear, said Abu Zaida, but he insists he relayed the warning to Israeli intelligence. The leader of the United Arab Emirates and Egypt's intelligence chief relayed similar warnings, according to reporting by NPR and other media outlets. "All what happened in 7 of October is needless," Abu Zaida said.
paras.zh: 阿布·扎伊达表示，尚不清楚是什么样的地震，但他坚称他已向以色列情报部门转达了这一警告。据美国国家公共广播电台和其他媒体报道，阿拉伯联合酋长国领导人和埃及情报负责人也发出了类似的警告。阿布·扎伊达说：“10 月 7 日发生的一切都是不必要的。”

paras.en: Nearly 1,200 people were killed when Hamas attacked army bases, residential communities and an outdoor music rave — and 251 people were taken hostage back to Gaza. Netanyahu denies he was warned and has never admitted any kind of responsibility for the security failure.
paras.zh: 哈马斯袭击军事基地、住宅区和户外音乐狂欢，造成近 1,200 人死亡，251 人被劫为人质带回加沙。内塔尼亚胡否认曾收到警告，也从未承认对安全失败负有任何责任。

paras.en: "Within days, his PR people were trying to shape the public narrative about events," said Amos Harel, a defense analyst for the Israeli newspaper Haaretz and author of 06:29 – Anatomy of a Failure, which details the Israeli failures to prevent the Oct. 7 attack. (The attack began that day at 6:29 a.m.) Netanyahu's strategy, he said, was "to shift the blame" to the security services and the military.
paras.zh: “几天之内，他的公关人员就试图塑造有关事件的公众叙述，”以色列《国土报》的防务分析师、《06:29 – 失败剖析》一书的作者阿莫斯·哈雷尔 (Amos Harel) 说，该书详细介绍了以色列未能阻止 10 月 7 日袭击事件。 （袭击于当天早上 6 点 29 分开始）他说，内塔尼亚胡的策略是“将责任归咎于”安全部门和军队。

paras.en: For much of the Gaza war, Israeli protesters flooded the streets demanding that Netanyahu strike a deal with Hamas to release Israeli hostages and end the fighting. It would take two years, Israel's longest ever war, before a hostage deal was reached. Netanyahu said he was seeking the total defeat of Hamas, though former officials who worked with Netanyahu allege he prolonged the war for political reasons — a charge that Netanyahu has denied.
paras.zh: 在加沙战争的大部分时间里，以色列抗议者涌上街头，要求内塔尼亚胡与哈马斯达成协议，释放以色列人质并结束战斗。以色列历时最长的战争持续了两年才达成人质协议。内塔尼亚胡表示，他正在寻求彻底击败哈马斯，尽管与内塔尼亚胡共事的前官员声称他出于政治原因延长了战争——内塔尼亚胡否认了这一指控。

paras.en: "I'm absolutely convinced that this is what happened," Harel said. "He felt that if this would move on too fast, then there will be more of a significant public demand for a national commission of inquiry."
paras.zh: “我绝对相信这就是发生的事情，”哈雷尔说。 “他认为，如果事情进展得太快，那么公众就会更加强烈地要求成立国家调查委员会。”

paras.en: There is a great demand among Israelis for an investigation into the attack, like the 9/11 Commission in the United States. Netanyahu has blocked one in Israel.
paras.zh: 以色列人强烈要求像美国的9/11委员会一样对这次袭击事件进行调查。内塔尼亚胡在以色列封锁了其中之一。

paras.en: So Israelis grappling with Oct. 7 go to the spot of the day's deadliest attack, where hundreds of people were killed when Hamas attacked the Nova music festival. The memorial there is a dusty field of plaques and thin poles bearing the pictures of smiling young people who were partying when they came under attack.
paras.zh: 因此，正在努力应对 10 月 7 日的以色列人前往当天最致命的袭击发生地，哈马斯袭击诺瓦音乐节，造成数百人死亡。纪念碑上有一片尘土飞扬的场地，上面有牌匾和细杆，上面挂着微笑的年轻人的照片，他们在遭到袭击时正在聚会。

paras.en: Kati and Meir Zohar, whose 23-year-old daughter Bar was killed there, helped build the memorial with other families. The Zohars say they received no government funding for the effort and no phone call from Netanyahu expressing his condolences.
paras.zh: 卡蒂·佐哈尔 (Kati Zohar) 和梅厄·佐哈尔 (Meir Zohar) 23 岁的女儿巴尔 (Bar) 在那里被杀，他们与其他家庭一起帮助修建了这座纪念碑。佐哈尔夫妇表示，他们没有收到任何政府资助，也没有内塔尼亚胡打来表示哀悼的电话。

paras.en: She believes Netanyahu bears the responsibility for what happened to her daughter on Oct. 7 and, like other Israelis, hopes Netanyahu faces a reckoning for it on election day.
paras.zh: 她认为内塔尼亚胡应对 10 月 7 日发生在她女儿身上的事情负责，并像其他以色列人一样，希望内塔尼亚胡在选举日接受清算。

paras.en: "It's a hope that something will change," Zohar said. "I hope that someone will come and take his place and be the one who [is] trying to keep this country together."
paras.zh: “希望事情会有所改变，”佐哈尔说。 “我希望有人能取代他的位置，成为努力让这个国家团结起来的人。”

paras.en: The Oct. 7 attack left Israelis in a state of shock.
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日的袭击事件让以色列人处于震惊之中。

paras.en: "I think the general line of thinking — not only among decision-makers, not only among ministers of the government, but also among commanders in the field — was that something biblical has happened to us and that something biblical needed to happen in return," Harel said.
paras.zh: 哈雷尔说：“我认为，普遍的思路——不仅是决策者，不仅是政府部长，还有战地指挥官——都是圣经中的事情发生在我们身上，而圣经中的事情也需要发生在我们身上。”

paras.en: What happened in return was an Israeli military onslaught that has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians and left most of Gaza destroyed. Today, Israel is fighting back against charges of genocide. Netanyahu faces an international arrest warrant for alleged war crimes. Israeli soldiers who fought in the war risk arrest in some countries.
paras.zh: 作为回报，以色列发动军事袭击，造成 74,000 多名巴勒斯坦人死亡，加沙大部分地区被毁。今天，以色列正在反击种族灭绝的指控。内塔尼亚胡因涉嫌战争罪而面临国际逮捕令。参加战争的以色列士兵有可能在一些国家被捕。

paras.en: "I'm proud of what I did and I know what I did," said Lior, 34, who was one of those soldiers. "I don't mind to be in front of a judge."
paras.zh: “我为自己所做的事情感到自豪，我知道自己做了什么，”34 岁的利奥尔说，他是其中一名士兵。 “我不介意在法官面前。”

paras.en: Lior spoke on the condition that his last name be withheld to protect his family overseas from harassment because of the nature of his role: he commanded an Israeli sniper unit in Gaza and Lebanon, serving over 500 days in uniform.
paras.zh: 利奥尔发表讲话的条件是隐去他的姓氏，以保护他在海外的家人免受骚扰，因为他的角色性质：他在加沙和黎巴嫩指挥一支以色列狙击部队，穿着制服服役了 500 多天。

paras.en: " When you're inside Gaza, your life is under danger 24/7. There is shooting, there is booming… sometimes you hear about Hezbollah, Hamas, what they are doing. So your body, your mind is under survival tension 24/7," Lior said.
paras.zh: “当你在加沙时，你的生命24/7都处于危险之中。有枪击，有繁荣……有时你会听到真主党、哈马斯，他们在做什么。所以你的身体、你的思想24/7都处于生存紧张状态，”利奥尔说。

paras.en: He is among the nearly 19,000 Israeli soldiers who have been newly diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder or related illnesses. It touches every part of his life: He imagines snipers on the streets. He sometimes breaks into tears riding the train. He struggles in his sex life. He and his fiancé broke up.
paras.zh: 他是近 19,000 名新被诊断患有创伤后应激障碍或相关疾病的以色列士兵之一。它触及了他生活的方方面面：他想象着街上的狙击手。有时他在火车上会流泪。他在性生活中挣扎。他和他的未婚夫分手了。

paras.en: Lior said he often returns to one memory from Gaza: his order to shoot and kill a man he described as a Hamas terrorist, standing next to his child in a place where he shouldn't have been.
paras.zh: 利奥尔说，他经常回想起加沙的一段记忆：他被命令射杀一名他描述为哈马斯恐怖分子的男子，这名男子站在他不应该出现的地方，站在他的孩子旁边。

paras.en: "Unfortunately, yeah, the kid saw his father dying in front of him," Lior said.
paras.zh: “不幸的是，这个孩子看到他的父亲死在他面前，”利奥尔说。

paras.en: He does not regret any of his decisions to open fire.
paras.zh: 他并不后悔自己开枪的任何决定。

paras.en: "To be honest, in my opinion, I don't have any mercy of people in Gaza. I know what's going on there. I know of the poverty, I know about the lack of water, electricity. I don't have any mercy on them," Lior said. "When you see things with your own eyes and you remember what happened on the 7th of October, I'm not forgiving for that."
paras.zh: “说实话，在我看来，我对加沙人民没有任何怜悯。我知道那里正在发生什么。我知道那里的贫困，我知道缺水、缺电。我对他们没有任何怜悯，”利奥尔说。 “当你亲眼所见并记得10月7日发生的事情时，我不会原谅你。”

paras.en: "You know, my Jewish identity (is) saying that I'm sure there is, but…I don't see it that way. That's what I told you about the kid," Lior said. "If he have the chance, he will kill me."
paras.zh: “你知道，我的犹太人身份表明我确信存在，但是......我不这么认为。这就是我告诉你的关于这个孩子的事情，”利奥尔说。 “如果有机会，他一定会杀了我。”

paras.en: He is among the nearly 300,000 young Israeli military veterans ordered to leave their civilian lives and serve as reservist soldiers after Oct. 7.
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日后，近 30 万名以色列年轻退伍军人被勒令离开平民生活，成为预备役士兵，他是其中之一。

paras.en: More than 67 percent of Israelis in a July 2025 poll said they were not very troubled about the suffering of people in Gaza. More than 60 percent of Israelis in an August 2025 poll said they believed there were no innocent people in Gaza. That view has been reinforced by mainstream Israeli media.
paras.zh: 2025 年 7 月的一项民意调查显示，超过 67% 的以色列人表示，他们对加沙人民的苦难并不十分担忧。在 2025 年 8 月的一项民意调查中，超过 60% 的以色列人表示，他们相信加沙没有无辜者。以色列主流媒体强化了这一观点。

paras.en: "There are no uninvolved civilians in Gaza," said Israeli reporter Almog Boker early last year on leading news network Channel 12.
paras.zh: “加沙没有不参与其中的平民，”以色列记者阿尔莫格·博克去年初在主要新闻网络第 12 频道上说道。

paras.en: This was not always the way Israeli media covered Palestinians in Gaza. Anat Saragusti, a veteran journalist, used to report from Gaza in the 1990s and early 2000s for Channel 12.
paras.zh: 以色列媒体并不总是这样报道加沙的巴勒斯坦人。阿纳特·萨拉古斯蒂 (Anat Saragusti) 是一位资深记者，曾于 20 世纪 90 年代和 2000 年代初为第 12 频道在加沙进行报道。

paras.en: "I tried to cover Gaza as if I was living in a foreign country, to show the complexity of life, to show different stories," Saragusti said from her Tel Aviv apartment. "To show the Israeli audience that Gaza is not what they thought and think now, you know, a black hole of terrorists."
paras.zh: “我试图像生活在外国一样报道加沙，展示生活的复杂性，展示不同的故事，”萨拉古斯蒂在特拉维夫的公寓里说。 “向以色列观众表明，加沙并不是他们现在所想的那样，你知道，加沙是恐怖分子的黑洞。”

paras.en: Twenty years ago, after Hamas took an Israeli soldier captive in Gaza, Israel practically sealed Gaza shut to Israeli journalists and to all Israelis. Then, Hamas took control of Gaza, Israel imposed a blockade, there were years of Hamas rocket fire into Israel and Israeli retaliation.
paras.zh: 二十年前，哈马斯在加沙俘虏了一名以色列士兵后，以色列实际上对以色列记者和所有以色列人封锁了加沙。随后，哈马斯控制了加沙，以色列实施封锁，哈马斯连续多年向以色列发射火箭弹，以色列进行报复。

paras.en: Since Oct. 7, most Israeli media chose not to show what Palestinian journalists were reporting day after day from Gaza: the tens of thousands of men, women and children killed; the forced displacement; the starvation; the misery of trying to survive.
paras.zh: 自10月7日以来，大多数以色列媒体选择不报道巴勒斯坦记者日复一日地从加沙报道的内容：数以万计的男人、女人和儿童被杀；被迫流离失所；饥饿；努力生存的痛苦。

paras.en: "The majority of the Israeli journalists didn't do one story, you know, not even one story was done on Gaza… to see whether what these Palestinian journalists are claiming is true," said Saragusti. "They were afraid of the pushback by the audience if they dare say something about Gaza."
paras.zh: “大多数以色列记者都没有做过一篇报道，你知道，甚至连一篇关于加沙的报道都没有做过……来看看这些巴勒斯坦记者的说法是否属实，”萨拉古斯蒂说。 “他们担心，如果他们敢于谈论加沙的话，就会遭到观众的抵制。”

paras.en: Harel, who writes a regular column for the Haaretz newspaper, says the nation's continuous war trauma also afflicted Israeli media.
paras.zh: 为《国土报》定期撰写专栏的哈雷尔表示，以色列媒体也深受国家持续战争创伤的困扰。

paras.en: " We were so busy with our pain and our suffering and worrying about the fate of the hostages — hundreds of hostages were held at that time by Hamas — that we didn't focus on what we did to the other side," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们忙于应对我们的痛苦和磨难，并担心人质的命运——当时哈马斯扣押了数百名人质——以至于我们没有关注我们对对方所做的事情。”

paras.en: There is one place where even veterans of Israel's military and security establishment say what Palestinians are enduring has gone too far: the Israeli-occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 有一个地方，甚至以色列军事和安全机构的资深人士也表示，巴勒斯坦人所忍受的一切已经太过分了：以色列占领的约旦河西岸。

paras.en: Since Oct. 7, Israeli settler violence toward Palestinians has skyrocketed. Settlers have seized more and more land there, with the support of the military and Netanyahu's pro-settler government, which has approved more than 100 new Jewish settlements in the West Bank, a record number.
paras.zh: 自10月7日以来，以色列定居者针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为急剧增加。在军方和内塔尼亚胡亲定居者政府的支持下，定居者在那里占领了越来越多的土地，内塔尼亚胡政府已批准在西岸建立 100 多个新的犹太人定居点，数量创历史新高。

paras.en: "We are making a historic revolution," cabinet minister Bezalel Smotrich said this July as he announced the 104th new settlement approved by Netanyahu's current government. He said it "would prevent the establishment of a terror state in the heart of Israel."
paras.zh: 今年 7 月，内阁部长贝扎雷尔·斯莫特里奇 (Bezalel Smotrich) 在宣布内塔尼亚胡现任政府批准的第 104 个新定居点时表示，“我们正在进行一场历史性革命”。他说这“将防止在以色列心脏地带建立恐怖国家”。

paras.en: A retired Israeli military general, Yaakov "Mendy" Or, leads groups of former Israeli military and security officials to Palestinian communities in the West Bank to show them the radical changes that have taken place over the last three years.
paras.zh: 以色列退役将军雅科夫·“门迪”·奥带领以色列前军事和安全官员小组前往约旦河西岸的巴勒斯坦社区，向他们展示过去三年发生的巨大变化。

paras.en: On a recent tour, he brought them to Umm al-Kheir, a Palestinian village surrounded by an expanse of desert hills, where Israeli settlers have set up trailer homes right outside a Palestinian family's property.
paras.zh: 在最近的一次旅行中，他带他们去了乌姆海尔，这是一个被大片沙漠丘陵包围的巴勒斯坦村庄，以色列定居者在一个巴勒斯坦家庭的房产外搭建了拖车房屋。

paras.en: Palestinian activist Eid Hatlin said barbed wire in the yard was placed by settlers. The settlers have blocked the family's outdoor bathroom and the Israeli army has blocked the path to their sheep, he said.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦活动人士艾德·哈特林表示，院子里的铁丝网是定居者放置的。他说，定居者封锁了这家人的户外浴室，以色列军队封锁了通往他们羊群的道路。

paras.en: "This is nasty. This is evil," said Ari Shuali, a former senior Israeli intelligence official who was part of the visiting group. "I don't believe that we as a people became such kind of unhuman behavior. I'm an Israeli. I'm a proud Israeli and I'm ashamed to be an Israeli [at] the same time."
paras.zh: “这太恶心了。这是邪恶的，”访问团成员、以色列前高级情报官员阿里·舒阿里 (Ari Shuali) 说。 “我不相信我们作为一个民族会做出如此不人道的行为。我是以色列人。我为以色列人感到自豪，但同时又为自己是以色列人而感到羞耻。”

paras.en: It's one reason why some Israelis — like him — want to vote Netanyahu out.
paras.zh: 这是一些以色列人——比如他——想要投票让内塔尼亚胡下台的原因之一。

paras.en: Netanyahu has downplayed Israeli settler violence in the West Bank and his allies are campaigning on a pledge to expel Palestinians — what they call encouraging emigration.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡淡化了以色列定居者在西岸的暴力行为，他的盟友正在竞选中承诺驱逐巴勒斯坦人——他们称之为鼓励移民。

paras.en: Netanyahu is campaigning on what he's done to fight back against external threats — with the wars in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran as examples of how he's making Israel safer since Oct. 7.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡正在竞选活动中宣传他为反击外部威胁所做的努力——以加沙、黎巴嫩和伊朗的战争为例，说明他自 10 月 7 日以来如何让以色列变得更安全。

paras.en: "On that darkest of days, our enemies expected us to collapse. Well, we didn't collapse. Instead, we rose and fought like lions!" Netanyahu said at the United Nations last month.
paras.zh: “在那段最黑暗的日子里，我们的敌人期望我们崩溃。但是，我们没有崩溃。相反，我们像狮子一样奋起战斗！”内塔尼亚胡上个月在联合国表示。

paras.en: Over the last three years, Israel has killed the leaders of Hamas, Hezbollah and Iran. It has sent soldiers to capture new territory in the West Bank, Gaza, Lebanon and Syria. It has fought Houthis in Yemen and militias in Iraq. Netanyahu vows to destroy Iran's nuclear capabilities if he is reelected.
paras.zh: 过去三年来，以色列杀害了哈马斯、真主党和伊朗的领导人。它已派出士兵占领约旦河西岸、加沙、黎巴嫩和叙利亚的新领土。它曾在也门与胡塞武装作战，在伊拉克与民兵作战。内塔尼亚胡誓言如果连任，将摧毁伊朗的核能力。

paras.en: "We're entangled in endless wars and this was done on purpose," Harel said. "It's not a bug, it's a feature. The whole idea is for Israel to keep fighting, because endless wars serve Netanyahu to maintain… a constant state of emergency."
paras.zh: 哈雷尔说：“我们陷入了无休止的战争，这是故意的。” “这不是一个错误，而是一个功能。整个想法是让以色列继续战斗，因为无休止的战争有利于内塔尼亚胡维持……持续的紧急状态。”

paras.en: Netanyahu has called them wars of "no choice," alongside a "war for truth" waged in international media and social media.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡称这些战争是“别无选择”的战争，同时也是国际媒体和社交媒体上发动的“真理之战”。

paras.en: At a recent stump speech, Gadi Eisenkot took the stage. He is short with cropped white hair and he was wearing all black. He was speaking to a crowd in Kiryat Gat, a city near the Gaza border — historically a conservative Netanyahu stronghold.
paras.zh: 在最近的一次巡回演讲中，加迪·艾森科特登台演讲。他身材矮小，留着白色的短发，穿着一身黑衣服。他在靠近加沙边境的加特城向人群发表讲话，该城市历史上是保守派内塔尼亚胡的据点。

paras.en: Eisenkot is the former military chief of staff, appointed by Netanyahu a decade ago, who came back into the public spotlight in the days after Oct. 7 when he joined Netanyahu's war cabinet. Soon after, Eisenkot's son was killed as a soldier in the Gaza war. The very next day, his nephew, too, was killed there.
paras.zh: 艾森科特是前军事参谋长，十年前由内塔尼亚胡任命，10 月 7 日加入内塔尼亚胡战时内阁后，他再次成为公众关注的焦点。不久之后，艾森科特的儿子作为士兵在加沙战争中阵亡。第二天，他的侄子也在那里被杀。

paras.en: Eisenkot told the crowd that he began to disagree with Netanyahu's prosecution of the war three months in. "I saw a deep dysfunction in the decision-making process," Eisenkot said. "I saw that political and personal considerations were put above everything else."
paras.zh: 艾森科特告诉人群，三个月后他开始不同意内塔尼亚胡对战争的起诉。“我看到决策过程中存在严重的功能障碍，”艾森科特说。 “我看到政治和个人考虑高于一切。”

paras.en: He has pledged, if he wins, to launch an official national investigation into the security failure of Oct. 7 — something Netanyahu has refused to do.
paras.zh: 他承诺，如果获胜，将对 10 月 7 日的安全失败展开正式的全国调查，但内塔尼亚胡拒绝这样做。

paras.en: "He's straight," said Yair Amar, a longtime Netanyahu voter, who said he has switched allegiances to Eisenkot.
paras.zh: “他是个异性恋，”内塔尼亚胡的长期选民亚伊尔·阿马尔说，他表示自己已经转而效忠艾森科特。

paras.en: "Many Israelis wish for a saner future," said Harel, the Haaretz columnist. "For somebody who perhaps is not as charismatic and doesn't look the part of an American senator, but is one of us and is seen as somebody who sacrificed a lot."
paras.zh: “许多以色列人希望有一个更加理智的未来，”《国土报》专栏作家哈雷尔说。 “对于一个也许没有那么有魅力、看起来不像美国参议员的人来说，但他是我们中的一员，被视为做出了很多牺牲的人。”

paras.en: The race is tight. Most polls show Eisenkot's camp ahead of Netanyahu's, but those same polls show neither has a clear path to victory. To win, parties must form a coalition to control a majority in Israel's parliament. The election could tip on a small amount of votes or it could end in stalemate, forcing a repeat election next year. If that were to happen, Netanyahu would stay in power with full authority to make fateful decisions, like going to war. He strongly suggests he wants to strike Iran again.
paras.zh: 比赛很紧张。大多数民意调查显示艾森科特的阵营领先于内塔尼亚胡的阵营，但同样的民意调查显示，双方都没有明确的胜利之路。为了获胜，各党派必须组成联盟来控制以色列议会的多数席位。选举可能会以少量选票而告终，也可能会陷入僵局，迫使明年再次举行选举。如果这种情况发生，内塔尼亚胡将继续掌权，并拥有做出决定性决定的全部权力，比如发动战争。他强烈暗示他想再次打击伊朗。

paras.en: If Netanyahu loses, Eisenkot vows a different approach. He has spoken of cracking down on settler expansion and violence against Palestinians in the West Bank and of reaching diplomatic agreements in the wars Netanyahu has kept open, but cautioned he would not withdraw troops from Lebanon and Gaza anytime soon.
paras.zh: 如果内塔尼亚胡输了，艾森科特发誓会采取不同的做法。他谈到了打击定居者扩张和西岸针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为，以及在内塔尼亚胡一直未决的战争中达成外交协议，但他警告说，他不会很快从黎巴嫩和加沙撤军。

paras.en: "Truth be told," Eisenkot told the crowd, "it will take a lot of time."
paras.zh: “说实话，”艾森科特告诉人群，“这需要很多时间。”

paras.en: On the biggest question of all — how to solve Israel's conflict with the Palestinians — Eisenkot boasted that he "never said the solution was two states for two peoples." Meaning the creation of a Palestinian state alongside Israel — the vision that the U.S. and the majority of the world have advocated for decades. Eisenkot thinks Israel should preserve possibilities for a solution in the future. After Oct. 7, Israelis do not want to discuss a Palestinian state.
paras.zh: 在最大的问题上——如何解决以色列与巴勒斯坦的冲突——艾森科特吹嘘说，他“从未说过解决方案是两国人民的两个国家”。这意味着与以色列并肩建立巴勒斯坦国——这是美国和世界大多数国家几十年来一直倡导的愿景。艾森科特认为以色列应该保留未来解决方案的可能性。 10 月 7 日之后，以色列人不想讨论巴勒斯坦国。

paras.en: "It's not something that the Israeli public can swallow at this time," Harel said. "More and more people suspect that the Arabs, the Palestinians, are out to kill us and that the world is out to get us. And there's less support for any kind of concessions because people keep bringing up Oct. 7."
paras.zh: 哈雷尔说：“这不是以色列公众目前能够接受的事情。” “越来越多的人怀疑阿拉伯人、巴勒斯坦人想要杀死我们，全世界都想要抓捕我们。而且，由于人们不断提起 10 月 7 日的事情，对任何形式让步的支持都越来越少。”

paras.en: This is not a race of conservatives versus liberals, right versus left. Eisenkot is leading a group of politicians who are largely right-wing, focused on matters of security and campaigning to enlist religious ultra-Orthodox Jews to the military, which Netanyahu has resisted in order to placate his ultra-Orthodox political allies.
paras.zh: 这不是保守派与自由派、右翼与左翼的竞赛。艾森科特领导的一群政治家大多是右翼，专注于安全问题，并致力于招募极端正统派犹太人参军，但内塔尼亚胡为了安抚他的极端正统派政治盟友而予以抵制。

paras.en: "I'm trusting him on the military level, but is it enough?" said Israeli high school theater teacher Anat Ben-Ari, who came to hear Eisenkot speak. She was almost nervous voicing an unpopular opinion out loud: she wants him to forge peace agreements.
paras.zh: “我在军事层面上信任他，但这就足够了吗？”来听艾森科特演讲的以色列高中戏剧老师阿纳特·本-阿里说道。她几乎紧张地大声说出了一个不受欢迎的观点：她希望他达成和平协议。

paras.en: "The only way to end war — all the history says that — is by agreements, is by people talking to people, even enemies. Mostly enemies," Ben-Ari said. "I think we should also pay the price for peace in order for less people to die here and not always live on our swords."
paras.zh: “所有历史都这么说，结束战争的唯一方法是通过协议，是人们与人民，甚至是敌人。大多数是敌人，”本-阿里说。 “我认为我们也应该为和平付出代价，以便更少的人死在这里，而不是总是靠我们的刀剑生存。”

paras.en: Lior, the soldier, is resigned to a future of war.
paras.zh: 士兵利奥尔（Lior）接受了战争的未来。

paras.en: "There will always be an enemy, so I think we will always be in a war. We [will] always live on our sword," Lior said. "It will always be."
paras.zh: “总会有敌人，所以我认为我们将永远处于战争之中。我们将永远靠我们的剑生存，”利奥尔说。 “永远都是。”

paras.en: Israeli voters now consider two different visions for their country. Should Israel fight to regain the world's acceptance or to increase their neighbors' deterrence?
paras.zh: 以色列选民现在考虑他们国家的两种不同愿景。以色列应该努力重新获得世界的认可，还是增强邻国的威慑力？

paras.en: Israelis yearn for both says author Micah Goodman, who has written about the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and previously served as an unofficial advisor to Israeli prime ministers.
paras.zh: 作家米迦·古德曼 (Micah Goodman) 表示，以色列人渴望两者。他撰写过有关以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突的文章，并曾担任以色列总理的非官方顾问。

paras.en: "In the Middle East, you wanna have a certain kind of reputation. You want to be seen as unpredictable and a little crazy. Like, don't mess with us… and in the West, we want to be seen as a Norwegian, nice, sweet country playing by the rules, predictable."
paras.zh: “在中东，你希望拥有某种声誉。你希望被视为不可预测、有点疯狂。比如，不要惹我们……而在西方，我们希望被视为一个挪威、友善、可爱的国家，按规则行事，可预测。”

paras.en: Goodman said Israelis made their choice.
paras.zh: 古德曼说，以色列人做出了自己的选择。

paras.en: "After Oct. 7, the Middle East didn't fear us and you have to restore fear. But everything we did to restore fear eroded the love."
paras.zh: “10月7日之后，中东不再害怕我们，你必须恢复恐惧。但我们为恢复恐惧所做的一切都侵蚀了爱。”

paras.en: Additional reporting by NPR journalists Itay Stern, Abu Bakr Bashir and Michael Levitt.
paras.zh: NPR 记者 Itay Stern、Abu Bakr Bashir 和 Michael Levitt 的补充报道。

articles.title: Venezuela's opposition leader María Corina Machado returns after months in exile
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Venezuela's opposition leader María Corina Machado returns after months in exile
paras.zh: 委内瑞拉反对派领袖玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多在流亡数月后返回

paras.en: CARACAS, Venezuela — Opposition leader and Nobel laureate María Corina Machado reappeared in Venezuela Sunday for the first time since December, about a month before the U.S. military deposed the country's then-President Nicolás Maduro.
paras.zh: 委内瑞拉加拉加斯——周日，反对派领袖、诺贝尔奖获得者玛丽亚·科里娜·马查多再次出现在委内瑞拉，这是去年 12 月以来的首次，大约一个月后，美国军方废黜了该国时任总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗。

paras.en: Machado announced her arrival on social media, writing "I am here. With you."
paras.zh: 马查多在社交媒体上宣布了她的到来，并写道“我在这里。和你在一起。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Venezuela's opposition leader Edmundo Gonzalez wrote on X confirming that Machado had arrived and that he would be next to her "very soon."
paras.zh: 与此同时，委内瑞拉反对派领导人埃德蒙多·冈萨雷斯（Edmundo Gonzalez）在 X 上写道，确认马查多已经抵达，并且“很快”就会出现在她身边。

paras.en: "Today is a very important day for Venezuelans. Our sovereign voice returns with her to lead and guide this process!" he wrote. "You know it, this is until the end."
paras.zh: “今天对委内瑞拉人来说是非常重要的一天。我们主权的声音与她一起回归，领导和指导这一进程！”他写道。 “你知道的，这件事到最后为止。”

paras.en: Machado's homecoming after more than 10 months in exile took place as doubts over Venezuela's democratic future — and the U.S.'s role in it — deepen.
paras.zh: 马查多在流亡十多个月后回国之际，人们对委内瑞拉的民主未来以及美国在其中所扮演的角色的疑虑加深。

paras.en: Since Maduro's ouster, Venezuela has been run by acting President Delcy Rodríguez, a longtime Maduro ally who received the Trump administration's blessing to succeed him.
paras.zh: 自马杜罗下台以来，委内瑞拉一直由代理总统德尔西·罗德里格斯领导，他是马杜罗的长期盟友，得到了特朗普政府的批准接替他。

paras.en: Rodríguez has exceeded the time she was authorized to serve as acting president following Maduro's capture and no election is scheduled.
paras.zh: 马杜罗被捕后，罗德里格斯已经超过了她被授权担任代理总统的时间，并且没有安排选举。

paras.en: Machado went into hiding in Venezuela for 11 months after being briefly detained following a protest in January 2025. After leaving the country in a clandestine escape, she reappeared that December in Norway, where she was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her peaceful challenge to Maduro's authoritarian government.
paras.zh: 马查多在 2025 年 1 月的一次抗议活动后被短暂拘留后，在委内瑞拉躲藏了 11 个月。秘密逃亡离开该国后，她于当年 12 月再次出现在挪威，并因和平挑战马杜罗独裁政府而被授予诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: Machado and her allies have been demanding a date for a presidential election in Venezuela, but U.S. officials have emphasized economic stabilization first.
paras.zh: 马查多和她的盟友一直要求委内瑞拉确定总统选举的日期，但美国官员首先强调经济稳定。

articles.title: Trump immigration win could strengthen admin's hand in looming Supreme Court fight

paras.en: The Trump administration scored a major full-panel victory at the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals Friday, which ruled that detained illegal immigrants who were never formally admitted into the U. S. are not constitutionally entitled to bond hearings while awaiting deportation.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府周五在第五巡回上诉法院取得了全体小组的重大胜利，该法院裁定，从未被正式允许进入美国的被拘留非法移民在等待驱逐出境时，根据宪法无权参加保释听证会。

paras.en: The ruling comes as the Supreme Court prepares to hear Rhoney v. Barbosa da Cunha this term, a closely related fight over whether the federal mandatory-detention statute applies at all to longtime immigrants arrested inside the country — setting up the possibility that the justices could either undercut Friday’s ruling or strengthen the government's hand.
paras.zh: 这项裁决是在最高法院准备本学期审理罗尼诉巴博萨·达库尼亚案之际做出的，这是一场与联邦强制拘留法规是否适用于在该国境内被捕的长期移民密切相关的争论，这使得法官们有可能削弱周五的裁决，也可能加强政府的力量。

paras.en: The Fifth Circuit answered the constitutional question in Ignacio Sosnava Rodriguez v. Sylvester M. Ortega, finding that three immigrant men detained under the mandatory-detention statute are not entitled to bond hearings under the Due Process Clause of the Fifth Amendment. The court held that their years or even decades of residence in the United States, along with ties to the country and their communities, do not create a constitutional right to a bond hearing.
paras.zh: 第五巡回法院回答了伊格纳西奥·索斯纳瓦·罗德里格斯诉西尔维斯特·M·奥尔特加一案中的宪法问题，认为根据强制拘留法规被拘留的三名移民男子无权根据第五修正案的正当程序条款参加保释听证会。法院认为，他们在美国居住了数年甚至数十年，以及与国家和社区的联系，并不构成宪法规定的保释听证会权利。

paras.en: "The Constitution does not entitle them to a bond hearing," the court wrote.
paras.zh: “宪法没有赋予他们举行保释听证会的权利，”法院写道。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Supreme Court will consider Rhoney, a case out of the Second Circuit, to determine whether the mandatory-detention law applies to longtime immigrants arrested inside the country in the first place.
paras.zh: 与此同时，最高法院将审理第二巡回法院审理的罗尼案，以确定强制拘留法是否适用于在该国境内被捕的长期移民。

paras.en: At the center of the issue is a 9-2 circuit split over which federal detention law applies to immigrants who entered the country illegally, were never formally admitted and were later arrested by immigration authorities after living in the U.S. for years — sometimes decades after crossing the border.
paras.zh: 问题的核心是9比2的分歧，联邦拘留法适用于非法进入美国、从未被正式接纳、在美国生活多年（有时是跨越边境数十年）后被移民当局逮捕的移民。

paras.en: The Fifth and Eighth Circuits have held that those immigrants remain "applicants for admission" under Section 1225 of the Immigration and Nationality Act, subjecting them to mandatory detention without an ordinary bond hearing while their removal proceedings play out. Nine other federal appeals courts have ruled that Section 1226 applies instead, which provides a path for them to seek release on bond.
paras.zh: 第五和第八巡回法院认为，根据《移民和国籍法》第 1225 条，这些移民仍然是“入境申请人”，在遣返程序进行期间，他们在没有举行普通保释听证会的情况下受到强制拘留。其他九个联邦上诉法院已裁定第 1226 条适用，这为他们寻求保释提供了途径。

paras.en: The Supreme Court will essentially decide whether immigrants who entered illegally and have lived in the U.S. for years can be subjected to the same mandatory-detention provision that applies to certain immigrants seeking admission into the country.
paras.zh: 最高法院将主要决定非法进入并在美国居住多年的移民是否可以受到适用于某些寻求进入该国的移民的相同强制拘留条款的约束。

paras.en: If the Supreme Court sides with the Second Circuit, Barbosa da Cunha — a Brazilian national who entered the country illegally roughly two decades ago and was detained in 2025 — would have a path to seek release on bond. Such a ruling would likely apply to the three longtime immigrants at the center of Rodriguez as well, substantially undercutting the significance of Friday’s ruling by eliminating the need to answer the constitutional question of whether due process requires a bond hearing.
paras.zh: 如果最高法院站在第二巡回法院一边，大约二十年前非法进入该国并于 2025 年被拘留的巴西国民巴博萨·达库尼亚 (Barbosa da Cunha) 将有途径寻求保释。这样的裁决可能也适用于罗德里格斯市中心的三名长期移民，通过消除回答正当程序是否需要保释听证会的宪法问题的需要，大大削弱了周五裁决的重要性。

paras.en: Judge Leslie Southwick pointed directly to the looming Supreme Court fight in her dissent.
paras.zh: 莱斯利·索斯威克法官在她的异议中直接指出了即将到来的最高法院之争。

paras.en: Should the Supreme Court eventually determine that this court was wrong as to the statute, then the constitutional issue we address here will have far less significance. It certainly has significance at the moment," Southwick wrote.
paras.zh: 如果最高法院最终判定本法院在该法规方面有误，那么我们在此讨论的宪法问题的意义就会小得多。目前这当然具有重要意义，”索斯威克写道。

paras.en: But conservative legal experts say Rodriguez could also strengthen the administration’s hand in Rhoney by undercutting one argument against the government’s interpretation of Section 1225: that applying the mandatory-detention provision to longtime residents would raise serious constitutional concerns.
paras.zh: 但保守派法律专家表示，罗德里格斯还可以通过削弱反对政府对第 1225 条解释的一个论点来加强政府对罗尼的控制：将强制拘留条款应用于长期居民会引起严重的宪法问题。

paras.en: Michael Morley, a constitutional law professor at Florida State University, said Friday’s ruling could influence how the justices approach that question because courts often consider whether a particular reading of federal law would create constitutional problems.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州立大学宪法学教授迈克尔·莫利表示，周五的裁决可能会影响法官处理该问题的方式，因为法院经常考虑对联邦法律的特定解读是否会产生宪法问题。

paras.en: "The Fifth Circuit’s en banc ruling in Rodriguez today takes the next step by holding that such detention would not violate the U.S. Constitution’s Due Process Clause," Morley said. "This holding may impact the Supreme Court’s reasoning, because an important consideration in disputes over federal laws is whether a particular interpretation would be unconstitutional."
paras.zh: 莫利说：“第五巡回法院今天对罗德里格斯案的全席裁决迈出了下一步，认为此类拘留不会违反美国宪法的正当程序条款。” “这一裁决可能会影响最高法院的推理，因为联邦法律争议中的一个重要考虑因素是特定解释是否违宪。”

paras.en: "If the Court agrees with the Fifth Circuit’s analysis that the Due Process Clause allows such detention, it may be more likely to conclude that federal law permits it, as well, Morley continued.
paras.zh: “如果法院同意第五巡回法院的分析，即正当程序条款允许此类拘留，那么可能更有可能得出联邦法律也允许这种拘留的结论，”莫利继续说道。

paras.en: Hans von Spakovsky, a senior legal fellow at Advancing American Freedom, argued that the decision could bolster the administration as the justices prepare to resolve the circuit split.
paras.zh: 促进美国自由组织的高级法律研究员汉斯·冯·斯帕科夫斯基认为，在大法官们准备解决巡回法庭分歧之际，这一决定可能会支持政府。

paras.en: "I actually think this ruling will help the government in the Rhoney case," von Spakovsky said, pointing to the Fifth Circuit’s position that the applicable immigration statute does not require bond hearings for immigrants who were never admitted to the United States.
paras.zh: 冯·斯帕科夫斯基表示：“实际上，我认为这项裁决将有助于政府处理罗尼案。”他指出，第五巡回法院的立场是，适用的移民法规不要求对从未进入美国的移民举行保释听证会。

paras.en: "There was already a split in the circuit courts on this issue but the Fifth Circuit has consistently held that the applicable immigration statute does not require bond hearings for aliens who were never admitted to the United States," he said. "I will be surprised if a majority of the Supreme Court disagrees when they ultimately issue a decision in the Rhoney case."
paras.zh: 他说：“巡回法院在这个问题上已经存在分歧，但第五巡回法院始终认为，适用的移民法规不要求对从未进入美国的外国人进行保释听证会。” “如果最高法院的大多数人在最终对罗尼案做出裁决时不同意，我会感到惊讶。”

paras.en: The Supreme Court has not yet scheduled oral arguments in Rhoney, which it agreed to hear earlier this month.
paras.zh: 最高法院尚未安排在罗尼举行的口头辩论，本月早些时候已同意听取口头辩论。

articles.title: Selena Gomez's vaping admission highlights hidden health risks doctors say millions face daily

paras.en: When Selena Gomez revealed to her millions of followers that heavy nicotine vaping had noticeably altered her voice, calling the habit "stupid," her confession highlighted a larger issue with the practice.
paras.zh: 当赛琳娜·戈麦斯向她的数百万粉丝透露，大量吸尼古丁电子烟明显改变了她的声音，并称这种习惯“愚蠢”时，她的坦白凸显了这种做法的一个更大问题。

paras.en: For the singer and actress, the physical toll manifested in her vocal cords. But medical professionals emphasize that her experience is only a visible symptom of a deeper health crisis affecting millions of Americans who use e-cigarettes every day.
paras.zh: 对于这位歌手兼演员来说，身体上的伤害体现在她的声带上。但医学专业人士强调，她的经历只是影响数百万每天使用电子烟的美国人的更深层次健康危机的一个明显症状。

paras.en: While often marketed as a safer alternative to conventional cigarettes, e-cigarettes pose significant health risks. Aside from the immediate vocal strain and airway inflammation noted by otolaryngologists, major health institutions warn that regular vaping exposes the body to a cocktail of toxic chemicals, cardiovascular strain and respiratory risks.
paras.zh: 虽然电子烟经常被宣传为传统香烟的更安全替代品，但它却带来了重大的健康风险。除了耳鼻喉科医生指出的直接声音紧张和气道炎症外，主要卫生机构还警告说，经常吸电子烟会使身体暴露在有毒化学物质、心血管紧张和呼吸系统风险的混合物中。

paras.en: Specialists emphasize that e-cigarettes deliver more concentrated doses of nicotine than traditional cigarettes, rapidly driving chemical dependency in the brain.
paras.zh: 专家强调，电子烟比传统香烟提供更浓缩剂量的尼古丁，迅速导致大脑对化学物质的依赖。
