articles.title: NAPA Academy Provides New Training Resources
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Running a successful parts store requires more than knowing which part fits which vehicle. It takes effective inventory management, dependable delivery service, employees who understand customers’ needs and a manager who can connect everyday decisions to the store’s financial performance.
paras.zh: 成功运营零件商店需要的不仅仅是了解哪个零件适合哪种车辆。它需要有效的库存管理、可靠的配送服务、了解客户需求的员工以及能够将日常决策与商店财务绩效联系起来的经理。

paras.en: NAPA is giving independent store owners new resources to develop those capabilities through NAPA Academy, extending training developed for its company-owned stores to independent businesses. The program was introduced during the 2026 NAPA Store Owner and Field Sales Meeting, held Sept. 21-24 in Atlanta. The initial offering focuses on store managers, combining short online courses with a downloadable resource guide designed to help translate training into daily practice.
paras.zh: NAPA正在通过NAPA学院为独立商店所有者提供新的资源，以发展这些能力，并将为其公司拥有的商店开发的培训扩展到独立企业。该计划于9月21日至24日在亚特兰大举行的2026年NAPA商店业主和现场销售会议期间推出。最初的产品侧重于商店经理，将简短的在线课程与可下载的资源指南相结合，旨在帮助将培训转化为日常实践。

paras.en: Introducing the program, Cassie Bell, NAPA’s senior vice president of HR, said the expansion supports the company’s Drive 2030 strategy and its investment in people. Although owners have requested training for several positions, she said store managers were a logical starting point.
paras.zh: NAPA人力资源高级副总裁Cassie Bell在介绍该计划时表示，此次扩张支持了公司的Drive 2030战略及其对人员的投资。虽然店主已经要求对几个岗位进行培训，但她说，门店经理是一个合乎逻辑的起点。

paras.en: “We believe fundamentally that the store manager is critical to obtaining consistent customer service, to building the teams and driving those operational performances inside of our stores,” Bell said.
paras.zh: “我们从根本上相信，商店经理对于获得一致的客户服务、建立团队并在我们的商店内推动这些运营绩效至关重要，”贝尔说。

paras.en: The program’s development began with a practical question: What do successful employees and stores do differently?
paras.zh: 该计划的发展始于一个实际问题：成功的员工和商店有什么不同？

paras.en: Jesse Parrish, NAPA’s director of learning and development, said the Academy worked with teams across the organization to identify the knowledge, skills and behaviors that define excellence in specific roles. NAPA partnered with industry professionals to turn those findings into training, reference materials and learning pathways.
paras.zh: NAPA的学习与发展总监杰西·帕里什（ Jesse Parrish ）表示，学院与整个组织的团队合作，确定了定义特定角色卓越的知识、技能和行为。国家适应行动方案与行业专业人士合作，将这些发现转化为培训、参考资料和学习途径。

paras.en: By observing high-performing managers and market directors in top-performing stores, the team identified the practices and strategies driving their success. Those real-world insights became the foundation for new training programs designed to help others apply proven strategies throughout the organization.
paras.zh: 通过观察表现最佳的商店的高绩效经理和市场总监，团队确定了推动其成功的实践和策略。这些真实世界的见解成为新培训计划的基础，旨在帮助其他人在整个组织中应用经过验证的策略。

paras.en: For store operations, the resulting framework has four areas of emphasis: driving financial results, leading and developing teams, enabling operational excellence and delivering exceptional customer service.
paras.zh: 对于商店运营，由此产生的框架有四个重点领域：推动财务业绩、领导和发展团队、实现卓越运营和提供卓越的客户服务。

paras.en: Those areas address responsibilities ranging from understanding store performance and building improvement plans to coaching employees, managing inventory, optimizing delivery service and building customer loyalty.
paras.zh: 这些领域涉及从了解商店绩效和建筑改进计划到指导员工、管理库存、优化派送服务和建立客户忠诚度等职责。

paras.en: The team documented those practices in how-to guides, training courses and tools intended to help other stores apply them.
paras.zh: 团队在操作指南、培训课程和工具中记录了这些做法，旨在帮助其他商店应用它们。

paras.en: The online courses generally take 10 to 20 minutes to complete. Owners can take the courses themselves or assign them to employees, allowing training to address specific development needs.
paras.zh: 在线课程通常需要10到20分钟才能完成。所有者可以自己参加课程或将其分配给员工，从而使培训能够满足特定的发展需求。

paras.en: Although the first offering centers on store management, its usefulness extends to other positions. Parrish pointed to customer service lessons, including effective phone conversations, as examples of content relevant to counter employees.
paras.zh: 虽然第一个产品以商店管理为中心，但它的实用性延伸到其他职位。Parrish指出，客户服务课程，包括有效的电话交谈，是与反员工相关的内容的示例。

paras.en: “It is not just limited to the store manager,” he said. “While the content’s focused on them, there are relevant courses here for others that may be frontline workers working the counter.”
paras.zh: “这不仅限于商店经理，”他说。“虽然内容侧重于他们，但对于其他可能是一线工作人员在柜台工作的人来说，这里有一些相关的课程。”

paras.en: That connection matters because a store’s customer experience depends on both management decisions and individual employee interactions. Training managers to coach their teams complements instruction that helps counter professionals better serve wholesale and retail customers.
paras.zh: 这种联系很重要，因为商店的客户体验取决于管理决策和个别员工的互动。培训经理指导他们的团队是对指导的补充，有助于专业人士更好地为批发和零售客户提供服务。

paras.en: The second major resource is a downloadable store manager guide. It outlines the role’s responsibilities, key functions and performance metrics, with linked how-to guidance covering subjects such as budgeting, performance management, customer service and root cause analysis.
paras.zh: 第二个主要资源是可下载的商店经理指南。它概述了岗位的职责、关键职能和绩效指标，以及涵盖预算编制、绩效管理、客户服务和根本原因分析等主题的链接操作指南。

paras.en: Parrish described its purpose in everyday terms: helping employees understand “how do you do the work on a Tuesday morning at nine o’clock?”
paras.zh: Parrish用日常用语描述了它的目的：帮助员工理解“在周二早上9点，你是如何完成工作的？”

paras.en: The training framework recognizes three proficiency levels: foundation, advanced and mastery. Foundation focuses on performing a job independently and effectively. Advanced emphasizes consistently meeting performance targets and helping others succeed. Mastery involves anticipating opportunities, leading broader improvements and consistently exceeding targets.
paras.zh: 培训框架认可三个熟练程度：基础、高级和掌握。FOUNDATION专注于独立和有效地执行工作。Advanced强调始终如一地达到绩效目标并帮助他人取得成功。精通涉及预测机会、领导更广泛的改进并始终如一地超越目标。

paras.en: That structure provides a development path for employees with different experience levels, from someone entering a management role to an established leader seeking to improve store performance.
paras.zh: 这种结构为具有不同经验水平的员工提供了一条发展道路，从进入管理岗位的人到寻求提高门店绩效的老牌领导者。

paras.en: Participation is voluntary, Parrish emphasized, with independent owners able to use the resources as they see fit within their businesses. The materials are intended to remain within the NAPA family. NAPA also is exploring how to tailor resources further to independent owners’ needs.
paras.zh: Parrish强调，参与是自愿的，独立所有者可以在其业务范围内使用他们认为合适的资源。这些材料旨在保留在NAPA系列中。NAPA还在探索如何根据独立业主的需求进一步定制资源。

paras.en: Bell encouraged owners to access the content, develop a plan for using it and return regularly as materials are updated. She also asked them to share feedback about missing resources or opportunities for improvement.
paras.zh: 贝尔鼓励所有者访问内容，制定使用计划，并在材料更新时定期返回。她还要求他们分享有关缺少资源或改进机会的反馈。

paras.en: “If you need something more, you need something different, something’s not working, whatever that looks like, please reach back out to us,” Bell said. “We are only as good as the feedback we’re receiving from you.”
paras.zh: Bell说： “如果你需要更多，你需要一些不同的东西，有些东西不起作用，不管是什么样子，请联系我们。”「我们只会根据您给我们的反馈提供最好的服务。」

articles.title: The Limits of Check Engine Light Code Readers
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Code readers help counter professionals identify diagnostic trouble codes associated with check engine lights, including misfires, oxygen sensor issues and evaporative emissions problems. However, a trouble code can have numerous underlying causes.
paras.zh: 代码阅读器可帮助计数器专业人员识别与检查发动机指示灯相关的诊断故障代码，包括失火、氧传感器问题和蒸发排放问题。但是，故障代码可能有许多潜在原因。

paras.en: While basic code readers provide valuable information, accurate diagnosis often requires professional scan tools that access additional vehicle data and pinpoint the problem.
paras.zh: 虽然基本的代码读取器提供了有价值的信息，但准确的诊断通常需要专业的扫描工具来访问其他车辆数据并查明问题。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 此视频由The Pronto Network赞助。

articles.title: Will plants survive climate change? The 'Great Dying' reveals clues about their resilience.
articles.author: Sarah Wild

paras.en: About 251 million years ago, volcanic eruptions wiped out most life on Earth. For about a million years, the Siberian Traps in Russia spewed huge clouds of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, leading to the most severe extinction event in our planet's history.
paras.zh: 大约2.51亿年前，火山爆发消灭了地球上的大部分生命。大约一百万年来，俄罗斯的西伯利亚陷阱向大气中喷出巨大的二氧化碳云，导致了地球历史上最严重的灭绝事件。

paras.en: Equatorial temperatures spiked, making much of the land too hot for life. Meanwhile, the oceans became acidic and most of the creatures in them suffocated from lack of oxygen. Known as the Permian-Triassic mass extinction or the "Great Dying," it ultimately destroyed more than 90% of ocean life and 70% of terrestrial species.
paras.zh: 赤道气温飙升，使得大部分土地对生命来说太热了。与此同时，海洋变得酸性，其中的大多数生物因缺氧而窒息。它被称为二叠纪-三叠纪大灭绝或“大灭绝” ，最终摧毁了90%以上的海洋生物和70%的陆地物种。

paras.en: However, in a corner of what is now China, a refuge of pollen-producing plants avoided that fate and created an oasis for surviving animals. Research suggests that this was not the only place where plants were able to weather catastrophic climate change during the Great Dying, and that plants may have been better able to withstand the extinction event than other organisms.
paras.zh: 然而，在现在中国的一个角落，产生花粉的植物的避难所避免了这种命运，并为幸存的动物创造了绿洲。研究表明，这并不是植物在大灭绝期间能够抵御灾难性气候变化的唯一地方，而且植物可能比其他生物更能承受灭绝事件。

paras.en: "Plants do indeed sometimes have a lot of resilience because they can't move individually, and even as a population, they're not very good at moving," Chris Thomas, an ecologist and evolutionary biologist at the University of York in the U.K., told Live Science. As a result, many plants have evolved mechanisms to survive in place despite difficult conditions, he said.
paras.zh: 英国约克大学生态学家和进化生物学家克里斯·托马斯（Chris Thomas）告诉《生活科学》杂志：“植物有时确实具有很大的恢复能力，因为它们无法单独移动，即使作为一个种群，它们也不太擅长移动。”他说，因此，许多植物进化出了即使在困难条件下也能在原地生存的机制。

paras.en: As climate change raises global temperatures and throws ecosystems into upheaval, plants will need to draw once more upon this resilience. Many plant species have evolved unique adaptations that help them weather harsh conditions. Experts told Live Science that these adaptations — along with a hefty dose of luck — will now decide the difference between survival and extinction.
paras.zh: 随着气候变化导致全球气温升高并使生态系统陷入剧变，植物将需要再次利用这种恢复能力。许多植物物种已经进化出独特的适应能力，帮助它们抵御恶劣的条件。专家告诉《生活科学》杂志，这些适应以及大量的运气现在将决定生存和灭绝之间的差异。

paras.en: Unlike most animals, many plants have the ability to regenerate limbs — and those limbs can make them better able to adapt to new environment conditions. Plants in general have higher developmental plasticity than animals, which means that they have greater flexibility to change how their cells and tissues grow and develop.
paras.zh: 与大多数动物不同，许多植物具有再生肢体的能力—这些肢体可以使它们更好地适应新的环境条件。一般来说，植物比动物具有更高的发育可塑性，这意味着它们具有更大的灵活性来改变其细胞和组织的生长和发育方式。

paras.en: "Many plants have what we call indeterminate growth and modular body plans," Amy Angert, a botanist at the University of British Columbia in Canada, told Live Science. Indeterminate growth means that an organism continues to grow and develop indefinitely throughout its lifespan.
paras.zh: 加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚大学的植物学家艾米·安格特告诉《生活科学》杂志：“许多植物都有我们所说的不确定生长和模块化的身体结构。”无限生长意味着生物体在其整个生命周期中无限期地持续生长和发育。

paras.en: "If we lost an arm, it would be gone forever. But on plants, if you cut off a branch, they can sprout new ones and those new ones can then receive signals from the current environment instead of being stuck with sort of developmental programs from the past environment."
paras.zh: “如果我们失去了一条胳膊，它就会永远消失。但是在植物上，如果你砍掉一根树枝，它们会长出新的树枝，然后这些新的树枝可以接收来自当前环境的信号，而不是被过去环境的某种发展计划所困扰。”

paras.en: For example, researchers found that resprouts on holm oak trees (Quercus ilex) are better able to cope with drought than those that had not resprouted.
paras.zh: 例如，研究人员发现，圣栎树（Quercus ilex）上的萌芽比那些未萌芽的树更能应对干旱。

paras.en: And because buds can go dormant, many plant species can resprout after catastrophic events, such as fire. Cape Floristic Region in South Africa, for example, is the smallest of the world's six recognized floral kingdoms, and most of its plant species depend on fire — its plants resprout after fire and many of their seeds require fire to germinate.
paras.zh: 由于芽可以休眠，许多植物物种可以在灾难性事件（例如火灾）后重新发芽。例如，南非的开普植物区是世界上六个公认的花卉王国中最小的一个，其大多数植物物种都依赖于火——其植物在火灾后会重新发芽，并且许多种子需要火才能发芽。

paras.en: Some plants, such as the Snow Gum (Eucalyptus pauciflora), have a thick layer of insulating bark to protect their buds, while others like stinging nettles (Urtica dioica) bury them underground in a "bud bank". The soil insulates the seed's buds from extreme heat and cold and protects most of the plant from life-threatening conditions. This widespread adaptation allows herbaceous plants to endure through the winter and plants with bulbs to hide their tissues from the ravages of fire.
paras.zh: 一些植物，如雪口胶（Eucalyptus pauciflora），有一层厚厚的绝缘树皮来保护它们的芽，而另一些植物，如荨麻（Urtica dioica）则将它们埋在地下的“芽库”中。土壤使种子的芽免受极热和极冷的影响，并保护植物的大部分免受危及生命的条件的影响。这种广泛的适应使草本植物能够熬过冬天，而球茎植物则可以隐藏其组织免受火灾的破坏。

paras.en: Plants can also store seeds underground when times are difficult. Almost 350,000 plant species produce seeds. For most of these species, the seeds contain dormant tiny versions of the young plant, with all the structures that will turn into leaves and roots.
paras.zh: 当困难时期，植物还可以将种子储存在地下。近 350,000 种植物产生种子。对于大多数这些物种来说，种子含有休眠的微小版本的幼苗，以及将变成叶子和根的所有结构。

paras.en: "Seeds can live essentially in stasis in the soil," Daniel Anstett, an evolutionary ecologist at Cornell University, told Live Science. "You can have the seed bank where certain seeds might come back, and there's access to the backward library of genetic information that many plants can ultimately draw upon."
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学的进化生态学家丹尼尔·安斯特特（ Daniel Anstett ）告诉Live Science ： “种子基本上可以在土壤中停滞不前。” “你可以有种子库，某些种子可能会回来，并且可以访问许多植物最终可以利用的落后的遗传信息库。”

paras.en: Seed banks are a vital tool for resilience in many plant species. They create the opportunity for metabolically inactive individuals to reanimate when environmental conditions improve, according to a 2021 paper published in the journal Nature Communications. "When lucky, at least some of these individuals will awaken in the future when the environment is more conducive for growth and reproduction," the authors wrote.
paras.zh: 种子库是许多植物物种恢复力的重要工具。根据2021年发表在《自然通讯》杂志上的一篇论文，当环境条件改善时，它们为代谢不活跃的个体创造了复活的机会。作者写道： “幸运的是，未来当环境更有利于生长和繁殖时，至少其中一些人会醒来。”

paras.en: Seedbanks can also be reservoirs of genetic diversity, which is integral to being able to adapt to new environments.
paras.zh: 种子库也可以是遗传多样性的水库，这对于适应新环境是不可或缺的。

paras.en: "The raw material for adaptation comes from genetic variation," said Angert. "Genetic variation is larger in large populations, and genetic variation can be shared between populations as the environment changes — if individuals can disperse successfully between them."
paras.zh: “适应的原材料来自遗传变异，” Angert说。“在大型种群中，遗传变异较大，如果个体能够在它们之间成功分散，随着环境的变化，遗传变异可以在种群之间共享。”

paras.en: In a paper published in journal Science earlier this year, researchers, including Angert and Anstett, showed rapid evolution saved scarlet monkey flower (Erythranthe cardinalis) populations from prolonged drought in the U.S. and Mexico between 2010 and 2018.
paras.zh: 在今年早些时候发表在《科学》杂志上的一篇论文中，包括安格特和安斯特特在内的研究人员表明，快速进化使红猴花（Erythranthe cardinalis）种群免受 2010 年至 2018 年美国和墨西哥长期干旱的影响。

paras.en: "They can either grow really fast, flower and put out seeds before the fall drought takes effect, or they can grow much more slowly and bunker down,” Anstett explained.
paras.zh: 安斯特解释说：“它们要么生长得非常快，在秋季干旱发生之前开花并结出种子，要么生长得慢得多并埋藏起来。”

paras.en: The researchers sequenced the genomes of 55 scarlet monkeyflower populations to find areas within their genomes linked to coping with stress and drought. They tracked the populations and how they changed over the period. Some populations experienced rapid evolution to cope with the changing environment.
paras.zh: 研究人员对55个猩红猴花种群的基因组进行了测序，以发现其基因组中与应对压力和干旱有关的区域。他们跟踪了人口以及他们在此期间的变化情况。一些种群经历了快速进化，以应对不断变化的环境。

paras.en: They found that, based on populations’ genetic diversity, they could predict whether a population would be able to survive the drought — even before it started.
paras.zh: 他们发现，根据种群的遗传多样性，他们可以预测一个种群是否能够在干旱开始之前存活下来。

paras.en: While this is only one plant species, Anstett believes it could be true of other organisms too.
paras.zh: 虽然这只是一种植物物种，但Anstett认为其他生物也可能如此。

paras.en: Some plants are able to transform how they produce energy to endure a changing environment. This is what Zhen Xu, a paleobotanist at the University of Leeds in the U.K, thinks allowed some plant species to survive the Permian-Triassic mass extinction and might become increasingly important for plants in today's changing climate.
paras.zh: 一些植物能够改变它们产生能量的方式，以承受不断变化的环境。这就是英国利兹大学的古植物学家Zhen Xu认为允许一些植物物种在二叠纪-三叠纪大灭绝中幸存下来，并可能在当今不断变化的气候中对植物变得越来越重要。

paras.en: Plants use photosynthesis to convert carbon dioxide and water into sugars and oxygen, and use stomata, or small pores on their leaf surface, to regulate the amount of carbon dioxide entering the plant.
paras.zh: 植物利用光合作用将二氧化碳和水转化为糖和氧气，并利用气孔或叶表面的小孔来调节进入植物的二氧化碳量。

paras.en: Many plants open their stomata during the day to let in CO2 and release oxygen. Others use CAM photosynthesis, which stands for "Crassulacean acid metabolism," to close their stomata during the day and protect themselves from the heat. At night, they absorb CO2 and transform it into an acid, which they store in their tissues to be used to make sugars during the day.
paras.zh: 许多植物在白天打开气孔以吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气。其他人则利用 CAM 光合作用（代表“景天酸代谢”）在白天关闭气孔，保护自己免受高温侵害。晚上，它们吸收二氧化碳并将其转化为酸，将其储存在组织中，用于白天制造糖。

paras.en: "CAM photosynthesis is very common in present day desert plants, like the cactus and succulents," Xu told Live Science. "It's a very smart way to escape from the high temperature or aridity during the daytime."
paras.zh: “凸轮光合作用在当今的沙漠植物中非常普遍，如仙人掌和多肉植物，”徐告诉Live Science。“这是白天逃离高温或干旱的一种非常聪明的方式。”

paras.en: In a study published in journal Nature Ecology & Evolution earlier this year, Xu and colleagues showed that plants that used CAM photosynthesis had an advantage during the Permian-Triassic mass extinction.
paras.zh: 在今年早些时候发表在《自然生态与进化》杂志上的一项研究中，徐和他的同事们表明，在二叠纪-三叠纪大规模灭绝期间，使用凸轮光合作用的植物具有优势。

paras.en: They found that Lycophytes, or are ancient vascular plants, switched to CAM photosynthesis around the time of the mass extinction. "We think CAM photosynthesis may be the special strategy to survive" and allowed these plants to dominate after the mass extinction, Xu said.
paras.zh: 他们发现，在大规模灭绝的时候，溶生菌或古老的维管植物转向了CAM光合作用。“我们认为CAM光合作用可能是生存的特殊策略” ，并允许这些植物在大规模灭绝后占主导地位，徐说。

paras.en: Some plants go to even more extreme lengths. During cataclysmic events, plants have turned into "hopeful monsters" to survive environmental upheaval, past research shows.
paras.zh: 有些植物的长度甚至更长。过去的研究表明，在灾难性事件中，植物已经变成了“有希望的怪物” ，以便在环境动荡中生存下来。

paras.en: In nine separate events over the past 150 million years, many flowering plants duplicated their whole genome to give themselves a better chance of survival, according to research published in journal Cell earlier this year. The duplicate genome gives them more opportunities to evolve and adapt to challenging environmental conditions.
paras.zh: 根据今年早些时候发表在《细胞》杂志上的研究，在过去的1.5亿年里，在九个不同的事件中，许多开花植物复制了它们的整个基因组，为自己提供了更好的生存机会。重复的基因组使它们有更多的机会进化和适应具有挑战性的环境条件。

paras.en: "We see clusterings of whole genome duplications in time, and every time it corresponds with a described, important geological event, whether it's a global cooling period, whether it's a global warming period, or whether there's an extinction event," study co-author Yves Van de Peer, a genome biologist at Ghent University in Belgium, told Live Science at the time.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、比利时根特大学基因组生物学家Yves Van de Peer当时告诉Live Science ： “我们看到全基因组重复聚集在一起，每次都与描述的重要地质事件相对应，无论是全球降温期，还是全球变暖期，或者是否存在灭绝事件。”

paras.en: Still, the survival of specific plant populations or species often boils down to luck, experts told Live Science.
paras.zh: 不过，专家告诉Live Science ，特定植物种群或物种的生存往往归结为运气。

paras.en: Plants "essentially have this broad toolkit" but "some of the plants have some pathways, and other plants have others, and some have some traits, and some have others", Anstett said. Whether the particular tools they have will help depends on the conditions they face.
paras.zh: Anstett说，植物“基本上有这种广泛的工具包” ，但“有些植物有一些通路，其他植物有一些通路，有些植物有一些特性，有些植物有一些特性”。他们所拥有的特定工具是否会有所帮助，取决于他们所面临的情况。

paras.en: During the Triassic-Permian mass extinction, the plants in refugia in China (and elsewhere) were in the right place at the right time, with the right suite of potential adaptations at their disposal and enough genetic variety to tap into them.
paras.zh: 在三叠纪-二叠纪大灭绝期间，中国（和其他地方）庇护所的植物在正确的时间出现在正确的地点，拥有正确的潜在适应套件和足够的遗传品种来利用它们。

paras.en: - 'The apple you eat isn't the apple your granddaughter will eat': What's on the menu in a warming world?
paras.zh: - “你吃的苹果不是你孙女会吃的苹果” ：在一个变暖的世界里，菜单上有什么？

paras.en: - 'If there's any country that will do it, it's China': Why is China diverting some of the world's mightiest rivers thousands of miles?
paras.zh: - “如果有哪个国家愿意这样做，那就是中国” ：为什么中国要将世界上最强大的河流改道数千英里？

paras.en: - A looming 'insect apocalypse' could endanger global food supplies. Can we stop it before it's too late?
paras.zh: -迫在眉睫的“昆虫启示录”可能会危及全球粮食供应。我们可以在为时已晚之前阻止它吗？

paras.en: The same holds true for modern-day species facing a changing climate and potential extinction. Angert said there are ways to make plant species "luckier" in the years ahead, such as connecting fragmented populations to increase genetic diversity, which increases the suite of potential tools at a plant species' disposal.
paras.zh: 同样的情况也适用于面临气候变化和潜在灭绝的现代物种。Angert说，有一些方法可以使植物物种在未来几年“更幸运” ，例如连接分散的种群以增加遗传多样性，这增加了植物物种处置的潜在工具套件。

paras.en: "The best thing we could do is to leave larger and better connected populations on the landscape," she said.
paras.zh: 她说： “我们能做的最好的事情就是在景观上留下更多、联系更好的人群。”

paras.en: Anstett agreed. "If populations become really disconnected, then potentially we're eroding away whatever toolkit that these plants have to be able to adapt."
paras.zh: Anstett同意。“如果种群变得真正脱节，那么我们可能会侵蚀这些植物必须能够适应的任何工具包。”

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进Live Science Pro ：我们一直在努力改进我们的内容。请在此处提供有关专业版的反馈。

paras.en: Sarah Wild is a British-South African freelance science journalist. She has written about particle physics, cosmology and everything in between. She studied physics, electronics and English literature at Rhodes University, South Africa, and later read for an MSc Medicine in bioethics.
paras.zh: Sarah Wild是英国和南非的自由科学记者。她撰写了有关粒子物理学、宇宙学以及介于两者之间的一切的文章。她在南非罗德大学学习物理、电子和英国文学，后来读了生物伦理学硕士学位。

paras.en: Since she started perpetrating journalism for a living, she's written books, won awards, and run national science desks. Her work has appeared in Nature, Science, Scientific American, and The Observer, among others. In 2017 she won a gold AAAS Kavli for her reporting on forensics in South Africa.
paras.zh: 自从她开始从事新闻工作以来，她撰写了书籍，赢得了奖项，并开设了国家科学办公室。她的作品出现在《自然》、《科学》、《科学美国人》和《观察家》等杂志上。2017年，她因报道南非的法医学而获得AAAS Kavli金奖。

articles.title: Japan launches world's first round-trip mission to Mars
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: On Monday (Oct. 19), Japan's space agency launched a first-of-its-kind sample-return mission to Mars. The historic endeavor marks another major step toward humanity's shared goal of understanding — and perhaps eventually colonizing — one of our closest planetary neighbors, experts say.
paras.zh: 周一（10 月 19 日），日本宇宙航空研究开发机构启动了首次火星样本返回任务。专家表示，这一历史性的努力标志着人类朝着理解——或许最终殖民——我们最近的行星邻居之一的共同目标又迈出了重要一步。

paras.en: The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency's (JAXA) Martian Moons Exploration (MMX) probe is an international effort, constructed with help from NASA, the European Space Agency (ESA) and others. Over the next few years, it will closely study the Red Planet's twin moons, Phobos and Deimos. The spacecraft will snap close-up photos of the pair before attempting to land on the larger satellite, Phobos, to scoop up rocky material that will hopefully be carried back to Earth in around five years.
paras.zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构 (JAXA) 的火星卫星探索 (MMX) 探测器是一项国际努力，在美国宇航局 (NASA)、欧洲航天局 (ESA) 和其他机构的帮助下建造。在接下来的几年里，它将密切研究这颗红色星球的双卫星火卫一和火卫二。该航天器将拍摄这对卫星的特写照片，然后尝试降落在更大的卫星火卫一上，以收集岩石材料，这些材料有望在大约五年内带回地球。

paras.en: If the mission is successful, the returned samples will finally settle a decades-old mystery about the origins of both moons. The findings could also help paint a picture of Mars' ancient history and provide clues about what the early solar system was like.
paras.zh: 如果任务成功，返回的样本将最终解决有关两颗卫星起源的数十年之谜。这些发现还可以帮助描绘火星的古代历史，并提供有关早期太阳系是什么样子的线索。

paras.en: "This mission marks a transformative leap in our capacity to investigate the Martian system," Sonia Fornasier, an astronomer at the Paris Observatory who has studied Phobos and Deimos extensively and is a project scientist for MMX's infrared spectrometer instrument (MIRS), told Live Science. It "ranks very high" among the missions we have sent to the Red Planet so far, she added.
paras.zh: 巴黎天文台天文学家索尼娅·福纳西尔（Sonia Fornasier）对《生活科学》杂志表示：“这次任务标志着我们研究火星系统能力的一次变革性飞跃。”她广泛研究了火卫一和火卫二，也是 MMX 红外光谱仪（MIRS）的项目科学家。她补充说，在我们迄今为止派往这颗红色星球的任务中，它“排名非常靠前”。

paras.en: JAXA launched the MMX probe on board an H3 rocket, which lifted off from Tanegashima Space Center in Kagoshima prefecture at 3:41 p.m. EDT Monday (4:41 a.m. Tuesday local time), Live Science's sister site Space.com reported. (The mission was initially scheduled to launch in 2024, but it was delayed due to initial concerns about the H3 rocket.)
paras.zh: JAXA 在 H3 火箭上发射了 MMX 探测器，该火箭于下午 3 点 41 分从鹿儿岛县种子岛航天中心升空。据 Live Science 的姊妹网站 Space.com 报道，美国东部时间周一（当地时间周二凌晨 4:41）。 （该任务最初计划于 2024 年发射，但由于最初对 H3 火箭的担忧而推迟。）

paras.en: The camper-van-sized spacecraft successfully separated from the rocket's fairing just over an hour later, and on Wednesday (Oct. 21), JAXA announced that the mission had passed the "initial critical operations phase," meaning the probe is now locked into its roughly 140 million-mile-long (225 million kilometers) journey to Mars, which will take around 10 months.
paras.zh: 一个多小时后，这辆露营车大小的航天器成功与火箭整流罩分离，周三（10 月 21 日），JAXA 宣布该任务已通过“初始关键操作阶段”，这意味着探测器现在已进入大约 1.4 亿英里（2.25 亿公里）长的火星之旅，这将需要大约 10 个月的时间。

paras.en: "MMX took its first step today," Naoki Murakami, general manager of Mitsubishi Electric’s space division, which led the design of the MMX probe, said in a postlaunch news conference early Tuesday morning (Oct. 20), according to The Japan Times. "This marks the beginning of a long, five-year journey."
paras.zh: 据《日本时报》报道，负责 MMX 探测器设计的三菱电机太空部门总经理村上直树 (Naoki Murakami) 在周二早上（10 月 20 日）发射后新闻发布会上表示：“MMX 今天迈出了第一步。” “这标志着漫长的五年旅程的开始。”

paras.en: Once the probe arrives at the Red Planet in August 2027, it will insert itself into a "quasi-satellite orbit" around Phobos. In other words, MMX will circle Mars alongside the moon but will not be gravitationally bound to it, similar to around half a dozen "quasi-moons" that currently accompany Earth around the sun.
paras.zh: 一旦探测器于 2027 年 8 月抵达这颗红色星球，它将进入火卫一周围的“准卫星轨道”。换句话说，MMX将与月球一起绕火星运行，但不会受到月球引力的束缚，类似于目前伴随地球绕太阳运行的大约六颗“准卫星”。

paras.en: After collecting data from a distance for a few months, MMX will swoop down and attempt to land on the surface of Phobos — not once, but twice.
paras.zh: 在从远处收集了几个月的数据后，MMX 将俯冲下来并尝试降落在火卫一的表面——不是一次，而是两次。

paras.en: During the first landing, MMX will hover just above the moon and deploy a mini rover, dubbed Idefix, onto the moon's surface. The wandering robot, built by the French and German space agencies, will have to contend with extremely weak gravity as it trundles across the surface of Phobos: The rover weighs around 55 pounds (25 kilograms) on Earth but will weigh only around half an ounce (15 grams) on Phobos, according to ESA.
paras.zh: 在第一次着陆期间，MMX 将盘旋在月球上方，并在月球表面部署一个名为 Idefix 的迷你漫游车。这个由法国和德国航天局建造的漫游机器人在穿越火卫一表面时将不得不应对极其微弱的重力：根据欧空局的数据，漫游车在地球上重约 55 磅（25 公斤），但在火卫一上仅重约半盎司（15 克）。

paras.en: Once Idefix has completed its initial assessment of the moon's surface, the entire MMX probe will set down on Phobos, on top of the spacecraft's four-legged lander module. Mission scientists hope this goes a lot more smoothly than the attempted landings of Japan's "Moon Sniper" and Resilience lunar landers, which crash-landed on Earth's moon in 2024 and 2025, respectively.
paras.zh: 一旦 Idefix 完成对月球表面的初步评估，整个 MMX 探测器将降落在火卫一上，位于航天器四足着陆器模块的顶部。任务科学家希望这比日本的“月球狙击手”和“弹性”月球着陆器的尝试着陆要顺利得多，这两个着陆器分别于 2024 年和 2025 年在月球上迫降。

paras.en: Two of the MMX lander's legs contain built-in sampling devices — one that will drill into Phobos and another that will hoover up surface material. The second device, dubbed the Pneumatic Sampler (or P-Sampler), was built by the Blue Origin-owned private company Honeybee Robotics on behalf of NASA and will collect its material in a "matter of seconds," Kris Zacny, vice president of the Exploration Technology Group at Honeybee Robotics, said at an Oct. 15 NASA news conference. "You blink, and it's all done."
paras.zh: MMX 着陆器的两条腿包含内置采样装置 - 一个将钻入火卫一，另一个将吸走表面材料。 Honeybee Robotics 探索技术小组副总裁 Kris Zacny 在 10 月 15 日的 NASA 新闻发布会上表示，第二个设备被称为气动采样器（或 P-Sampler），由 Blue Origin 旗下的私营公司 Honeybee Robotics 代表 NASA 制造，将在“几秒钟内”收集材料。 “你一眨眼，一切就完成了。”

paras.en: In total, JAXA aims to collect around a third of an ounce (10 grams) of material from Phobos. That would be around twice as much material as the space agency managed to snag on its most recent sample-return mission, Hayabusa2, which collected samples from the "spinning-top" asteroid Ryugu in 2019, finding materials rich in surprising organic compounds.
paras.zh: 总的来说，JAXA 的目标是从火卫一收集约三分之一盎司（10 克）的材料。这大约是美国宇航局在最近一次样本返回任务“隼鸟二号”中获得的材料的两倍左右，该任务于 2019 年从“陀螺”小行星“龙宫”收集了样本，发现了富含令人惊讶的有机化合物的材料。

paras.en: Once the samples have been acquired, at some point between late 2028 and early 2029, the probe will conduct a series of close flybys of Mars' smaller moon, Deimos, before beginning the long trip back to Earth in late 2030 — the first return flight ever attempted by a spacecraft sent to Mars.
paras.zh: 一旦获得样本，探测器将在 2028 年末至 2029 年初之间的某个时间点对火星较小的卫星火卫二进行一系列近距离飞越，然后在 2030 年底开始返回地球的长途旅行——这是发射到火星的航天器首次尝试返回地球。

paras.en: When the probe returns to Earth in 2031, it will release its samples in a 20-inch-wide (60 centimeters) container that will fall back to our planet's surface, most likely somewhere in Australia, according to ESA.
paras.zh: 据欧空局称，当探测器于 2031 年返回地球时，它将在一个 20 英寸宽（60 厘米）的容器中释放样本，该容器将落回地球表面，最有可能在澳大利亚的某个地方。

paras.en: What could we learn about Phobos and Deimos?
paras.zh: 关于火卫一和火卫二我们能了解到什么？

paras.en: Mars' twin satellites, which were first spotted by American astronomer Asaph Hall in 1877, are nothing like Earth's constant companion. For starters, they are much smaller; Phobos is around 14 miles (22 km) across, while Deimos is just 7.5 miles (12 km) wide. The duo also have lopsided shapes and are between 12 and 64 times closer to Mars than the moon is to Earth. (Phobos, meaning "fear," and Deimos, meaning "terror," are named after the sons of the Greek war god Ares, the counterpart to the Roman war god Mars.)
paras.zh: 火星的双卫星于 1877 年由美国天文学家阿萨夫·霍尔 (Asaph Hall) 首次发现，它们与地球的永恒伴侣完全不同。首先，它们要小得多。火卫一宽约 22 公里（14 英里），而火卫二宽仅 12 公里（7.5 英里）。这两个行星的形状也是不平衡的，它们与火星的距离是月球与地球距离的 12 到 64 倍。 （Phobos，意思是“恐惧”，Deimos，意思是“恐怖”，是以希腊战神阿瑞斯的儿子命名的，阿瑞斯是罗马战神马尔斯的对应者。）

paras.en: Phobos is dominated by the 6-mile-wide (10 km) Stickney crater, which was left by an ancient asteroid impact. The larger moon is also slowly falling toward Mars and may eventually be ripped apart before it reaches the Red Planet's surface.
paras.zh: 火卫一的主体是 6 英里宽（10 公里）的斯蒂克尼陨石坑，该陨石坑是古代小行星撞击留下的。较大的卫星也正在慢慢落向火星，最终可能在到达火星表面之前被撕裂。

paras.en: Other Martian spacecraft, such as the Emirates Mars Mission orbiter, have flown close to the moons, and NASA's Mars rovers have frequently looked up to see the satellites eclipsing the sun in Mars' sky (sometimes both at the same time). Yet many mysteries remain about the pair.
paras.zh: 其他火星航天器，例如阿联酋火星任务轨道飞行器，已经飞近月球，美国宇航局的火星漫游者也经常抬头看到卫星在火星天空中遮住太阳（有时两者同时出现）。 Yet many mysteries remain about the pair.

paras.en: "Mars is right in our cosmic backyard, and yet we haven't explored the planet's moons," Nancy Chabot, a space exploration expert at the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory in Maryland and the deputy principal investigator of NASA's MEGANE instrument on board MMX, told Live Science in an email. "MMX will do this!"
paras.zh: “火星就在我们的宇宙后院，但我们还没有探索过这颗行星的卫星，”马里兰州约翰霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室的太空探索专家、美国宇航局 MMX 上 MEGANE 仪器的副首席研究员南希·查博特 (Nancy Chabot) 在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。 “MMX会做到这一点！”

paras.en: The biggest mystery surrounding Phobos and Deimos is their origin. Some researchers suspect the satellites are asteroids, or maybe even comets, that have been captured by Mars' gravity, while others think the moons emerged from the debris of an ancient impact on the planet's surface, similar to how Earth's moon formed.
paras.zh: 火卫一和火卫二最大的谜团是它们的起源。一些研究人员怀疑这些卫星是小行星，甚至可能是被火星引力捕获的彗星，而另一些研究人员则认为这些卫星是从古代撞击火星表面的碎片中出现的，类似于地球月球的形成方式。

paras.en: - A secretive Chinese probe has just arrived at one of Earth's 'quasi-moons' and will soon attempt a first-of-its-kind landing
paras.zh: - 一个秘密的中国探测器刚刚抵达地球的一个“准卫星”，并将很快尝试首次着陆

paras.en: - 'We're not a competitor to fusion. We are fusion': Inside the race to harness unlimited solar power in space
paras.zh: - “我们不是核聚变的竞争对手。我们正在融合”：在太空中利用无限太阳能的竞赛

paras.en: - 'Is having two legs useful' in space?: Astronaut explains what life in orbit might be like for the first physically disabled person in space
paras.zh: - “两条腿在太空有用吗”？：宇航员解释了第一个进入太空的身体残疾人在轨道上的生活可能会是什么样子

paras.en: Neither theory is conclusive, meaning the moons' origins "remain enigmatic," Christopher Edwards, a planetary scientist at Northern Arizona University and one of NASA's participating scientists for MMX, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 北亚利桑那大学的行星科学家、美国宇航局参与 MMX 的科学家之一克里斯托弗·爱德华兹 (Christopher Edwards) 告诉《生活科学》，这两种理论都不是结论性的，这意味着卫星的起源“仍然是个谜”。

paras.en: For example, explaining how Mars captured the moons is "quite hard from an orbital mechanics perspective," but if they did form from a debris disk from an ancient impact, they should have coalesced into better-defined spheres, Edwards said.
paras.zh: 例如，爱德华兹说，解释火星如何捕获卫星“从轨道力学的角度来看相当困难”，但如果它们确实是由远古撞击产生的碎片盘形成的，它们应该会合并成更清晰的球体。

paras.en: "MMX will solve this debate thanks to the spacecraft observations and the detailed analysis of the samples of Phobos on Earth," Fornasier said. The data the probe collects from its flybys of Deimos will also allow researchers to generate a "full characterization of this body," she added.
paras.zh: 福纳西尔说：“由于航天器的观测和对地球上火卫一样本的详细分析，MMX 将解决这场争论。”她补充说，探测器从飞越火卫二上收集的数据也将使研究人员能够“对该物体进行全面的描述”。

paras.en: Fornasier is "particularly excited" by the possibility that the moons are captured asteroids because that would mean they would likely contain "organic and hydrated materials," which would have a big "astrobiological implication" and would shed light on what the early solar system was like.
paras.zh: 福纳西尔对这些卫星被小行星捕获的可能性“特别兴奋”，因为这意味着它们可能含有“有机和水合材料”，这将具有重大的“天体生物学意义”，并将揭示早期太阳系的情况。

paras.en: Regardless of how the twin moons formed, researchers also stand to learn a lot about Mars and how planets form and evolve.
paras.zh: 无论这对双卫星是如何形成的，研究人员都可以了解很多关于火星以及行星如何形成和演化的知识。

paras.en: "Phobos and Deimos are interesting, but not just in their own right," Tom Statler, an MMX program executive and scientist in NASA's Planetary Science Division, said at the Oct. 15 news conference. "Their presence is a key piece of the larger story of the Mars system. By uncovering the moons' origin, we'll gain new insights into the history of both Mars and Earth."
paras.zh: “火卫一和火卫二很有趣，但不仅仅是它们本身，”美国宇航局行星科学部门的 MMX 项目主管兼科学家汤姆·斯塔特勒 (Tom Statler) 在 10 月 15 日的新闻发布会上说。 “它们的存在是火星系统更大故事的关键部分。通过揭示卫星的起源，我们将对火星和地球的历史获得新的见解。”

paras.en: If the moons did form via an impact scenario, the samples MMX collects may also contain actual pieces of Mars for researchers to study.
paras.zh: 如果卫星确实是通过撞击场景形成的，那么 MMX 收集的样本也可能包含火星的实际碎片，供研究人员研究。

paras.en: "If these objects are in fact pieces from the Martian surface that have coalesced moons, we'll collect the best-preserved samples of the Martian surface," Edwards said. Other fragments of Mars have already reached Earth as meteorites. However, entry into Earth's atmosphere can transform them.
paras.zh: 爱德华兹说：“如果这些物体实际上是来自火星表面并合并了卫星的碎片，我们将收集火星表面保存最完好的样本。”火星的其他碎片已经以陨石的形式到达地球。然而，进入地球大气层可以改变它们。

paras.en: If Phobos is a chunk of Mars, that would be a real boon to NASA, which canceled its Mars Sample Return program — a mission that would have retrieved samples collected by the Perseverance rover — earlier this year. The agency's researchers will receive up to 15% of the MMX samples to analyze.
paras.zh: 如果火卫一是火星的一大块，那对美国宇航局来说将是一个真正的福音，美国宇航局今年早些时候取消了火星样本返回计划——该计划本来可以取回毅力号火星车收集的样本。该机构的研究人员将收到最多 15% 的 MMX 样本进行分析。

paras.en: During its three-year stay in the Red Planet's system, the Japanese probe will also collect lots of data on Mars that could contribute to a wide range of future findings. "MMX will conduct in-depth studies of the Martian atmosphere, with a particular emphasis on dust and water transport mechanisms and the escape processes shaping Mars' atmospheric dynamics," Fornasier said.
paras.zh: 在这颗红色行星系统停留的三年期间，日本探测器还将收集大量有关火星的数据，这些数据可能有助于未来的广泛发现。福纳西尔说：“MMX将对火星大气进行深入研究，特别关注尘埃和水的传输机制以及塑造火星大气动力学的逃逸过程。”

paras.en: This atmospheric data could temporarily fill a gap left by the recent death of NASA's iconic MAVEN spacecraft, which stopped sending data back to Earth late last year.
paras.zh: 这些大气数据可以暂时填补美国宇航局标志性的 MAVEN 航天器最近失效所留下的空白，该航天器去年年底停止向地球发送数据。

paras.en: Analysis of craters on the Martian moons could also provide clues about other events in Mars' history. For example, some researchers think the Red Planet may have once had rings like Saturn or a larger moon.
paras.zh: 对火星卫星上陨石坑的分析也可以提供有关火星历史上其他事件的线索。例如，一些研究人员认为这颗红色星球可能曾经有过像土星或更大的卫星那样的光环。

paras.en: Other experts are hopeful that the MMX findings could help lay the groundwork for future missions to explore — and perhaps colonize — Mars. "The samples from MMX will bring forth paradigm-shifting science on the Mars system for generations to come, especially as NASA prepares to send the first humans to Mars," Nicky Fox, associate administrator for NASA's Science Mission Directorate, said in a recent statement.
paras.zh: 其他专家希望 MMX 的发现能够为未来探索火星（或许还有殖民火星）的任务奠定基础。 NASA 科学任务理事会副局长尼基·福克斯 (Nicky Fox) 在最近的一份声明中表示：“来自 MMX 的样本将为子孙后代带来火星系统范式转变的科学，特别是在 NASA 准备将第一批人类送往火星之际。”

paras.en: The next sample-return trip to Mars will be China's Tianwen-3 mission, which is scheduled to launch in 2028 and will aim to land on and retrieve samples directly from the Red Planet's surface, according to Space.com.
paras.zh: 据 Space.com 报道，下一次火星样本返回之旅将是中国的天问三号任务，该任务计划于 2028 年发射，旨在直接着陆在这颗红色星球的表面并直接从其表面检索样本。

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家报道”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。

articles.title: Watch bizarre snake 'cartwheel' away from danger at more than 12 feet per second
articles.author: Patrick Pester

paras.en: Cryptic snakes in Southeast Asia have evolved a remarkable trick for evading predators: Instead of slithering, they arch their long bodies and tumble away at high speeds.
paras.zh: 东南亚的隐蛇进化出了一种躲避捕食者的非凡技巧：它们不是滑行，而是拱起长长的身体并高速翻滚。

paras.en: The dwarf reed snakes (Pseudorabdion) pull off this acrobatic feat by keeping their head in a relatively fixed position while rotating the rest of their body, according to a new study published Monday (Oct. 19) in the journal Current Biology.
paras.zh: 根据周一（10 月 19 日）发表在《当代生物学》杂志上的一项新研究，矮芦苇蛇（Pseudorabdion）通过将头部保持在相对固定的位置，同时旋转身体的其余部分来完成这一杂技壮举。

paras.en: Researchers filmed the snakes from different angles to better understand the mechanics of the rolling, or cartwheeling, behavior. They found that the snakes were capable of reaching velocities of up to 12.1 feet per second (3.69 meters per second), which is much faster than they can slither (technically referred to as undulating locomotion).
paras.zh: 研究人员从不同角度拍摄了蛇，以更好地了解蛇滚动或侧手翻行为的机制。他们发现蛇能够达到每秒 12.1 英尺（每秒 3.69 米）的速度，这比它们滑行的速度（技术上称为波动运动）快得多。

paras.en: "Rolling allows them to escape from danger very quickly," study first author Yosuke Kojima, a lecturer in the biology department at Toho University in Japan, told Live Science. "In our study, their peak forward velocity during rolling was, on average, four times that of normal undulating locomotion."
paras.zh: “滚动可以让它们很快逃离危险，”该研究的第一作者、日本东邦大学生物系讲师小岛洋介告诉《生活科学》。 “在我们的研究中，它们在滚动过程中的峰值前进速度平均是正常波动运动的四倍。”

paras.en: Dwarf reed snakes are secretive, often nocturnal species that live across Southeast Asia, where they are prey for birds and other snakes. Although the snakes are extremely cryptic and usually hidden beneath leaves or other natural objects, people occasionally observe the serpents' dazzling rolls.
paras.zh: 矮芦苇蛇是一种神秘的、通常是夜间活动的物种，生活在东南亚各地，是鸟类和其他蛇类的猎物。尽管蛇极其神秘，通常隐藏在树叶或其他自然物体下，但人们偶尔会观察到蛇令人眼花缭乱的滚动。

paras.en: In a 2023 study, researchers formally documented the rolling behavior for the first time in one dwarf reed snake species (P. longiceps), which researchers observed in northwestern Malaysia in 2019. Kojima's team started independently observing the behavior around the same time in the Malaysian state of Sarawak, on Borneo.
paras.zh: 在 2023 年的一项研究中，研究人员首次正式记录了一种矮芦蛇（P. longiceps）的滚动行为，研究人员于 2019 年在马来西亚西北部观察到这种行为。小岛的团队大约在同一时间开始在马来西亚婆罗洲的沙捞越州独立观察这种行为。

paras.en: "I had never seen anything like it before, and I immediately wanted to learn more about it," Kojima said.
paras.zh: 小岛说：“我以前从未见过这样的东西，我立即想了解更多。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: For the new study, researchers filmed the rolling behavior multiple times in three dwarf reed species — P. saravacense, P. collaris and P. longiceps — between 2019 and 2022. The team also studied three reed snakes from another genus (Calamaria), which didn't perform the behavior.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，研究人员在 2019 年至 2022 年间多次拍摄了三种矮芦苇物种（P. saravacense、P. colonis 和 P. longiceps）的翻滚行为。该团队还研究了来自另一个属（Calamaria）的三种芦苇蛇，它们没有这种行为。

paras.en: Kojima said their study builds on the 2023 research by quantifying the rolling movements, confirming the overall movement pattern that research described, and revealing further details, including how the snakes stabilize their heads.
paras.zh: 小岛表示，他们的研究建立在 2023 年研究的基础上，通过量化滚动运动，确认研究描述的整体运动模式，并揭示更多细节，包括蛇如何稳定头部。

paras.en: Snakes aren't the only tumblers in nature. For example, some desert spiders can roll away from danger, as can mother-of-pearl moth caterpillars (Pleurotya ruralis or Patania ruralis). However, the snakes are unique in that they seem to have good control over their rolls.
paras.zh: 蛇并不是自然界中唯一的不倒翁。例如，一些沙漠蜘蛛可以滚离危险，珍珠母蛾毛毛虫（Pleurotya africais 或 Patania africais）也可以。然而，蛇的独特之处在于它们似乎能够很好地控制自己的滚动。

paras.en: Rolling movements typically destabilize the head and disrupt sensory-guided adjustment, especially at high speeds, according to the authors of the new study. In other words, it's hard for animals to control their bodies when they're rolling around. The snakes' technique of keeping their heads relatively fixed and often elevated off the ground likely counters what would otherwise be destabilizing effects.
paras.zh: 这项新研究的作者表示，滚动运动通常会破坏头部的稳定性并扰乱感官引导的调节，尤其是在高速行驶时。换句话说，动物在翻滚时很难控制自己的身体。蛇保持头部相对固定且经常抬离地面的技术可能会抵消否则会造成不稳定的影响。

paras.en: In addition to studying speed and form, the researchers found that the snakes could move in a relatively straight line, readily moving along a "racetrack" that was only 8 inches (20 centimeters) wide. The researchers noted that the snakes often ended their tumbling routine by diving underneath nearby objects, so they seem to remain aware of their surroundings.
paras.zh: 除了研究速度和形态外，研究人员还发现蛇可以沿相对直线移动，轻松地沿着仅 8 英寸（20 厘米）宽的“跑道”移动。研究人员指出，蛇经常会潜入附近物体下面来结束翻滚的过程，因此它们似乎仍然了解周围的环境。

paras.en: The rolling is a behavioral innovation that allows the snakes to overcome their physical constraints and pull off an otherwise impossible movement, according to the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，滚动是一种行为创新，可以让蛇克服身体限制，完成原本不可能完成的动作。

paras.en: "Behavioral innovation can give rise to surprising new abilities that we would not expect from an animal's appearance alone," Kojima said.
paras.zh: 小岛说：“行为创新可以带来令人惊讶的新能力，这是我们仅从动物的外表上无法想象到的。”

paras.en: Researchers have speculated that the bizarre behavior could surprise and confuse predators, in addition to being a rapid means of escape. The authors of the 2023 study also hypothesized that rolling would result in a patchy scent trail, and because king cobras (Ophiophagus) use scent cues to locate their prey, this could make it harder for the predators to hunt dwarf reed snakes.
paras.zh: 研究人员推测，这种奇怪的行为除了是一种快速逃跑的手段之外，还可能让捕食者感到惊讶和困惑。 2023 年研究的作者还假设，滚动会产生斑驳的气味痕迹，而且由于眼镜王蛇 (Ophiophagus) 使用气味线索来定位猎物，这可能会让捕食者更难捕猎矮芦苇蛇。

paras.en: Kojima, Y., Fukuyama, I., Hossman, M. Y., Kaliang, C. H., & Nishikawa, k. (2026). Locomotor kinematics and head stabilization in rolling snakes. Current Biology, 36(20). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cub.2026.08.057
paras.zh: 小岛，Y.，福山，I.，霍斯曼，M.Y.，卡良，C.H.，和西川，k。 （2026）。滚动蛇的运动运动学和头部稳定性。现代生物学，36（20）。 https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cub.2026.08.057

paras.en: How much do you know about snakes? Test your knowledge with our snake quiz!
paras.zh: 关于蛇，你了解多少？通过我们的蛇测验测试您的知识！

paras.en: Patrick Pester is the trending news writer at Live Science. His work has appeared on other science websites, such as BBC Science Focus and Scientific American. Patrick retrained as a journalist after spending his early career working in zoos and wildlife conservation. He was awarded the Master's Excellence Scholarship to study at Cardiff University where he completed a master's degree in international journalism. He also has a second master's degree in biodiversity, evolution and conservation in action from Middlesex University London. When he isn't writing news, Patrick investigates the sale of human remains.
paras.zh: 帕特里克·佩斯特 (Patrick Pester) 是《Live Science》的热门新闻撰稿人。他的作品曾出现在其他科学网站上，例如 BBC Science Focus 和 Scientific American。帕特里克在其早期职业生涯从事动物园和野生动物保护工作后，接受了记者再培训。他获得了硕士卓越奖学金，前往卡迪夫大学学习，并在那里完成了国际新闻学硕士学位。他还拥有伦敦密德萨斯大学生物多样性、进化和保护实践的第二个硕士学位。当帕特里克不写新闻时，他会调查人类遗骸的买卖。

articles.title: Shanghai's 'Audacious' New Opera House Just Opened Its Doors—and a Gravity-Defying Staircase—to the Public

paras.en: The world’s newest opera house officially opened its doors this week, featuring a bold architectural flair and a soaring spiral staircase that connects city streets to a rooftop stage and observation deck.
paras.zh: 世界上最新的歌剧院于本周正式开业，其建筑风格大胆，高耸的螺旋楼梯将城市街道与屋顶舞台和观景台连接起来。

paras.en: The Shanghai Grand Opera House now stands complete on the banks of China’s Huangpu River, a decade after Snøhetta, an architecture firm from Norway, won the international competition to design it.
paras.zh: 距离挪威 Snøhetta 建筑公司赢得国际设计竞赛十年后，上海大歌剧院现已在中国黄浦江畔落成。

paras.en: The nearly 1.6 million square-foot building is home to three separate auditoriums with a combined capacity of 4,200 seats. Its stages were built to accommodate myriad performances and rehearsals, from traditional operas to classical symphonies and experimental productions.
paras.zh: 这座近 160 万平方英尺的建筑拥有三个独立的礼堂，总共可容纳 4,200 个座位。它的舞台是为了容纳从传统歌剧到古典交响乐和实验作品的无数表演和排练而建造的。

paras.en: In a statement, Snøhetta describes the primary performance space—the 2,000-seat Harmony Hall—as a “finely tuned instrument, combining state-of-the-art theatre systems with carefully calibrated acoustics.” It contains five levels of seating and is furnished in dark reds.
paras.zh: Snøhetta 在一份声明中将主要表演空间（拥有 2,000 个座位的和谐厅）描述为“精心调校的乐器，将最先进的剧院系统与精心校准的音响效果相结合”。它有五层座位，并以深红色装饰。

paras.en: With 1,200 seats, the Soar Theatre was designed with baroque and classical opera in mind. The slightly smaller Open Stage, which offers panoramic views of the riverfront, prioritizes flexibility, with changing stage and seating configurations that can accommodate a variety of experimental performances. The main hall of the building is a stark white space, filled with natural light and sharp red accents.
paras.zh: 翱翔剧院拥有 1,200 个座位，其设计考虑了巴洛克和古典歌剧。稍小的开放舞台可以欣赏河滨全景，优先考虑灵活性，舞台和座位配置不断变化，可以容纳各种实验表演。建筑的主厅是一个纯白色的空间，充满自然光和鲜明的红色调。

paras.en: “A cultural building, any building for that matter, must respond to its surroundings, the people who use it, the performers it serves, and the city it becomes part of,” Kjetil Thorsen, the co-founder of Snøhetta, tells Dezeen’s Lizzie Crook. “When I last visited the site, I was asked by a Chinese architecture student how we managed to create a building that felt so Chinese despite not being from China. The answer lies in observation and understanding context.”
paras.zh: Snøhetta 的联合创始人 Kjetil Thorsen 告诉 Dezeen 的 Lizzie Crook：“一座文化建筑，任何建筑，都必须对其周围环境、使用它的人、它所服务的表演者以及它所属的城市做出回应。” “当我上次访问该网站时，一位中国建筑系学生问我，我们如何设法建造一座感觉如此中国的建筑，尽管它不是来自中国。答案在于观察和理解背景。”

paras.en: Visitors do not need a ticket to enter to the building or to explore its architectural flourishes. That philosophy of openness is embodied by the opera house’s massive exterior staircase, which rises from Shanghai’s riverfront, spiraling upwards to form the roof. It is meant to connect the the city’s existing walkways with an open-air observation deck, gathering spaces and a stage.
paras.zh: 游客不需要门票即可进入该建筑或探索其建筑瑰宝。这种开放的哲学体现在歌剧院巨大的外部楼梯上，楼梯从上海的河边升起，螺旋上升形成屋顶。它的目的是将城市现有的人行道与露天观景台、聚会空间和舞台连接起来。

paras.en: “Buildings like opera houses inevitably create thresholds through walls, doors and ticketed programs,” Thorsen tells Dezeen. “We see it as our responsibility to challenge those thresholds and make the building as much a civic destination as a performance venue.”
paras.zh: “像歌剧院这样的建筑不可避免地会通过墙壁、门和售票节目设置门槛，”索尔森告诉 Dezeen。 “我们认为挑战这些门槛是我们的责任，使这座建筑既是一个表演场所，又是一个公民目的地。”

paras.en: Even on its own, the staircase is something to behold, akin to a large public sculpture. Its design is reminiscent of a traditional Chinese fan, a swirling dance movement, piano keys and the flow of the Huangpu River.
paras.zh: 即使楼梯本身也很引人注目，就像一个大型公共雕塑。其设计让人想起中国传统的扇子、旋转的舞蹈动作、钢琴键和黄浦江的流动。

paras.en: “The audacious architectural gesture now needs to be filled in with contents, with projects, with life, with people,” Serge Dorny, the director general of Germany’s Bavaria State Opera, tells ShanghaiEye.
paras.zh: 德国巴伐利亚国家歌剧院院长谢尔盖·多尔尼 (Serge Dorny) 告诉《上海之眼》：“大胆的建筑姿态现在需要充满内容、项目、生活和人。”

paras.en: The opera house’s inaugural season runs from October through February 2027. It will feature 82 performances, including ballet numbers from Russia’s Eifman Ballet and the American Ballet Theatre; a Beethoven cycle from Staatskapelle Berlin, one of the world’s leading orchestras; and traditional Chinese operas, called xiqu, including The Peony Pavilion and Dream of the Red Chamber.
paras.zh: 该歌剧院的首演季从 10 月持续到 2027 年 2 月。将有 82 场演出，包括俄罗斯艾夫曼芭蕾舞团和美国芭蕾舞剧院的芭蕾舞剧目；柏林国家管弦乐团（世界领先的管弦乐团之一）的贝多芬套曲；以及中国传统戏曲，称为戏曲，包括《牡丹亭》和《红楼梦》。

paras.en: Snøhetta has designed several opera house projects in recent years that combine performance with public accessibility. In Oslo, the waterfront Norwegian National Opera and Ballet opened in 2008. The firm’s design for the Busan Opera House in South Korea, another waterfront institution, is set to make its debut sometime in 2027, while the Royal Diriyah Opera House in Saudi Arabia is expected to open its doors in 2028.
paras.zh: Snøhetta 近年来设计了多个歌剧院项目，将表演与公共可达性结合起来。在奥斯陆，位于海滨的挪威国家歌剧院和芭蕾舞团于 2008 年开业。该公司为另一个海滨机构韩国釜山歌剧院的设计预计将于 2027 年首次亮相，而沙特阿拉伯皇家迪里耶歌剧院预计将于 2028 年开业。

paras.en: In recent years, Shanghai, a financial hub home to roughly 25 million people, has made a major push to establish itself as a cultural center. Since 2021, the Museum of Art Pudong, Shanghai Museum East, West Bund Grand Theatre and Shanghai Literature Museum have all opened their doors.
paras.zh: 近年来，拥有约 2500 万人口的金融中心上海大力推动文化中心建设。 2021年以来，浦东美术馆、上海博物馆东馆、西岸大剧院、上海文学馆相继开馆。

paras.en: “Accessibility is about daring to go in,” Thorsen tells CNN’s Stephy Chung. “It’s not only about the glass walls and the doors, but it’s about being attracted to the space as you come in, and you feel that even if you’re not the average opera goer, you’re invited in.”
paras.zh: “无障碍就是敢于进去，”托森告诉 CNN 的斯蒂芬·钟 (Stephy Chung)。 “这不仅仅是关于玻璃墙和门，而是当你进来时被这个空间所吸引，你会觉得即使你不是普通的歌剧观众，你也会被邀请进去。”

articles.title: African Elephants Shape the Savanna Ecosystem—and Continue Doing So Long After They've Died, Study Suggests

paras.en: African savanna elephants are considered ecosystem engineers. For up to roughly 70 years, each massive animal rips through trees and brush, digs wells in the ground and spreads seeds in its poop.
paras.zh: 非洲草原象被认为是生态系统工程师。在长达大约 70 年的时间里，每只大型动物都会撕扯树木和灌木丛，在地上挖井，并在粪便中传播种子。

paras.en: But even after their lives have ended, the hulking pachyderms continue making contributions to the environment, according to a study published October 12 in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. Scientists found a surprising chronology of events—involving microbes, plants and animals—near elephant remains that persists for at least eight years. The work highlights a relatively new line of research into how mega-carcasses affect the land.
paras.zh: 但根据 10 月 12 日发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》杂志上的一项研究，即使它们的生命结束了，这些巨大的厚皮动物仍然继续为环境做出贡献。科学家们在大象遗骸附近发现了令人惊讶的事件年表——涉及微生物、植物和动物——并且持续了至少八年。这项工作突出了关于巨型动物尸体如何影响土地的相对较新的研究方向。

paras.en: “We are really only fairly recently starting to get a handle on how large animals shape their ecosystems altogether, even in life,” Amanda Subalusky, an ecologist at the University of Florida who did not participate in the study, tells the Washington Post’s Meghan Bartels. “We are just beginning to scratch the surface on the role that their carcasses play.”
paras.zh: 佛罗里达大学的生态学家阿曼达·苏巴鲁斯基（Amanda Subalusky）没有参与这项研究，他告诉《华盛顿邮报》的梅根·巴特尔斯（Meghan Bartels）：“我们实际上只是最近才开始了解大型动物如何整体塑造它们的生态系统，甚至在生命中也是如此。” “我们才刚刚开始了解它们尸体所扮演的角色。”

paras.en: When an elephant named Alexander at Kruger National Park in South Africa died in 2009, study co-author Dave Thompson, a biodiversity scientist at the South African Environmental Observation Network, and a colleague started wondering how the carcass might affect the soil and food web, according to a statement.
paras.zh: 一份声明称，当南非克鲁格国家公园一头名叫亚历山大的大象于 2009 年死亡时，该研究的合著者、南非环境观测网络的生物多样性科学家戴夫·汤普森 (Dave Thompson) 和一位同事开始想知道大象尸体可能如何影响土壤和食物网。

paras.en: That curiosity turned into a larger effort to investigate soil chemistry, microbiology, biodiversity and herbivores feeding near 40 elephant carcasses in the park between 2023 and 2025. The animals had died between eight days and almost eight years before sample collection.
paras.zh: 这种好奇心转化为更大的努力，调查 2023 年至 2025 年间公园内近 40 具大象尸体的土壤化学、微生物学、生物多样性和食草动物。这些动物在采集样本前的八天到近八年之间就已死亡。

paras.en: Analyses revealed that initially, the large animal’s body kills off all biomass directly beneath it. Scavengers also swoop in to feast on the carcass, clearing the surrounding area. The remains leak nutrients into the ground, drastically boosting their levels. “At really fresh carcass sites, soil nitrogen concentrations can be up to 3,000 times higher” than locations without a carcass, says lead author Courtney Reed, an ecologist at Princeton University, in the statement. “That’s just insane.”
paras.zh: 分析显示，最初，这种大型动物的身体会杀死其正下方的所有生物量。食腐动物也会猛扑过来吃掉尸体，清理了周围的区域。遗骸将营养物质泄漏到地下，大大提高了它们的水平。主要作者、普林斯顿大学生态学家考特尼·里德在声明中表示，“在真正有新鲜尸体的地方，土壤氮浓度可能比没有尸体的地方高出 3000 倍”。 “这太疯狂了。”

paras.en: The flood of nutrients isn’t a good thing for plants. The sheer amount is toxic and stops their growth. On the other hand, microbial activity in the soil increases, though only in a small number of species.
paras.zh: 营养物质的泛滥对植物来说并不是一件好事。大量的有毒物质会阻止它们的生长。另一方面，土壤中的微生物活性有所增加，尽管只是少数物种。

paras.en: Once the nutrient concentrations eventually go down, plants behave similarly to the microbes, with just some fast-growing species taking over the hyperlocal environment for at least around eight years. These greens are particularly nutritious and attract grazing animals, which keep coming back to the site and fertilizing the land with their poop.
paras.zh: 一旦营养浓度最终下降，植物的行为与微生物类似，只有一些快速生长的物种占据超本地环境至少八年左右。这些绿色植物特别有营养，能吸引食草动物，它们会不断地回到这里，用粪便给土地施肥。

paras.en: “You have herbivores like zebra and buffalo and rhinos who are all coming in, and they’re selectively chewing on these nitrogen-rich grasses,” says Reed, who conducted the research while at the University of California, Santa Barbara, to Dave Seglins on the CBC’s “As It Happens.” “So, you actually get this burst of herbivore activity that continues for years after the elephants died.”
paras.zh: “像斑马、水牛和犀牛这样的食草动物都会进来，它们会选择性地咀嚼这些富含氮的草，”在加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校进行这项研究的里德在 CBC 节目《As It Happens》中向戴夫·塞格林斯 (Dave Seglins) 说道。 “所以，你实际上看到了这种食草动物活动的爆发，这种活动在大象死后持续了数年。”

paras.en: There are two species of African elephants. Savanna elephants are larger and have outward-curving tusks, while forest elephants are darker and have straighter, downward-pointing tusks.
paras.zh: 非洲象有两种。稀树草原象体型较大，象牙向外弯曲，而森林象颜色较深，象牙较直、向下。

paras.en: The phenomenon somewhat resembles what happens when a whale dies. Its body sinks to the bottom of the ocean—a process called whale fall—and can fuel a jump in biodiversity and activity from all the organisms it attracts. It provides a plethora of nutrients in the deep ocean, where they’re scarce. But an elephant body delivers such a high concentration of nutrients in a fertile location that it instead causes a years-long biodiversity cold spot for microbes and vegetation.
paras.zh: 这种现象有点类似于鲸鱼死亡时发生的情况。它的身体沉入海底（这一过程称为鲸落），可以促进其吸引的所有生物体的生物多样性和活动的跃升。它在深海中提供了大量的营养物质，而这些物质在深海中是稀缺的。但大象的身体在肥沃的地方提供了如此高浓度的营养物质，反而给微生物和植被造成了长达数年的生物多样性冷区。

paras.en: Interestingly, the savannas might be especially prone to a strong, long-lasting ecological cascade. A mega-carcass might have a weaker impact in a more dynamic ecosystem, like a forest or wetland with lots of rain, or in a desert where droughts limit microbial and plant activity. The team hopes to test these ideas in sub-Saharan Africa, and they’ll continue monitoring the carcass sites in Kruger National Park to see how the land keeps changing.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，稀树草原可能特别容易产生强烈、持久的生态级联。在更具活力的生态系统中，例如多雨的森林或湿地，或者干旱限制微生物和植物活动的沙漠中，巨型尸体的影响可能较弱。该团队希望在撒哈拉以南非洲测试这些想法，他们将继续监测克鲁格国家公园的尸体地点，以了解土地如何不断变化。

paras.en: “There are hidden processes occurring underground all across our landscapes,” says Philip Barton, an ecologist at Deakin University in Australia, who wasn’t involved in the study, to the Washington Post. “And they are critical to driving ecosystem structure and function.”
paras.zh: 澳大利亚迪肯大学的生态学家菲利普·巴顿（未参与这项研究）对《华盛顿邮报》表示：“在我们的地貌中，地下都存在着隐藏的过程。”他没有参与这项研究。 “它们对于推动生态系统结构和功能至关重要。”

articles.title: Archaeologists May Have Solved the Mystery of a Roman Sarcophagus Excavated at Westminster Abbey in 1869

paras.en: When Arthur Penrhyn Stanley, the dean of Westminster Abbey, returned home after an 1869 trip to Italy, he was surprised to learn that in his absence, workers at the centuries-old London church had stumbled upon a limestone sarcophagus “belonging to the same epoch and nation as the great city which I had just quitted.”
paras.zh: 1869 年，当威斯敏斯特教堂院长阿瑟·彭林·斯坦利 (Arthur Penrhyn Stanley) 结束意大利之行返回家乡时，他惊讶地发现，在他不在的情况下，这座有着数百年历史的伦敦教堂的工作人员偶然发现了一个石灰石石棺，“与我刚刚离开的这座伟大城市属于同一时代和国家”。

paras.en: The find presented a mystifying puzzle: How did a seemingly ancient coffin end up in a medieval abbey? And whose body was buried inside it?
paras.zh: 这一发现提出了一个神秘的谜题：一把看似古老的棺材如何最终出现在中世纪的修道院里？而里面埋着的又是谁的尸体呢？

paras.en: Stanley detailed his study of the sarcophagus in an 1870 journal article. Although the coffin bore a Latin inscription apparently dated to the Roman occupation of Britain, its lid featured a large cross that was more consistent with the early medieval period, hundreds of years later. As the dean wrote, “There was nothing to indicate the rank of the person, nor in fact anything but the skeleton, with the exception of a few fragments of brick, apparently Roman brick, and a piece of dark gray, slag-like substance.” Still, Stanley concluded that the skeleton itself likely wasn’t Roman, instead dating to a later era.
paras.zh: 斯坦利在 1870 年的一篇期刊文章中详细介绍了他对石棺的研究。尽管棺材上的拉丁铭文显然可以追溯到罗马占领英国的时期，但它的盖子上有一个大十字架，这与数百年后的中世纪早期更加一致。正如院长所写，“除了几块砖块（显然是罗马砖块）和一块深灰色的矿渣状物质外，没有任何东西可以表明这个人的等级，事实上除了骨架之外什么也没有。”尽管如此，斯坦利得出的结论是，这具骨架本身很可能不是罗马的，而是可以追溯到更晚的时代。

paras.en: In the century and a half since the coffin was first excavated, scholars have offered varying explanations for its presence in the abbey, where only a few other Roman artifacts have been found. Now, archaeologist and architectural historian Warwick Rodwell has seemingly solved the mystery, drawing on radiocarbon dating and a skeletal analysis conducted by colleague James Langthorne to identify the sarcophagus’ occupant.
paras.zh: 自首次挖掘棺材以来的一个半世纪里，学者们对其在修道院中的存在提出了不同的解释，而修道院只发现了一些其他罗马文物。现在，考古学家兼建筑历史学家沃里克·罗德威尔（Warwick Rodwell）似乎已经解开了这个谜团，他利用放射性碳测年法和同事詹姆斯·兰索恩（James Langthorne）进行的骨骼分析来识别石棺的主人。

paras.en: In a paper published in the Journal of the British Archaeological Association, Rodwell argues that the skeleton likely belongs to Aelfwig, a monk who served as Westminster’s abbot (equivalent to a dean) prior to his death around 1020. Another possible candidate is Aelfwig’s successor, Wulfnoth.
paras.zh: 罗德威尔在《英国考古协会杂志》上发表的一篇论文中认为，这具骨架很可能属于艾尔夫维格，他是一位僧侣，在 1020 年左右去世前曾担任威斯敏斯特修道院院长（相当于院长）。另一个可能的候选人是艾尔夫维格的继任者武尔夫诺斯。

paras.en: “We have two viable contenders for the occupant of the sarcophagus,” Rodwell says in a statement. “We do not know the date of birth of either. But either would fit equally well if we assume the abbot was in his early 20s when the appointment was made and close to 50 when he died.” (Langthorne’s assessment identified the skeleton as a roughly 5-foot-9, 35- to 49-year-old man, contradicting earlier analyses that suggested he was slightly shorter and no older than 30.)
paras.zh: 罗德威尔在一份声明中说：“对于石棺的主人，我们有两个可行的竞争者。” “我们不知道他们的出生日期。但如果我们假设任命时方丈20岁出头，去世时接近50岁，那么任何一个都同样合适。” （兰索恩的评估确定这具骨架是一名身高约 5 英尺 9 英寸、年龄在 35 至 49 岁之间的男性，这与之前的分析相矛盾，之前的分析表明他略矮，年龄不超过 30 岁。）

paras.en: Stanley and his contemporaries looked to an inscription on the coffin for insights regarding its original owner. Translated into English, the message reads, “To the memory of Valerius Amandinus. Valerius Superventor and [Valerius] Marcellus made [this] for [their] father.”
paras.zh: 斯坦利和他的同时代人通过棺材上的铭文来了解其原主人。这条信息被翻译成英文，写道：“为了纪念瓦莱里乌斯·阿曼迪努斯。瓦莱里乌斯·超级文托和[瓦莱里乌斯]马塞勒斯为[他们的]父亲制作了[这个]。”

paras.en: Based in part on this eulogy, Victorian scholars dated the sarcophagus to between the second and fifth centuries. Rodwell, for his part, agrees with a theory put forth by Martin Henig, an archaeologist at the University of Oxford. As Rodwell notes in the paper, Henig argued that the coffin “was a Christian burial, probably of the Constantinian era,” in the early fourth century. Although the inscription’s “high quality” implies that Amandinus was “a significant figure in Roman London … nothing is known about his career,” Rodwell adds.
paras.zh: 部分基于这篇悼词，维多利亚时代的学者将石棺的年代定为二至五世纪之间。罗德威尔则同意牛津大学考古学家马丁·海尼格提出的理论。正如罗德威尔在论文中指出的那样，海尼格认为这口棺材是四世纪初的“基督教墓葬，可能是君士坦丁时代的”。罗德威尔补充道，尽管铭文的“高品质”意味着阿曼迪努斯是“罗马伦敦的一位重要人物……但我们对他的职业生涯一无所知”。

paras.en: Did you know? Famous faces at Westminster Abbey
paras.zh: 你可知道？威斯敏斯特教堂的名人面孔

paras.en: Notable individuals buried at Westminster Abbey include the Tudor monarchs Elizabeth I and Mary I, English polymath Isaac Newton, naturalist Charles Darwin, and poet Robert Barrett Browning.
paras.zh: 埋葬在威斯敏斯特教堂的名人包括都铎王朝君主伊丽莎白一世和玛丽一世、英国博学者艾萨克·牛顿、博物学家查尔斯·达尔文和诗人罗伯特·巴雷特·勃朗宁。

paras.en: As for the coffin’s Roman origins, Rodwell notes that ancient sarcophagi were sometimes reused centuries after their initial interment. The English monk Bede, for instance, wrote that the body of the seventh-century saint Elethdreda was buried in a “white marble coffin, most beautifully wrought,” that was found “near the city walls” of Grantacaestir, a Roman town near Cambridge, and brought back to the monastery where she’d served as abbess.
paras.zh: 至于棺材的罗马起源，罗德威尔指出，古代石棺有时会在最初埋葬几个世纪后被重复使用。例如，英国僧侣贝德写道，七世纪圣人埃勒斯德雷达的遗体被埋葬在“制作精美的白色大理石棺材”中，该棺材是在剑桥附近的罗马小镇格兰塔卡埃斯特“城墙附近”发现的，并被带回她曾担任女修道院院长的修道院。

paras.en: Rodwell tells the Guardian’s Nicola Davis that Westminster “was not [the coffin’s] original place of burial.” Instead, he suggests that the sarcophagus was taken from the wall recess of a mausoleum located elsewhere—a theory that would account for the absence of decorations on all but one of its sides. “Almost certainly, it was housed in a recess in a wall, so that only the inscribed front and the lid were visible,” the archaeologist writes in the study.
paras.zh: 罗德威尔告诉《卫报》的尼古拉·戴维斯，威斯敏斯特“不是[棺材]最初的埋葬地。”相反，他认为石棺是从位于其他地方的一座陵墓的墙壁凹进处取出的——这一理论可以解释除了一侧之外的所有侧面都没有装饰的原因。这位考古学家在研究中写道：“几乎可以肯定，它被安置在墙壁的凹槽中，因此只能看到刻有铭文的正面和盖子。”

paras.en: Exactly what happened to Amandinus’ skeleton, as well as how his coffin was selected to hold the abbot’s body, remains unclear. But radiocarbon testing of the skeleton that ultimately replaced Amandinus’ dated it to between 987 and 1052, offering a clearer sense of when the sarcophagus was repurposed.
paras.zh: 阿曼迪努斯的骨骼究竟发生了什么，以及如何选择他的棺材来容纳方丈的尸体，目前仍不清楚。但对最终取代阿曼迪努斯骨骼的放射性碳测试表明，该骨骼的年代是在 987 年至 1052 年之间，这让人们更清楚地了解石棺何时被改变用途。

paras.en: Around this time, the Roman-era lid was recut to feature a relief carving of a long cross, which distinguished it “as an important Christian burial,” Rodwell writes. The coffin was then buried beneath the floor of Westminster Abbey, where it likely remained until the mid-13th century, when the English king Henry III rebuilt the historic church in the Gothic style. Medieval builders moved the remains to the abbey’s sacristy, an L-shaped structure used to house sacred vessels and vestments.
paras.zh: 大约在这个时候，罗马时代的盖子被重新切割，上面刻有一个长十字架的浮雕，这使它成为“一个重要的基督教墓葬”，罗德威尔写道。随后棺材被埋在威斯敏斯特教堂的地板下，很可能一直保留到13世纪中叶，当时英国国王亨利三世以哥特式风格重建了这座历史悠久的教堂。中世纪的建筑者将遗骸移至修道院的圣器收藏室，这是一个 L 形结构，用于存放神圣的器皿和法衣。

paras.en: Workers removed the sarcophagus from the ruins of the demolished sacristy’s courtyard in 1869—but they weren’t the first to uncover the medieval burial. An oft-overlooked pencil sketch indicates that workers “wantonly broke” the coffin’s lid in 1820, removing the slab in search of treasures buried alongside the deceased. “The disarray recorded when the sarcophagus was next opened in 1869 is typical of looting, but we will never know whether any metal or other intrinsically significant objects were present and pilfered,” Rodwell explains in the paper.
paras.zh: 1869 年，工人们从被拆除的圣器收藏室庭院的废墟中移出了石棺，但他们并不是第一个发现这座中世纪墓葬的人。一幅经常被忽视的铅笔草图显示，工人们在 1820 年“肆意地打破”棺材盖，移开棺材板，寻找埋在死者身边的宝藏。 “1869 年石棺再次打开时所记录的混乱是典型的抢劫行为，但我们永远不会知道是否有任何金属或其他本质上重要的物品存在并被盗，”罗德威尔在论文中解释道。

paras.en: Since the coffin’s rediscovery in the 19th century, it has been moved multiple times, most recently to the Queen’s Diamond Jubilee Galleries, which opened at the abbey in 2018. Although Rodwell writes that its occupant’s identity “cannot be answered with certainty,” he maintains that “the fact that he was honored with a fine sarcophagus, topped with a lid displaying a [5.9-foot-tall] Latin cross, should imply that he was almost certainly an abbot.” As the archaeologist tells the Guardian, “Nobody of lower rank would have been buried in anything like that. The Latin cross again points to a major ecclesiastic.”
paras.zh: 自 19 世纪重新发现棺材以来，它已被多次移动，最近一次被移至 2018 年在修道院开放的女王钻禧画廊。尽管罗德威尔写道，棺材主人的身份“无法确定”，但他坚称“事实上，他获得了一个精致的石棺，顶部的盖子上显示着[5.9英尺高]的雕像”。拉丁十字，应该意味着他几乎肯定是一位修道院院长。”正如考古学家告诉《卫报》的那样，“级别较低的人不会被埋在这样的东西里。拉丁十字再次指向一位主要的教会。”

articles.title: 12 Absolutely Banging Proper Watches Under $400
articles.author: Jeremy White

paras.en: The wonderful counter to rising prices at the very top end of the watch world is that, frankly, things have never looked better for those seeking proper mechanical watches on a budget. Entry-level timepieces keep getting better and cheaper—and this isn't just from newly established microbrands hoping to make a name for themselves, but from the major players, too.
paras.zh: 坦率地说，与手表世界最高端的价格上涨相反，对于那些在预算内寻求合适的机械手表的人来说，情况从未如此美好。入门级时计不断变得更好、更便宜——这不仅来自那些希望成名的新成立的微型品牌，也来自主要参与者。

paras.en: To check my math and make sure I wasn't going slightly crazy, I reached out to WIRED's wider circle of watch experts with a devilishly tricky, unenviable challenge: Pick their favorite mechanical watch for less than $400, the sort of price where quartz watches dominate. It was a hard ask, but they delivered. Here's the list—all are exceptional value, and watches we'd be delighted to sport on our wrists.
paras.zh: 为了检查我的数学并确保我不会有点疯狂，我联系了《连线》更广泛的手表专家圈子，提出了一个极其棘手、不令人羡慕的挑战：以低于 400 美元的价格挑选他们最喜欢的机械手表，这种价格在石英手表中占主导地位。这是一个很难的要求，但他们做到了。以下是清单——所有手表都具有非凡的价值，我们很乐意将其戴在手腕上。

paras.en: Caravelle has no right to make a mechanical dive watch this attractive and capable for a mere $300, but here it is. The secret to its timeless look is that Bulova's budget brand sensibly fashioned this modern Sea Hunter heavily on the diver's design from the late 1960s, while bumping the size up to a more modern 39 mm. Elegant and stylish, it's practically a GADA (go anywhere, do anything) watch. But with 200 meters of waterproofing, a 120-click unidirectional bezel, and a 42-hour power reserve, the Sea Hunter is a compelling sports watch. Throw on a rubber strap for diving, a nato for casual (our pick is Artem), or stick with the three-link steel bracelet for a more classic look.
paras.zh: Caravelle 没有权利以区区 300 美元的价格制造出如此具有吸引力和功能的机械潜水表，但它就是这样。其永恒外观的秘诀在于，Bulova 的廉价品牌在很大程度上借鉴了 20 世纪 60 年代末潜水员的设计，明智地打造了这款现代 Sea Hunter，同时将尺寸增加到更现代的 39 毫米。优雅时尚，它实际上是一款 GADA（去任何地方，做任何事）手表。但凭借 200 米防水、120 次点击的单向表圈和 42 小时动力储存，Sea Hunter 是一款引人注目的运动手表。潜水时戴上橡胶表带，休闲时戴上 nato（我们选择 Artem），或者坚持使用三链节钢表带以获得更经典的外观。

paras.en: Unquestionably one of the best-value automatic dress watches you can buy today, the $295 Orient Bambino’s timeless 38-mm design with white dial and leather strap has been carefully shrunken down from the original 40.5-mm casing, making this piece incredibly wearable (both in these smaller watch times and when case sizes inevitably get larger again.) You can view the automatic Japanese movement through the exhibition case back, and there's even 30 meters of water resistance—not that you should be swimming with such a watch. Want something less traditional? Go for the pink dial with a stainless steel bracelet.
paras.zh: 毫无疑问，售价 295 美元的 Orient Bambino 是您今天能买到的最超值的自动正装手表之一，它采用白色表盘和皮革表带的永恒 38 毫米设计，在原来的 40.5 毫米表壳的基础上精心缩小，使这款手表非常耐磨（无论是在手表越来越小的时代，还是在表壳尺寸不可避免地再次变大的情况下）。您可以通过展览表背看到自动日本机芯，甚至还有 30 米的防水性能，但这并不是您应该做的。带着这样的手表去游泳。想要一些不那么传统的东西吗？选择粉色表盘搭配不锈钢表链。

paras.en: This new smaller take on Brew's original Metric Retro is the choice of Mike Christensen, British GQ's lifestyle director and watch editor. Cashing in on the current trend for very small watches, Mike loves that this 30-mm piece is wearable for both men and women. “This li'l Brew number is so retro they decided to call it exactly that,” he says. At just $375, the stainless steel Metric Lite Retro, complete with a matching bracelet, uses an automatic movement visible through the open caseback. It has 50 meters of water resistance, and even sapphire crystal atop the striking dial. Proper retro charm that's forgiving on the bank balance.
paras.zh: 英国《GQ》生活方式总监兼腕表编辑迈克·克里斯滕森 (Mike Christensen) 选择了 Brew 原创 Metric Retro 的这款全新小型腕表。迈克抓住了当前超小型手表的趋势，喜欢这款 30 毫米的男士和女士佩戴手表。 “这个 li'l Brew 的号码太复古了，他们决定这么称呼它，”他说。不锈钢 Metric Lite Retro 腕表售价仅为 375 美元，配有配套表链，采用自动机芯，透过开放式表背即可看到。它具有 50 米的防水性能，引人注目的表盘上还配有蓝宝石水晶玻璃。适当的复古魅力，可以节省银行余额。

paras.en: Chris Hall, a watch expert who writes for WIRED, The New York Times, Financial Times, and others, as well as his excellent The Fourth Wheel Substack, recommends the Timex Marlin 1965 Reissue Hand-Wound at $259. “It was the model that marked Timex’s return to mechanical watches about a decade ago, and unlike so many watches at this level, it isn’t a rip-off of something else: It’s a tribute to one of Timex’s own designs,” Hall says. “It’s small, quirky, and very much its own thing. Never mind the mechanics, getting real personality and credibility at this price is what’s really impressive.” At 34 mm on a leather strap, the design feels pure, and the 30-meter water resistance is a bonus.
paras.zh: Chris Hall 是一名手表专家，为《连线》、《纽约时报》、《金融时报》等杂志撰稿，他还推荐了 Timex Marlin 1965 Reissue 手动上链腕表，售价为 259 美元。 “这款腕表标志着 Timex 大约十年前回归机械腕表，与众多同级别腕表不同的是，它并非抄袭其他产品：它是对 Timex 自身设计之一的致敬，”Hall 说道。 “它很小，很古怪，而且很有自己的特色。别介意机械装置，以这个价格获得真正的个性和可信度才是真正令人印象深刻的。” 34毫米的皮革表带，设计感十足，30米防水也是加分项。

paras.en: Looking a little further afield can often pay off in the watch world. A prime example is the Sea-Gull 1963, a hand-wound mechanical chronograph based on a vintage pilot's timepiece originally built for the Chinese Air Force back in 1961. Many call this watch the gateway drug to watch collecting, but there are a few different versions. Here we've gone for the “International Edition,” which seems to be a budget model of the 1963 Sea-Gull, as it sells alternative iterations for more on its own website. The design is faithful (including the ST1901 movement), the 38-mm size is perfect, and you can't argue with the unfathomably low $269 price.
paras.zh: 在钟表世界里，把目光放得更远一些往往会得到回报。一个典型的例子是 Sea-Gull 1963，这是一款手动上链机械计时码表，以 1961 年为中国空军打造的老式飞行员时计为基础。许多人称这款手表为手表收藏的入门毒品，但也有几个不同的版本。在这里，我们选择了“国际版”，它似乎是 1963 年海鸥的廉价型号，因为它在自己的网站上以更多价格出售替代版本。设计忠实（包括 ST1901 机芯），38 毫米尺寸完美，而且 269 美元的低得令人难以置信的价格。

paras.en: Founded in 2016 by Etienne Malec and debuting on Kickstarter in 2017, this French micro-brand was inspired by the watch collection Malec inherited from his late father, whose family hailed from northern Poland near the Baltic Sea. The brand has quickly become a darling of watch reviewers, so it's no surprise that two of WIRED's watch experts have chosen the 1940s-inspired three-hand HMS (cheating ever so slightly as the HMS clocks in at $430).
paras.zh: 这个法国微型品牌由 Etienne Malec 于 2016 年创立，并于 2017 年在 Kickstarter 上首次亮相，其灵感来自于 Malec 从已故父亲那里继承的手表系列，他的家族来自波罗的海附近的波兰北部。该品牌很快成为手表评论家的宠儿，因此 WIRED 的两位手表专家选择 1940 年代风格的三针 HMS 也就不足为奇了（HMS 的售价为 430 美元，这有点作弊）。

paras.en: Robin Swithinbank, who writes on watches for The New York Times, Financial Times, and Business of Fashion, and hosts the Luxury Society Podcast, has been won over by the 38-mm HMS 002 Silver (above right). “At any price, I like my watches simple, legible, and hardwired with the kind of style that never dies. Baltic absolutely nailed it with this,” he says. Powered by an automatic Miyota 8315 movement with a 60-hour power reserve, it also has 50 meters of water resistance.
paras.zh: Robin Swithinbank 为《纽约时报》、《金融时报》和《时尚商业》撰写有关手表的文章，并主持 Luxury Society Podcast，他被 38 毫米 HMS 002 Silver（上右图）所吸引。 “无论价格如何，我都喜欢我的手表简单、清晰、坚固，具有永不消亡的风格。Baltic 绝对做到了这一点，”他说。搭载 Miyota 8315 自动机芯，动力储存 60 小时，防水深度 50 米。

paras.en: Tim Vaux, who writes for both Hodinkee and British GQ about watches, prefers the HMS 003 Salmon (above left). It's smaller than the 002 at 36.5 mm, but still uses the Miyota 8315 movement. “In 2026, there’s no need to look at the household names anymore. The HMS 003 has one of the most classically configured dials you’ll find at any price,” Vaux says. “Walk into a room wearing this and nods of approval will come from all angles. With the Salmon dial, you can’t go wrong.”
paras.zh: Tim Vaux 为 Hodinkee 和英国《GQ》撰写有关手表的文章，他更喜欢 HMS 003 Salmon（上图左）。它比002小36.5毫米，但仍然使用Miyota 8315机芯。 “到 2026 年，不再需要关注家喻户晓的名字。HMS 003 拥有您在任何价格都能找到的最经典配置的表盘之一，”Vaux 说。 “戴着它走进房间，各个角度都会点头表示赞同。有了鲑鱼表盘，你就不会出错。”

paras.en: As Caravelle's big brother, Bulova has appeared in our bargain watch roundups before. Still, this time, Felix Scholz, editor-in-chief of Revolution Australia and cohost of OT: The Podcast, chose the A-11 Hack Watch, on sale for just $357. “Military watches hold a special place in the hearts of watch enthusiasts,” Scholz says. “And while they might not be rare or intrinsically valuable, the hacking watches produced by numerous American makers during the Second World War are among the greatest.”
paras.zh: 作为 Caravelle 的大哥，Bulova 之前曾出现在我们的廉价手表综述中。不过，这一次，Revolution Australia 的主编兼 OT: The Podcast 的联合主持人 Felix Scholz 还是选择了 A-11 Hack Watch，售价仅为 357 美元。 “军用手表在手表爱好者的心中占有特殊的地位，”肖尔茨说。 “虽然它们可能并不稀有或具有内在价值，但二战期间众多美国制造商生产的黑客手表是最伟大的。”

paras.en: Legible and functional, Scholz says such pieces are a true slice of history, and that Bulova is one of the historic manufacturers of this type. “The A-11 Hack captures the spirit, but the less martial blue dial feels contemporary, and doesn't make you look like you're LARPing as a reenactor.”
paras.zh: Scholz 表示，这些作品清晰易读且实用，是历史的真实片段，而宝路华 (Bulova) 是此类作品历史悠久的制造商之一。 “A-11 Hack 抓住了这种精神，但不那么军事化的蓝色表盘给人一种现代感，而且不会让你看起来像是一个重演者。”

paras.en: Pickings are admittedly slim for genuine automatic GADA (go anywhere, do anything) watches under $400, but take a look at the $396 Citizen Tsuyosa with its classic black dial and integrated stainless steel bracelet. It features a 40-mm case, 50 meters of water resistance, sapphire crystal, 42-hour power reserve, and a 3 o’clock date window that will see you from beach to boardroom. If black is too serious, Citizen offers several dial hues (gold and green is a nice combo).
paras.zh: 诚然，400 美元以下的正品自动 GADA（去任何地方，做任何事）手表的选择很少，但看看 396 美元的 Citizen Tsuyosa，它配备经典的黑色表盘和一体式不锈钢表链。它采用 40 毫米表壳、50 米防水深度、蓝宝石水晶玻璃、42 小时动力储存，以及 3 点钟位置的日期窗口，让您从海滩到会议室都能一目了然。如果黑色太严肃，西铁城提供了多种表盘颜色（金色和绿色是一个不错的组合）。

paras.en: WIRED's top pick, however, is the new, more wearable 37-mm range conveniently on sale right now at just under our $400 target. If you venture above $600, park Citizen and go for the Lorier Falcon or Traska Commuter 36 instead.
paras.zh: 然而，《连线》杂志的首选是新款、更耐磨的 37 毫米系列，目前正在方便地销售，价格略低于我们的目标价格 400 美元。如果您的价格超过 600 美元，请停放 Citizen，然后选择 Lorier Falcon 或 Traska Commuter 36。

paras.en: WIRED watch expert Laura McCreddie-Doak has seen our Chinese chrono option and upped the ante with this Russian dive watch. Vostok traces back to the Soviet Union's Chistopol Watch Factory, a supplier to the USSR Ministry of Defense during World War II. This Amphibia 420269 (there are many, many other models) has a 2416B automatic movement that offers a 31-hour power reserve. Bafflingly just $151 on a steel bracelet, it's rated for 200 meters of water resistance, thanks to its unique, pressure-tightening case design. “This watch needs no other justification for inclusion on this list other than it was worn by Bill Murray as Jacques Cousteau-alike Steve Zissou in Wes Anderson’s The Life Aquatic,” says McCreddie-Doak.
paras.zh: 《连线》手表专家 Laura McCreddie-Doak 看到了我们的中国计时表选项，并提高了这款俄罗斯潜水表的赌注。 Vostok的历史可以追溯到苏联的奇斯托波尔钟表厂，该厂是二战期间苏联国防部的供应商。这款Amphibia 420269（还有很多很多其他型号）配备2416B自动机芯，提供31小时动力储存。令人费解的是，精钢表链售价仅为 151 美元，由于其独特的压力密封表壳设计，其防水深度可达 200 米。麦克雷迪-多克表示：“这款手表不需要任何其他理由就能列入这份名单，除了比尔·默里 (Bill Murray) 在韦斯·安德森 (Wes Anderson) 的《水上生活》(The Life Aquatic) 中饰演雅克·库斯托 (Jacques Cousteau) 那样的史蒂夫·齐苏 (Steve Zissou) 时佩戴的这款手表。”

paras.en: Finally, we come to the almost inevitable inclusion of the Seiko 5 Sports automatic. The familiar and affordable Seiko 5 Sports line began in 1968 as a tougher, sportier evolution of the 1963 Seiko Sportsmatic 5. The lineup is still going strong with dozens of variants plus a back catalog of thousands. That explains why, for the second time on this list, two of our experts chose the 5 Sports.
paras.zh: 最后，我们几乎不可避免地要包括 Seiko 5 Sports 自动腕表。熟悉且价格实惠的 Seiko 5 Sports 系列始于 1968 年，是 1963 年 Seiko Sportsmatic 5 的更坚固、更具运动性的演变。该产品线仍然很强大，有数十种变体和数千种旧产品。这解释了为什么我们的两位专家第二次在此列表中选择了 5 项运动。

paras.en: WIRED watch writer and author Josh Sims says the Seiko 5 Sports “is the MPV of watches: dependable, rugged, adaptable, as happy in the city as out of it. For my money—and this really is a lot of watch for, relatively, not a lot of money—it also has the cool of not being Swiss.
