paras.en: Al-Jabari called the latest lockdown a “form of collective punishment” and suggested Netanyahu’s intervention was motivated by politics.
paras.zh: 贾巴里称最新的封锁是“集体惩罚的形式”，并暗示内塔尼亚胡的干预是出于政治动机。

paras.en: “With the Israeli elections only days away, Netanyahu is seeking to secure as many votes as possible by appeasing the settlers,” he said.
paras.zh: “距离以色列选举只有几天了，内塔尼亚胡正在寻求通过安抚定居者来获得尽可能多的选票，”他说。

paras.en: Netanyahu has long faced pressure from his far-right allies to embrace harder stances in the West Bank. In his comments Friday, he praised settlers as “heroic,” saying they were “an example to the people of Israel and to the state of Israel.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡长期以来一直面临来自极右翼盟友的压力，要求其在约旦河西岸采取更强硬的立场。他在周五的评论中称赞定居者是“英雄”，称他们是“以色列人民和以色列国的榜样”。

paras.en: The leader, facing a tough re-election battle, has focused much of his campaign ahead of Tuesday’s vote on security. His government has repeatedly warned of potential attacks by the country’s “enemies” in the lead-up to the election, without providing evidence.
paras.zh: 这位领导人面临着一场艰难的连任之战，在周二的安全投票之前，他的大部分竞选活动都集中在安全问题上。他的政府在选举前多次警告该国“敌人”可能发动袭击，但没有提供证据。

paras.en: In the wake of Friday’s attack, he said that he had “warned several weeks ago about our enemies’ attempts to harm us, our civilians and our soldiers ahead of the elections. That is what they tried to here.”
paras.zh: 周五袭击事件发生后，他表示，他“几周前就曾警告我们的敌人试图在选举前伤害我们、我们的平民和士兵。这就是他们在这里试图做的事。”

paras.en: U.N. spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said at a press briefing Friday that “closures severely restrict Palestinians’ freedom of movement, access to basic services and livelihoods.”
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克在周五的新闻发布会上表示，“封锁严重限制了巴勒斯坦人的行动自由、获得基本服务和生计的机会。”

paras.en: Mayy El Sheikh, a spokesperson for the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, said in a statement Friday that the lockdown was “yet another episode in a never-ending stream of suffocating measures making life more and more unbearable for Palestinians.”
paras.zh: 联合国驻巴勒斯坦被占领土人权事务高级专员办事处发言人梅伊·谢赫周五在一份声明中表示，封锁是“一系列永无休止的令人窒息的措施中的又一插曲，使巴勒斯坦人的生活变得越来越难以忍受。”

paras.en: “It follows a pattern of collective punishment whenever Palestinians commit acts of violence against Israeli settlers or soldiers,” she said.
paras.zh: “每当巴勒斯坦人对以色列定居者或士兵实施暴力行为时，都会遵循集体惩罚的模式，”她说。

paras.en: H.A. Hellyer, a senior associate fellow at the Royal United Services Institute in London, told NBC News that Netanyahu could be showing a “strong arm” ahead of the elections by locking down the West Bank, but he said the link was not clear, noting that the main candidates in the election were broadly aligned.
paras.zh: 哈。伦敦皇家联合三军研究所高级副研究员赫勒告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，内塔尼亚胡可能会通过封锁约旦河西岸来在选举前展示出“强有力的手段”，但他表示这种联系尚不清楚，并指出选举中的主要候选人大致上是一致的。

paras.en: Even if Netanyahu loses, he said, “I don’t expect there to be change on the West Bank.”
paras.zh: 他说，即使内塔尼亚胡失败，“我也不认为约旦河西岸会发生变化。”

paras.en: Israeli officials did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 以色列官员没有立即回应置评请求。

articles.title: Man dies after being crushed by ramp in northern Victoria
articles.author: Andrew Mangelsdorf

paras.en: A man has died in a workplace incident on a rural property near Shepparton in Victoria's north-east.
paras.zh: 一名男子在维多利亚州东北部谢珀顿附近一处农村地产的工作场所事故中死亡。

paras.en: Emergency services were called to Evans Road, Waggarandall, about 40 kilometres north-east of Shepparton, to reports a man was trapped under a loading ramp about 10:20am on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日上午 10 点 20 分左右，紧急服务人员接到电话称，谢珀顿东北约 40 公里处的瓦加兰德尔 (Waggarandall) 埃文斯路 (Evans Road) 发现一名男子被困在装货坡道下。

paras.en: Advanced life support paramedics attended the property, but the man died at the scene.
paras.zh: 先进的生命支持护理人员赶到了现场，但该男子当场死亡。

paras.en: The death is not being treat as suspicious and WorkSafe has been notified.
paras.zh: 死亡事件并未被视为可疑，工作安全局已收到通知。

paras.en: Police will prepare a report for the coroner.
paras.zh: 警方将为验尸官准备一份报告。

articles.title: Live: Diamonds play Constellation Cup on home soil
articles.author: Brittany Carter

paras.en: Constellation Cup live: Australia vs New Zealand game three
paras.zh: 星座杯直播：澳大利亚对阵新西兰第三场比赛

paras.en: Australia is trailing New Zealand in the Constellation Cup 2-0 and fighting to keep hold of the coveted trophy in game three in Sydney.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队在星座杯中以 2-0 落后新西兰队，并在悉尼举行的第三场比赛中为保住梦寐以求的奖杯而奋斗。

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: Oh no. You know those wonderful changes to the line-up we spoke about? With players returning to their favoured positions? That's been thrown out with the first centre pass. Moloney came off the court with a busted hand. It appears her stitches may have re-opened.
paras.zh: 哦不。你知道我们谈到的阵容的那些奇妙变化吗？球员们回到了他们喜欢的位置？第一个中路传球就被淘汰了。莫洛尼下场时手受伤了。看来她的缝线可能又重新裂开了。

paras.en: As a result, Watson shifts to centre, Horjus to wing attack and Sophie Dwyer comes off the bench to grabs the goal attack bib.
paras.zh: 结果，沃森转移到中锋，霍尔尤斯转移到边路进攻，索菲·德怀尔替补上场抢夺球门进攻号码布。

paras.en: New Zealand have the first centre pass. Although Australia got a couple of tips on the ball but it doesn't stop them converting.
paras.zh: 新西兰拥有第一张中线通行证。尽管澳大利亚得到了一些建议，但这并不能阻止他们转变。

paras.en: In my coaching experience , lopsided penalty counts can often come when a team under pressure ‘tries that bit harder’. Players lose track of the ball play because they are determined to ‘get there first’ resulting in early or late interventions meaning increased penalties. Coach’s job to keep player mindset correct.
paras.zh: 根据我的执教经验，当一支球队在压力下“更加努力”时，往往会出现不平衡的点球计数。球员会失去对球的跟踪，因为他们决心“首先到达那里”，从而导致过早或过晚的干预，这意味着增加处罚。教练的工作就是保持球员心态正确。

paras.en: This can be true Phil! But the biggest issue for the Diamonds were the offensive penalties called against their goal shooters in the final quarter. There was at least five called against Donnell Wallam, Kiera Austin and Sophie Garbin as they tried to push off the body of Kelly Jackson and get free. It lead to a lot of turnover.
paras.zh: 这可能是真的菲尔！但钻石队面临的最大问题是最后一节对射手的进攻处罚。至少有五个人对唐纳·沃勒姆、基拉·奥斯汀和索菲·加尔宾进行了处罚，因为他们试图推开凯利·杰克逊的尸体并获得自由。这导致了大量的营业额。

paras.en: With the series on the line, the Diamonds have made five changes to their starting line-up.
paras.zh: 随着系列赛的临近，钻石队对首发阵容进行了五次调整。

paras.en: SUBS: Kiera Austin, Sophie Dwyer, Sarah Klau, Cara Koenen, Donnell Wallam
paras.zh: 替补：基拉·奥斯汀、索菲·德怀尔、莎拉·克劳、卡拉·科南、唐纳尔·沃勒姆

paras.en: Captain Liz Watson has been under some pressure for her performances but she has been playing at centre to cover injuries. Today she takes back hold of the wing attack bib and her apprentice Georgie Horjus gets a start IN THE CIRCLE!
paras.zh: 队长莉兹·沃森（Liz Watson）的表现承受着一些压力，但她一直在中锋位置上以弥补伤病。今天，她夺回了侧翼攻击号码布，她的学徒乔治·霍尤斯 (Georgie Horjus) 在圈子里开始了！

paras.en: Horjus is an excellent WA / GA swing and yet she is the only shooting option the Diamonds haven't tried this series. Horjus is the smallest player in the team at 172cm. She is 20cm shorter than Silver Ferns goal keeper Kelly Jackson and 12cm shorter than goal defence Karin Burger — but it doesn't seem to trouble her in Super Netball, where she's won three titles with the Adelaide Thunderbirds. That means Kiera Austin heads to the bench.
paras.zh: 霍尤斯是一名出色的西澳/乔治亚挥杆球员，但她是钻石队在本系列赛中唯一没有尝试过的投篮选择。霍尔尤斯是队中个子最小的球员，身高172厘米。她比银蕨队守门员凯利·杰克逊 (Kelly Jackson) 矮 20 厘米，比守门员卡琳·伯格 (Karin Burger) 矮 12 厘米，但这似乎并没有对她在超级无板篮球比赛中造成困扰，她在阿德莱德雷鸟队 (Adelaide Thunderbirds) 中赢得了三个冠军。这意味着基拉·奥斯汀将坐在替补席上。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Kate Moloney returns to her best position at centre, making room for Amy Parmenter to get her first start of the series at wing defence. And lastly, new centurion Courtney Bruce — who has typically started in goal keeper for most of her prior 101 caps —starts in goal defence.
paras.zh: 与此同时，凯特·莫洛尼回到了她在中锋的最佳位置，为艾米·帕门特腾出空间，让她在边路防守中首次首发。最后，新百夫长考特尼·布鲁斯（Courtney Bruce）在之前 101 场国家队比赛中大部分时间都是作为守门员首发，而他则在守门员位置上首发。

paras.en: SUBS: Parris Mason, Kimiora Poi, Ta Paea Selby-Rickit, Carys Stythe, Amelia Walmsley
paras.zh: 替补：帕里斯·梅森、基米奥拉·波伊、塔·佩亚·塞尔比-里基特、卡里斯·斯蒂斯、阿米莉亚·沃尔姆斯利

paras.en: Maddy Gordon is into wing attack, Kate Heffernan is into centre and Mila Reuelu-Buchanan gets her first start of the series at wing defence. She was excellent there throughout the Commonwealth Games.
paras.zh: 麦迪·戈登（Maddy Gordon）负责侧翼进攻，凯特·赫夫南（Kate Heffernan）担任中锋，米拉·鲁埃卢·布坎南（Mila Reuelu-Buchanan）在侧翼防守中首次首发。她在整个英联邦运动会上表现出色。

paras.en: Speaking on Friday in Sydney, Marinkovich told ABC Sport reporter Amanda Shalala that the biggest lesson the team has taken from the opening matches is to get the start of the match right.
paras.zh: 周五在悉尼发表讲话时，马林科维奇告诉美国广播公司体育记者阿曼达·沙拉拉，球队从揭幕战中得到的最大教训就是要正确开局。

paras.en: "For us, we've really got to be able to take the first five minutes of the quarters," she said.
paras.zh: “对我们来说，我们真的必须能够拿下本节的前五分钟，”她说。

paras.en: "I think they've got little jumps on us in those moments. We've got to really solidify ball that we do get and make sure that we do put it on the scoreboard to pass some of that pressure back to New Zealand."
paras.zh: “我认为他们在那些时刻对我们的影响很小。我们必须真正巩固我们确实得到的球，并确保我们确实将其放在记分牌上，以将一些压力传递回新西兰。”

paras.en: Australia has been heavily penalised throughout the series and Stacey Marinkovich said her team would be looking for clarification from the umpires as to why that is.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队在整个系列赛中受到了严重处罚，史黛西·马林科维奇表示，她的球队将寻求裁判的澄清，以解释原因。

paras.en: New Zealand has conceded 100 penalties so far, while the Diamonds have conceded 145. That's a lot of time standing beside your player, unable to contribute to play.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，新西兰队已经丢了 100 个点球，而钻石队则丢了 145 个点球。你需要花很多时间站在球员身边，无法为比赛做出贡献。

paras.en: The same two umpires will officiate all four games of the series: Gary Burgess (English) and Alison Harrison (Welsh).
paras.zh: 同样的两名裁判将执法该系列赛的所有四场比赛：加里·伯吉斯（英格兰）和艾莉森·哈里森（威尔士）。

paras.en: But Marinkovich told the media that she felt the Diamonds were umpired differently on home soil. Whether the coach agrees or not, they definitely need to be more disciplined today.
paras.zh: 但马林科维奇告诉媒体，她觉得钻石队在本土受到的裁判有所不同。不管教练同意与否，他们今天肯定需要更加遵守纪律。

paras.en: "In history, for the last four years, we've been penalised in New Zealand and it kind of shifts when we're in Australia … But I don't think our game plan changes too differently."
paras.zh: “历史上，过去四年，我们在新西兰受到了惩罚，而当我们在澳大利亚时，情况就会发生变化……但我认为我们的比赛计划不会有太大不同。”

paras.en: Australia has two players out with Jamie-Lee Price nursing a calf injury and Matilda Garrett scratched from the game with concussion so this 12 is literally the only 12 players left in their Constellation Cup squad.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚有两名球员缺席，杰米-李·普莱斯 (Jamie-Lee Price) 小腿受伤，玛蒂尔达·加勒特 (Matilda Garrett) 因脑震荡缺席比赛，因此这 12 名球员实际上是星座杯阵容中仅剩的 12 名球员。

paras.en: One of the Diamonds' strengths is the squad's depth, so that's taken a hit. As has its confidence. It'll be interesting to see how they fare without this pair.
paras.zh: 钻石队的优势之一是球队的深度，所以这受到了打击。正如它的信心一样。如果没有这对，看看他们的表现会很有趣。

paras.en: Thankfully there is some good news and that is that Kate Moloney is back fighting fight after suffering a nasty finger laceration at training. She missed the first outing but was stitched up and appeared on Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 值得庆幸的是，有一些好消息，那就是凯特·莫洛尼在训练中手指严重割伤后，已经回归战斗。她错过了第一次外出，但被缝合后于周三晚上出现。

paras.en: "The finger is fine. I had a few more stitches put in after the game, but the finger is good to go," Moloney told the ABC.
paras.zh: “手指没事。赛后我又缝了几针，但手指已经可以走了，”莫洛尼告诉美国广播公司。

paras.en: Head coach Noeline Taurua has made a single change to her team for game three and it's caught us by surprise.
paras.zh: 主教练诺埃琳·陶鲁亚（Noeline Taurua）在第三场比赛中对她的球队做出了一个改变，这让我们感到惊讶。

paras.en: In Auckland, Kimiora Poi started the match in WA and put on a solid performance.
paras.zh: 在奥克兰，Kimiora Poi在西澳首发出场并表现出色。

paras.en: She was replaced in the team by Peta Toeava for the Christchurch game, who went from outside the side into the starting line-up, taking hold of that WA bib.
paras.zh: 在基督城的比赛中，佩塔·托阿瓦 (Peta Toeava) 取代了她的位置，后者从边路进入首发阵容，并拿到了西澳的号码布。

paras.en: She was phenomenal and really hard to shut down. Now there's been a direct swap again. Poi in for Toeava.
paras.zh: 她非常出色，很难让人停下来。现在又出现了直接交换。 Poi 替补 Toeava。

paras.en: Keeping us on our toes! Both offer such different styles of wing attack. Maybe this is their trial for the sport for next year's World Cup?
paras.zh: 让我们保持警惕！两者都提供不同风格的侧翼攻击。也许这是他们为明年世界杯进行的试训？

paras.en: If you missed Wednesday night's game in Christchurch where the Diamonds suffered a heavy defeat to the Silver Ferns 62-50 you can find our blog from game two here.
paras.zh: 如果您错过了周三晚上在基督城举行的比赛，那场钻石队以 62-50 惨败给银蕨队，您可以在这里找到我们第二场比赛的博客。

paras.en: Hello! Thanks for joining our live blog for the Constellation Cup. Brittany Carter at the Sydney SuperDome ready for game three. It's so nice to be in-person for this one. I cannot think of a better way to end the week than some international netball.
paras.zh: 你好！感谢您加入我们的星座杯直播博客。布列塔尼·卡特在悉尼超级圆顶体育场准备第三场比赛。能够亲临现场真是太好了。我想不出比国际无板篮球更好的方式来结束这一周了。

paras.en: A reminder, we've already had two games played in this series for the New Zealand leg, with the Diamonds trailing 2-0 as they try to get back on track on home soil. If the Aussies win today, the series will still be alive ahead of the final match in Melbourne. However, if they lose this match the Constellation Cup will be the Silver Ferns for just the fourth time in history. There is also thought that three games might be enough for New Zealand to dethrone the Aussies from the world number one ranking spot, but the way the rankings are worked out is confusing... We do know for sure that a 4-0 cleansweep would see a change at the top.
paras.zh: 提醒一下，新西兰站系列赛我们已经打了两场比赛，钻石队试图在主场重回正轨，但以 2-0 落后。如果澳大利亚队今天获胜，那么该系列赛在墨尔本的决赛之前仍然存在。然而，如果他们输掉这场比赛，星座杯将在历史上第四次成为银蕨队。还有人认为，三场比赛可能足以让新西兰队将澳大利亚队从世界排名第一的位置上夺走，但排名的计算方式令人困惑……我们确实知道，4-0 横扫将导致排名发生变化。

paras.en: Game 1: Sunday 18 October, 5:40pm AEDT — Auckland
paras.zh: 第 1 场比赛：10 月 18 日星期日下午 5:40（澳大利亚东部时间）——奥克兰

paras.en: Game 2: Wednesday 21 October, 5:40pm AEDT — Christchurch
paras.zh: 第 2 场比赛：10 月 21 日星期三，澳大利亚东部时间下午 5:40 — 基督城

paras.en: Game 3: Sunday 25 October, 4:00pm AEDT — Sydney
paras.zh: 第 3 场比赛：10 月 25 日星期日下午 4:00（澳大利亚东部夏令时间）— 悉尼

paras.en: Game 4: Wednesday 28 October, 7:30pm AEDT — Melbourne
paras.zh: 第 4 场比赛：10 月 28 日星期三，澳大利亚东部时间晚上 7:30 — 墨尔本

articles.title: Measles-stricken Amish hit hard amid US vaccine misinformation fight
articles.author: Luke Cooper

paras.en: The US state of Pennsylvania is grappling with its worst measles outbreak in three decades, with more than 1,300 cases reported since April.
paras.zh: 美国宾夕法尼亚州正在应对三十年来最严重的麻疹疫情，自 4 月份以来已报告了 1,300 多例病例。

paras.en: Amish communities have been directly impacted due to low vaccination rates, leading to the deaths of six people.
paras.zh: 阿米什社区因疫苗接种率低而受到直接影响，导致六人死亡。

paras.en: The outbreak is the largest of multiple outbreaks across the US, happening amid an uproar over Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr's controversial vaccine stance.
paras.zh: 这次疫情是美国多起疫情中规模最大的一次，发生在卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪(Robert F Kennedy Jr)颇具争议的疫苗立场引发轩然大波之际。

paras.en: In a rural corner of the US state of Pennsylvania, crop fields, maple trees and colonial-era barn farmhouses dot a patchwork landscape of rolling grassy hills.
paras.zh: 在美国宾夕法尼亚州的一个乡村角落，农田、枫树和殖民时代的谷仓农舍点缀在连绵起伏的青草山丘上。

paras.en: At the foot of the Appalachian Mountains, Lancaster County is less than 300 kilometres from New York City and home to the country's oldest and largest Amish community.
paras.zh: 兰开斯特县位于阿巴拉契亚山脉脚下，距离纽约市不到 300 公里，是美国最古老、最大的阿米什社区的所在地。

paras.en: But it has also become the focus of a heated political row amid a scramble to contain one of the US's worst measles outbreaks in recent history.
paras.zh: 但在遏制美国近代历史上最严重的麻疹疫情之一的斗争中，它也成为激烈政治争论的焦点。

paras.en: Measles is a highly contagious illness that can lead to the hospitalisation or death of a person, with up to nine out of 10 people who are not vaccinated likely to fall sick, the Australian Centre for Disease Control says.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚疾病控制中心表示，麻疹是一种高度传染性的疾病，可能导致一个人住院或死亡，未接种疫苗的人中多达十分之九可能会生病。

paras.en: Authorities in Pennsylvania say the outbreak there began in late April, west of one of the state's largest cities, Philadelphia.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州当局表示，该州最大城市之一费城以西的疫情于四月下旬开始爆发。

paras.en: Cases have since ballooned above 1,300 in what has become Pennsylvania's largest spread of the disease in more than three decades.
paras.zh: 此后，病例数激增至 1,300 多例，成为宾夕法尼亚州三十多年来最大规模的疾病传播。

paras.en: At least six people have died, including two infants — one of which was a newborn — and a 20-year-old from Lancaster County, an 18-year-old resident of Mifflin County, a 40-year-old woman from Jefferson County and a 39-year-old female from Franklin County.
paras.zh: 至少有六人死亡，其中包括两名婴儿（其中一名是新生儿）、一名来自兰开斯特县的 20 岁男子、一名来自米夫林县的 18 岁居民、一名来自杰斐逊县的 40 岁女性和一名来自富兰克林县的 39 岁女性。

paras.en: The Pennsylvania Health Department said none of the victims was vaccinated, and Franklin County officials reported the 39-year-old had a previous measles diagnosis and "several underlying conditions".
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州卫生部门表示，没有一名受害者接种了疫苗，富兰克林县官员报告称，这名 39 岁的患者之前曾被诊断出患有麻疹，并且患有“几种潜在疾病”。

paras.en: Authorities say the disease has mostly impacted people aged between 18 and 49, who account for about 800 of the state's cases, and at least 251 people — or about one in every five — have been hospitalised.
paras.zh: 当局表示，这种疾病主要影响 18 岁至 49 岁之间的人群，该人群约占该州病例的 800 例，至少有 251 人（约五分之一）住院治疗。

paras.en: Low vaccination rates, mostly in vulnerable Amish communities, remain the biggest challenge according to officials.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，疫苗接种率低（主要是在脆弱的阿米什社区）仍然是最大的挑战。

paras.en: At least five who died were from Amish communities, local media reported.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，至少有五人死亡来自阿米什社区。

paras.en: The Amish are insular, religious people who associate piety with surrendering to strict rules for the greater good of their community, and reject modern-day technologies.
paras.zh: 阿米什人是与世隔绝的宗教民族，他们将虔诚与为了社区的更大利益而服从严格的规则联系在一起，并且拒绝现代技术。

paras.en: They came to the US from Europe in the 1700s, and more than 410,000 still live across the country, including at least 40,000 in Lancaster County.
paras.zh: 他们于 1700 年代从欧洲来到美国，目前仍有超过 410,000 人居住在全国各地，其中至少有 40,000 人居住在兰开斯特县。

paras.en: Braxton Mitchell, co-director of the University of Maryland's Amish research program, says their communal way of life creates a unique risk of rapid virus spread.
paras.zh: 马里兰大学阿米什研究项目联合主任布拉克斯顿·米切尔表示，他们的集体生活方式造成了病毒快速传播的独特风险。

paras.en: "Amish are very social. The Amish families have a lot of kids — the average [has] seven or eight, so a lot of people in the household," he said.
paras.zh: “阿米什人非常善于交际。阿米什人的家庭有很多孩子——平均有七八个，所以家里有很多人，”他说。

paras.en: "The Amish get together with their neighbours, with their relatives; they have church services on Sundays which tend to be at somebody's house and the whole church district shows up."
paras.zh: “阿米什人与他们的邻居和亲戚聚会；他们在周日举行教堂礼拜，通常是在某人的家里，整个教堂区都会出现。”

paras.en: He said they were sceptical of government intervention and do not see the need to engage with modern medicine.
paras.zh: 他说，他们对政府干预持怀疑态度，并且认为没有必要接触现代医学。

paras.en: "With some diseases, the Amish [believe] 'if we get sick, if God's will is that we're meant to survive, we'll survive'."
paras.zh: “对于某些疾病，阿米什人[相信]‘如果我们生病了，如果上帝的旨意是我们要活下去，我们就会活下来’。”

paras.en: Steve Nolt, a professor at Elizabethtown College, has lived in Lancaster County for most of his life and said he loves the area's reputation for diversity, manufacturing, picturesque nature and pleasantness of local life.
paras.zh: 伊丽莎白敦学院 (Elizabethtown College) 教授史蒂夫·诺尔特 (Steve Nolt) 在兰开斯特县生活了大半生，他表示，他喜欢该地区多样性、制造业、风景如画的自然风光和宜人的当地生活的声誉。

paras.en: "There's a strong sense of Lancaster heritage and Lancaster identity … [The county] is special, especially in the minds of people with deep roots here," he said.
paras.zh: “兰卡斯特遗产和兰卡斯特身份有强烈的感觉……[这个县]很特别，尤其是在根深蒂固的人们的心中，”他说。

paras.en: But he said while the majority of the non-Amish population live with them harmoniously, there is still concern about the spread of measles.
paras.zh: 但他表示，虽然大多数非阿米什人与他们和谐相处，但仍然担心麻疹的传播。

paras.en: That worry has extended to non-Amish residents warily monitoring transmission alerts naming schools, stores or other popular locations where the virus has spread outside of Amish areas, Mr Nolt said.
paras.zh: 诺尔特表示，这种担忧已经延伸到非阿米什居民，他们警惕地监控传播警报，并列出病毒在阿米什地区以外传播的学校、商店或其他热门地点。

paras.en: In the neighbouring Chester County, 93 cases have been reported this year, but there is concern around unreported infections.
paras.zh: 在邻近的切斯特县，今年已报告了 93 例病例，但人们对未报告的感染病例感到担忧。

paras.en: Jeanne Franklin, the county's public health director, said officials were aware of people who fell ill and did not feel the need to access medical care or alert authorities.
paras.zh: 该县公共卫生主任珍妮·富兰克林(Jeanne Franklin)表示，官员们知道有人生病，但并不认为需要获得医疗护理或向当局发出警报。

paras.en: She said by the time some patients present to hospitals or other medical clinics, they were significantly ill.
paras.zh: 她说，当一些患者到医院或其他医疗诊所就诊时，他们已经病情严重。

paras.en: "What we're seeing is the worst of the worst," she told the ABC.
paras.zh: “我们所看到的是最糟糕的情况，”她告诉美国广播公司。

paras.en: "It is definitely bigger than we are able to report because it is moving very quickly … Statistically speaking, we're likely going to see more deaths."
paras.zh: “它肯定比我们能够报告的还要大，因为它的发展速度非常快……从统计数据来看，我们可能会看到更多的死亡。”

paras.en: Ms Franklin described the Amish as "vaccine hesitant", but does not treat them as unique from the non-Amish who choose not to be vaccinated according to political or religious beliefs.
paras.zh: 富兰克林女士将阿米什人描述为“对疫苗犹豫不决”，但并不认为他们与非阿米什人不同，非阿米什人因政治或宗教信仰而选择不接种疫苗。

paras.en: "What we want to remind people is, regardless of whether you're Amish or an anti-vaxxer … reassess the decision in the light of today," she said.
paras.zh: “我们想提醒人们的是，无论你是阿米什人还是反疫苗者……请根据今天的情况重新评估这一决定，”她说。

paras.en: "Thirty years ago you may have said: 'Why do I need that? Measles isn't an issue.' Well, guess what, it's an issue."
paras.zh: “三十年前你可能会说：‘为什么我需要这个？麻疹不是问题。’好吧，你猜怎么着，这是一个问题。”

paras.en: She said Chester County adopted a word-of-mouth approach to promoting vaccination and dispelling common myths about measles.
paras.zh: 她说，切斯特县采取了口口相传的方式来促进疫苗接种并消除有关麻疹的常见误解。

paras.en: "We have a whole team … painting the picture [of the disease's spread]. Where is it? Is it in our adults? Is it in our youth?" she said.
paras.zh: “我们有一整个团队……描绘了[疾病传播]的情况。它在哪里？它在我们的成年人身上吗？它在我们的年轻人身上吗？”她说。

paras.en: "We're a health department; we can't be everywhere, but we know the church on Main Street, the food pantry on South Street, and the hardware store are trusted business owners and community members.
paras.zh: “我们是一个卫生部门；我们不可能无处不在，但我们知道主街的教堂、南街的食品储藏室和五金店都是值得信赖的企业主和社区成员。

paras.en: "We are going out to meet them, educate them, so if they get questions, they know how to direct to us … Some of them are like, 'give me 100 [flyers], I'm going to put it in everyone's grocery bag.'"
paras.zh: “我们要出去见见他们，教育他们，所以如果他们有问题，他们知道如何直接联系我们……他们中的一些人会说，‘给我 100 张[传单]，我会把它放在每个人的购物袋里。’”

paras.en: White House clash clouds vaccine efforts
paras.zh: 白宫冲突给疫苗工作蒙上阴影

paras.en: With more than 4,500 reported cases, the US is enduring its worst year for measles since 1991, the Centers for Disease Control (CDC) said.
paras.zh: 美国疾病控制中心 (CDC) 表示，美国已报告了 4,500 多例麻疹病例，这是自 1991 年以来麻疹疫情最严重的一年。

paras.en: Rural Pennsylvania is not the only area under strain — large outbreaks have been reported in Texas, Utah, South Carolina, Wisconsin and Florida.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州的农村地区并不是唯一面临压力的地区——德克萨斯州、犹他州、南卡罗来纳州、威斯康星州和佛罗里达州都报告了大规模疫情爆发。

paras.en: In New York, Governor Kathy Hochul this month declared a disaster emergency because of rising cases in neighbouring states.
paras.zh: 在纽约，由于邻近州的病例不断增加，州长凯西·霍赫尔本月宣布进入灾难紧急状态。

paras.en: The US eliminated the domestic spread of measles in 2000 by maintaining high vaccination rates.
paras.zh: 2000年，美国通过维持高疫苗接种率消除了麻疹在国内的传播。

paras.en: But the CDC said rates have fallen recently to below the 95 per cent coverage needed to prevent outbreaks.
paras.zh: 但疾病预防控制中心表示，最近比率已降至预防疫情爆发所需的 95% 覆盖率以下。

paras.en: Following Pennsylvania's first two deaths, a political clash erupted between the state's vaccine-promoting Democratic Governor Josh Shapiro and the Trump Administration's Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr — known for raising alarms about vaccines.
paras.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州出现前两例死亡病例后，该州提倡疫苗接种的民主党州长乔什·夏皮罗（Josh Shapiro）和特朗普政府的卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪（Robert F Kennedy Jr）之间爆发了政治冲突，后者因对疫苗发出警报而闻名。

paras.en: Mr Kennedy suggested Mr Shapiro's office may have "altogether fabricated" the deaths and accused the governor of "fearmongering, misinformation, finger-pointing, and the weaponisation of infectious disease fears for political gain."
paras.zh: 肯尼迪表示，夏皮罗的办公室可能“完全捏造”了这些死亡事件，并指责州长“散布恐惧、错误信息、相互指责以及将传染病恐惧武器化以获取政治利益”。

paras.en: For weeks, the CDC did not record the measles-related deaths on its public disease-tracking dashboard, saying it was seeking more information to prove their validity.
paras.zh: 几周来，疾病预防控制中心没有在其公共疾病跟踪仪表板上记录与麻疹相关的死亡人数，称其正在寻求更多信息来证明其有效性。

paras.en: Mr Shapiro condemned Mr Kennedy for those comments, and other claims he made that the US's MMR vaccine — which protects people against measles, mumps and rubella — included traces of fetal tissue.
paras.zh: 夏皮罗先生谴责肯尼迪先生的这些言论，以及他提出的其他说法，即美国的 MMR 疫苗（保护人们免受麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹的侵害）含有胎儿组织的痕迹。

paras.en: "Unfortunately at a time where I needed the top 'health expert' in the nation to responsibly work with us to deal with this outbreak, he instead chose to go down a rabbit hole of conspiracy theories and false claims," Mr Shapiro said in a post on X.
paras.zh: 夏皮罗在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示：“不幸的是，当我需要国家顶级‘健康专家’负责任地与我们合作应对此次疫情时，他却选择了陷入阴谋论和虚假声明的陷阱。”

paras.en: "The correlation is clear: Secretary Kennedy has stoked confusion amongst parents and others — and the result has been less protection from measles and more cases."
paras.zh: “相关性很明显：肯尼迪部长在家长和其他人中引起了混乱，其结果是麻疹的保护减少，病例增加。”

paras.en: The Pennsylvania Health Department said at least 6,500 MMR vaccines have been administered at 226 pop-up clinics in affected communities since April.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州卫生部门表示，自 4 月份以来，受影响社区的 226 个临时诊所已接种了至少 6,500 剂 MMR 疫苗。

paras.en: Paul Griffin, the director of infectious diseases at Mater Health Services, said that while the vaccine was "incredibly effective", Mr Kennedy's comments undermine public health efforts.
paras.zh: 马特健康服务中心传染病主任保罗·格里芬表示，虽然疫苗“非常有效”，但肯尼迪先生的言论破坏了公共卫生努力。

paras.en: "We need the advice to come from people that have a very good understanding of what [measles] is and what we need to do to address it," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们需要那些非常了解麻疹是什么以及我们需要采取哪些措施来解决它的人提供建议。”

paras.en: Ms Franklin said she had seen no evidence of Mr Kennedy's comments impacting how frontline CDC health staff, who were aware of the urgency of addressing the outbreak, operate.
paras.zh: 富兰克林女士表示，她没有看到任何证据表明肯尼迪先生的言论影响了疾控中心一线卫生人员的运作方式，因为他们知道应对疫情的紧迫性。

paras.en: "They are still core passionate public health professionals … They're not misleading; they're being told what they can and cannot publish [and] how they define things," she said.
paras.zh: “他们仍然是核心热情的公共卫生专业人员……他们没有误导；他们被告知可以发布什么、不能发布什么，以及如何定义事物，”她说。

paras.en: She says the outbreak is now a race against time.
paras.zh: 她说，现在的疫情爆发是一场与时间的赛跑。

paras.en: "It's either how many people can get vaccinated and protected, or how many people are going to get the disease," she said.
paras.zh: “问题要么是有多少人可以接种疫苗并受到保护，要么是有多少人会感染这种疾病，”她说。

paras.en: "Pennsylvania is too far into this, by the numbers only, to outrace it. Now it's, how do we stay the course with as many people as we can in the hopes of minimising the impact and deaths?"
paras.zh: “仅从数字来看，宾夕法尼亚州在这方面已经走得太远了，无法超越它。现在的问题是，我们如何与尽可能多的人一起坚持到底，以尽量减少影响和死亡？”

articles.title: Black Sea sailors thought a rescue boat was racing toward them. Instead, it was a drone that sank their ship
articles.author: Briar Stewart

paras.en: Black Sea sailors thought a rescue boat was racing toward them. Instead, it was a drone that sank their ship
paras.zh: 黑海水手们以为一艘救援船正在向他们驶来。相反，是一架无人机击沉了他们的船

paras.en: Nearly 50 commercial vessels were struck in the Black Sea in October alone, according to maritime analysts
paras.zh: 海事分析人士称，仅 10 月份就有近 50 艘商船在黑海遭到袭击

paras.en: In the early hours of Oct. 13, the crew from the HS Dignity gathered on the deck of the cargo ship and put on life jackets as the vessel rocked in the churning waves of the Black Sea. The captain had given the order to abandon the vessel because it was sinking after a sea drone struck its hull.
paras.zh: 10月13日凌晨，当货船在黑海翻腾的海浪中摇晃时，HS Dignity号的船员们聚集在货船的甲板上，穿上救生衣。船长已下令弃船，因为一艘海上无人机击中船体后，该船正在下沉。

paras.en: As the 16-man crew, made up of Syrian and Egyptian nationals, peered into the darkness, they spotted the outline of a boat moving quickly toward them. They shone their flashlights, thinking rescuers might have already responded to their distress call.
paras.zh: 当由叙利亚和埃及国民组成的 16 名船员向黑暗中凝视时，他们发现一艘船的轮廓正在快速向他们驶来。他们用手电筒照射，认为救援人员可能已经对他们的求救信号做出了反应。

paras.en: “We realized that this boat was also part of the group that was attacking us. Of course, we all ran,” said Ashraf Mamdouh, the vessel's 42-year-old chief officer.
paras.zh: “我们意识到这艘船也是攻击我们的团体的一部分。当然，我们都跑了，”该船 42 岁的大副阿什拉夫·马姆杜 (Ashraf Mamdouh) 说。

paras.en: The sea drone rammed directly into the ship.
paras.zh: 海上无人机直接撞上了船。

paras.en: “The vessel began sinking rapidly into the water. The whole crew was falling to the deck; nobody could stand properly because of the impact and the chaos,” he said.
paras.zh: “船开始迅速下沉到水中。全体船员都倒在甲板上；由于撞击和混乱，没有人能够正确站立，”他说。

paras.en: “We didn't have time to finish launching the lifeboats.”
paras.zh: “我们没有时间完成救生艇的下水。”

paras.en: The Dignity is one of nearly 50 commercial vessels that maritime analysts say have been attacked in the Black Sea this month as the conflict between Russia and Ukraine escalates at sea.
paras.zh: 海事分析人士称，随着俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的海上冲突升级，本月有近 50 艘商船在黑海遭到袭击，尊严号是其中之一。

paras.en: The strikes have brought much of the traffic through the key shipping corridor to a halt and prompted NATO to step up maritime security, including by deploying more patrol boats and radar.
paras.zh: 袭击导致主要航运走廊的大部分交通中断，并促使北约加强海上安全，包括部署更多巡逻艇和雷达。

paras.en: At least 31 seafarers have been killed or are missing in the attacks.
paras.zh: 至少 31 名海员在袭击中丧生或失踪。

paras.en: Many of the vessels that were recently attacked were travelling through the western Black Sea, including some that were struck off the coasts of NATO members Bulgaria and Romania.
paras.zh: 最近遭到袭击的许多船只正在穿越黑海西部，其中一些是在北约成员国保加利亚和罗马尼亚海岸被击中的。

paras.en: On Friday, a search-and-rescue operation was underway after a ship flagged to Comoros, a small archipelago off the coast of East Africa, was struck by drones just outside Romania's territorial waters.
paras.zh: 周五，一艘驶往东非海岸小群岛科摩罗的船只在罗马尼亚领海外遭到无人机袭击，搜救行动正在进行中。

paras.en: The crew of 13 included Ukrainian and Azerbaijani sailors. One body has been recovered, while officials say three people remain missing.
paras.zh: 13名船员包括乌克兰和阿塞拜疆水手。目前已找到一具尸体，但官员称仍有三人失踪。

paras.en: Romanian President Nicușor Dan blamed Russia for the attacks.
paras.zh: 罗马尼亚总统尼库索尔·丹将袭击归咎于俄罗斯。

paras.en: Data shared with CBC News by maritime risk management firm Ambrey suggest there have been more than 500 attacks on commercial vessels this year in the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov, which are connected by the narrow Kerch Strait.
paras.zh: 海事风险管理公司 Ambrey 与 CBC News 分享的数据显示，今年在由狭窄的刻赤海峡连接的黑海和亚速海发生了 500 多起商船袭击事件。

paras.en: Of the 45 attacks recorded in October, Ambrey believes Russia was responsible for 40.
paras.zh: 安布雷认为，在 10 月份记录的 45 起袭击事件中，有 40 起是俄罗斯所为。

paras.en: Russia's Ministry of Defence has acknowledged striking dozens of ships this month alone in social media posts, almost always claiming the vessels were supporting Ukraine's military.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部承认仅本月就在社交媒体帖子中袭击了数十艘船只，几乎总是声称这些船只是在支持乌克兰军队。

paras.en: But Mamdouh, who spoke to CBC News from a hotel in Varna, Bulgaria, said the Dignity had sailed from Algeria and was headed for Romania, where it was scheduled to pick up grain.
paras.zh: 但在保加利亚瓦尔纳一家酒店接受加拿大广播公司新闻采访的马姆杜表示，“尊严”号从阿尔及利亚出发，前往罗马尼亚，计划在那里装载谷物。

paras.en: Ashraf Mamdouh, the chief officer aboard the HS Dignity, arrives in Varna, Bulgaria, on Oct. 13 after his ship sank when it was hit by two sea drones. (Nikolay Doychinov/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 10 月 13 日，HS Dignity 号大副阿什拉夫·马姆杜 (Ashraf Mamdouh) 抵达保加利亚瓦尔纳，此前他的船被两架海上无人机击中而沉没。 （尼古拉·多伊奇诺夫/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: The Dignity had already been at sea for more than a month when the drones struck at about 1:30 a.m.
paras.zh: 当无人机于凌晨 1 点 30 分左右袭击时，尊严号已经在海上航行了一个多月。

paras.en: Mamdouh and other experienced crew members urged everyone aboard to get as far away from the ship as possible to avoid being pulled under as the 123-metre vessel sank beneath the churning waves.
paras.zh: Mamdouh 和其他经验丰富的船员敦促船上的每个人尽可能远离这艘船，以免在这艘 123 米长的船沉没在翻腾的海浪下时被拉下。

paras.en: “We tried to gather together to reduce everyone's fear and panic. We wanted to remain in one group so that, if a rescue team arrived, it would be easier for them to rescue as many people as possible,” Mamdouh said.
paras.zh: “我们试图聚集在一起，以减少每个人的恐惧和恐慌。我们希望留在一个小组中，这样，如果救援队到达，他们会更容易救援尽可能多的人，”马姆杜说。

paras.en: This undated image of the HS Dignity shows the ship before it sank in the Black Sea on Oct. 13. (Submitted by Ashraf Mamdouh)
paras.zh: 这张未注明日期的 HS Dignity 图像显示了该船于 10 月 13 日在黑海沉没之前的情况。（由 Ashraf Mamdouh 提交）

paras.en: He began calling out to other crew members, but the strong winds drowned out their voices.
paras.zh: 他开始向其他船员呼喊，但强风淹没了他们的声音。

paras.en: “I started asking everyone, ‘Why are you moving away from each other?’ I hadn't realized that I was drifting away, too. The sea currents were separating us.”
paras.zh: “我开始问每个人，‘为什么你们要彼此疏远？’我没有意识到我也在逐渐疏远。海流将我们分开。”

paras.en: At one point, a life raft suddenly appeared beside him. He climbed aboard and lay there for four hours, until another commercial vessel appeared nearby.
paras.zh: 就在这时，一艘救生筏突然出现在他的身边。他爬上船并在那里躺了四个小时，直到另一艘商船出现在附近。

paras.en: Still clutching his cellphone, he switched on its flashlight to attract the attention of the crew aboard the Azov Concord.
paras.zh: 他仍然抓着手机，打开手电筒以吸引亚速协和号上船员的注意。

paras.en: Cargo ships are seen in the Black Sea from Port Varna, in Varna, eastern Bulgaria on October 13. (Nikolay Doychinov/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 10 月 13 日，从保加利亚东部瓦尔纳的瓦尔纳港出发的黑海中的货船。（Nikolay Doychinov/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Mamdouh was pulled from the water and is one of five crew members who survived. Eleven remain officially listed as missing, including 18-year-old Hamza Suleiman, a Syrian who was on his first voyage aboard a ship.
paras.zh: 马姆杜被从水中救起，是幸存的五名船员之一。官方仍将 11 人列为失踪人员，其中包括 18 岁的叙利亚人哈姆扎·苏莱曼 (Hamza Suleiman)，他是第一次乘船出海。

paras.en: “The last phone call between Hamza and me was on the night of Oct. 12,” said his father, Basel, who spoke to CBC News via Zoom from Tartus, Syria.
paras.zh: “哈姆扎和我最后一次通电话是在 10 月 12 日晚上，”他的父亲巴塞尔 (Basel) 在叙利亚塔尔图斯通过 Zoom 接受 CBC 新闻采访时说道。

paras.en: “Hamza contacted us and said hi to his mother and reassured us. He said, ‘Dad, we're in Bulgaria now.’”
paras.zh: “哈姆扎联系了我们，向他的母亲问好，并向我们保证。他说，‘爸爸，我们现在在保加利亚。’”

paras.en: Basel said his son had taken the job aboard the Syrian-owned ship because he expected to work in the engine room, where he hoped to learn more about engineering.
paras.zh: 巴塞尔表示，他的儿子在叙利亚拥有的船上接受了这份工作，因为他希望在机舱工作，希望在那里学习更多有关工程学的知识。

paras.en: Hamza Suleiman, 18, boarded the HS Dignity in August for his first job as a seafarer. He has been missing since the vessel sank on Oct. 13 off the coast of Bulgaria. (Submitted by Basel Suleiman)
paras.zh: 18 岁的哈姆扎·苏莱曼 (Hamza Suleiman) 于 8 月登上 HS Dignity 号，开始了他的第一份海员工作。自从该船10月13日在保加利亚海岸沉没以来，他一直失踪。 （巴塞尔·苏莱曼提交）

paras.en: But he became disillusioned when he was assigned to work on the deck. He grew increasingly fearful after learning that another vessel, the Alfa Watan, had been struck by drones on Oct. 6.
paras.zh: 但当他被分配到甲板上工作时，他的幻想破灭了。在得知另一艘船 Alfa Watan 于 10 月 6 日被无人机袭击后，他变得越来越害怕。

paras.en: Ten crew members aboard that ship, most of them Syrian, have yet to be recovered.
paras.zh: 该船上的十名船员（其中大多数是叙利亚人）尚未被找到。

paras.en: After the Alfa Watan attack, Suleiman spoke with his son, who said he wanted to leave the vessel.
paras.zh: 阿尔法瓦坦袭击事件发生后，苏莱曼与儿子交谈，儿子说他想离开这艘船。

paras.en: Basel Suleiman told CBC News he tried contacting the ship's owners to arrange for his son to disembark in Turkey, but the young man remained aboard.
paras.zh: 巴塞尔苏莱曼告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，他试图联系船主安排他的儿子在土耳其下船，但这名年轻人仍然留在船上。

paras.en: Mamdouh, who spoke with Suleiman's father, told him that the last time he saw his son, the young man was aboard the ship wearing a life jacket. That detail has helped sustain his father's hope that he might still be alive.
paras.zh: 马姆杜与苏莱曼的父亲交谈，他告诉他，最后一次见到儿子时，这个年轻人穿着救生衣在船上。这个细节帮助他父亲维持了他还活着的希望。

paras.en: Basel agreed to speak publicly about his son despite the uncertainty surrounding his fate.
paras.zh: 尽管儿子的命运存在不确定性，巴塞尔还是同意公开谈论他的儿子。

paras.en: “We don't have the ability to reach the [Bulgarian] authorities or to go and look for our children with our own hands,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们没有能力联系[保加利亚]当局，也没有能力亲手去寻找我们的孩子，”他说。

paras.en: Khaldoun Nabelsi, head of the Syrian Seafarers Association of the U.K., said he had been in contact with several families whose relatives had been killed in strikes on commercial vessels. He said he had counted at least 18 Syrian seafarers killed.
paras.zh: 英国叙利亚海员协会会长哈尔杜恩·纳贝尔西(Khaldoun Nabelsi)表示，他已经与几个家庭取得了联系，他们的亲属在商船袭击中丧生。他说，据他统计，至少有 18 名叙利亚海员丧生。

paras.en: “Nobody is forced to take these jobs, but in other ways you are forced. If you want to work, you have to go,” Nabelsi said.
paras.zh: “没有人被迫接受这些工作，但在其他方面你是被迫的。如果你想工作，你就必须离开，”纳贝尔西说。

paras.en: “They have to find a deal to stop this. But from our side, as a seaman or as a shipping company, we can do nothing.”
paras.zh: “他们必须找到一项协议来阻止这种情况。但从我们这边，作为海员或航运公司，我们无能为力。”

paras.en: The deteriorating security situation has prompted the Philippine government to issue a directive prohibiting its citizens from boarding vessels navigating the northern stretches of the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 不断恶化的安全局势促使菲律宾政府发布指令，禁止其公民登上在黑海北部海域航行的船只。

paras.en: In an image supplied by the Romanian government, the fire-damaged Royad Mammadov ship sits in the Black Sea on Oct. 5 after a suspected drone strike that killed two people. (Romanian Interior Ministry/Handout/Reuters)
paras.zh: 在罗马尼亚政府提供的一张图片中，10 月 5 日，遭到火灾损坏的 Royad Mammadov 船停泊在黑海，此前疑似无人机袭击造成两人死亡。 （罗马尼亚内政部/讲义/路透社）

paras.en: Shipping companies scale back operations
paras.zh: 航运公司缩减运营规模

paras.en: Some shipping companies that normally operate in the region are avoiding it altogether or have sharply reduced the number of vessels they deploy there.
paras.zh: 一些通常在该地区运营的航运公司正在完全避免这种情况，或者大幅减少在那里部署的船只数量。

paras.en: Turkey-based ED Shipping has a fleet of 26 vessels, but 19 are currently “laid up,” meaning they are temporarily out of service and not operating at sea, said the company's chief financial officer, Demre İşcen.
paras.zh: 总部位于土耳其的 ED Shipping 拥有一支由 26 艘船舶组成的船队，但该公司首席财务官 Demre şcen 表示，目前有 19 艘船舶“闲置”，这意味着它们暂时停止服务且不在海上运营。

paras.en: One of the company's ships, the Circon, was struck on June 5 while transiting the Sea of Azov. Two crew members were killed.
paras.zh: 该公司的一艘船“Circon”号于 6 月 5 日在亚速海航行时遭遇袭击。两名船员遇难。

paras.en: Ukraine carried out the attack, acknowledging that it had targeted five vessels that night, including ships stationed at occupied Ukrainian ports. Ukraine said the vessels were involved in transporting stolen Ukrainian grain, as well as military cargo and fuel.
paras.zh: 乌克兰实施了这次袭击，承认当晚袭击了五艘船只，其中包括驻扎在被占领的乌克兰港口的船只。乌克兰表示，这些船只参与运输被盗的乌克兰粮食以及军用货物和燃料。

paras.en: İşcen disputes that account, saying the Circon was on its way to a port in the Sea of Azov near Rostov-on-Don, Russia, where he said the company had a contract to load Russian grain.
paras.zh: 伊斯森对这一说法提出质疑，称“Circon”号正在前往俄罗斯顿河畔罗斯托夫附近的亚速海港口，他表示该公司在那里有一份装载俄罗斯谷物的合同。

paras.en: “Our crew members are Azeri and Turkish nationals. We didn't have anything to do with Ukraine. We didn't have anything to do with occupied-area grain … stolen grain, whatever,” he told CBC News in an interview from Istanbul.
paras.zh: “我们的船员是阿塞拜疆和土耳其国民。我们与乌克兰没有任何关系。我们与占领区的粮食没有任何关系……被盗的粮食，等等，”他在伊斯坦布尔接受 CBC 新闻采访时表示。

paras.en: “Ninety per cent of the time, we carry grain cargo from Russia to Turkey, Bulgaria, Romania, Moldova, Georgia, Greece, all around the Mediterranean, Aegean Sea, Red Sea, Black Sea. This is our main trading area.”
paras.zh: “百分之九十的时间，我们将谷物货物从俄罗斯运送到土耳其、保加利亚、罗马尼亚、摩尔多瓦、格鲁吉亚、希腊，以及地中海、爱琴海、红海、黑海各地。这是我们的主要贸易区域。”

paras.en: İşcen said the company was losing millions of dollars every month and that some of its seafarers were out of work because its ships were no longer travelling to Black Sea ports.
paras.zh: 伊斯森表示，该公司每月损失数百万美元，部分海员失业，因为其船只不再前往黑海港口。

paras.en: Other mariners say they will refuse any work in the region.
paras.zh: 其他海员表示，他们将拒绝在该地区进行任何工作。

paras.en: Mamdouh remains in Bulgaria with the other surviving members of the Dignity's crew. They are waiting for new documents so they can leave Europe and fly home.
paras.zh: 马姆杜与尊严号船员的其他幸存成员仍留在保加利亚。他们正在等待新的文件，以便他们可以离开欧洲并飞回家。

paras.en: “I will not go back to the Black Sea again. Never,” he said.
paras.zh: “我不会再回到黑海了。永远不会，”他说。

paras.en: A Bulgarian border police vessel carrying crew members from a ship damaged in a drone attack, in Varna, Bulgaria, on Oct. 6. (Petko Momchilov/Reuters)
paras.zh: 10 月 6 日，保加利亚瓦尔纳，一艘保加利亚边防警察船载着一艘在无人机袭击中受损的船上的船员。（Petko Momchilov/路透社）

paras.en: With files from Yasmine Hassan, Arzu Efeoğlu and Angela Johnston
paras.zh: 来自 Yasmine Hassan、Arzu Efeoğlu 和 Angela Johnston 的文件

articles.title: Musk says he was behind Starlink speed restriction in Ukraine

paras.en: Musk says he was behind Starlink speed restriction in Ukraine
paras.zh: 马斯克称他是乌克兰星链限速的幕后黑手

paras.en: Announcement comes as Kyiv says satellite speeds restored after days of issues
paras.zh: 基辅宣布卫星速度在几天的问题后已恢复

paras.en: Elon Musk said on Saturday that his company SpaceX had throttled the Starlink satellite internet service in Ukraine, disrupting operations that the country relies on to defend itself against Russia.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 周六表示，他的公司 SpaceX 已经限制了乌克兰的 Starlink 卫星互联网服务，扰乱了该国赖以防御俄罗斯的运营。

paras.en: Musk's admission on social media came after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Ukraine's access to Starlink and Starshield satellite links has been restored to the speeds it had before restrictions that disrupted front-line operations for more than a week.
paras.zh: 马斯克在社交媒体上承认，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰对星链和星盾卫星链路的访问已经恢复到了干扰前线作业一周多的限制之前的速度。

paras.en: Questions have persisted since last week about who ordered the interruptions to the Musk-made satellite internet system that Kyiv has relied on for years to counter Moscow's attacks.
paras.zh: 自上周以来，关于是谁下令中断马斯克制造的卫星互联网系统的问题一直存在，基辅多年来一直依靠该系统来应对莫斯科的袭击。

paras.en: "The speeds are now where they need to be," Zelenskyy wrote on X, adding that restoration began overnight and were sufficient by Saturday morning, improving front-line logistics and defence against Russian jet-powered Shahed drones.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在 X 上写道：“现在的速度已经达到了需要的速度。”他补充说，恢复工作在一夜之间开始，到周六早上就已经足够了，改善了前线后勤和对俄罗斯喷气动力“沙赫德”无人机的防御。

paras.en: After Ukraine said the services had been restored, Musk spoke out on the speed restrictions that began last week. In a post Saturday on X, Musk acknowledged that his company SpaceX throttled the Starlink satellite internet service.
paras.zh: 在乌克兰表示服务已恢复后，马斯克谈到了上周开始的速度限制。在周六 X 上的一篇帖子中，马斯克承认他的公司 SpaceX 限制了 Starlink 卫星互联网服务。

paras.en: But he maintained that the U.S. government controlled whatever changes happened with Starshield, the military-grade version of Starlink that is the backbone of Ukraine's drone operations and communication. He also defended the role of SpaceX in bolstering Ukraine's defences since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
paras.zh: 但他坚称，美国政府控制着“星盾”发生的任何变化，“星盾”是“星链”的军用版本，是乌克兰无人机操作和通信的支柱。他还为自 2022 年 2 月俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来 SpaceX 在加强乌克兰防御方面所发挥的作用进行了辩护。

paras.en: Restrictions imposed last week on Starshield alarmed the country's military and government officials, with commanders reporting lost drones and disrupted missions.
paras.zh: 上周对星盾实施的限制令该国军方和政府官员感到震惊，指挥官报告称无人机丢失，任务中断。

paras.en: The restoration follows a new U.S. diplomatic push to end the war. Russia agreed Wednesday to resume three-way negotiations with Washington and Kyiv next month. On Friday, Kyiv and Moscow also agreed to a localized ceasefire brokered by U.S. first lady Melania Trump around Oleshky, a war-ravaged, Russian-occupied town in Ukraine's southern Kherson region.
paras.zh: 恢复之前，美国采取了新的外交努力来结束战争。俄罗斯周三同意下个月恢复与华盛顿和基辅的三方谈判。周五，基辅和莫斯科还同意在美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普的斡旋下，在乌克兰南部赫尔松地区饱受战争蹂躏、被俄罗斯占领的奥列什基镇周围实现局部停火。

paras.en: Restriction sparked Ukraine, U.S. tension
paras.zh: 限制引发乌克兰和美国紧张局势

paras.en: The episode added to tensions between Kyiv and Washington, a relationship already strained by U.S. President Donald Trump's reported deal with Moscow on Russian diesel imports, which Ukraine viewed as a betrayal.
paras.zh: 这一事件加剧了基辅和华盛顿之间的紧张关系，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普据报道与莫斯科就俄罗斯柴油进口达成了协议，乌克兰认为这是一种背叛，这种关系已经变得紧张。

paras.en: Ukraine's Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara credited "direct dialogue" and Zelenskyy's diplomacy with Washington, adding that the outcome mattered most "for our front, for the military, the work of drones, logistics and communications."
paras.zh: 乌克兰国防部长叶夫尼·赫马拉赞扬了与华盛顿的“直接对话”和泽伦斯基的外交，并补充说，结果“对于我们的前线、军队、无人机、后勤和通讯工作”最重要。

paras.en: Trump has maintained that he didn't make the call, while also saying Musk should not be blamed. U.S. Vice-President JD Vance has hinted at White House co-ordination with Musk, while Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth have denied any administration involvement.
paras.zh: 特朗普坚称自己没有打这个电话，同时也表示不应责怪马斯克。美国副总统 JD 万斯暗示白宫将与马斯克进行协调，而国务卿马可·卢比奥和国防部长皮特·赫格斯则否认政府有任何参与。

paras.en: Meanwhile, a man was killed and two others wounded in a missile attack on the city of Lozova in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, local officials said Saturday.
paras.zh: 与此同时，当地官员周六表示，乌克兰哈尔科夫地区洛佐瓦市遭受导弹袭击，造成一名男子死亡，两人受伤。

paras.en: Moscow-installed authorities in cities across Russia-occupied Crimea reported power blackouts Saturday following overnight Ukrainian attacks.
paras.zh: 莫斯科在俄罗斯占领的克里米亚各城市设立的当局报告称，在乌克兰夜间袭击后，周六停电。

paras.en: Ukraine's General Staff said Saturday that its forces hit a chemical plant in the Russian city of Tolyatti, which produces materials used in rocket fuel. Tolyatti Mayor Ilya Sukhikh said the overnight attack damaged industrial facilities in the city.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总参谋部周六表示，其部队袭击了俄罗斯城市陶里亚蒂的一家化工厂，该工厂生产火箭燃料材料。陶里亚蒂市市长伊利亚·苏希赫 (Ilya Sukhikh) 表示，夜间袭击破坏了该市的工业设施。

paras.en: Ukrainian forces also hit an electronics plant in the city of Oryol, Ukraine's General Staff confirmed Saturday. Local officials in Oryol said Saturday that three people were killed in Friday's attack. The General Staff said the plant makes components for the cruise and ballistic missiles Russia fires at Ukrainian cities.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总参谋部周六证实，乌克兰军队还袭击了奥廖尔市的一家电子工厂。奥廖尔当地官员周六表示，周五的袭击造成三人死亡。总参谋部表示，该工厂为俄罗斯向乌克兰城市发射的巡航导弹和弹道导弹生产零部件。

paras.en: Ukrainian drones also reached Russia's Omsk region in western Siberia, more than 2,000 kilometres from the border with Ukraine. Omsk regional Gov. Vitaly Khotsenko said drones "reached a northern industrial hub."
paras.zh: 乌克兰无人机还抵达俄罗斯西西伯利亚鄂木斯克地区，距离乌克兰边境2000多公里。鄂木斯克地区州长维塔利·霍特申科表示，无人机“到达了北部工业中心”。

paras.en: Online retailer Ozon said Saturday that its logistics centre in Omsk has been attacked by a drone, but there were no casualties. Ozon is a competitor to Wildberries, whose facilities Ukraine has also targeted.
paras.zh: 在线零售商 Ozon 周六表示，其位于鄂木斯克的物流中心遭到无人机袭击，但没有造成人员伤亡。 Ozon 是 Wildberry 的竞争对手，乌克兰也瞄准了 Wildberry 的设施。

articles.title: 'They’re the nicest people': Obama mocks Trump for hitting Canada with tariffs

paras.en: 'They’re the nicest people': Obama mocks Trump for hitting Canada with tariffs
paras.zh: “他们是最好的人”：奥巴马嘲笑特朗普对加拿大征收关税

paras.en: 'These are the people who gave us maple syrup and Martin Short': ex-president
paras.zh: “这些人给了我们枫糖浆和马丁·肖特”：前总统

paras.en: Former U.S. president Barack Obama slammed the Trump administration's tariff regime on Saturday, and mocked the absurdity of engaging in a trade war with longtime ally Canada.
paras.zh: 美国前总统巴拉克·奥巴马周六猛烈抨击特朗普政府的关税制度，并嘲笑与长期盟友加拿大进行贸易战的荒谬性。

paras.en: "The big trade war he's starting now is with that well-known evil empire: Canada," Obama said at a Cleveland rally for Democratic candidates in Ohio.
paras.zh: 奥巴马在俄亥俄州克利夫兰举行的民主党候选人集会上表示：“他现在发起的大规模贸易战是针对那个众所周知的邪恶帝国：加拿大。”

paras.en: "These are the people who gave us maple syrup and Martin Short.… They're the nicest people," he joked. "They're our friendly neighbours to the north, and he's picking a fight with them?"
paras.zh: “这些人给了我们枫糖浆和马丁·肖特……他们是最好的人，”他开玩笑说。 “他们是我们北方的友好邻居，他却要跟他们打架？”

paras.en: Obama, who has been stumping for Democrats ahead of the U.S. midterm elections, also criticized Donald Trump's tariffs policy more generally, saying they have had the expected negative effect on U.S. consumers who bear the brunt of the rising costs.
paras.zh: 在美国中期选举前一直支持民主党的奥巴马也更广泛地批评了唐纳德·特朗普的关税政策，称这些政策对首当其冲地承受成本上升的美国消费者产生了预期的负面影响。

paras.en: Those rising costs have hampered Republican chances in the midterms, especially in border states, leading Trump to announce on Friday that he plans to lift tariffs on some Canadian products.
paras.zh: 这些不断上升的成本阻碍了共和党在中期选举中获胜的机会，尤其是在边境州，导致特朗普周五宣布，他计划取消对一些加拿大产品的关税。

paras.en: Canada-U.S. Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc said on CBC's Power & Politics that Ottawa isn't expecting a deal before before the Nov. 3 vote.
paras.zh: 加拿大-美国贸易部长多米尼克·勒布朗 (Dominic LeBlanc) 在 CBC 的《权力与政治》节目中表示，渥太华预计在 11 月 3 日投票之前不会达成协议。

paras.en: The U.S. and Canada have been engaging in retaliatory tariffs since Trump first launched his levy campaign last year — ostensibly to combat alleged fentanyl trafficking and trade imbalances — and trade talks broke down in August.
paras.zh: 自特朗普去年首次发起征税活动以来，美国和加拿大一直在实施报复性关税——表面上是为了打击所谓的芬太尼贩运和贸易失衡——但贸易谈判于八月破裂。

paras.en: Trump has routinely used Canada as a punching bag in his campaign rally speeches.
paras.zh: 特朗普在竞选集会演讲中经常将加拿大作为出气筒。

paras.en: "At some point, we're making a deal that's gonna be amazing," Trump said during a stop in Highland Heights, Ky., on Oct. 17.
paras.zh: 10 月 17 日，特朗普在肯塔基州高地高地停留时表示，“到了某个时候，我们将达成一项令人惊叹的协议”。

paras.en: "But for years we've lost billions and billions of dollars, and they just felt so emboldened."
paras.zh: “但多年来我们已经损失了数十亿美元，而他们却感到如此大胆。”

paras.en: He was cheered when he called former prime minister Justin Trudeau a "loser" before taking aim at his successor, Mark Carney.
paras.zh: 当他称前总理贾斯汀·特鲁多为“失败者”，然后将矛头指向继任者马克·卡尼时，他受到了欢呼。

paras.en: "Your current guy's good … he's a nice guy, but he's not nice when it comes to trade," he said.
paras.zh: “你现在的人很好......他是一个好人，但在交易方面他并不好，”他说。

paras.en: "They're learning and they're suffering."
paras.zh: “他们正在学习，他们正在受苦。”

articles.title: Is Iran ready for another major US attack after midterm elections?

paras.en: Officials in Tehran are preparing for renewed strikes
paras.zh: 德黑兰官员正在为新一轮罢工做准备

paras.en: following media reports that the United States and Israel have been examining new options for escalating their war against Iran.
paras.zh: 此前有媒体报道称，美国和以色列一直在研究升级对伊朗战争的新选择。

paras.en: The US midterm elections on November 3 and Israel's October 27 election have injected a political factor into how both countries are approaching the conflict, which they launched in late February.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日的美国中期选举和 10 月 27 日以色列的选举为两国如何应对 2 月底发起的冲突注入了政治因素。

paras.en: Polls show that high energy prices brought on by the Iran war are hurting Donald Trump's Republican Party. On October 8, the president posted on social media that the United States would not attack Iran before the midterms, citing "productive discussions" with Tehran. The United States last launched strikes on Iran in early September.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，伊朗战争带来的高能源价格正在损害唐纳德·特朗普领导的共和党。 10月8日，总统在社交媒体上发帖称，美国不会在中期选举前攻击伊朗，并称与德黑兰进行了“富有成效的讨论”。美国上次对伊朗发动打击是在九月初。

paras.en: After the elections are over, however, Trump may feel less politically constrained.
paras.zh: 然而，选举结束后，特朗普可能会感到政治上的限制减少了。

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has campaigned on a platform of regime change in Iran.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡以伊朗政权更迭为竞选纲领。

paras.en: Report: Plans in place for 'short' US-Israeli operation
paras.zh: 报告：美以“短期”行动计划已到位

paras.en: Citing senior US officials the New York Times reported on Wednesday that the United States and Israel have "developed specific plans" for a "short but intensive operation" in Iran that would include targets such as nuclear facilities, energy infrastructure, and the country's arsenal of missiles and drones.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》周三援引美国高级官员的话说，美国和以色列已经“制定了具体计划”，在伊朗进行“短期但密集的行动”，其中包括核设施、能源基础设施以及该国的导弹和无人机武库等目标。

paras.en: One official told the newspaper that the goal would be to force Iran into making "diplomatic concessions" by further weakening its economy, as negotiations to end the conflict have gone nowhere. The United States has also maintained a blockade of Iranian oil exports in the Strait of Hormuz that has sapped Tehran's oil revenues.
paras.zh: 一名官员告诉该报，目标是通过进一步削弱伊朗经济来迫使伊朗做出“外交让步”，因为结束冲突的谈判毫无进展。美国还维持对霍尔木兹海峡伊朗石油出口的封锁，这削弱了德黑兰的石油收入。

paras.en: Other outlets have reported similar plans in recent weeks. In early October, Axios reported that the Pentagon has instructed US Central Command "to conclude preparations for resuming major combat operations in Iran."
paras.zh: 最近几周，其他媒体也报道了类似的计划。 10月初，Axios报道称，五角大楼已指示美国中央司令部“完成在伊朗恢复重大作战行动的准备工作”。

paras.en: There are currently two US aircraft carrier strike groups in the Arabian Sea, with a third expected to arrive by late November.
paras.zh: 目前，阿拉伯海有两个美国航母战斗群，第三个预计将于 11 月底抵达。

paras.en: On October 15, Trump told the right-wing broadcaster Newsmax that he was considering a strike on Pickaxe Mountain, near the Natanz nuclear complex, where US officials say Iran may have moved sensitive nuclear-related material underground.
paras.zh: 10 月 15 日，特朗普告诉右翼广播公司 Newsmax，他正在考虑对纳坦兹核设施附近的镐山发动袭击，美国官员称伊朗可能已将敏感的核相关材料转移到地下。

paras.en: A day later, CNN reported that Trump is considering using a Massive Ordnance Air Blast bomb on Iranian targets. As the MOAB creates a humungous blast wave above ground, its effectiveness in targeting underground facilities such as Pickaxe would be limited.
paras.zh: 一天后，美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 报道称，特朗普正在考虑对伊朗目标使用大型空爆炸弹。由于 MOAB 在地面上产生巨大的冲击波，其瞄准镐等地下设施的效果将受到限制。

paras.en: Iranian officials say they are prepared for another attack, with a broad response that would include strikes on US bases and energy facilities in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 伊朗官员表示，他们已准备好应对另一次袭击，并做出广泛回应，其中包括对海湾地区的美国基地和能源设施进行袭击。

paras.en: Ali Asghar Shafieian, a media adviser to Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, told DW that, although the United States retains a significant technological and military advantage, Tehran's strategy is based on preserving the regime's hold on the country rather than matching US strength.
paras.zh: 伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安(Masoud Pezeshkian)的媒体顾问阿里·阿斯加尔·沙菲安(Ali Asghar Shafieian)告诉德国之声，尽管美国保留着显着的技术和军事优势，但德黑兰的战略是基于维持伊朗政权对该国的控制，而不是与美国的实力相匹配。

paras.en: "The United States has the upper hand in military power and technology, but Iran's strength is in how it deals with a crisis," Shafieian said.
paras.zh: 沙菲安说：“美国在军事力量和技术方面占据上风，但伊朗的优势在于其应对危机的方式。”

paras.en: Shafieian pointed to the rapid replacement of senior officials killed in previous attacks as an example of how Tehran has tried to make its political structure more resilient. Iran has also been rebuilding missile and drone capabilities that were hit during the massive wave of strikes during the first weeks of the war.
paras.zh: 沙菲安指出，德黑兰迅速更换在先前袭击中丧生的高级官员是德黑兰如何努力使其政治结构更具弹性的一个例子。伊朗还一直在重建在战争头几周的大规模袭击浪潮中受到打击的导弹和无人机能力。

paras.en: Citing Iranian officials, the Reuters news agency reported this week that Iran is "preparing for renewed Israeli and US attacks, not for a deal with America to end the war," adding that Tehran was prolonging negotiations to try to weaken Trump ahead of the midterms.
paras.zh: 路透社本周援引伊朗官员的话说，伊朗“正在为以色列和美国再次发动袭击做准备，而不是为与美国达成协议以结束战争”，并补充说，德黑兰正在延长谈判，试图在中期选举前削弱特朗普。

paras.en: Iran has told regional governments that US military bases and critical infrastructure could become targets if neighboring countries assist another US or Israeli operation.
paras.zh: 伊朗告诉地区政府，如果邻国协助美国或以色列的另一项行动，美国的军事基地和关键基础设施可能成为目标。

paras.en: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has warned that participation or cooperation by regional states would result in a "decisive and proportionate response."
paras.zh: 伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇警告说，地区国家的参与或合作将导致“果断和适当的反应”。

paras.en: "Iran is prepared to give diplomacy another chance if we see strong evidence of a sincere desire by US to build trust & reach a just solution," Araghchi posted on X Wednesday. "But, if US chooses war over diplomacy, it'll certainly result in an even greater strategic failure."
paras.zh: 阿拉格奇周三在 X 上发帖称：“如果我们看到强有力的证据表明美国真诚希望建立信任并达成公正的解决方案，伊朗准备再给外交一次机会。” “但是，如果美国选择战争而不是外交，那肯定会导致更大的战略失败。”

paras.en: Rahman Ghahremanpour, a Tehran-based political analyst, told DW that Iran's preparations extend beyond missiles and drones to prioritizing internal security.
paras.zh: 德黑兰政治分析家拉赫曼·加勒曼普尔 (Rahman Ghahremanpour) 告诉德国之声，伊朗的准备工作不仅限于导弹和无人机，还优先考虑内部安全。

paras.en: That includes confronting armed opposition groups, preparing for possible protests and developing plans to prevent external military pressure from combining with domestic unrest.
paras.zh: 这包括对抗武装反对派团体、为可能的抗议活动做准备以及制定计划以防止外部军事压力与国内动乱结合起来。

paras.en: Another conflict, he said, could bring renewed internet restrictions and a stronger mobilization of government supporters in public spaces.
paras.zh: 他说，另一场冲突可能会带来新的互联网限制，并在公共场所更强有力地动员政府支持者。

paras.en: "In the government's asymmetric-war strategy, the ultimate objective is to convince the United States that regime change through military action is impossible," Ghahremanpour said.
paras.zh: 加勒曼普尔说：“政府的不对称战争战略的最终目标是让美国相信通过军事行动改变政权是不可能的。”

paras.en: Ghahremanpour added that some factions within Iran have supported returning to a negotiated agreement. But he believes that Washington's demands are now considered so extensive that even Iranian officials who favor compromise struggle to build domestic support for them.
paras.zh: 加勒曼普尔补充说，伊朗内部的一些派系支持恢复通过谈判达成的协议。但他认为，华盛顿的要求现在被认为是如此广泛，以至于即使是赞成妥协的伊朗官员也很难为他们争取国内支持。

paras.en: "For now, we are facing a deadlock," Ghahremanpour said. "Iranian officials do not appear optimistic about reaching an agreement."
paras.zh: “目前，我们面临僵局，”加勒曼普尔说。 “伊朗官员似乎对达成协议并不乐观。”

paras.en: Talks continue to snag on Iran's nuclear program, which US officials say must top the agenda.
paras.zh: 谈判继续围绕伊朗核计划展开，美国官员表示，伊朗核计划必须成为首要议程。

paras.en: Iran's latest proposal to the United States, sent through Qatari mediators, included an offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz under Iranian control, in exchange for the US's lifting its maritime blockade, releasing frozen assets and ending military actions.
paras.zh: 伊朗通过卡塔尔调解人向美国提出的最新提议包括重新开放伊朗控制下的霍尔木兹海峡，以换取美国解除海上封锁、释放冻结资产并结束军事行动。

paras.en: Citing data from the ship tracker Kpler, the Wall Street Journal reported this week that oil flows through Hormuz are approaching prewar levels as the US military escorts tankers and shipping companies are more willing to take risks for a bigger payoff. This raises questions about whether Iran's leverage over oil flows might be weakening.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》本周援引船舶跟踪器 Kpler 的数据报道称，由于美国军方护航油轮和航运公司更愿意为了更大的回报而冒险，因此经过霍尔木兹的石油流量已接近战前水平。这引发了人们的疑问：伊朗对石油流动的影响力是否可能正在减弱。

paras.en: An escalation in the confrontation would come at a moment of severe economic pressure and growing political polarization for Iranians.
paras.zh: 对抗升级将发生在伊朗面临严峻的经济压力和日益严重的政治两极分化之际。

paras.en: A doctor in Tehran told DW that she fears what would happen should fighting resumed. Speaking with the media in Iran remains very dangerous, and she spoke under condition of anonymity.
paras.zh: 德黑兰的一名医生告诉德国之声，她担心如果战斗重新爆发会发生什么。在伊朗接受媒体采访仍然非常危险，而且她在匿名的情况下发言。

paras.en: "The economic situation has become extremely bad," she said. "Even if you have a good income yourself, you don't feel good living among so many people struggling with poverty," she added.
paras.zh: “经济形势已经变得极其糟糕，”她说。 “即使你自己收入不错，但生活在这么多与贫困作斗争的人中间，你的感觉也不好，”她补充道。

paras.en: She expects authorities to restrict internet access again if fighting resumes.
paras.zh: 她预计，如果战斗重新爆发，当局将再次限制互联网访问。

paras.en: A woman in Tehran described anger toward regime supporters and said another war combined with domestic protests could increase the risk of confrontations on the streets.
paras.zh: 德黑兰的一名妇女描述了对政权支持者的愤怒，并表示另一场战争加上国内抗议可能会增加街头对抗的风险。

paras.en: Asked about possible attacks on underground nuclear sites, she said the issue felt increasingly detached from her everyday problems.
paras.zh: 当被问及地下核设施可能遭受的袭击时，她说这个问题与她的日常问题越来越脱节。

paras.en: "What do the nuclear sites have to do with us?" she said. "They are inside mountains."
paras.zh: “核设施和我们有什么关系？”她说。 “他们在山里。”

articles.title: Albania's student protests are only getting bigger

paras.en: The fallout from the October 13 protests was still visible when students and faculty from the University of Tirana gathered outside the Education Ministry in Albania's capital on Tuesday to express their continued discontent. Smashed windows have yet to be replaced; the walls are still black with soot from fires that broke out during the protests.
paras.zh: 周二，地拉那大学的学生和教师聚集在阿尔巴尼亚首都教育部外，表达他们持续的不满，10 月 13 日抗议活动的影响仍然清晰可见。被打碎的窗户尚未更换；墙壁仍然因抗议期间爆发的火灾而被烟灰熏黑。

paras.en: Albania has seen nearly five months of peaceful anti-government protests, sparked initially when plans were made public that Jared Kushner — a son-in-law of US President Donald Trump — and associates intended to build a luxury hotel complex within a nature reserve.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚已经经历了近五个月的和平反政府抗议活动，最初是在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳及其同事打算在自然保护区内建造一座豪华酒店综合体的计划公开时引发的。

paras.en: Since then, anti-government and anti-corruption protests have escalated. Now, college and high school students clash with police forces almost daily, with the fiercest clashes so far occurring last week.
paras.zh: 此后，反政府和反腐败抗议活动不断升级。现在，大学生和高中生几乎每天都会与警察发生冲突，迄今为止最激烈的冲突发生在上周。

paras.en: Protesters denounce corruption, mismanaged universities and the rising cost of education in Albania — and call for the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, who has been in office since 2013.
paras.zh: 抗议者谴责阿尔巴尼亚的腐败、大学管理不善以及不断上涨的教育成本，并要求自 2013 年就任的总理埃迪·拉马辞职。

paras.en: Wearing a black hooded jacket and a scarf across her face to conceal her identity, a woman who asked to be called Sara because she fears repercussions for speaking to the press told DW that protesters "communicate via text messages — that's the only way."
paras.zh: 一名身穿黑色连帽夹克并用围巾遮住脸以隐藏身份的女子告诉德国之声，抗议者“通过短信进行交流——这是唯一的方式”。由于担心接受媒体采访而受到影响，她要求自己称呼自己为萨拉。

paras.en: She cut the interview short as some protesters began flinging stones at the Education Ministry. Police pushed demonstrators and journalists out of the way, using water cannons to disperse the crowd.
paras.zh: 当一些抗议者开始向教育部投掷石块时，她中断了采访。警察将示威者和记者推开，并使用高压水枪驱散人群。

paras.en: "Social media is the most important public space today — more so than physical spaces," Besmir Semanaj, a prominent Albanian cybersecurity advocate told DW. "Young Albanians no longer organize through traditional structures such as political parties, associations or public appeals. Instead, they organize themselves where they spend much of their daily lives: on their cellphones."
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚著名网络安全倡导者贝斯米尔·塞马纳吉 (Besmir Semanaj) 告诉德国之声：“社交媒体是当今最重要的公共空间，比物理空间更重要。” “年轻的阿尔巴尼亚人不再通过政党、协会或公众呼吁等传统结构进行组织。相反，他们在日常生活中大部分时间都在手机上组织自己。”

paras.en: "The most important communication channels include Instagram, WhatsApp groups for academic-year cohorts, departments and dormitories, Telegram channels for general announcements, and TikTok for sharing videos," Semanaj said. He added that people who are especially concerned with security use the Signal messaging app.
paras.zh: Semanaj 说：“最重要的沟通渠道包括 Instagram、针对学年班级、院系和宿舍的 WhatsApp 群组、用于一般公告的 Telegram 频道以及用于分享视频的 TikTok。”他补充说，特别关心安全的人会使用 Signal 消息应用程序。

paras.en: "This is a horizontal organizational structure, without individual 'leaders' and without a central command structure," Semanaj said. "That is exactly why the government is having such a hard time understanding and controlling the situation."
paras.zh: “这是一个横向的组织结构，没有个人‘领导者’，也没有中央指挥结构，”塞马纳吉说。 “这正是政府如此难以理解和控制局势的原因。”

paras.en: Semanaj said the Telegram messenger app had proven particularly useful for protesters. "Telegram channels allow you to reach tens of thousands of people at once," he said. "Notifications are sent out within seconds, and external control is more difficult to establish than on traditional platforms."
paras.zh: Semanaj 表示，Telegram 通讯应用程序已被证明对抗议者特别有用。 “电报频道可以让你同时联系数以万计的人，”他说。 “通知在几秒钟内发出，外部控制比传统平台更难建立。”

paras.en: Rama has called the youth uprising a "hybrid war." He said protesters thought they could "make Albania a better country through TikTok and without even being able to string together more than seven coherent words." Though not all are terrorists, he said, he believes that "they are hostages to a certain mindset, a new ideology that has only one goal: to destroy, to turn everything upside down, to raze everything to the ground."
paras.zh: 拉玛称青年起义是一场“混合战争”。他说，抗议者认为他们可以“通过 TikTok 让阿尔巴尼亚成为一个更好的国家，甚至无法将七个以上连贯的单词串在一起。”他说，虽然并非所有人都是恐怖分子，但他相信“他们是某种心态、一种新意识形态的人质，这种意识形态只有一个目标：摧毁、颠覆一切、将一切夷为平地。”

paras.en: Over nearly five months, Rama has accused various "true" masterminds of organizing the anti-government and anti-corruption protests. He has alleged that the governments of Greece, Russia and Iran are stirring up dissent.
paras.zh: 近五个月来，拉玛指责各种“真正”的策划者组织了反政府和反腐败抗议活动。他声称希腊、俄罗斯和伊朗政府正在煽动异议。

paras.en: Most recently, Rama said it was "antifa" — or a decentralized movement of global antifascists — that had stoked anti-government and anti-corruption sentiments in Albania. "These are young people who have been radicalized and ideologically indoctrinated and who are acting under the pressure or influence of a new, dark force that has emerged in Europe and the United States, a force that the President of the United States has designated as a terrorist organization: Antifa," Rama claimed.
paras.zh: 最近，拉马表示，“反法西斯运动”（即全球反法西斯分子的去中心化运动）激起了阿尔巴尼亚的反政府和反腐败情绪。拉马声称：“这些年轻人已经被激进化和意识形态灌输，他们在欧洲和美国出现的新的黑暗势力的压力或影响下行事，美国总统将这股势力定为恐怖组织：Antifa。”

paras.en: Redion Qirjazi, a security affairs researcher who focuses on violence prevention and conflict resolution, told DW that Rama's claim was not likely to prove true. "That is a serious accusation — one that requires equally compelling evidence," Qirjazi said. "To date, no verifiable evidence has been presented to prove the existence of an organized Antifa structure in Albania, let alone its involvement in coordinating the protests."
paras.zh: 专注于预防暴力和解决冲突的安全事务研究员雷迪恩·齐贾兹 (Redion Qirjazi) 告诉德国之声，拉玛的说法不太可能得到证实。 “这是一项严重的指控，需要同样令人信服的证据，”齐贾兹说。 “迄今为止，还没有任何可证实的证据证明阿尔巴尼亚存在有组织的安提法组织，更不用说它参与协调抗议活动了。”

paras.en: Qirjazi said Rama's reference to Trump's calling antifa a terror group was problematic. "Antifa is not a unified international organization with a centralized structure or leadership," he said, "but rather an umbrella term for various movements and groups united by the fact that they are, at their core, anti-fascist."
paras.zh: 基尔贾兹表示，拉玛提及特朗普称安提法为恐怖组织的说法是有问题的。他说：“Antifa 不是一个具有集中结构或领导层的统一国际组织，而是各种运动和团体的总称，这些运动和团体的核心是反法西斯。”

paras.en: Sara said she rejected the "terrorist" label that Rama had attempted to slap on her and her fellow protesters. "There are groups that are willing to use violence — that's true — but I have nothing to do with them," she said. "As soon as I see violence, I walk away; I'm against it."
paras.zh: 萨拉说，她拒绝拉玛试图给她和其他抗议者贴上“恐怖分子”标签。 “有些团体愿意使用暴力——这是事实——但我与他们没有任何关系，”她说。 “我一看到暴力，我就会走开；我反对它。”

paras.en: Arlind Qori, the chairman of the Together Movement, a social-democratic opposition party with just one seat in Albania's parliament, said youths had taken to the streets out of dissatisfaction with the status quo rather than any particular ideology. "Young Albanians are outraged by the current socioeconomic conditions: the poverty, the fact that many of their parents have emigrated because they couldn't support their families, the decline of the education system, the lack of postgraduation prospects," Qori said. The students' central demand is for Rama to resign, he added "not a socialist revolution."
paras.zh: 在阿尔巴尼亚议会中只有一个席位的社会民主党反对党“共同运动”的主席阿尔林德·科里表示，年轻人走上街头是出于对现状的不满，而不是出于任何特定的意识形态。科里说：“年轻的阿尔巴尼亚人对当前的社会经济状况感到愤怒：贫困、许多父母因为无法养家糊口而移民、教育体系衰落、缺乏毕业前景。”学生们的核心要求是拉玛辞职，他补充说“不是社会主义革命”。

paras.en: "People aren't demanding anything radical," Qori said. "They merely want a corrupt head of government to resign — that's a fundamental and moderate demand. But Edi Rama continues to meet this demand with police violence and arrogance."
paras.zh: “人们并没有要求任何激进的东西，”科里说。 “他们只是希望腐败的政府首脑辞职——这是一个基本且温和的要求。但埃迪·拉玛继续以警察暴力和傲慢来满足这一要求。”

paras.en: Qirjazi said Rama's allegations of foreign interference could be a strategy. "When a government faces protests and public discontent, linking demonstrators to extremism and foreign influence may serve to divert attention away from the actual causes and toward a national security narrative," he said.
paras.zh: 基尔贾兹表示，拉玛关于外国干涉的指控可能是一种策略。他说：“当政府面临抗议和公众不满时，将示威者与极端主义和外国影响联系起来可能会转移人们对实际原因的注意力，而转向国家安全的叙述。”

paras.en: "This can serve several political purposes: to delegitimize the protesters, to weaken their support among the public, and to justify a tougher crackdown in the name of law and order," Qirjazi said.
paras.zh: 齐尔贾兹说：“这可以达到几个政治目的：使抗议者失去合法性，削弱他们在公众中的支持，并为以法律和秩序的名义进行更严厉的镇压提供理由。”

paras.en: Semanaj said this was a common pattern in governments' efforts to dismiss dissent. "Protests are portrayed as acts of violence," he said. "Young people are cast as manipulated, and their legitimate concerns — conditions at universities, tuition fees, corruption and a lack of prospects — vanish from the news agenda."
paras.zh: 塞马纳吉表示，这是政府消除异议的常见模式。 “抗议被描述为暴力行为，”他说。 “年轻人被认为是被操纵的，他们的合理担忧——大学条件、学费、腐败和缺乏前景——从新闻议程中消失了。”

paras.en: This article was translated from German.
paras.zh: 这篇文章是从德文翻译过来的。

articles.title: El Clasico awaits a Yamal vs Mbappe showdown on Mourinho’s return to La Liga

paras.en: Barcelona, Spain – It has been 15 years since Jose Mourinho was first thrown into the ring of fire at Camp Nou and the famously polarising manager’s Real Madrid side was handed a La Liga battering by Barcelona.
paras.zh: 西班牙巴塞罗那——自从何塞·穆里尼奥第一次在诺坎普被扔进火圈以来，已经过去了 15 年，这位著名的两极分化主教练的皇家马德里队在西甲联赛中被巴塞罗那队击败。

paras.en: The home team’s supporters have not forgotten that cold November night from 2010, when Pep Guardiola’s men stamped their authority with a 5-0 win.
paras.zh: 主队的支持者并没有忘记2010年那个寒冷的11月夜晚，当时瓜迪奥拉的球队以5-0的胜利奠定了他们的权威。

paras.en: It became an enduring image of a rivalry that spilled from the pitch onto the touchline, sparking heated confrontations among players and bitter exchanges between managers for years to come.
paras.zh: 这成为了一场持久的竞争形象，从球场蔓延到边线，在未来几年引发了球员之间的激烈对抗和教练之间的激烈交流。

paras.en: Now, Barcelona – the city and the club – are ready to “welcome back” Mourinho on his second stint as the manager of their fiercest rival.
paras.zh: 现在，巴塞罗那——这座城市和俱乐部——已经准备好“欢迎回来”穆里尼奥第二次担任他们最强劲对手的主教练。

paras.en: “I remember the 5-0 [scoreline] but also the tension,” recalls Aleix Soler, a Barcelona fan.
paras.zh: “我记得 5-0 [比分]，但也记得那种紧张气氛，”巴塞罗那球迷阿莱克斯·索勒 (Aleix Soler) 回忆道。

paras.en: “You’d spend the whole week arguing about the game even before a ball was kicked,” he tells Al Jazeera at a Barcelona fan zone.
paras.zh: “甚至在球被踢之前，你就会花整整一周的时间争论比赛，”他在巴塞罗那球迷区告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: The 35-year-old culer – as Barcelona’s supporters are known – will watch the match, having also attended games during Mourinho’s first Madrid spell.
paras.zh: 这位 35 岁的库勒（巴塞罗那支持者的绰号）将观看这场比赛，他也曾在穆里尼奥首次执教马德里期间观看过比赛。

paras.en: “Beating Madrid is always special, but against Mourinho, you’re still smiling on Monday morning.”
paras.zh: “击败马德里总是很特别，但对阵穆里尼奥，你在周一早上仍然微笑。”

paras.en: As Mourinho returns to the fixture after 13 years on Sunday, he will face another Barcelona side that has set a punishing pace in the league.
paras.zh: 周日，穆里尼奥时隔 13 年重返赛场，他将面对另一支在联赛中表现出色的巴塞罗那球队。

paras.en: The spotlight will be on Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe – with their growing rivalry adding another dramatic layer to the plot.
paras.zh: 焦点将集中在拉明·亚马尔和基利安·姆巴佩身上——他们日益激烈的竞争为剧情增添了另一层戏剧性的色彩。

paras.en: The two forwards meet a day before the Ballon d’Or award ceremony in London, bringing individual ambition to a contest that isn’t shorn of consequences for either club.
paras.zh: 这两名前锋在伦敦举行的金球奖颁奖典礼前一天会面，将个人雄心带入这场比赛，这对任何一家具乐部都会产生影响。

paras.en: Barcelona have won all nine of their league games, scoring 39 goals, and lead Madrid by six points.
paras.zh: 巴塞罗那队赢得了全部 9 场联赛，打进 39 球，领先马德里队 6 分。

paras.en: Victory would stretch that gap to nine. A Madrid win would not only reduce it to three points, but also inject new belief in Mourinho’s side.
paras.zh: 胜利将把差距扩大到九分。马德里队的胜利不仅能让积分减少到三分，还能给穆里尼奥的球队注入新的信心。

paras.en: Mourinho acknowledged the significance of the occasion after his team’s Champions League victory over RB Leipzig on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 在周三他的球队在欧冠联赛中战胜莱比锡红牛后，穆里尼奥承认了这一时刻的重要性。

paras.en: “It’s another league match, but it’s not a match like the others,” he told local broadcaster Movistar.
paras.zh: “这又是一场联赛，但与其他比赛不同，”他告诉当地广播公司Movistar。

paras.en: Madrid are third in La Liga standings, behind Atletico Madrid, and have lost six of their past seven Clasicos. Mourinho must find a way to interrupt that pattern before the title chase intensifies.
paras.zh: 马德里在西甲积分榜上排名第三，仅次于马德里竞技，并且在过去七场国家德比中输掉了六场。穆里尼奥必须在冠军追逐加剧之前找到一种方法来打破这种模式。

paras.en: While Hansi Flick has made this fixture a source of strength for Barcelona in his two years as manager, the hosts approach it with their own questions after a 4-2 defeat at Paris Saint-Germain, their first loss of the season, on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 虽然汉西·弗利克在担任主教练的两年里让这场比赛成为了巴塞罗那的力量源泉，但在周二以 4-2 输给巴黎圣日耳曼队（这是他们本赛季的首场失利）后，主队也带着自己的问题来对待这场比赛。

paras.en: Barcelona scored freely against Getafe, Galatasaray and Real Betis before travelling to France. In Paris, their attacking threat remained but defensive absences and the spaces opened up to PSG made the evening uncomfortable.
paras.zh: 在前往法国之前，巴塞罗那对阵赫塔菲、加拉塔萨雷和皇家贝蒂斯均取得进球。在巴黎，他们的进攻威胁依然存在，但防守缺席以及向巴黎圣日耳曼打开的空间让整个晚上感到不舒服。

paras.en: Barcelona defenders Eric Garcia and Jules Kounde were out injured, leaving Flick with Xavi Espart and Joao Cancelo as full-back options on either side of Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin.
paras.zh: 巴塞罗那后卫埃里克·加西亚和儒勒·昆德因伤缺阵，弗里克留下哈维·埃斯帕特和若奥·坎塞洛作为保罗·库巴西和杰拉德·马丁两侧的后卫选择。

paras.en: Kounde remained absent from training on Friday, while midfielder Dani Olmo’s adductor injury further narrowed the coach’s options.
paras.zh: 孔德仍然缺席周五的训练，而中场球员丹尼·奥尔莫的内收肌受伤进一步缩小了教练的选择范围。

paras.en: Madrid enjoyed a more encouraging European evening, beating Leipzig 4-1 with goals from Bernardo Silva, Arda Guler, Mbappe and Yan Diomande.
paras.zh: 马德里队度过了一个更加鼓舞人心的欧洲之夜，凭借贝尔纳多·席尔瓦、阿尔达·古勒、姆巴佩和扬·迪奥曼德的进球，4-1击败莱比锡。

paras.en: Their three wins from three Champions League games offer a foundation, even if domestic consistency has proved harder to establish.
paras.zh: 他们在三场欧冠比赛中取得的三场胜利为他们奠定了基础，尽管事实证明国内的一致性更难建立。

paras.en: However, they will face Barcelona without the suspended Vinicius Junior, removing one of their most dangerous runners and leaving Mourinho with another decision to make about Mbappe.
paras.zh: 然而，他们将在没有停赛的维尼修斯·儒尼奥尔的情况下对阵巴塞罗那，这使得他们最危险的跑动者之一被淘汰，穆里尼奥又需要对姆巴佩做出另一个决定。

paras.en: Yan Diomande offers an alternative on the left, while Guler’s passing and Jude Bellingham’s movement could be essential to getting Madrid’s leading scorer into dangerous positions.
paras.zh: 扬·迪奥曼德在左路提供了另一种选择，而古勒的传球和裘德·贝林汉姆的跑动对于让马德里的头号得分手陷入危险的位置至关重要。

paras.en: The task begins with escaping Barcelona’s pressure. If Madrid can move the ball beyond the first challenge and find a passer facing forward, Mbappe can attack the space behind Flick’s defensive line.
paras.zh: 任务始于摆脱巴塞罗那的压力。如果皇马能够将球转移到第一个挑战之外并找到一个面向前方的传球手，那么姆巴佩就可以攻击弗里克防线后面的空间。

paras.en: For Barcelona, maintaining pressure on that passer will be as important as tracking the run. Retreat too readily, and they risk losing the compact shape that allows them to recover possession and keep attacks coming.
paras.zh: 对于巴塞罗那来说，对传球者保持压力与追踪跑动同样重要。撤退得太容易，他们就有可能失去紧凑的阵型，而这种阵型可以让他们重新夺回控球权并继续进攻。

paras.en: Federico Valverde’s recent deployment at right-back gives Madrid another route forward, with his overlapping runs complementing teammates who move inside.
paras.zh: 费德里科·巴尔韦德最近在右后卫位置上的部署为皇马提供了另一条前进路线，他的重叠跑动可以补充内线的队友。

paras.en: Whether Mourinho keeps him there will help determine the balance between creativity and defensive cover in midfield.
paras.zh: 穆里尼奥是否留住他将有助于决定中场创造力和防守掩护之间的平衡。

paras.en: Madrid must decide how much attention they can afford to give Yamal.
paras.zh: 马德里必须决定他们能够给予亚马尔多少关注。

paras.en: The young sensation’s dribbling can draw a second defender towards Barcelona’s right wing, but that help comes at a cost elsewhere as Pedri can redirect possession towards the space left open.
paras.zh: 这位年轻球星的盘带可以将第二名后卫吸引到巴塞罗那的右翼，但这种帮助会在其他地方付出代价，因为佩德里可以将控球权转移到空位。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Raphinha’s movement threatens opponents concentrating on the ball, and his 12 league goals underline the danger of treating Barcelona as a one-man attack.
paras.zh: 与此同时，拉菲尼亚的跑动威胁到了专注于球的对手，他的 12 个联赛进球突显了将巴塞罗那视为单人进攻的危险。

paras.en: Stopping Yamal from beating his marker will achieve little success if the supporting defensive movements leave another player free.
paras.zh: 如果支援的防守动作让另一名球员获得自由，那么阻止亚马尔突破盯防者将收效甚微。

paras.en: For Real Madrid fans, one glorious night at Camp Nou could be seen as a turning point.
paras.zh: 对于皇马球迷来说，诺坎普的一个辉煌夜晚可以被视为一个转折点。

paras.en: “Winning there would make me believe we can win the league, especially if we play with courage”, says Lucia Martin, a Madrid supporter.
paras.zh: “在那里获胜会让我相信我们能够赢得联赛冠军，特别是如果我们勇敢地比赛的话”，马德里球迷露西娅·马丁说道。

paras.en: The 26-year-old is travelling to Barcelona with her father to attend the game, and much of her hope rests on Mbappe, although she wants the team to share the responsibility.
paras.zh: 这位 26 岁的球员将与父亲一起前往巴塞罗那观看比赛，她的大部分希望都寄托在姆巴佩身上，尽管她希望球队能够分担责任。

paras.en: “When he gets the ball, I always think something can happen, but we can’t spend 90 minutes waiting for him to rescue us.”
paras.zh: “当他拿到球时，我总是认为可能会发生一些事情，但我们不能花 90 分钟等待他来拯救我们。”

paras.en: Despite leading all conversations around the match, Yamal and Mbappe will rarely confront each other directly; their influence will be measured in the problems they create for everyone else.
paras.zh: 尽管亚马尔和姆巴佩在比赛中主导了所有的谈话，但他们很少直接正面交锋。他们的影响力将通过他们给其他人制造的问题来衡量。

paras.en: Yamal has eight goals and six assists in nine league appearances. Mbappe has nine goals and two assists across the same number of games.
paras.zh: 亚马尔在 9 场联赛中打进 8 粒进球和 6 次助攻。姆巴佩在相同场次的比赛中打入 9 粒进球并助攻 2 次。

paras.en: One can pull defenders towards the ball before releasing a teammate, the other can force them backwards with the threat of a run.
paras.zh: 一个可以在释放队友之前将防守者拉向球，另一个可以通过跑动威胁迫使他们向后退。

paras.en: Both are nominees for the upcoming Ballon d’Or and although the match falls outside the assessment period for this year’s award, it will serve as the perfect build-up to one of the most hotly-contested awards in recent years.
paras.zh: 两人都是即将到来的金球奖的提名者，尽管这场比赛超出了今年金球奖的评估期，但它将为近年来竞争最激烈的奖项之一做好完美准备。

paras.en: Before football celebrates its outstanding performers in London, two of its strongest claimants to the title of world’s best will share a stage where reputations are tested under exceptional pressure and strengthen their claim as the world’s best.
paras.zh: 在足球界在伦敦庆祝其杰出表现之前，两位最有力的世界最佳球员将同台竞技，在巨大的压力下考验声誉，并巩固他们作为世界最佳球员的地位。

paras.en: On the eve of the Ballon d’Or, Yamal has a chance to extend Barcelona’s perfect start and deepen Madrid’s frustration.
paras.zh: 金球奖前夕，亚马尔有机会延续巴萨的完美开局，加深皇马的挫败感。

paras.en: For Mbappe, there is the opportunity to bring his team back into the race at their rival’s expense.
paras.zh: 对于姆巴佩来说，有机会以牺牲对手为代价，让他的球队重新回到比赛中。

articles.title: New York Archdiocese agrees to pay $800m to 1,300 sexual abuse survivors

paras.en: The Archdiocese of New York has agreed to pay more than $800m to settle the legal claims of about 1,300 survivors of sexual abuse by clergy.
paras.zh: 纽约总教区已同意支付超过 8 亿美元，以解决约 1,300 名神职人员性虐待幸存者的法律索赔。

paras.en: New York Archbishop Ronald Hicks said on Saturday that the settlement will be formally signed on November 6 after an agreement with the plaintiffs and their lawyers.
paras.zh: 纽约大主教罗纳德·希克斯周六表示，在与原告及其律师达成协议后，和解协议将于 11 月 6 日正式签署。
