paras.zh: 专题照片由 LordHenriVoton/iStock 提供

paras.en: Embedded images of Republican Bob Sullivan and Democrat Craig MacIntrye from their campaign websites.
paras.zh: 嵌入了共和党人鲍勃·沙利文和民主党人克雷格·麦金特里的竞选网站上的图像。

articles.title: Rivian launches invite-only Autonomy Early Access Program
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Some Rivian drivers have started receiving invites to the automaker’s Autonomy Early Access Program, according to the company’s website.
paras.zh: 据该公司网站称，一些 Rivian 司机已开始收到该汽车制造商 Autonomy Early Access 计划的邀请。

paras.en: The program is designed to test and refine pre-released driver assistance features before they roll out to the broader fleet. The features include “point-to-point” autonomy features.
paras.zh: 该计划旨在测试和完善预先发布的驾驶员辅助功能，然后再将其推广到更广泛的车队。这些功能包括“点对点”自治功能。

paras.en: All owners with an active Autonomy+ subscription can indicate their interest to join the program by applying through their Rivian account. The invitations go to a limited group of owners with high autonomy feature usage and clean recent safety record.
paras.zh: 所有拥有有效 Autonomy+ 订阅的车主都可以通过其 Rivian 帐户申请，表明有兴趣加入该计划。邀请对象是有限的拥有高度自主功能使用和近期安全记录良好的业主群体。

paras.en: It also will start with Rivian R1 Gen 2 and R2 owners in California and Florida. It will steadily expand to other states prior to a planned 2027 release, the website states.
paras.zh: 它还将从加利福尼亚州和佛罗里达州的 Rivian R1 Gen 2 和 R2 用户开始。该网站称，它将在计划 2027 年发布之前稳步扩展到其他州。

paras.en: The invitation rollout follows comments made by Rivian founder and CEO RJ Scaringe regarding the company’s plans for autonomous vehicle software during a TechCrunch Disrupt event, held last week.
paras.zh: 在此次邀请发布之前，Rivian 创始人兼首席执行官 RJ Scaringe 在上周举行的 TechCrunch Disrupt 活动中就该公司的自动驾驶汽车软件计划发表了评论。

paras.en: TechCrunch reports Scaringe said he’s willing to delay profitability to develop autonomous vehicle software for EVs. Rivian could be venturing into a different type of vehicle from its outdoorsy SUVs in the future, he said.
paras.zh: TechCrunch 报道称，斯卡林奇表示，他愿意推迟盈利时间来开发电动汽车自动驾驶软件。他表示，Rivian 未来可能会尝试推出与户外 SUV 不同类型的汽车。

paras.en: “Where it gets really interesting is when you think beyond R2 and R3 and start to imagine the form factors that you want to build for a personally owned autonomous vehicle. You know, it opens up all kinds of design opportunities. It can create dramatically different experiences,” he said in an interview with TechCrunch. “I’m wildly excited about what the next 10 years look like in transportation because of what this enables us to dream and think about.”
paras.zh: “真正有趣的是，当你超越 R2 和 R3 的思维，开始想象你想要为个人拥有的自动驾驶汽车打造的外形尺寸时。你知道，它开辟了各种设计机会。它可以创造截然不同的体验，”他在接受 TechCrunch 采访时说道。 “我对未来 10 年交通运输业的发展感到非常兴奋，因为这让我们能够梦想和思考。”

paras.en: TechCrunch states that Rivian is a few years away from reworking the company for a self-driving software. It describes Rivian’s “point-to-point’ navigation as driving without intervention but under supervision.
paras.zh: TechCrunch 表示，Rivian 距离公司改造以开发自动驾驶软件还有几年的时间。它将 Rivian 的“点对点”导航描述为无需干预但在监督下驾驶。

paras.en: Rivian is also working toward a full autonomy software that will deploy in robotaxi versions of its R2 SUV, TechCrunch reports.
paras.zh: 据 TechCrunch 报道，Rivian 还在致力于开发一款完全自主的软件，该软件将部署在其 R2 SUV 的机器人出租车版本中。

paras.en: Scaringe told TechCrunch that he believes most driving with autonomy will continue to happen in personal vehicles.
paras.zh: 斯卡林奇告诉 TechCrunch，他相信大多数自动驾驶将继续发生在私人车辆上。

paras.en: “Where it gets really interesting is when you think beyond R2 and R3 and start to imagine the form factors that you want to build for a personally owned autonomous vehicle,” he told TechCrunch. “You know, it opens up all kinds of design opportunities. It can create dramatically different experiences. I’m wildly excited about what the next 10 years look like in transportation because of what this enables us to dream and think about.”
paras.zh: “真正有趣的是，当你超越 R2 和 R3 的思维，并开始想象你想要为个人拥有的自动驾驶汽车打造的外形尺寸时，”他告诉 TechCrunch。 “你知道，它开启了各种设计机会。它可以创造截然不同的体验。我对未来 10 年交通运输的面貌感到非常兴奋，因为这让我们能够梦想和思考。”

paras.en: For information on how to participate in Rivian’s Autonomy Early Access Program visit here.
paras.zh: 有关如何参与 Rivian 的 Autonomy 早期访问计划的信息，请访问此处。

articles.title: Hyundai on child safety seat education
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Hyundai recently joined the Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) to highlight the program’s impact and provide families with hands-on safety education.
paras.zh: 现代汽车最近加入了费城儿童医院 (CHOP)，以强调该计划的影响，并为家庭提供实践安全教育。

paras.en: “Every parent and caregiver deserves access to reliable information and resources that help keep their children safe while traveling,” said Benjamin Michajlyszyn, Hyundai Motor North America safety test and investigations laboratory director, in a Hyundai press release. “Our work with Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia helps connect families with expert guidance and hands-on support, making child passenger safety education more accessible throughout the community.”
paras.zh: 现代汽车北美安全测试和调查实验室主任 Benjamin Michajlyszyn 在现代汽车新闻稿中表示：“每位家长和看护人都应该获得可靠的信息和资源，以帮助确保孩子在旅行时的安全。” “我们与费城儿童医院的合作帮助家庭获得专家指导和实践支持，使整个社区更容易接受儿童乘客安全教育。”

paras.en: According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), nearly half of child safety seats are installed incorrectly or used improperly.
paras.zh: 根据美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）的数据，近一半的儿童安全座椅安装不正确或使用不当。

paras.en: NHTSA says the most common misuse errors are:
paras.zh: NHTSA 表示，最常见的误用错误是：

paras.en: Securing children properly in age- and size-appropriate car seats can reduce the risk of fatal injury by 71% for infants younger than 1 year old and by 54% for 1- to 4-year-olds, according to NHTSA’s data.
paras.zh: 根据 NHTSA 的数据，将儿童正确固定在适合年龄和体型的汽车座椅中，可以将 1 岁以下婴儿致命伤害的风险降低 71%，将 1 至 4 岁婴儿致命伤害的风险降低 54%。

paras.en: Last week, Hyundai Hope, Hyundai Motor America’s corporate social responsibility initiative, donated $50,000 to CHOP’s Car Seat Safety for Kids program.
paras.zh: 上周，现代汽车美国公司的企业社会责任倡议 Hyundai Hope 向 CHOP 的儿童汽车座椅安全项目捐赠了 50,000 美元。

paras.en: The investment supports child passenger safety education, car seat inspections, and resources for families in the region, according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，这项投资支持儿童乘客安全教育、汽车座椅检查以及为该地区的家庭提供资源。

paras.en: “CHOP’s Car Seat Safety for Kids program teaches families how to properly install and use child safety seats through education, inspections, and one-on-one guidance from certified child passenger safety technicians,” the release states. “During child safety seat check events, technicians inspect seats for expiration dates, manufacturer recalls, and proper fit while providing hands-on instruction to parents and caregivers. Families in need may also receive replacement seats, helping to ensure children travel safely. Hyundai’s support helps expand access to these critical resources and reinforces safe transportation practices for children across the community.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“CHOP 的儿童汽车座椅安全计划通过教育、检查和经过认证的儿童乘客安全技术人员的一对一指导，教会家庭如何正确安装和使用儿童安全座椅。” “在儿童安全座椅检查活动期间，技术人员会检查座椅的有效期、制造商召回情况和是否合适，同时向家长和护理人员提供实践指导。有需要的家庭还可能会收到替换座椅，有助于确保儿童安全出行。现代汽车的支持有助于扩大对这些关键资源的获取，并加强整个社区儿童的安全交通实践。”

paras.en: Hyundai says Hyundai Hope is committed to the principle of “progress for humanity and the goal of improving the well-being of society.” It dedicates time and supplies resources to nonprofit organizations to help support the health and safety of individuals and positive growth in communities.
paras.zh: 现代汽车表示，现代希望致力于“人类进步和改善社会福祉的目标”的原则。它为非营利组织投入时间和资源，以帮助支持个人的健康和安全以及社区的积极发展。

paras.en: Since 2022, Hyundai’s support has helped CHOP provide more than 21,000 new car seats and booster seats to families in need and has helped conduct more than 2,600 child safety seat inspections, according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，自 2022 年以来，现代汽车的支持已帮助 CHOP 向有需要的家庭提供了超过 21,000 个新车座椅和加高座椅，并帮助进行了 2,600 多次儿童安全座椅检查。

paras.en: “Child passenger safety is one of the most important steps families can take to protect children every time they travel,” said Gina Duchossois, CHOP’s injury prevention manager, in the release. “Hyundai’s support enables us to provide personalized assistance to caregivers, helping ensure more children are riding safely in the right seat for their age, size, and stage of development.”
paras.zh: CHOP 伤害预防经理 Gina Duchossois 在新闻稿中表示：“儿童乘客安全是家庭每次旅行时可以采取的保护儿童的最重要措施之一。” “现代汽车的支持使我们能够为护理人员提供个性化的帮助，帮助确保更多的孩子安全地坐在适合他们年龄、体型和发育阶段的正确座椅上。”

paras.en: In August, Hyundai Hope also made $25,000 donations to child safety seat programs in Massachusetts and Washington, as well as in Metro Detroit last month and Washington, D.C., in July.
paras.zh: 8 月，现代 Hope 还向马萨诸塞州和华盛顿州以及上个月底特律大都会和 7 月华盛顿特区的儿童安全座椅项目捐赠了 25,000 美元。

paras.en: A new law took effect in Colorado earlier this year that requires insurance policies to cover the replacement of child restraint systems involved in a collision. It also requires insurers to ask a claimant if a child restraint system was in the vehicle at the time of a collision.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，科罗拉多州生效了一项新法律，要求保险单涵盖碰撞事故中儿童约束系统的更换。它还要求保险公司询问索赔人碰撞时车内是否有儿童约束系统。

paras.en: Colorado Gov. Jared Polis signed HB 25-1179 into law in April 2025. The Colorado Division of Insurance’s Department of Regulatory Agencies later issued a guidance bulletin to insurance companies.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州州长 Jared Polis 于 2025 年 4 月将 HB 25-1179 签署成为法律。科罗拉多州保险司监管机构部随后向保险公司发布了指导公告。

paras.en: Several presentations given at the 2025 SEMA Show highlighted the importance of post-collision seatbelt, steering column, and airbag inspections.
paras.zh: 2025 年 SEMA 展会上的多场演讲强调了碰撞后安全带、转向柱和安全气囊检查的重要性。

paras.en: Collision Advice’s Mike Anderson said repairers must inspect the seatbelt webbing and mounting locations. For example, this includes the latch systems — the triangle piece that mounts to the package tray where child safety seats are installed.
paras.zh: 碰撞咨询公司的迈克·安德森表示，维修人员必须检查安全带织带和安装位置。例如，这包括闩锁系统——安装在安装儿童安全座椅的行李托盘上的三角形部件。

paras.en: “Every single vehicle manufacturer says seatbelts must be inspected after a collision,” Anderson said. “Sometimes it’s not limited to just the seatbelt that was in use during the accident, but any seatbelts as well that were not in use, as well as child safety seat latches or the tether points.”
paras.zh: “每家汽车制造商都表示，碰撞后必须检查安全带，”安德森说。 “有时，它不仅限于事故期间使用的安全带，还包括未使用的任何安全带，以及儿童安全座椅闩锁或系绳点。”

paras.en: Featured image: Children are properly secured in car seats during a car seat safety event at the Middleman Family Pavilion at CHOP in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, on Oct. 17, 2026. (Credit: Hyundai)
paras.zh: 特色图片：2026 年 10 月 17 日，在宾夕法尼亚州普鲁士国王 CHOP 的 Middleman Family Pavilion 举行的汽车座椅安全活动中，儿童被妥善固定在汽车座椅上。（图片来源：现代）

articles.title: U.S. Light-Vehicle Sales Expected to Remain Low
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: U.S. light-vehicle sales are projected to reach 16.1 million units in 2026 and 16.4 million by 2030, according to Mobility Global’s latest forecast. That remains below the roughly 17 million annual sales that characterized the pre-pandemic market. Analysts at a recent Mobility Global media briefing cited affordability as the key constraint shaping buyer demand and automaker strategy.
paras.zh: 根据 Mobility Global 的最新预测，美国轻型汽车销量预计到 2026 年将达到 1,610 万辆，到 2030 年将达到 1,640 万辆。这仍低于大流行前市场约 1700 万辆的年销量。分析师在最近的 Mobility Global 媒体吹风会上指出，负担能力是影响买家需求和汽车制造商战略的关键制约因素。

paras.en: U.S. Light-Vehicle Sales Remain Below Potential
paras.zh: 美国轻型汽车销量仍低于潜在水平

paras.en: The market has struggled to return to pre-pandemic volume despite improved supply conditions. Analysts said affordability is now the primary factor limiting recovery.
paras.zh: 尽管供应状况有所改善，但市场仍难以恢复到大流行前的成交量。分析师表示，负担能力现在是限制复苏的主要因素。

paras.en: “We don’t see the U.S. returning to pre-pandemic levels of volumes,” said Peter Nagle, associate director for Americas demand forecasting. “Obviously, there is something constraining the market from those 17-million-unit thresholds that we routinely hit back in, say, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019.”
paras.zh: 美洲需求预测副总监彼得·内格尔表示：“我们认为美国的销量不会恢复到大流行前的水平。” “显然，有一些因素限制了市场的销量，比如我们在 2016 年、2017 年、2018 年、2019 年都会达到 1700 万台的门槛。”

paras.en: BEV Programs Shift as Hybrids Gain Share
paras.zh: 随着混合动力汽车份额的增加，纯电动汽车项目发生转变

paras.en: Analysts noted that recent changes to emissions and fuel economy rules have prompted automakers to adjust product plans.
paras.zh: 分析师指出，最近排放和燃油经济性规则的变化促使汽车制造商调整产品计划。

paras.en: “The resulting wave of battery-electric vehicle (BEV) cancellations may leave some suppliers wary of chasing future BEV programs,” said Eric Anderson, associate director for light vehicle powertrain forecasting.
paras.zh: 轻型汽车动力总成预测副总监埃里克·安德森 (Eric Anderson) 表示：“由此产生的电池电动汽车 (BEV) 取消浪潮可能会让一些供应商对追逐未来的 BEV 项目持谨慎态度。”

paras.en: Even so, Mobility Global said it expects North American BEV assembly to surpass 1 million units in 2027. Internal combustion engine vehicles and hybrids are expected to remain central to the market as buyers weigh cost and convenience.
paras.zh: 即便如此，Mobility Global 表示，预计 2027 年北美纯电动汽车组装量将超过 100 万辆。随着买家权衡成本和便利性，内燃机汽车和混合动力汽车预计仍将是市场的核心。

paras.en: The firm forecasts North American full hybrid electric vehicle (FHEV) assembly to exceed 3 million units in 2027. That would represent a 25% annual increase. Forecasts project FHEVs will account for nearly one-third of North American light-vehicle assembly by 2030.
paras.zh: 该公司预计，到 2027 年，北美全混合动力电动汽车 (FHEV) 装配量将超过 300 万辆。这意味着年增长率为 25%。预测到 2030 年，FHEV 将占北美轻型汽车装配量的近三分之一。

paras.en: Shifts in the powertrain mix can affect service bay needs. These include tire selection and load ratings for electrified vehicles, along with alignment and brake service intervals linked to regenerative braking and vehicle mass.
paras.zh: 动力总成组合的变化可能会影响维修站的需求。其中包括电动车辆的轮胎选择和额定载荷，以及与再生制动和车辆质量相关的定位和制动保养间隔。

paras.en: Regionalization Shapes Global Strategies
paras.zh: 区域化塑造全球战略

paras.en: Analysts discussed China’s influence on global strategies and a broader trend toward regionalization and de-globalization.
paras.zh: 分析人士讨论了中国对全球战略的影响以及区域化和去全球化的更广泛趋势。

paras.en: “The auto industry is moving toward three major regional islands,” said Joe Langley, director of research and analysis. “North America, Europe and Asia, and automakers will increasingly have to build where they sell and design for the regions they serve. The difficult part is doing that while costs continue to rise.”
paras.zh: 研究与分析总监乔·兰利表示：“汽车行业正在向三个主要区域岛屿发展。” “北美、欧洲和亚洲以及汽车制造商将越来越多地必须在其销售地点进行生产并为其服务的地区进行设计。困难的部分是在成本持续上升的情况下做到这一点。”

paras.en: Mobility Global launched FAST (Forecasting and Simulation Tool) to help organizations evaluate market shifts. Mobility Global, a provider of automotive data, intelligence and forecasting, separated from S&P Global on July 1. It now operates as an independent company focused on the mobility sector.
paras.zh: Mobility Global 推出了 FAST（预测和模拟工具）来帮助组织评估市场变化。 Mobility Global 是一家汽车数据、情报和预测提供商，于 7 月 1 日从 S&P Global 分拆。现在，它作为一家专注于移动出行领域的独立公司运营。

paras.en: “We are seeing firsthand that certainty is becoming increasingly rare, and the ability to navigate uncertainty with speed is becoming the most valuable competitive advantage in this market,” said Kristen Balasia, senior vice president of Mobility Global Planning Solutions.
paras.zh: 移动全球规划解决方案高级副总裁克里斯汀·巴拉西亚 (Kristen Balasia) 表示：“我们亲眼目睹，确定性变得越来越稀有，而快速应对不确定性的能力正在成为这个市场上最有价值的竞争优势。”

articles.title: A Look at Tirevio TPMS Sensors
articles.author: Tomorrow's Technician Staff

paras.en: Tirevio TPMS sensors are designed for aftermarket tire-pressure monitoring system service. The company also offers service kits and programming tools for technicians handling sensor failures, damaged valve stems and relearn procedures.
paras.zh: Tirevio TPMS 传感器专为售后轮胎压力监测系统服务而设计。该公司还为技术人员提供服务套件和编程工具来处理传感器故障、损坏的阀杆和重新学习程序。

paras.en: TPMS warning lights often appear when temperatures change, tire season begins or a vehicle undergoes inspection. Common service issues include depleted sensor batteries, broken valve stems, damaged sensors and unsuccessful relearns.
paras.zh: 当温度变化、轮胎换季开始或车辆接受检查时，TPMS 警告灯通常会出现。常见的服务问题包括传感器电池耗尽、阀杆损坏、传感器损坏和重新学习不成功。

paras.en: Tirevio focuses on OE-quality TPMS products developed for aftermarket applications. The company manufactures its sensors using OEM-level engineering and production processes.
paras.zh: Tirevio 专注于为售后市场应用开发的原厂品质 TPMS 产品。该公司采用 OEM 级工程和生产流程制造传感器。

paras.en: Distribution centers in Indiana and California support product availability in the United States. Tirevio’s engineering and manufacturing team has an OEM background.
paras.zh: 印第安纳州和加利福尼亚州的配送中心支持美国的产品供应。 Tirevio 的工程和制造团队具有 OEM 背景。

paras.en: The team has experience working with global vehicle manufacturers. Its experience covers passenger cars, performance vehicles and commercial applications.
paras.zh: 该团队拥有与全球汽车制造商合作的经验。其经验涵盖乘用车、高性能车辆和商业应用。

paras.en: Tirevio TPMS Sensors, Validation Testing
paras.zh: Tirevio TPMS 传感器，验证测试

paras.en: TPMS sensors operate under heat cycles, moisture, road salt, vibration and impacts from road conditions. Tirevio subjects each sensor to validation testing intended to support reliable operation.
paras.zh: TPMS 传感器在热循环、潮湿、路盐、振动和路况影响下工作。 Tirevio 对每个传感器进行验证测试，旨在支持可靠运行。

paras.en: The testing includes pressure evaluation, battery-life validation and software-coverage testing. It also includes high-temperature durability testing. Tirevio’s product range includes universal programmable sensors, service kits and TPMS programming tools powered by ATEC.
paras.zh: 测试包括压力评估、电池寿命验证和软件覆盖测试。它还包括高温耐久性测试。 Tirevio 的产品系列包括由 ATEC 提供支持的通用可编程传感器、服务套件和 TPMS 编程工具。

paras.en: Replacing service components during sensor installation can help prevent later leaks. Valve seals can dry out, valve cores can corrode and caps can seize. Tirevio offers rubber snap-in and clamp-in sensor designs. The appropriate style depends on the vehicle application.
paras.zh: 在传感器安装过程中更换维修组件有助于防止以后发生泄漏。阀门密封件可能会变干，阀芯可能会腐蚀，盖子可能会卡住。 Tirevio 提供橡胶卡入式和夹入式传感器设计。合适的样式取决于车辆应用。

paras.en: The sensors are compatible with the Tirevio TV41 tool powered by ATEC. They also work with ATEC open tools. These tools provide vehicle coverage and sensor-programming capabilities. They also allow technicians to use a familiar TPMS service process.
paras.zh: 这些传感器与由 ATEC 提供支持的 Tirevio TV41 工具兼容。他们还可以使用 ATEC 开放工具。这些工具提供车辆覆盖和传感器编程功能。它们还允许技术人员使用熟悉的 TPMS 服务流程。

paras.en: Tirevio TPMS Sensor Installation Process
paras.zh: Tirevio TPMS 传感器安装流程

paras.en: A typical replacement begins after a technician identifies a TPMS fault caused by a failed sensor battery.
paras.zh: 技术人员发现传感器电池故障导致 TPMS 故障后，通常会开始更换。

paras.en: After removing the tire from the wheel, the technician removes the existing sensor. The technician then installs the new Tirevio sensor. Correct torque on the valve hardware is important during installation. Hardware that is too loose can leak. Excessive torque can damage the sensor or wheel.
paras.zh: 从车轮上拆下轮胎后，技术人员拆下现有的传感器。然后技术人员安装新的 Tirevio 传感器。安装过程中阀门硬件上的正确扭矩非常重要。太松的硬件可能会泄漏。扭矩过大会损坏传感器或车轮。

paras.en: After installation, the technician can program and relearn the sensor with the Tirevio tool. Depending on the vehicle, the technician can clone the original sensor information. The technician can also create a new sensor ID and complete the required relearn procedure.
paras.zh: 安装后，技术人员可以使用 Tirevio 工具对传感器进行编程和重新学习。根据车辆的不同，技术人员可以克隆原始传感器信息。技术人员还可以创建新的传感器 ID 并完成所需的重新学习过程。

paras.en: Once the relearn is complete, the vehicle recognizes the replacement sensor. The TPMS warning light then turns off. Tirevio designed its TPMS sensors, service kits and tools to support repair reliability, vehicle coverage and technician workflow.
paras.zh: 重新学习完成后，车辆会识别更换的传感器。然后 TPMS 警告灯熄灭。 Tirevio 设计了 ​​TPMS 传感器、服务套件和工具，以支持维修可靠性、车辆覆盖范围和技术人员工作流程。

articles.title: Global EV Market Expected to Hit $1.31 Trillion by 2035
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Electric Vehicle Market is projected to grow from $794.59 billion in 2026 to $1,312.73 billion in 2035 at a compound annual growth rate of 5.7%, according to MarketsandMarkets.
paras.zh: 根据 MarketsandMarkets 的数据，电动汽车市场预计将从 2026 年的 7,945.9 亿美元增长到 2035 年的 13,127.3 亿美元，复合年增长率为 5.7%。

paras.en: Growth is supported by increasing consumer demand, government actions to cut transport emissions, and advancements in batteries and charging that enable higher ranges, lower costs and faster charging. Volatile fuel prices are strengthening the economic case for EVs as they generally have lower operating costs than internal combustion engine vehicles. The International Energy Agency (IEA) estimates that higher oil prices in 2026 raised annual fuel cost savings from driving an EV in the European Union by 35% compared with 2025, while EV sales increased strongly in several markets during the second quarter of 2026.
paras.zh: 消费者需求的增加、政府减少交通排放的行动以及电池和充电技术的进步（可实现更大的续航里程、更低的成本和更快的充电）都支持了增长。波动的燃油价格增强了电动汽车的经济理由，因为它们的运营成本通常比内燃机汽车低。国际能源署 (IEA) 估计，2026 年油价上涨将使欧盟驾驶电动汽车的年度燃油成本比 2025 年节省 35%，而 2026 年第二季度多个市场的电动汽车销量强劲增长。

paras.en: Global EV Sales, Model Availability, and Charging Expansion
paras.zh: 全球电动汽车销量、车型可用性和充电扩展

paras.en: Global electric car sales exceeded 20 million units in 2025, up 20% year over year, with EVs accounting for one in four new cars sold worldwide, according to the MarketsandMarkets report. Consumer acceptance is broadening as model availability, affordability, driving range, and charging access improve.
paras.zh: 根据 MarketsandMarkets 的报告，到 2025 年，全球电动汽车销量将超过 2000 万辆，同比增长 20%，其中电动汽车占全球新车销量的四分之一。随着车型可用性、可承受性、行驶里程和充电接入的改善，消费者的接受度正在扩大。

paras.en: Nearly 1,000 electric car models were available globally in 2025. The number of EV models in India increased from 33 to 45 between 2024 and 2025. Charging infrastructure development is improving access along long-distance travel corridors, supporting adoption. Advances in energy-dense batteries, thermal management, power electronics, and lightweight designs are enabling products that meet wider consumer requirements.
paras.zh: 到 2025 年，全球将推出近 1,000 款电动汽车车型。2024 年至 2025 年间，印度的电动汽车车型数量从 33 款增加到 45 款。充电基础设施的发展正在改善长途旅行走廊沿线的交通，支持电动汽车的普及。高能量密度电池、热管理、电力电子和轻量化设计的进步使产品能够满足更广泛的消费者需求。

paras.en: Component Demand and Platform Strategies
paras.zh: 组件需求和平台策略

paras.en: As the market evolves, both plug-in hybrid and fully electric platforms are creating overlapping demand for components. This is increasing the use of conventional powertrain parts alongside EV-specific solutions such as lithium iron phosphate battery packs, high-efficiency inverters, and advanced cooling systems.
paras.zh: 随着市场的发展，插电式混合动力和全电动平台都对零部件产生了重叠的需求。这增加了传统动力总成部件以及电动汽车专用解决方案的使用，例如磷酸铁锂电池组、高效逆变器和先进的冷却系统。

paras.en: Automakers are expanding model portfolios across sizes and body types while balancing affordability, performance, range, and reliability.
paras.zh: 汽车制造商正在扩大不同尺寸和车身类型的车型组合，同时平衡经济性、性能、续航里程和可靠性。

paras.en: OEM Investments, Partnerships and Policy Support
paras.zh: OEM投资、合作和政策支持

paras.en: OEMs are making targeted investments to address cost and adoption challenges. Tesla is expanding localized battery production with its Gigafactories in the United States and Mexico, while Volkswagen is investing in software-driven energy management systems to optimize efficiency. Hyundai is building scalable EV platforms to serve multiple vehicle types across regions.
paras.zh: OEM 正在进行有针对性的投资，以解决成本和采用方面的挑战。特斯拉正在通过其位于美国和墨西哥的超级工厂扩大本地化电池生产，而大众汽车正在投资软件驱动的能源管理系统以优化效率。现代汽车正在构建可扩展的电动汽车平台，以服务于跨地区的多种车型。

paras.en: Partnerships between automakers and suppliers are growing to overcome supply chain disruptions, meet safety standards, and enhance performance. Combined with government incentives, tax credits, and rising consumer awareness, these developments are reshaping mobility trends and reinforcing the long-term EV outlook.
paras.zh: 汽车制造商和供应商之间的合作伙伴关系正在不断发展，以克服供应链中断、满足安全标准并提高绩效。结合政府激励措施、税收抵免和消费者意识的提高，这些发展正在重塑出行趋势并强化电动汽车的长期前景。

paras.en: IEA Outlook: EV Share of Global Sales in 2026
paras.zh: IEA 展望：2026 年电动汽车占全球销量的份额

paras.en: According to the IEA, global electric vehicle sales are projected to account for 29% of total car sales worldwide in 2026, driven by a second-quarter surge and shifting consumer habits amid fluctuating energy markets.
paras.zh: IEA 预计，受第二季度销量激增以及能源市场波动中消费者习惯转变的推动，到 2026 年，全球电动汽车销量预计将占全球汽车总销量的 29%。

paras.en: - More than 20 million electric cars were sold globally in 2025, representing 25% of new car sales. The important implication is that EVs are no longer limited to a small premium segment. Growth is increasingly being supported by greater model availability, improving affordability, and stronger competition among manufacturers.
paras.zh: - 2025年全球电动汽车销量将超过2000万辆，占新车销量的25%。重要的含义是电动汽车不再局限于小型高端市场。增长越来越受到更多型号可用性、提高可承受性以及制造商之间更激烈竞争的支持。

paras.en: - Electric car sales outside the three major markets reached 2 million in 2025, up almost 50%. In emerging and developing economies excluding China, sales increased about 80%, largely because lower-cost Chinese EVs are expanding consumer access to electric cars.
paras.zh: - 2025年三大市场以外的电动汽车销量将达到200万辆，增长近50%。在除中国之外的新兴和发展中经济体，销量增长了约 80%，这主要是因为成本较低的中国电动汽车正在扩大消费者对电动汽车的接触。

paras.en: - Europe illustrates the policy effect, with sales increasing more than 30% following the implementation of stricter EU CO2 standards. Germany also benefited from more affordable EV models, which contributed to a roughly 6% decline in average BEV prices. This suggests that future market expansion will depend not only on incentives but also on manufacturers’ ability to offer cost-competitive EVs across mainstream segments.
paras.zh: - 欧洲体现了政策效应，在实施更严格的欧盟二氧化碳标准后，销售额增长了30%以上。德国还受益于更实惠的电动汽车车型，这导致纯电动汽车平均价格下降了约 6%。这表明未来的市场扩张不仅取决于激励措施，还取决于制造商在主流细分市场提供具有成本竞争力的电动汽车的能力。

paras.en: The battery electric vehicle segment is expected to remain the largest growth area as improvements in battery economics and charging performance address key barriers to mass adoption. Global EV battery deployment increased almost 30% to 1.2 TWh in 2025, while average battery prices declined 8%.
paras.zh: 随着电池经济性和充电性能的改善解决了大规模采用的主要障碍，电池电动汽车领域预计仍将是最大的增长领域。 2025 年，全球电动汽车电池部署量增加近 30%，达到 1.2 TWh，而平均电池价格下降 8%。

paras.en: According to the International Energy Agency, LFP batteries accounted for more than 55% of global EV battery deployment in 2025, up from nearly 50% in 2024.
paras.zh: 根据国际能源署的数据，到 2025 年，磷酸铁锂电池将占全球电动汽车电池部署量的 55% 以上，高于 2024 年的近 50%。

articles.title: Turning ADAS Calibration into a Competitive Advantage
articles.author: ImportCar Staff Writers

paras.en: See how Zimbrick of Madison transformed its approach to ADAS calibration by bringing more of the process in-house. With three body shops, 16 automotive brands and a centralized glass and calibration center, Zimbrick partnered with National Calibration and Diagnostic Solutions (NCDS) and Autel to build a more controlled and scalable calibration workflow. The video explores how the right equipment, training and support can help collision repair facilities improve efficiency, documentation, repair quality and customer communication while keeping up with increasingly complex vehicle technology.
paras.zh: 了解 Zimbrick of Madison 如何通过将更多流程引入内部来改变其 ADAS 校准方法。 Zimbrick 拥有 3 个车身修理厂、16 个汽车品牌以及一个集中式玻璃和校准中心，与国家校准和诊断解决方案 (NCDS) 以及 Autel 合作，构建了更加受控和可扩展的校准工作流程。该视频探讨了正确的设备、培训和支持如何帮助碰撞修复机构提高效率、文档记录、维修质量和客户沟通，同时跟上日益复杂的车辆技术的步伐。

paras.en: - Bringing ADAS calibration in-house: Zimbrick reduced its reliance on outside vendors to gain greater control over scanning, calibration and the overall repair process.
paras.zh: - 将 ADAS 校准引入内部：Zimbrick 减少了对外部供应商的依赖，以更好地控制扫描、校准和整个维修过程。

paras.en: - Centralizing calibration services: A hub-and-spoke model allows three body shops to work with a centralized calibration center while maintaining consistent processes.
paras.zh: - 集中校准服务：中心辐射模型允许三个车身修理厂与集中校准中心合作，同时保持一致的流程。

paras.en: - Improving repair quality and accountability: In-house capabilities give Zimbrick greater visibility into technician training, OEM procedures, documentation and how calibrations are completed.
paras.zh: - 提高维修质量和问责制：内部能力使 Zimbrick 能够更好地了解技术人员培训、OEM 程序、文档以及如何完成校准。

paras.en: - Combining glass and calibration: Locating glass replacement and ADAS calibration together allows Zimbrick to complete more windshield installations and calibrations on the same day.
paras.zh: - 将玻璃和校准相结合：将玻璃更换和 ADAS 校准结合在一起，使 Zimbrick 能够在同一天完成更多挡风玻璃安装和校准。

paras.en: - Training the entire team: Education extends beyond technicians to estimators, helping staff better understand ADAS requirements and explain necessary procedures to customers.
paras.zh: - 培训整个团队：教育范围从技术人员延伸到估算人员，帮助员工更好地了解 ADAS 要求并向客户解释必要的程序。

paras.en: - Building customer confidence: Employees can explain why a calibration is required, what equipment is being used and how the procedure fits into a complete repair rather than simply presenting an additional charge.
paras.zh: - 建立客户信心：员工可以解释为什么需要校准、使用什么设备以及该程序如何适应完整的维修，而不是简单地收取额外费用。

paras.en: - Getting more from ADAS technology: Autel equipment provides diagnostic, calibration and documentation capabilities, while NCDS provides tooling recommendations, training, workflow guidance and ongoing technical support.
paras.zh: - 从 ADAS 技术中获得更多收益：Autel 设备提供诊断、校准和文档功能，而 NCDS 提供工具建议、培训、工作流程指导和持续的技术支持。

paras.en: - Creating a scalable operation: With approximately 400 repair orders moving through the operation each month, bringing scans and calibrations under Zimbrick’s control helps turn a necessary repair procedure into an opportunity for greater efficiency and additional in-house service.
paras.zh: - 创建可扩展的运营：每个月约有 400 个维修订单通过运营，将扫描和校准置于 Zimbrick 的控制之下有助于将必要的维修程序转变为提高效率和额外内部服务的机会。

paras.en: The RAPA solenoid valve block adds a replacement option across several luxury SUV applications. Confirm the specific vehicle and year before ordering.
paras.zh: RAPA 电磁阀块为多种豪华 SUV 应用添加了替换选项。订购前请确认具体车辆和年份。

articles.title: How the Alignment Process is Changing
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: If you were working in an alignment pit before the 1980s, obtaining the initial angles was a relatively easy process because most vehicles had steel wheels. Mounting the alignment “sensor” with rim clamps provided a very accurate representation of the front wheels’ planes of rotation for measuring camber, caster and toe. However, because the tools used to measure these angles were contained inside the sensor head, they were very fragile and frequently fell out of calibration.
paras.zh: 如果您在 20 世纪 80 年代之前在对准坑中工作，获得初始角度是一个相对容易的过程，因为大多数车辆都配有钢轮。用轮辋夹具安装对准“传感器”可以非常准确地表示前轮的旋转平面，以测量外倾角、主销后倾角和前束角。然而，由于用于测量这些角度的工具包含在传感器头内，因此它们非常脆弱并且经常无法校准。

paras.en: By the 1980s, more vehicles were being equipped with cast-alloy wheels that did not have a suitable lip for mounting the sensor head. Getting a secure grip on the rim became more difficult. It was not uncommon for a rim clamp to come off during an alignment and damage the expensive head.
paras.zh: 到 20 世纪 80 年代，越来越多的车辆配备了铸造合金车轮，但这些车轮没有合适的唇缘来安装传感器头。牢固地抓住轮缘变得更加困难。轮辋夹在对准过程中脱落并损坏昂贵的云台的情况并不罕见。

paras.en: In the 1990s, alignment technology began to change with improvements in digital cameras. Engineers started mounting cameras to fixtures positioned in front of the vehicle. The expensive sensors at the wheels were replaced with simple targets that the cameras could scan to determine the alignment angles.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代，随着数码相机的改进，对准技术开始发生变化。工程师开始将摄像头安装到车辆前方的固定装置上。车轮上昂贵的传感器被简单的目标取代，摄像机可以扫描这些目标以确定对准角度。

paras.en: However, cameras added a new wrinkle to the alignment process: the rolling-compensation procedure. This procedure also helped resolve problems caused by attaching alignment targets to alloy wheels.
paras.zh: 然而，相机给对准过程增加了一个新的问题：滚动补偿程序。此过程还有助于解决因将对准目标连接到合金轮毂而引起的问题。

paras.en: Nearly every modern chassis alignment system uses this step to obtain accurate alignment measurements. First, the vehicle is positioned 12 to 20 inches behind the front turntables. Most systems require the targets to be attached so that a specified part of each target is level with the center of the wheel. The vehicle is then rolled forward onto the turntables. This process is called rolling compensation.
paras.zh: 几乎每个现代底盘对准系统都使用此步骤来获得准确的对准测量结果。首先，车辆位于前转盘后方 12 至 20 英寸处。大多数系统要求连接目标，以便每个目标的指定部分与车轮中心齐平。然后车辆向前滚动到转盘上。这个过程称为滚动补偿。

paras.en: Modern camera-based aligners attach a target to each wheel, and the vehicle is rolled backward or forward a short distance while the cameras track each target through part of a wheel revolution.
paras.zh: 现代基于摄像头的定位器将一个目标固定在每个车轮上，车辆向后或向前滚动一小段距离，同时摄像头通过车轮旋转的一部分跟踪每个目标。

paras.en: As the wheel rotates, the aligner observes the path traveled by the target. The system detects changes in the target’s orientation or the center of the wheel’s rotation caused by clamp runout, wheel damage or an off-center target. From these observations, the software calculates the relationship between the target and the wheel’s actual plane of rotation. This prevents a slightly crooked clamp or target from being interpreted as camber or toe.
paras.zh: 当车轮旋转时，对准器会观察目标的行进路径。该系统可检测由于夹具跳动、车轮损坏或目标偏心导致的目标方向或车轮旋转中心的变化。根据这些观察结果，软件计算目标与车轮实际旋转平面之间的关系。这可以防止稍微弯曲的夹具或目标被解释为外倾或趾部。

paras.en: The primary purpose of rolling compensation is to establish the true rotational plane and centerline of each wheel while compensating for target or clamp mounting errors. Camber and toe can then be calculated directly. Caster and steering-axis inclination require a separate steering sweep.
paras.zh: 滚动补偿的主要目的是建立每个车轮的真实旋转平面和中心线，同时补偿目标或夹具安装误差。然后可以直接计算外倾角和前束角。主销后倾角和转向轴倾斜度需要单独的转向扫描。

paras.en: Some systems do not require rolling compensation. These systems typically use lasers, mirrors or other devices mounted near the center of the lift to calculate the alignment angles. On some heavy-duty alignment systems, the target or sensor is mounted directly to the spindle.
paras.zh: 有些系统不需要滚动补偿。这些系统通常使用安装在电梯中心附近的激光器、镜子或其他设备来计算对准角度。在一些重型对准系统上，目标或传感器直接安装到主轴上。

paras.en: With today’s electronic parking brakes and advanced driver-assistance systems, including collision-mitigation systems, the alignment process is becoming more challenging.
paras.zh: 凭借当今的电子驻车制动器和先进的驾驶员辅助系统（包括碰撞缓解系统），对准过程变得更具挑战性。

paras.en: Even pulling a vehicle onto an alignment rack can be a struggle. We recently had a 2024 Audi Q4 come into our training center. As the technician began driving the vehicle onto the ramps of the drive-on lift, the car applied the brakes, stopped and displayed a collision warning on the instrument panel. The technician applied the accelerator, and the vehicle eventually began moving again.
paras.zh: 即使将车辆拉到对准架上也可能很困难。最近，我们的培训中心迎来了一辆 2024 款奥迪 Q4。当技术人员开始将车辆开上行车电梯的坡道时，汽车踩下刹车，停下来，并在仪表板上显示碰撞警告。技术人员踩下油门，车辆最终再次开始行驶。

paras.en: Even after reviewing the service information, it was unclear what caused this behavior. Was the alignment equipment interfering with the vehicle’s sensors, or was the system reacting to the proximity of the wall and toolbox in front of the vehicle? Were the lasers on the cameras causing the issue?
paras.zh: 即使在查看了服务信息后，也不清楚是什么原因导致了这种行为。对准设备是否干扰了车辆的传感器，或者系统是否对车辆前方的墙壁和工具箱附近做出了反应？相机上的激光是否导致了该问题？

paras.en: We had a similar incident with a 2023 Ford F-150 that bucked like a bronco (not a Ford Bronco) while we were positioning it on a drive-on lift. Once again, neither the service information nor the owner’s manual clearly explained the behavior.
paras.zh: 我们的 2023 款福特 F-150 也发生过类似事件，当我们将其放置在驾驶式升降机上时，它像野马（不是福特野马）一样颠簸。再次，服务信息和用户手册都没有明确解释该行为。

paras.en: Most other late-model vehicles with collision-mitigation systems that we have driven onto the same lift issue audible and visual warnings when they detect what they interpret as a possible threat in the bay. However, they rarely intervene and stop the vehicle.
paras.zh: 我们驾驶到同一电梯上的大多数其他带有碰撞缓解系统的新型车辆，当它们检测到海湾中可能存在的威胁时，都会发出声音和视觉警告。然而，他们很少干预并停车。

paras.en: Even more challenging are the procedures for preparing a vehicle for an alignment when it must be moved during rolling compensation. The primary difficulties involve keeping the parking brake released and the transmission in neutral.
paras.zh: 更具挑战性的是在滚动补偿过程中必须移动车辆时准备车辆对准的程序。主要的困难在于保持驻车制动器释放以及变速器处于空档。

paras.en: Many modern vehicles use electronic parking brakes that engage automatically when the vehicle is parked. Some systems do this for safety, while others use the parking brake to prevent slight vehicle movement before the transmission’s parking pawl fully engages.
paras.zh: 许多现代车辆都使用电子驻车制动器，在车辆停车时自动接合。有些系统这样做是为了安全，而另一些系统则使用驻车制动器来防止车辆在变速箱驻车棘爪完全接合之前发生轻微移动。

paras.en: Even if the transmission is placed in neutral and the ignition is switched off using a push button or physical key, the parking brake may engage automatically without any action from the driver.
paras.zh: 即使变速箱处于空档并且使用按钮或物理钥匙关闭点火装置，驻车制动器也可能会自动接合，而无需驾驶员进行任何操作。

paras.en: On many vehicles, the driver’s gear selection does not have final authority. Even after neutral is selected, a control module may shift the transmission into park when it detects certain conditions, such as an open driver’s door or an unbuckled seat belt.
paras.zh: 在许多车辆上，驾驶员的档位选择没有最终决定权。即使选择空档后，控制模块在检测到某些条件（例如驾驶员车门打开或安全带未扣）时也可能会将变速箱切换至驻车档。

paras.en: Modern transmissions use electronic driver interfaces and communicate with numerous other vehicle systems. This integration has made selecting neutral—and keeping the transmission in neutral—more challenging.
paras.zh: 现代变速箱使用电子驾驶员接口并与许多其他车辆系统进行通信。这种集成使得选择空档并保持变速箱处于空档变得更具挑战性。

paras.en: Working around systems designed to protect the driver requires awareness, accurate information and, in some cases, a scan tool. Many vehicles have built-in procedures or operating modes that allow them to remain in neutral and roll freely. The challenge is finding the correct procedure.
paras.zh: 围绕旨在保护驾驶员的系统工作需要意识、准确的信息，在某些情况下还需要扫描工具。许多车辆都有内置程序或操作模式，使它们能够保持空档并自由行驶。挑战在于找到正确的程序。

paras.en: Many late-model Ford vehicles have a Stay in Neutral or Temporary Neutral mode that remains active for a limited period. Depending on the vehicle, the mode may be engaged by holding the brake pedal, selecting neutral and pressing the manual-mode or low-range button when prompted.
paras.zh: 许多新款福特汽车都具有“保持空档”或“临时空档”模式，该模式在有限的时间内保持活动状态。根据车辆的不同，可以通过按住制动踏板、选择空档并在出现提示时按下手动模式或低档按钮来启用该模式。

paras.en: Some Tesla alignment procedures require the technician to buckle the front seat belts and manually close the front door latches before placing the vehicle in neutral. This prevents the vehicle from determining that the occupants have exited and automatically applying park or the electronic parking brake.
paras.zh: 一些特斯拉对准程序要求技术人员扣好前排安全带并手动关闭前门锁，然后再将车辆置于空档。这可以防止车辆确定乘员已离开并自动应用驻车或电子驻车制动器。

paras.en: Other vehicles allow technicians to activate these modes through the infotainment system. Some require a particular sequence of button presses to keep the transmission in neutral and the electronic parking brake released. Instructions for these procedures may be found in the service information or owner’s manual.
paras.zh: 其他车辆允许技术人员通过信息娱乐系统激活这些模式。有些需要按特定顺序的按钮来保持变速箱处于空档并释放电子驻车制动器。这些程序的说明可以在服务信息或用户手册中找到。

paras.en: In other cases, a scan tool with bidirectional controls or dedicated service functions may be needed to select neutral, place the braking system in a service mode or release the electronic parking brake. Regardless of the method, technicians must follow the manufacturer’s instructions and use wheel chocks whenever the vehicle is not being moved for the rolling-compensation procedure.
paras.zh: 在其他情况下，可能需要具有双向控制或专用服务功能的扫描工具来选择空档、将制动系统置于服务模式或释放电子驻车制动器。无论采用哪种方法，技术人员都必须遵循制造商的说明，并在不移动车辆进行滚动补偿程序时使用车轮楔块。

paras.en: It is easy to see that alignment and ADAS calibration are beginning to merge into a single service as chassis alignment and ADAS sensor positioning become increasingly dependent on each other. One area that is currently growing is the integration of vehicle communication capabilities into the alignment and calibration bay. As more late-model vehicles come out of warranty, alignment service will require an even more increased use of scan tools to initiate adjustments and calibrations.
paras.zh: 很容易看出，随着底盘对准和 ADAS 传感器定位变得越来越相互依赖，对准和 ADAS 校准开始合并为一项服务。目前正在发展的一个领域是将车辆通信功能集成到对准和校准台中。随着越来越多的新型车辆超出保修期，对准服务将需要更多地使用扫描工具来启动调整和校准。

articles.title: Autel Drives a New Era in A/C Diagnostics
articles.author: Autel

paras.en: An A/C complaint used to mean an uncomfortable customer. On a vehicle whose thermal system also helps cool batteries, power electronics and other critical components, it can mean compromised performance—or a vehicle that cannot complete the trip. The responsibility has changed. Gary DeLuca believes the industry’s approach to diagnosing the system is overdue for a change, too.
paras.zh: 空调投诉过去意味着顾客感到不舒服。对于热系统还有助于冷却电池、电力电子设备和其他关键部件的车辆来说，这可能意味着性能受损，或者车辆无法完成行程。责任变了。加里·德卢卡 (Gary DeLuca) 认为，行业诊断系统的方法也早就该改变了。

paras.en: Autel is taking on that challenge with the new MaxiHVAC AC909 Advanced A/C Diagnostic System and a full day of advanced HVAC and thermal-management training on Friday, October 30, in Port Washington, New York. For technicians and educators, the event offers a rare opportunity to learn directly from DeLuca, the Autel U.S. founder who spearheaded the tool’s development, and understand the diagnostic strategy behind it. Join Autel’s advanced HVAC training October 30, 8 a.m.–6 p.m., at the Hilton Garden Inn Roslyn in Port Washington, NY. Tickets are $249, including meals. Seating is limited. Register at autel.cc/hvac-training-ny.
paras.zh: Autel 将于 10 月 30 日星期五在纽约华盛顿港通过全新 MaxiHVAC AC909 高级空调诊断系统以及一整天的高级 HVAC 和热管理培训来迎接这一挑战。对于技术人员和教育工作者来说，此次活动提供了一个难得的机会，可以直接向该工具开发的 Autel 美国创始人 DeLuca 学习，并了解其背后的诊断策略。参加 Autel 于 10 月 30 日上午 8 点至下午 6 点在纽约州华盛顿港罗斯林希尔顿花园酒店举办的高级 HVAC 培训。票价249美元，含餐。座位有限。请在 autel.cc/hvac-training-ny 上注册。

paras.en: “The training and the testing equipment needed to properly diagnose these HVAC, now thermal-management systems have not kept up with the technology over the last 25 years,” DeLuca said.
paras.zh: “正确诊断这些 HVAC 所需的培训和测试设备，现在的热管理系统在过去 25 年里已经跟不上技术的发展了，”DeLuca 说。

paras.en: For a technician facing a difficult cooling complaint, that gap means more time spent trying to reconcile gauge readings, scan data and component behavior. For a shop owner, it can mean an unresolved repair, another comeback or advanced work leaving the shop. Autel’s answer is to bring the precision and diagnostic discipline of commercial HVAC into automotive service—and put the technician’s understanding of the system at the center of the process.
paras.zh: 对于面临棘手的冷却投诉的技术人员来说，这种差距意味着需要花费更多时间来协调仪表读数、扫描数据和组件行为。对于店主来说，这可能意味着未解决的维修、再次卷土重来或高级工作离开店。 Autel 的答案是将商用 HVAC 的精确性和诊断原理引入汽车服务中，并将技术人员对系统的理解置于流程的中心。

paras.en: This is familiar territory for Autel. The company has built a history of industry disruption by challenging established ways of working and putting more capability into technicians’ hands. Its TPMS tools have simplified sensor programming and relearns. Its diagnostic tablets have expanded independent shops’ access to vehicle information and testing. Its camera-based ADAS positioning systems have brought guided optical measurement to the demanding work of calibration setup. Each advancement has helped shops take on increasingly complex service with greater confidence.
paras.zh: 这是 Autel 熟悉的领域。该公司通过挑战既定的工作方式并将更多能力交给技术人员，创造了行业颠覆的历史。其 TPMS 工具简化了传感器编程和重新学习。其诊断平板电脑扩大了独立商店获取车辆信息和测试的范围。其基于摄像头的 ADAS 定位系统将引导光学测量带入了要求严格的校准设置工作中。每一项进步都帮助商店更有信心地承担日益复杂的服务。

paras.en: DeLuca has been part of that work throughout. He led Autel U.S. through its formative years and has contributed his repair and teaching experience to the engineering and development of Autel’s tools and diagnostic tablets. His understanding of what happens in the bay has helped shape what those tools test, how they present information and how they guide the technician toward a repair decision.
paras.zh: 德卢卡自始至终都参与了这项工作。他领导 Autel 美国公司度过了其形成时期，并将他的维修和教学经验贡献给了 Autel 工具和诊断平板电脑的工程和开发。他对海湾中发生的情况的了解有助于确定这些工具的测试内容、它们如何呈现信息以及它们如何指导技术人员做出维修决策。

paras.en: DeLuca first crossed paths with Autel’s future global leadership at industry events and trade shows and began working with them to develop products built around technicians’ real-world needs. The company’s beginnings were modest: Autel U.S. launched in 2011 with a handful of employees. DeLuca helped build that operation into a growing diagnostic-tool company, grounding its development in the needs of working technicians.
paras.zh: DeLuca 首次在行业活动和贸易展览中与 Autel 未来的全球领导层相遇，并开始与他们合作开发围绕技术人员实际需求的产品。该公司成立之初并不起眼：Autel U.S. 于 2011 年成立，当时只有少数员工。德卢卡帮助将该公司打造成一家不断发展的诊断工具公司，将其发展立足于工作技术人员的需求。

paras.en: His own foundation was the repair shop. DeLuca began working in his father’s shop at age 12, earned an Automotive Technology degree from Morrisville College, and spent more than 40 years as a shop owner and trainer. With more than 50 years of automotive repair and education experience, including A/C and commercial HVAC, he brings both technical knowledge and a teacher’s determination to make it useful.
paras.zh: 他自己的基金会是修理厂。 DeLuca 12 岁时开始在父亲的商店工作，在莫里斯维尔学院获得汽车技术学位，并担任商店老板和培训师超过 40 年。他拥有 50 多年的汽车维修和教育经验，包括空调和商用暖通空调，他带来了技术知识和教师使其有用的决心。

paras.en: “At my core, I am a teacher and an educator. My success is based on change, and if we don’t change, we are not going to go forward,” said DeLuca.
paras.zh: “从本质上讲，我是一名教师和教育家。我的成功基于变革，如果我们不变革，我们就不会前进，”德卢卡说。

paras.en: That outlook drove the AC909 from initial concept through the development of a functioning system. Technicians were telling DeLuca they needed help finding the cause of difficult complaints, locating leaks and reducing comebacks. Meanwhile, the systems themselves were becoming more demanding: variable-displacement and electric compressors, electronically controlled expansion valves, chillers, heat exchangers and multiple thermal circuits. Depending on the vehicle, thermal management can serve the cabin, battery, inverter, drive motor and heat-sensitive electronics.
paras.zh: 这种前景推动了 AC909 从最初的概念到功能系统的开发。技术人员告诉德卢卡，他们需要帮助找到棘手投诉的原因、定位泄漏并减少问题再次发生。与此同时，系统本身的要求也变得越来越高：可变排量和电动压缩机、电控膨胀阀、冷水机、热交换器和多个热回路。根据车辆的不同，热管理可以服务于驾驶室、电池、逆变器、驱动电机和热敏电子设备。

paras.en: “A complete professional A/C service goes far beyond refrigerant removal, recycling and recharging,” DeLuca said. Refrigerant-handling equipment performs an essential service function. Finding the cause of a performance problem requires another level of investigation: understanding how pressures, temperatures, airflow and electronic controls affect one another. That is the diagnostic skill Autel set out to strengthen with the AC909.
paras.zh: “完整的专业空调服务远远超出了制冷剂去除、回收和充电的范围，”德卢卡说。制冷剂处理设备执行基本的服务功能。查找性能问题的原因需要进行另一层次的调查：了解压力、温度、气流和电子控制如何相互影响。这就是 Autel 打算通过 AC909 来加强的诊断技能。

paras.en: A compressor may be underperforming because of an internal fault, an electrical problem or the command it is receiving. A cabin cooling complaint may involve airflow or blend-door operation even when the refrigerant circuit is functioning. The technician needs to see both what the vehicle is asking the system to do and what the system is actually doing. The AC909 connects those two sides of the diagnosis.
paras.zh: 压缩机可能由于内部故障、电气问题或其接收的命令而表现不佳。即使制冷剂回路正在运行，机舱冷却投诉也可能涉及气流或混合门操作。技术人员需要了解车辆要求系统做什么以及系统实际在做什么。 AC909 连接了诊断的这两个方面。

paras.en: The AC909 was developed to give technicians the measurements and system insight needed to make those decisions. Refrigerant pressures, temperatures, humidity and other physical measurements appear alongside supported vehicle diagnostic data on a single graphical analysis screen. Illustrated procedures and dedicated component tests help technicians evaluate operation, isolate faults and verify the repair. The approach pairs guided testing with the information technicians need to understand why a result matters and what to investigate next.
paras.zh: AC909 的开发旨在为技术人员提供做出这些决策所需的测量和系统洞察力。制冷剂压力、温度、湿度和其他物理测量值与支持的车辆诊断数据一起显示在单个图形分析屏幕上。图示程序和专用组件测试可帮助技术人员评估操作、隔离故障并验证修复情况。该方法将引导测试与信息技术人员配对，以了解结果为何重要以及下一步要调查什么。

paras.en: DeLuca’s strategy considers four connected areas: the electrical, refrigerant, air and coolant loops. That means checking vehicle modules for trouble codes and relevant live data, evaluating refrigerant-system efficiency, verifying airflow and blend-door operation, and considering coolant temperatures and operating conditions where applicable.
paras.zh: DeLuca 的战略考虑了四个互联领域：电力、制冷剂、空气和冷却剂回路。这意味着检查车辆模块的故障代码和相关实时数据，评估制冷剂系统效率，验证气流和混合门操作，并在适用的情况下考虑冷却剂温度和操作条件。

paras.en: The AC909D package also brings commercial HVAC testing practices into the automotive workflow. A Bluetooth-enabled NAVAC vacuum pump and digital micron gauge provide live vacuum measurements on the tablet. Micron measurement and decay testing give technicians a measurable basis for evaluating evacuation and system readiness. Nitrogen and forming gas testing accurately support leak diagnosis before charging.
paras.zh: AC909D 套件还将商业 HVAC 测试实践引入汽车工作流程。支持蓝牙的 NAVAC 真空泵和数字微米计可在平板电脑上提供实时真空测量。微米测量和衰减测试为技术人员评估疏散和系统准备情况提供了可测量的基础。氮气和合成气体测试可准确支持充电前的泄漏诊断。

paras.en: The goal is a repair process technicians can follow from the initial complaint through final verification. For shop owners, that means an opportunity to reduce unnecessary parts replacement and repeated labor, use refrigerant more carefully and equip their teams to retain more demanding thermal-management work.
paras.zh: 目标是技术人员可以遵循从最初投诉到最终验证的维修流程。对于店主来说，这意味着有机会减少不必要的零件更换和重复劳动，更谨慎地使用制冷剂，并让他们的团队能够完成要求更高的热管理工作。

paras.en: The response has reinforced the need for training. DeLuca describes interest in the AC909 as “phenomenal,” with technicians and college instructors traveling from across the country to attend. In evaluations at Pittsburg State University, faculty and students benchmarked properly operating systems and tested vehicles with poor A/C performance. Scott Norman, professor and Automotive Technology Program Coordinator, described the AC909 as “like going from DOS to Windows” and “a huge game changer in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: 这一反应强化了培训的必要性。 DeLuca 形容人们对 AC909 的兴趣是“非凡的”，技术人员和大学讲师从全国各地赶来参加。在匹兹堡州立大学的评估中，教师和学生对正确的操作系统进行了基准测试，并测试了空调性能较差的车辆。教授兼汽车技术项目协调员 Scott Norman 将 AC909 描述为“就像从 DOS 到 Windows”和“汽车行业的巨大游戏规则改变者”。

paras.en: On October 30, DeLuca will teach the approach behind that change. The program will cover vehicle data and physical measurements, pressure and temperature relationships, humidity analysis, component testing, new leak-detection techniques, and thermal-management strategies for conventional vehicles, hybrids and EVs, including heat pumps.
paras.zh: 10 月 30 日，DeLuca 将教授这一变革背后的方法。该计划将涵盖传统车辆、混合动力汽车和电动汽车（包括热泵）的车辆数据和物理测量、压力和温度关系、湿度分析、部件测试、新泄漏检测技术以及热管理策略。

paras.en: That same emphasis on understanding will guide the training. Attendees will learn how to connect a test result to system behavior and a repair decision. For DeLuca, restoring the diagnostic discipline of A/C service and preparing technicians for modern thermal management are part of the same job: teaching people to measure, analyze, repair and verify with confidence.
paras.zh: 同样强调理解也将指导培训。与会者将学习如何将测试结果与系统行为和修复决策联系起来。对于德卢卡来说，恢复空调服务的诊断规则和为现代热管理技术人员做好准备是同一项工作的一部分：教人们自信地测量、分析、维修和验证。

paras.en: “This event will start the new era of change,” he said.
paras.zh: “这一事件将开启变革的新时代，”他说。

paras.en: For an industry already experiencing that change in its service bays, Autel is bringing the tool, the strategy and the people behind its development together in one room.
paras.zh: 对于一个已经在服务区经历这种变化的行业来说，Autel 正在将其开发背后的工具、战略和人员聚集在一个房间里。

paras.en: The training runs from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. in the Grand Ballroom at the Hilton Garden Inn Roslyn, 3 Harbor Park Drive, Port Washington, New York. Tickets are $249 and include continental breakfast, snacks and lunch. Seating is limited. A discounted hotel rate is available using group code “Autel.” Register here. For AC909D details, visit autel.us/product/maxihvac-ac909.
paras.zh: 培训时间为上午8点至下午6点。位于纽约州华盛顿港海港公园大道 3 号罗斯林希尔顿花园酒店的大宴会厅。票价为 249 美元，包括欧陆式早餐、小吃和午餐。座位有限。使用团体代码“Autel”可享受酒店折扣价。在这里注册。有关 AC909D 的详细信息，请访问 autel.us/product/maxihvac-ac909。

articles.title: Niterra Names Donny Seyfer Automotive Trailblazer of the Year
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Niterra North America, Inc. announced Donny Seyfer, executive officer of the National Automotive Service Task Force (NASTF), as the recipient of its 2026 Automotive Trailblazer of the Year Award. Established in 2025, the annual award recognizes individuals whose leadership and innovation help advance the automotive service and repair industry.
paras.zh: Niterra North America, Inc. 宣布国家汽车服务工作组 (NASTF) 执行官 Donny Seyfer 荣获 2026 年度汽车开拓者奖。该年度奖项设立于 2025 年，旨在表彰那些在领导力和创新方面帮助推动汽车服务和维修行业发展的个人。

paras.en: A third-generation shop owner with more than 30 years of hands-on experience, Seyfer has dedicated his career to supporting independent automotive repair professionals. Through his leadership at NASTF, he has helped advance technical resources, training opportunities, and secure credentialing solutions that enable technicians and shop owners to navigate increasingly complex vehicle technologies.
paras.zh: 作为拥有 30 多年实践经验的第三代店主，Seyfer 致力于为独立汽车维修专业人士提供支持。通过在 NASTF 的领导，他帮助推进了技术资源、培训机会和安全认证解决方案，使技术人员和店主能够驾驭日益复杂的车辆技术。

paras.en: His contributions include supporting secure vehicle data access initiatives, advancing Vehicle Security Professional (VSP) credentialing, and expanding operational resources for independent repair facilities nationwide. Through these efforts, Seyfer has helped strengthen the technical capabilities and professional development of the automotive service community, Niterra said.
paras.zh: 他的贡献包括支持安全车辆数据访问计划、推进车辆安全专业人员 (VSP) 认证以及扩大全国独立维修设施的运营资源。 Niterra 表示，通过这些努力，Seyfer 帮助加强了汽车服务界的技术能力和专业发展。

paras.en: “Donny Seyfer is a true champion for the repair community. Through his leadership at NASTF, he has built trusted bridges between automakers and independent repairers, ensuring that independent bays remain competitive, safe, and fully equipped. Therefore, we are honored to have him be selected as this year’s recipient,” said Philip Austin, manager of technical training at Niterra North America.
paras.zh: Niterra 北美技术培训经理 Philip Austin 表示：“Donny Seyfer 是维修界真正的拥护者。通过他在 NASTF 的领导，他在汽车制造商和独立维修商之间建立了值得信赖的桥梁，确保独立维修站保持竞争力、安全和设备齐全。因此，我们很荣幸他被选为今年的获奖者。”

paras.en: The Automotive Trailblazer of the Year Award reflects Niterra North America‘s commitment to technical education, professional growth, and collaboration across the automotive aftermarket. Seyfer’s career exemplifies the value of sharing expertise, developing practical resources, and helping service professionals succeed as automotive technology continues to evolve, the company said.
paras.zh: 年度汽车开拓者奖反映了 Niterra North America 对整个汽车售后市场的技术教育、专业发展和协作的承诺。该公司表示，随着汽车技术的不断发展，Seyfer 的职业生涯体现了分享专业知识、开发实用资源以及帮助服务专业人员取得成功的价值。

articles.title: UAF to Celebrate 40th Anniversary With Las Vegas Reception
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The University of the Aftermarket Foundation (UAF) will celebrate its 40th anniversary with a reception benefiting the foundation and its scholarship program. UAF will host the event Saturday, Oct. 31, at 6 p.m. Pacific at The Venetian Las Vegas. Individuals and organizations can learn more about attending the event and supporting the campaign through the UAF website.
paras.zh: 售后市场大学基金会 (UAF) 将举办一场有利于基金会及其奖学金计划的招待会，庆祝其成立 40 周年。 UAF 将于 10 月 31 日星期六下午 6 点举办该活动。拉斯维加斯威尼斯人太平洋酒店。个人和组织可以通过 UAF 网站了解有关参加活动和支持活动的更多信息。

paras.en: UAF Recognizes 40 Years of Scholarships and Grants
paras.zh: UAF 表彰 40 年来的奖学金和助学金

paras.en: “The celebration event in Las Vegas is a wonderful opportunity to reflect on the foundation’s history and celebrate all those who have made it possible for UAF to fund grants and award more than 8,000 scholarships over the last 40 years,” said Roger McCollum, MAAP, chairman, University of the Aftermarket Foundation. “We extend our sincere thanks to all those who have supported the UAF 40th Anniversary campaign, especially the Ruby Celebration Host donors. Their generosity will ensure that UAF can continue to invest in the education of the next generation for the next 40 years and beyond.”
paras.zh: “拉斯维加斯的庆祝活动是一个很好的机会，可以回顾基金会的历史，并向所有在过去 40 年里为 UAF 提供资助并颁发 8,000 多项奖学金的人们致敬，”售后市场大学基金会主席、MAAP 罗杰·麦科勒姆 (Roger McCollum) 说道。 “我们衷心感谢所有支持 UAF 40 周年纪念活动的人士，特别是 Ruby Celebration Host 捐助者。他们的慷慨将确保 UAF 在未来 40 年及以后继续投资于下一代的教育。”

paras.en: The foundation recognized the following donors for their support of its 40th anniversary campaign.
paras.zh: 该基金会感谢以下捐助者对其 40 周年纪念活动的支持。

paras.en: – Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA)
paras.zh: – 售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA)

paras.en: Foundation Invites Industry Participation
paras.zh: 基金会邀请业界参与

paras.en: “We invite everyone attending AWDA and AAPEX to join us for the celebration. Those who are not able to be in Las Vegas may still support the campaign with a donation,” said McCollum.
paras.zh: “我们邀请所有参加 AWDA 和 AAPEX 的人加入我们的庆祝活动。那些无法到达拉斯维加斯的人仍然可以通过捐款来支持该活动，”麦科勒姆说。

articles.title: Milton Industries Names Odd Joergenrud President and CEO
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Milton Industries, provider of air and fluid flow solutions, tools and accessories for the automotive and industrial markets, announced that Odd Joergenrud has been named president and chief executive officer. He succeeds Greg Carlson, who will remain with the company as executive chairman of the board, focusing on strategic growth and acquisitions.
paras.zh: 为汽车和工业市场提供空气和流体流动解决方案、工具和配件的供应商 Milton Industries 宣布，Odd Joergenrud 已被任命为总裁兼首席执行官。他接替格雷格·卡尔森 (Greg Carlson)，后者将继续担任公司董事会执行主席，专注于战略增长和收购。

paras.en: Joergenrud brings more than 30 years of global leadership experience in the automotive aftermarket and industrial sectors across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, including roles at Bosch, Terrepower (formerly BBB Industries), and Maxcess International. He has a track record of growth through innovation, operational excellence, and acquisitions, the company said.
paras.zh: Joergenrud 在北美、欧洲和亚太地区的汽车售后市场和工业领域拥有 30 多年的全球领导经验，曾在博世、Terrepower（前身为 BBB Industries）和 Maxcess International 任职。该公司表示，他拥有通过创新、卓越运营和收购实现增长的记录。

paras.en: “Milton’s strength is rooted in its American heritage, the quality of its products, and the trust it has earned from generations of customers,” said Joergenrud. “That is the foundation of our future. My responsibility is to protect and strengthen those values while investing in the people, products, and capabilities that will define our next chapter.”
paras.zh: Joergenrud 表示：“Milton 的优势植根于其美国传统、产品质量以及几代客户所赢得的信任。” “这是我们未来的基础。我的责任是保护和加强这些价值观，同时投资于将定义我们下一个篇章的人员、产品和能力。”

paras.en: “Our customers depend on products that perform and brands they can trust,” Joergenrud added. “Our focus is simple: strengthen our American industrial foundation, support our employees and customers, and build products that stand the test of time.”
paras.zh: “我们的客户依赖于他们可以信赖的高性能产品和品牌，”Joergenrud 补充道。 “我们的重点很简单：加强我们的美国工业基础，支持我们的员工和客户，并打造经得起时间考验的产品。”

paras.en: Joergenrud said his priority will be listening to Milton’s employees, customers, distributors, and partners.
paras.zh: Joergenrud 表示，他的首要任务是倾听 Milton 员工、客户、分销商和合作伙伴的意见。

articles.title: Magnaflow President Dan Paolone on the ‘Long-Term Play’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Dan Paolone, president, Magnaflow.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 Magnaflow 总裁 Dan Paolone。

paras.en: Paolone said Magnaflow’s family-owned heritage has shaped both its culture and its long-term approach to the market. Founded in 1981 by his uncle, Jerry Paolone, the company has operated around a “build it and stand by it” philosophy while emphasizing lasting relationships and accountability from design through manufacturing. While Magnaflow is widely associated with performance exhaust, Paolone emphasized that the company is fundamentally an emissions and exhaust business, with approximately 10,000 SKUs across catalytic converters and BRExhaust. That breadth, combined with its premium performance brands, gives Magnaflow a much broader aftermarket presence than its performance reputation alone might suggest, he explained.
paras.zh: Paolone 表示，Magnaflow 的家族传统塑造了其文化和长期市场策略。该公司由他的叔叔 Jerry Paolone 于 1981 年创立，围绕“打造并坚持”的理念运营，同时强调从设计到制造的持久关系和责任。虽然 Magnaflow 与高性能排气有着广泛的联系，但 Paolone 强调，该公司本质上是一家排放和排气业务，在催化转换器和 BRExhaust 方面拥有大约 10,000 个 SKU。他解释说，这种广度，加上其优质的性能品牌，使 Magnaflow 拥有比其性能声誉本身所暗示的更广泛的售后市场影响力。

paras.en: Vertical integration is another key part of Magnaflow’s strategy. Paolone said the company invests consistently in employees, infrastructure and capital to maintain greater control from research and development through manufacturing and distribution. That approach also extends to data, an area where Magnaflow has made significant investments. By controlling more of the process and supply chain, Paolone said the company gains flexibility while supporting its long-term strategy. That philosophy reflects Magnaflow’s broader approach to business: Rather than managing quarter to quarter, the company views each quarter as another step toward executing a plan measured in years and decades.
paras.zh: 垂直整合是 Magnaflow 战略的另一个关键部分。 Paolone 表示，公司持续投资于员工、基础设施和资本，以保持从研发到制造和分销的更大控制力。这种方法还延伸到了数据领域，Magnaflow 在这个领域进行了大量投资。 Paolone 表示，通过控制更多的流程和供应链，公司在支持其长期战略的同时获得了灵活性。这一理念反映了 Magnaflow 更广泛的业务方法：该公司不是按季度进行管理，而是将每个季度视为执行以年和几十年为单位的计划的又一步。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Paolone sees significant growth opportunities across Magnaflow’s existing emissions and exhaust business, BRExhaust and its expanding OE business. The company models vehicle trends through 2040 and expects hybrids, which still require catalytic converters and exhaust systems, to create additional opportunities. BRExhaust is also expanding by offering complete installation kits for repair shops that eliminate the need for welding, cutting or pipe bending, helping technicians complete more repairs in-house. On the OE side, Magnaflow sees an opportunity to serve lower-volume platforms, particularly vehicles in the 10,000- to 20,000-unit range, where its infrastructure and consumer-facing brand can make it an attractive partner.
paras.zh: 展望未来，Paolone 认为 Magnaflow 现有的排放和废气业务、BRExhaust 及其不断扩大的 OE 业务存在巨大的增长机会。该公司对 2040 年的汽车趋势进行了建模，预计仍需要催化转换器和排气系统的混合动力汽车将创造更多机会。 BRExhaust 还通过为维修店提供完整的安装套件来扩展业务，消除了焊接、切割或弯管的需要，帮助技术人员在内部完成更多维修。在OE方面，Magnaflow看到了为小批量平台提供服务的机会，特别是10,000至20,000辆范围内的车辆，其基础设施和面向消费者的品牌可以使其成为有吸引力的合作伙伴。

paras.en: To hear more of Paolone’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解 Paolone 的更多见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

articles.title: James Webb telescope discovers surprising trove of metals around the Milky Way's supermassive black hole
articles.author: Elizabeth Howell

paras.en: The Milky Way's supermassive black hole is surrounded by a surprising trove of heavy metals, according to new observations by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). The metals may offer new clues about how Earth got its share of heavy elements — but it could also make one of the greatest mysteries about our local black hole even harder to solve.
paras.zh: 根据詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜 (JWST) 的最新观测，银河系的超大质量黑洞周围环绕着大量令人惊讶的重金属。这些金属可能会提供关于地球如何获得重元素的新线索，但它也可能使我们当地黑洞的最大谜团之一变得更加难以解开。

paras.en: In astronomy, metals refer to any element heavier than hydrogen or helium, with common examples including oxygen, carbon, iron or gold. These elements are forged through nuclear fusion in the hearts of stars that are reaching the ends of their lives, before being sprayed into space and incorporated into new generations of stars.
paras.zh: 在天文学中，金属是指任何比氢或氦重的元素，常见的例子包括氧、碳、铁或金。这些元素是在生命即将结束的恒星中心通过核聚变形成的，然后被喷射到太空并融入新一代恒星中。

paras.en: Scientists say the material spotted by JWST likely came from supernovas — stellar explosions that blasted the metal into the region around Sagittarius A (Sgr A*), the monster black hole in the middle of our galaxy.
paras.zh: 科学家表示，JWST 发现的物质很可能来自超新星——恒星爆炸将金属喷射到人马座 A (Sgr A*) 周围的区域，人马座 A 是我们银河系中部的巨型黑洞。

paras.en: The metals, detected as gas, appear to have the same composition as several nearby stars, which suggests both the stars and the gas originated at the same time. Researchers shared the observations in a paper published Oct. 19 in The Astronomical Journal, following up on work published in The Astrophysical Journal in May.
paras.zh: 这些金属被检测为气体，似乎与附近的几颗恒星具有相同的成分，这表明恒星和气体是同时起源的。研究人员在 10 月 19 日在《天文学杂志》上发表的一篇论文中分享了这些观察结果，这是继 5 月份在《天体物理学杂志》上发表的研究成果的后续研究。

paras.en: "We know there's a black hole at the centre of our galaxy pulling material into itself, but we see that it's eating a lot less material than other supermassive black holes, and more slowly," Nicole Ford, first author of the new paper and a doctoral student in astrophysics at McGill University in Montreal, said in a statement. "Part of understanding why this is happening means looking at the properties of the materials available for it to consume, including gas, dust and the stars orbiting around it."
paras.zh: 这篇新论文的第一作者、蒙特利尔麦吉尔大学天体物理学博士生妮可·福特在一份声明中表示：“我们知道银河系中心有一个黑洞正在将物质拉入自身，但我们发现它吞噬的物质比其他超大质量黑洞要少得多，而且速度也更慢。” “要理解为什么会发生这种情况，就需要研究可供它消耗的材料的特性，包括气体、尘埃和围绕它运行的恒星。”

paras.en: JWST orbits at Lagrange point 2, which is about 1 million miles (1.5 million kilometers) from Earth in the opposite direction of the sun. The telescope identified the heat signatures of specific gas clouds billowing near the black hole, as well as the metal content within those clouds.
paras.zh: JWST 的轨道位于拉格朗日点 2，该点距离地球约 100 万英里（150 万公里），与太阳的方向相反。该望远镜识别了黑洞附近翻滚的特定气体云的热特征，以及这些云中的金属含量。

paras.en: "These findings could advance understanding of how metals are distributed around supermassive black holes in more distant galaxies, as well as the processes that supplied Earth with many of these elements," McGill researchers said in the statement. The metals' presence "influences how quickly gases cool, which in turn influences how readily the gas can be drawn into a black hole," they added.
paras.zh: 麦吉尔研究人员在声明中表示：“这些发现可以促进人们对更遥远星系中超大质量黑洞周围金属如何分布的理解，以及向地球提供许多这些元素的过程。”他们补充说，这些金属的存在“影响气体冷却的速度，进而影响气体被吸入黑洞的容易程度”。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The previous study in The Astrophysical Journal showed that gas emissions near the black hole have been influenced by conditions in the local clouds. Unfortunately, this means the gas alone cannot serve as a proxy for how often the black hole has been active, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 《天体物理学杂志》之前的研究表明，黑洞附近的气体排放受到当地云层条件的影响。不幸的是，研究人员表示，这意味着气体本身无法代表黑洞活跃的频率。

paras.en: Ford, N. M., Balakrishnan, M., Von Fellenberg, S. D., Haggard, D., Michail, J. M., Cui, Y., Hora, J. L., Neilsen, J., Principe, G., Roychowdhury, T., Sabha, N. B., Smith, H. A., Sumners, Z., & Willner, S. P. (2026). Ionization Structure and Metal Enrichment of the Galactic Center Minispiral Observed with JWST. The Astronomical Journal, 172(5), 267. https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ae994d
paras.zh: 福特，N.M.，巴拉克里希南，M.，冯·费伦伯格，S.D.，哈格德，D.，米歇尔，J.M.，崔，Y.，霍拉，J.L.，尼尔森，J.，普林西比，G.，罗伊乔杜里，T.，萨巴哈，N.B.，史密斯，H.A.，萨姆纳，Z.，和威尔纳，S.P. （2026）。 JWST 观测到的银河系中心微型螺旋的电离结构和金属富集。 《天文学杂志》，172(5), 267。https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ae994d

paras.zh: 通过我们的黑洞测验看看您对黑洞了解多少！

paras.en: Elizabeth Howell was staff reporter at Space.com between 2022 and 2024 and a regular contributor to Live Science and Space.com between 2012 and 2022. Elizabeth's reporting includes multiple exclusives with the White House, speaking several times with the International Space Station, witnessing five human spaceflight launches on two continents, flying parabolic, working inside a spacesuit, and participating in a simulated Mars mission. Her latest book, "Why Am I Taller?" (ECW Press, 2022) is co-written with astronaut Dave Williams.
paras.zh: 伊丽莎白·豪厄尔 (Elizabeth Howell) 于 2022 年至 2024 年间担任 Space.com 的特约记者，并于 2012 年至 2022 年间为 Live Science 和 Space.com 定期撰稿。伊丽莎白的报道包括白宫的多项独家报道、与国际空间站的多次对话、见证了在两大洲的五次载人航天发射、抛物线飞行、在宇航服内工作以及参与模拟火星任务。她的最新书《为什么我更高？》 （ECW Press，2022 年）与宇航员戴夫·威廉姆斯 (Dave Williams) 共同撰写。

articles.title: Surprising new pattern of groundwater loss may signal a turning point for the Colorado River Basin
articles.author: Sascha Pare

paras.en: Western states that were thought to be resistant to prolonged drought may be more vulnerable than scientists previously believed, a new analysis of groundwater reserves in the Colorado River Basin finds.
paras.zh: 对科罗拉多河流域地下水储量的一项新分析发现，被认为能够抵抗长期干旱的西方各州可能比科学家之前认为的更脆弱。

paras.en: Researchers revealed the four states that together make up the Upper Basin — Colorado, New Mexico, Utah and Wyoming — lost almost twice as much groundwater as the Lower Basin did during an intense drought in the southwestern U.S. between 2020 and 2022. The finding was unexpected and might signal a turning point for the region, because the Upper Basin has long been seen as more resilient to dry spells than the Lower Basin, said Esther Oyedele, a doctoral student in geosciences at Virginia Tech and the study's first author.
paras.zh: 研究人员透露，在 2020 年至 2022 年美国西南部的严重干旱期间，组成上盆地的四个州——科罗拉多州、新墨西哥州、犹他州和怀俄明州——损失的地下水几乎是下盆地的两倍。地球科学博士生 Esther Oyedele 表示，这一发现出人意料，可能标志着该地区的一个转折点，因为长期以来人们认为上盆地比下盆地更能抵御干旱。弗吉尼亚理工大学的教授，也是该研究的第一作者。

paras.en: "The Upper Colorado River Basin has historically been considered more resilient because it receives more precipitation, particularly snowfall in the Rocky Mountains," Oyedele told Live Science in an email. "I think the important takeaway is that we should not assume that the Upper Basin will remain relatively resilient simply because it has historically received more precipitation and snowmelt."
paras.zh: 奥耶德勒在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》：“历史上，科罗拉多河流域上游被认为更具弹性，因为它接收更多的降水，尤其是落基山脉的降雪。” “我认为重要的一点是，我们不应该仅仅因为历史上经历过更多的降水和融雪就认为上盆地将保持相对的弹性。”

paras.en: The Lower Basin comprises parts of Nevada, California and Arizona. Less rain and snowfall means the Lower Basin naturally has less groundwater recharge, or less replenishment from other water sources, than the Upper Basin. On top of that, the Lower Basin generally has higher evaporation rates and substantial water demands, given that roughly 30 million of the 40 million people that depend on the Colorado River for water live in the Lower Basin, Oyedele said.
paras.zh: 下盆地包括内华达州、加利福尼亚州和亚利桑那州的部分地区。降雨和降雪较少意味着下流域的地下水补给量或其他水源的补给量自然少于上流域。 Oyedele 表示，最重要的是，鉴于依赖科罗拉多河供水的 4000 万人中约有 3000 万人生活在下盆地，因此下盆地的蒸发率普遍较高，需水量也很大。

paras.en: In the new study, published Oct. 13 in the journal Water Resources Research, researchers used satellite and hydrological data to estimate groundwater depletion across the Colorado River Basin between 2004 and 2023. The data included measurements of surface water, soil moisture and snow-water storage, as well as observations from the Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment mission and its successor, called the Follow-On.
paras.zh: 在10月13日发表在《水资源研究》杂志上的这项新研究中，研究人员利用卫星和水文数据来估计2004年至2023年间科罗拉多河流域的地下水枯竭情况。这些数据包括地表水、土壤湿度和雪水储存量的测量结果，以及重力恢复和气候实验任务及其后续任务（称为后续任务）的观测结果。

paras.en: The results showed that groundwater depletion has been a persistent problem in the Colorado River Basin over the past two decades, but losses accelerated in 2019. The three-year drought that began in 2020 is the principal cause of this, because it shrank the snowpack in the Rocky Mountains, increased evaporation and boosted water demand across the basin, Oyedele said.
paras.zh: 结果显示，过去二十年来，地下水枯竭一直是科罗拉多河流域的一个长期问题，但2019年损失加速。奥耶德勒说，2020年开始的三年干旱是造成这一问题的主要原因，因为它减少了落基山脉的积雪，增加了蒸发，并增加了整个流域的用水需求。

paras.en: During the drought between 2020 and 2022, the Upper Basin lost around 4.2 cubic miles (17.5 cubic kilometers) of groundwater, while the Lower Basin lost about 2.3 cubic miles (9.4 cubic km). In total, the Colorado River Basin lost 14 cubic miles (58.3 cubic km) of groundwater — equivalent to 25 million Olympic-size swimming pools' worth of water — during the study period, between 2004 and 2023.
paras.zh: 在2020年至2022年的干旱期间，上盆地损失了约4.2立方英里（17.5立方公里）的地下水，而下盆地则损失了约2.3立方英里（9.4立方公里）的地下水。在 2004 年至 2023 年的研究期间，科罗拉多河流域总共流失了 14 立方英里（58.3 立方公里）的地下水，相当于 2500 万个奥林匹克规模游泳池的水量。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: It's unclear why the deficit is so much higher in the Upper Basin than in the Lower Basin, but the Upper Basin's proximity to and dependence on the mountains for aquifer recharge probably didn't help, Oyedele said. As snow melts, some of it replenishes groundwater, so a reduction in snowfall between 2020 and 2022 would have affected the Upper Basin particularly badly, she noted.
paras.zh: 奥耶德勒说，目前还不清楚为什么上盆地的赤字比下盆地高得多，但上盆地靠近山区并依赖山区进行含水层补给可能没有帮助。她指出，随着积雪融化，其中一些会补充地下水，因此 2020 年至 2022 年降雪量减少将对上流域造成特别严重的影响。

paras.en: The Upper Basin also recorded more aquifer recharge during wet periods before the drought than the Lower Basin did, so it's possible that the pronounced decline during the drought was linked to a higher initial amount of groundwater in the Upper Basin, Oyedele said.
paras.zh: 奥耶德莱说，在干旱前的湿润期，上盆地的含水层补给量也比下盆地多，因此干旱期间的明显下降可能与上盆地初始地下水量较高有关。

paras.en: Next, the researchers used advanced statistical methods to explore the relationship between groundwater and surface water in the Colorado River Basin. Due to global warming and the overallocation of the Colorado River's water in a 1922 document, the river's flow is now 35% less than it was on average in the 20th century. Water scarcity in the basin has reached alarming levels, according to the study, and Lake Mead and Lake Powell, the two largest reservoirs in the U.S., dropped to record lows in August.
paras.zh: 接下来，研究人员利用先进的统计方法探讨了科罗拉多河流域地下水和地表水之间的关系。由于全球变暖以及 1922 年文件中对科罗拉多河水量的过度分配，该河的流量现在比 20 世纪的平均流量减少了 35%。研究显示，该流域的水资源短缺已达到惊人水平，美国最大的两个水库米德湖和鲍威尔湖的水量在八月份跌至历史最低水平。

paras.en: The team found that in the Upper Basin, groundwater levels evolve in the same direction as surface water, but with a slight delay. This suggests groundwater losses occur due to a lack of recharge and more aquifer pumping during periods of drought, when surface water levels drop. In the Lower Basin, however, this link is weaker and more complex. The results showed that groundwater losses sometimes preceded surface water declines during the study period, suggesting that groundwater depletion is not simply tied to less surface water trickling into the ground or to humans extracting groundwater when there's less surface water available. Instead, groundwater is consistently being overused, Oyedele said.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，在上游盆地，地下水位的演变方向与地表水相同，但略有延迟。这表明地下水流失是由于干旱期间地表水位下降时缺乏补给和更多含水层抽水造成的。然而，在下盆地，这种联系较弱且更为复杂。结果表明，在研究期间，地下水流失有时先于地表水下降，这表明地下水枯竭不仅仅与流入地下的地表水减少或在地表水减少时人类抽取地下水有关。相反，地下水一直被过度使用，奥耶代勒说。

paras.en: "This distinction is important because it suggests that groundwater depletion is not simply a direct response to surface-water shortages," she said. "Human water use, particularly sustained groundwater extraction, may also play a significant role."
paras.zh: “这种区别很重要，因为它表明地下水枯竭不仅仅是地表水短缺的直接反应，”她说。 “人类的用水，特别是持续的地下水开采，也可能发挥重要作用。”

paras.en: - Drought paradox study reveals plants around Colorado River turn to groundwater when it gets too hot and dry, reducing flow into the already strained basin
paras.zh: - 干旱悖论研究表明，科罗拉多河周围的植物在变得太热和干燥时会转向地下水，从而减少流入已经紧张的盆地的流量

paras.en: - Colorado River negotiations have stalled among 7 states and water is scarce. What happens next?
paras.zh: - 七个州之间的科罗拉多河谈判陷入僵局，水源稀缺。接下来会发生什么？

paras.en: - 'It has become very dire in a lot of places': New map reveals exactly where humans are adding and removing precious fresh water on Earth
paras.zh: -“很多地方的情况都变得非常可怕”：新地图准确揭示了人类在地球上添加和去除宝贵淡水的位置

paras.en: Looking ahead, it's hard to tell if the Upper Basin will continue to lose more groundwater than the Lower Basin and what that would mean for the region, Oyedele said. What seems clear, however, is that the Upper Basin is more vulnerable to drought than experts had thought.
paras.zh: 奥耶代勒说，展望未来，很难判断上盆地是否会继续比下盆地流失更多地下水，以及这对该地区意味着什么。然而，似乎很清楚的是，上游盆地比专家想象的更容易受到干旱的影响。

paras.en: "Continued warming, changes in snowpack, prolonged drought, and increasing water demand could place additional pressure on groundwater resources across both basins," Oyedele said. However, future groundwater responses will depend on several factors, including precipitation, snowmelt, water use and management decisions, she added.
paras.zh: 奥耶代勒说：“持续变暖、积雪变化、长期干旱和不断增加的需水量可能会给这两个盆地的地下水资源带来额外压力。”然而，她补充说，未来地下水的反应将取决于几个因素，包括降水、融雪、用水和管理决策。

paras.en: On the management side, Oyedele suggested tackling groundwater and surface water together rather than as two separate resources. Groundwater helps to sustain river flows, and rivers can recharge aquifers — so the two are interconnected. Groundwater often serves as a backup during drought, but it shouldn't be treated as an unlimited reserve, she said.
paras.zh: 在管理方面，奥耶德勒建议同时处理地下水和地表水，而不是作为两种单独的资源。地下水有助于维持河流流量，河流可以给含水层补给——因此两者是相互关联的。她说，地下水通常在干旱期间作为备用水，但不应被视为无限的储备。

paras.en: Oyedele, E. O., Werth, S., & Carlson, G. (2026). Contrasting groundwater response to surface water shortages in the Upper and Lower Colorado River Basins. Water Resources Research, 62(10). https://doi.org/10.1029/2025wr041695
paras.zh: Oyedele, E. O.、Werth, S. 和 Carlson, G. (2026)。科罗拉多河流域上游和下游地下水对地表水短缺的反应对比。水资源研究，62(10)。 https://doi.org/10.1029/2025wr041695

paras.en: Sascha is a U.K.-based staff writer at Live Science. She holds a bachelor’s degree in biology from the University of Southampton in England and a master’s degree in science communication from Imperial College London. Her work has appeared in The Guardian and the health website Zoe. Besides writing, she enjoys playing tennis, bread-making and browsing second-hand shops for hidden gems.
paras.zh: Sascha 是 Live Science 驻英国的特约撰稿人。她拥有英国南安普顿大学生物学学士学位和伦敦帝国理工学院科学传播硕士学位。她的作品曾出现在《卫报》和健康网站 Zoe 上。除了写作之外，她还喜欢打网球、制作面包和逛二手店寻找隐藏的宝石。
