paras.zh: “春丽原本应该砍掉一根手指，但卡普空……他们反复讨论剧本，最终决定手工烙印是更好的方法，”梁分享道。 “如果她在[潜在系列]的其余部分中没有小指，这会在某种程度上使这个角色变形。”

paras.en: Getting into spoiler territory, Liang admits she was a little frustrated that Chun-Li didn’t get to fulfill her mission of taking down Bison.
paras.zh: 进入剧透区，梁承认她对春丽未能完成击倒野牛的使命感到有点沮丧。

paras.en: “Honestly, a little bit,” Liang says when asked if she was disappointed. “The whole film, especially Chun-Li’s storyline, builds toward Chun-Li’s final takedown of Bison. But there’s a reason for everything, and hopefully, if we get a sequel one day, we’ll get to explore that. I’m sure it’d be epic.”
paras.zh: 当被问及是否感到失望时，梁说：“老实说，有一点。” “整部电影，尤其是春丽的故事情节，都是为了春丽最终打败野牛而构建的。但一切都是有原因的，希望有一天我们能拍续集，我们能对此进行探索。我相信这将是史诗般的。”

paras.en: During a scene in which Chun-Li tries to wake Ken up to the fact that the tournament is merely a front for draining the power of his former best friend and training partner, Ryu, another creative choice wound up on the cutting-room floor. Dating back to her chemistry read with Centineo, Liang suggested slapping Ken, and her co-star encouraged her to truly go for the jugular. But despite filming the moment on set, the genuine slap ultimately fell by the wayside.
paras.zh: 在春丽试图让肯清醒认识到比赛只是为了耗尽他以前最好的朋友和训练搭档 Ryu 的力量的幌子的场景中，另一个创意选择最终被搁置在剪辑室里。追溯到她与 Centineo 一起读到的化学反应，梁建议扇肯一巴掌，而她的搭档则鼓励她真正直击要害。但尽管在片场拍摄了这一时刻，真正的一巴掌最终还是被搁置了。

paras.en: “On the day, we actually tried multiple takes where I physically slapped him across the face,” Liang says. “There was no way to really fake it, so Noah just let me slap him in the face a couple of times. It didn’t end up making it into the final cut, but it was fun.”
paras.zh: “那天，我们实际上尝试了多次拍摄，我打了他一巴掌，”梁说。 “没有办法真正假装它，所以诺亚就让我打了他几巴掌。它最终没有进入最终剪辑，但很有趣。”

paras.en: Below, in a conversation with THR, Liang also discusses the “Tuesday” homage to Raul Julia’s M. Bison in 1994’s Street Fighter, as well as turning Chun-Li’s infamous shower scene from Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie into an amusing gag.
paras.zh: 下面，在与 THR 的对话中，梁还讨论了向 1994 年《街头霸王》中劳尔·朱莉娅 (Raul Julia) 饰演的 M. Bison 致敬的“星期二”，以及将《街头霸王 II：动画电影》中春丽臭名昭著的淋浴场景变成了一个有趣的笑话。

paras.en: I first saw you in Presence, and while it’s not easy to make single-location movies compelling, you guys pulled it off. Did you feel a career bump after that? Did it perhaps open the door to Street Fighter?
paras.zh: 我第一次在《Presence》中见到你们，虽然要让单一地点的电影引人注目并不容易，但你们成功了。之后你有感受到职业生涯的坎坷吗？它是否可能打开了《街头霸王》的大门？

paras.en: Presence definitely opened a lot of doors for me, but I don’t know if it directly connected to me getting Street Fighter. I started auditioning for Street Fighter two years after we finished Presence, so it had been a while. When I first connected with [Legendary Pictures producer] Cale [Boyter], I remember he was like, “No, I haven’t seen Presence.” Maybe he finally watched it after meeting me.
paras.zh: 存在确实为我打开了很多大门，但我不知道它是否与我获得《街头霸王》有直接联系。在完成《Presence》两年后，我开始参加《街头霸王》的试镜，所以已经有一段时间了。当我第一次与[传奇影业制片人]凯尔[博伊特]联系时，我记得他说，“不，我还没看过《存在》。”也许他在遇见我之后终于看到了。

paras.en: But working with Steven Soderbergh was a huge honor, and I learned so much from being on set with him. Most of my scenes, as Chloe, were with the ghost, and the ghost was essentially the camera with Steven as the DoP. So a lot of it was mainly just me and Steven interacting with each other. It truly felt like a masterclass in cinematography.
paras.zh: 但与史蒂文·索德伯格合作是一种巨大的荣幸，我从与他一起拍摄中学到了很多东西。我扮演克洛伊的大部分场景都是与鬼魂在一起，而鬼魂本质上是由史蒂文担任摄影指导的摄影机。所以很多事情主要是我和史蒂文之间的互动。这确实感觉就像是电影摄影大师班。

paras.en: On the first day, Steven said to the cast, “I’m going to go all-in. It’s risky to make a movie like this. There’s only one way it’s going to go. It either works or it doesn’t, and we just all have to trust that it’s going to work.” And it ended up working.
paras.zh: 第一天，史蒂文对演员们说：“我要全力以赴。制作这样的电影是有风险的。只有一条路可以走。要么成功，要么失败，我们都必须相信它会成功。”它最终起作用了。

paras.en: You got a call from your reps about auditioning for Chun-Li in Street Fighter, starting with a Zoom call with director Kitao Sakurai and producer Cale Boyter. Afterwards, they signaled to your agent that you were probably dead in the water, but you kept getting called back — to the point that you had to bail on your birthday plans with your friends to fly out for a chemistry read with Noah Centineo. Have your pals finally forgiven you for choosing career advancement over them?
paras.zh: 您接到代表的电话，要求您参加《街头霸王》中春丽的试镜，首先是与导演樱井北雄和制片人凯尔·博伊特进行 Zoom 通话。之后，他们向你的经纪人发出信号，说你可能已经死在水里了，但你不断接到回电——以至于你不得不取消和朋友们的生日计划，飞出去和诺亚·琴蒂内奥一起读化学课。你的朋友们终于原谅你选择职业发展而不是他们了吗？

paras.en: (Laughs.) Oh, absolutely. If any of my friends were unwilling to forgive me, then they weren’t a real one to begin with. It was a crazy ride, and honestly, it was the best birthday present I could have ever asked for. A couple days after I got back from the chemistry read with Noah in L.A., Kitao called me personally to tell me that I got the role of Chun-Li. So it was a dream come true, and there was no better way I would’ve spent my birthday.
paras.zh: （笑）哦，当然。如果我的任何朋友不愿意原谅我，那么他们一开始就不是真正的朋友。这是一次疯狂的旅程，说实话，这是我能要求的最好的生日礼物。我在洛杉矶和诺亚读完化学课回来几天后，北尾亲自打电话给我，告诉我我得到了春丽这个角色。所以这是我的梦想成真，没有比这更好的方式来度过我的生日了。

paras.en: Did you and Noah read the bathroom scene where she warns Ken that the tournament is a front to steal Ryu’s power?
paras.zh: 你和诺亚读过浴室里的场景吗？她警告肯，这场比赛是窃取 Ryu 力量的幌子？

paras.en: We did the scene where Chun-Li invites Ken to the tournament, and then we did the scene of us together in the bathroom. In the chemistry read, Cale sat in on some of it, but it was mostly me, Noah and Kitao working together.
paras.zh: 我们拍了春丽邀请肯参加比赛的场景，然后我们拍了我们一起在浴室的场景。在化学朗读中，凯尔旁听了其中的一部分，但主要是我、诺亚和北尾一起工作。

paras.en: At some point, Kitao was like, “To get Ken to see that the tournament is not a real thing, I think Chun-Li would get physical. Do you think you can add some physicality to it?” And I was like, “Noah, are you comfortable with this?” And he was like, “Sure, go ahead.” And I was like, “Alright, if I have the green light.” So for one of the takes, I grabbed him by the collar and slapped him across the face, saying, “Wake up! This is not a real tournament.” It was so much fun. Then we brought Cale in to watch it, and he was like, “Oh my gosh, I wasn’t expecting that. That was great.”
paras.zh: 在某些时候，北尾就像是，“为了让肯明白比赛不是真实的，我认为春丽会加强身体素质。你认为你可以在其中添加一些身体素质吗？”我当时想，“诺亚，你对此感到满意吗？”他说：“当然，继续吧。”我当时想，“好吧，如果我有绿灯的话。”因此，在其中一个镜头中，我抓住他的衣领，打了他一巴掌，说：“醒醒！这不是一场真正的比赛。”太有趣了。然后我们带凯尔去看，他说，“天哪，我没想到会这样。那太棒了。”

paras.en: On the day, we actually tried multiple takes where I physically slapped him across the face. There was no way to really fake it, so Noah just let me slap him in the face a couple of times. It didn’t end up making it into the final cut, but it was fun.
paras.zh: 那天，我们实际上尝试了多次拍摄，我用身体打了他的脸。没有办法真正假装它，所以诺亚只是让我打了他几巴掌。它最终没有进入最终剪辑，但很有趣。

paras.en: There’s a video of you guys promoting the movie somewhere, and Noah suddenly jumped on the game-inspired car that was there, giving you quite a jump-scare. What’s your version of that story?
paras.zh: 某处有一段你们宣传电影的视频，诺亚突然跳上了那里的游戏风格汽车，让你吓了一跳。你对这个故事有什么版本？

paras.en: ComplexCon was a lot of fun, but hectic. We were up on this stage with an audience of people watching, and all I could think in my head was that I was wearing these six-inch heels with insane platforms. They looked amazing with my outfit. My stylists, Wayman and Micah, kill it every single time. But I was just trying my hardest to stay balanced and not fall over while we were taking pictures and filming content around that car in front of the crowd that gathered at our stand.
paras.zh: ComplexCon 很有趣，但也很忙碌。我们站在舞台上，周围都是观众，我脑子里所想的就是我穿着这双六英寸厚底高跟鞋。他们搭配我的衣服看起来棒极了。我的造型师 Wayman 和 Micah 每次都很出色。但当我们在聚集在我们展位的人群面前围绕那辆车拍照和拍摄内容时，我只是尽最大努力保持平衡，不要摔倒。

paras.en: Then Noah jumped on the car, but I’m honestly used to it. Working with Noah and [Andrew] Koji, they always pretend to fight each other or jump on things, on and off set. So I was mostly just like, Oh my gosh, I can’t fall over. Not right now. But other than that, I was like, Oh, it’s just Noah being Noah. I didn’t end up falling over, and all was good. But I was concerned about his shoulder. I actually asked him afterwards if he hurt it, and he said he didn’t.
paras.zh: 然后诺亚跳上了车，但老实说我已经习惯了。与诺亚（Noah）和[安德鲁]科吉（Andrew）Koji 合作，无论在片场还是片场外，他们总是假装互相打斗或跳到东西上。所以我当时的反应就是，天哪，我不能摔倒。现在不行。但除此之外，我就想，哦，诺亚就是诺亚。我最终没有摔倒，一切都很好。但我担心他的肩膀。后来我问他疼不疼，他说不疼。

paras.en: Back to pre-production, you had two months to get jacked, particularly your legs, since Chun-Li is known for her dangerous kicks. Was it a sprint to the finish line?
paras.zh: 回到前期制作，你有两个月的时间被踢，尤其是你的腿，因为春丽以其危险的踢腿而闻名。这是冲刺到终点线吗？

paras.en: Yeah, absolutely. I sprinted all the way. Even after filming had started, I kept going to weightlifting sessions whenever my schedule allowed it. Stunt training also kept going all throughout. I learned the first choreo I had to film, and then after we filmed that, I had to learn the second choreo I had to film. So I kept up with the eating, and that’s why my legs kept growing from the first day of filming to the last day of filming. Honestly, I wasn’t expecting it, but the amazing crafty table they had on set definitely helped. So I definitely felt the pressure of time, the expectations of longtime fans and the expectations I had of myself. I just didn’t want to disappoint anyone.
paras.zh: 是的，绝对是。我一路冲刺。即使在拍摄开始后，只要我的日程允许，我就会继续参加举重训练。特技训练也一直在进行。我学会了我必须拍摄的第一个舞蹈，然后在我们拍摄之后，我必须学习我必须拍摄的第二个舞蹈。所以我就坚持吃，所以从拍戏的第一天到拍戏的最后一天，我的腿一直在变长。老实说，我没想到会这样，但他们在片场拥有的令人惊叹的狡猾的桌子确实有帮助。所以我确实感受到了时间的压力、老粉丝的期望以及我对自己的期望。我只是不想让任何人失望。

paras.en: So it’s true that you used the fan response to your casting as bulletin board material?
paras.zh: 那么你真的把粉丝对你选角的反应作为公告板材料吗？

paras.en: Yeah, it really was motivation. A lot of the comments I read online just motivated me even more to prove them wrong, but nothing really got to me personally. I was like, Listen, I agree with you guys. As an outsider who’s also a fan of the games and the character, I agree that, physically, where I started wasn’t where I would ideally want Chun-Li to be. But there’s always room for growth. You can always be better, and that’s the way I looked at it.
paras.zh: 是的，这确实是动力。我在网上读到的很多评论只是更加激励我去证明他们是错误的，但没有什么真正对我个人产生影响。我当时想，听着，我同意你们的观点。作为一个局外人，同时也是游戏和角色的粉丝，我同意，从身体上来说，我开始的地方并不是我理想中希望春丽所在的地方。但总有成长的空间。你总是可以变得更好，这就是我的看法。

paras.en: The Street Fighter cast is such an odd collection of people. You have wrestlers, a rapper, a real-life vampire, a few comedians, a country musician, a bodybuilder and several martial artists. Was the set basically a rambunctious carnival?
paras.zh: 《街头霸王》的演员阵容非常奇怪。你有摔跤手、说唱歌手、现实生活中的吸血鬼、一些喜剧演员、一位乡村音乐家、一位健美运动员和几位武术家。这个场景基本上是一场喧闹的嘉年华吗？

paras.en: Yes, absolutely. There’s really no better way to put it. There was never a dull moment on set. Every day was chaotic, but chaotic in a fun way. I was personally fangirling over 50 Cent whenever he was on set. Eric André and Schulz were always making jokes and filming prank videos. I was always confused by them, but I ended up laughing along with them.
paras.zh: 是的，绝对是。确实没有更好的方式来表达它。片场从来没有沉闷的时刻。每天都是混乱的，但混乱的方式很有趣。每当他在片场时，我个人都会迷恋超过 50 美分。埃里克·安德烈和舒尔茨总是开玩笑并拍摄恶作剧视频。我总是被他们弄糊涂，但最终我也跟着他们一起笑。

paras.en: I was actually really intimidated by the wrestlers at first. Who wouldn’t be? You have Roman Reigns and Cody Rhodes, and what they do looks scary. But they ended up being the sweetest people. They’re such puppies in the best way, and they were super nice to hang around with on set. And Orville Peck has become one of my best friends after filming this whole thing together.
paras.zh: 事实上，一开始我真的被摔跤手吓到了。谁不会呢？有罗曼·雷恩斯和科迪·罗兹，他们所做的事情看起来很可怕。但他们最终成为最可爱的人。它们是最好的小狗，而且在片场和它们在一起非常好。一起拍摄这整件事后，奥维尔·佩克成为了我最好的朋友之一。

paras.en: David [Dastmalchian] is a real-life vampire, for sure, but in the best way. It was magnificent working with him and diving into the psychology of Bison and Chun-Li. We got to do some of the more serious stuff, which excited me a lot personally.
paras.zh: 大卫（达斯马奇安）无疑是现实生活中的吸血鬼，但以最好的方式。与他一起工作并深入研究 Bison 和 Chun-Li 的心理真是太棒了。我们必须做一些更严肃的事情，这让我个人非常兴奋。

paras.en: But it was a crazy set. You had your crazy uncles and aunties and cousins, and it genuinely felt like one big, crazy family.
paras.zh: 但这是一个疯狂的组合。你有疯狂的叔叔阿姨和表兄弟姐妹，这真的感觉就像一个疯狂的大家庭。

paras.en: There’s an amazing sight gag in this film after Chun-Li does some drunken nunchucking. She goes to take a shower, and just as she’s about to be revealed, the movie match-cuts to E. Honda’s exposed upper body. Was this gag scripted carefully so that you knew what to expect?
paras.zh: 在春丽醉酒后打双节棍之后，这部电影中有一个令人惊叹的视觉笑料。她去洗澡，正当她即将被揭露时，电影镜头切到了 E. Honda 裸露的上半身。这个笑话是否经过精心设计，以便您知道会发生什么？

paras.en: (Laughs.) It was scripted from day one. Kitao sent me a mock-up about a week before we filmed it, showing exactly how they were planning to shoot it, including the push-in and reveal of E. Honda’s big chest. I was made to feel very comfortable from the start, and I knew exactly what I was stepping into on the day. So I was very happy to do it because it’s such an iconic scene from Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie. As a fan myself, that’s probably my favorite movie in the franchise, so I was like, “We’ve got to add that Easter egg in there.” And now it’s gotten big laughs at all the screenings. Audiences have loved it. Even I laughed when I first saw it.
paras.zh: （笑）从第一天起就已经写好了剧本。拍摄前大约一周，北尾给我发了一个模型，准确地展示了他们计划如何拍摄，包括 E. Honda 大胸部的推入和露出。从一开始我就感觉很舒服，而且我清楚地知道我那天要做什么。所以我很高兴这样做，因为这是《街头霸王 II：动画电影》中的一个标志性场景。作为我自己的粉丝，这可能是我最喜欢的电影，所以我想，“我们必须在其中添加复活节彩蛋。”现在，它在所有放映中都引起了大笑。观众很喜欢它。连我第一眼看到的时候都笑了。

paras.en: Chun-Li is an undercover Interpol officer, and she infiltrates M. Bison’s organization as part of her long-running effort to avenge her father’s murder at his hand. She then brands herself with his Shadaloo symbol to prove her loyalty. Did they do anything on the day to give you some kind of sensation you could play off?
paras.zh: 春丽是一名国际刑警卧底官员，她渗透进了 M. Bison 的组织，这是她为父亲报仇的长期努力的一部分。然后，她在自己身上贴上了他的 Shadaloo 标志，以证明她的忠诚。那天他们有没有做任何事情来给你带来某种你可以发挥的感觉？

paras.en: No, actually. That scene used to be something else. I don’t know if I’m allowed to say this, but the movie is out now, so it should be fine. Chun-Li was originally supposed to chop off a finger, but Capcom … They went back and forth with the script, and eventually they decided that hand-branding was the better way to do it.
paras.zh: 不，实际上。那个场景曾经是另外一回事。我不知道我是否可以这么说，但电影现在已经上映了，所以应该没问题。春丽原本应该砍掉一根手指，但卡普空……他们反复讨论剧本，最终决定手工烙印是更好的方法。

paras.en: I remember testing that scene during the camera test. I tried it, and I thought, It’s a lot. She’s about to physically hurt herself. But Kitao kept going, “More, more, more. I want to see it in her eyes. She’s almost shaking.” And I was like, “Alright, say less.”
paras.zh: 我记得在相机测试期间测试了那个场景。我尝试了一下，我想，这很多。她即将伤害自己。但北尾继续说道：“更多，更多，更多。我想从她的眼睛里看到这一点。她几乎在发抖。”我当时就想，“好吧，少说点。”

paras.en: So, on the day, I mentally channeled whatever pain I could into what was happening physically. But I wish there had been something to help me feel that sensation. It was all just stone-cold acting.
paras.zh: 所以，那天，我在精神上将我所能承受的一切痛苦转移到身体上发生的事情上。但我希望有什么东西可以帮助我感受到那种感觉。这一切都只是冰冷的表演。

paras.en: There was a lot of rigamarole with the studio over Keanu Reeves, as John Wick, cutting off a finger in the John Wick series, so that’s an interesting yet familiar story. I wonder if that’s where the inspiration came from.
paras.zh: 工作室对基努·里维斯（Keanu Reeves）在《疾速追杀》系列中饰演约翰·威克（John Wick）砍掉一根手指的事情有很多废话，所以这是一个有趣而又熟悉的故事。我想知道这是否是灵感的来源。

paras.en: If she had no pinky for the rest of the [potential series], it would be deforming the character in a way. But regardless, I think the hand-branding worked, and it was very fun to play.
paras.zh: 如果她在[潜在系列]的其余部分中没有小指，这会在某种程度上使角色变形。但无论如何，我认为手工烙印很有效，而且玩起来非常有趣。

paras.en: Kitao told me that the reasoning came down to the source material being too substantial to cram it all into one movie, but were you disappointed at all that Chun-Li didn’t get to take out M. Bison in this film?
paras.zh: 北尾告诉我，原因在于源材料太丰富，无法将所有内容都塞进一部电影中，但是你对春丽没有在这部电影中除掉野牛先生感到失望吗？

paras.en: Oh, man. Honestly, a little bit. The whole film, especially Chun-Li’s storyline, builds toward Chun-Li’s final takedown of Bison. But there’s a reason for everything, and hopefully, if we get a sequel one day, we’ll get to explore that. I’m sure it’d be epic.
paras.zh: 哦，伙计。老实说，有一点。整部电影，尤其是春丽的故事情节，都是以春丽最终击败野牛为目标的。但一切都是有原因的，希望如果有一天我们能拍出续集，我们就能探索这一点。我确信这将是史诗般的。

paras.en: You made a good point elsewhere that if she does kill him, who is she after that? She’s devoted her entire life toward this one mission.
paras.zh: 你在其他地方提出了一个很好的观点，如果她真的杀了他，那么她是谁？她为这一使命奉献了一生。

paras.en: Exactly. That’s another part of her storyline and character arc I’d be interested to explore. Whenever I went into my scenes with Bison in this film, I had to tap into this weird mental state of hating him so much, but finding comfort in knowing exactly what Chun-Li needed to do, who she hated and what her mission was.
paras.zh: 确切地。这是我有兴趣探索的她的故事情节和人物弧线的另一部分。每当我进入这部电影中与野牛的场景时，我都必须进入这种奇怪的心理状态，即非常讨厌他，但在确切地知道春丽需要做什么、她讨厌谁以及她的使命是什么时找到安慰。

paras.en: Even in the moments before she brands herself, he says, “There’s a deep sadness in you and also a great potential.” I almost felt emotional as her during those moments. It’s almost the first time anyone has truly seen Chun-Li for who she is, so there’s a weird sense of emotional support in that moment.
paras.zh: 即使在她为自己打造品牌之前的那一刻，他也说：“你内心深处充满悲伤，但也蕴藏着巨大的潜力。”在那些时刻，我几乎和她一样情绪激动。这几乎是第一次有人真正认识春丽，所以那一刻有一种奇怪的情感支持感。

paras.en: After she brands herself, he brings her up close to the painting of himself, which is hilarious. She could have easily chosen to attack him when he hands her the knife while standing that close to him, but she chose not to. So that’s really interesting to think about because she probably didn’t want her mission to end just yet. She was probably afraid to confront what would come for her, mentally, once it was all over. So I 100 percent don’t know how she’d feel after finally accomplishing Bison’s death.
paras.zh: 在她给自己打上烙印后，他带她靠近自己的画，这很搞笑。当他把刀递给她，而且站得离他那么近时，她本可以很容易地选择攻击他，但她选择不这样做。所以考虑起来真的很有趣，因为她可能不希望她的任务就这样结束。一旦一切结束，她可能害怕面对精神上将会发生的事情。所以我百分百不知道她最终完成了野牛的死亡后会有什么感觉。

paras.en: Maybe you weren’t there for David Dastmalchian’s coverage after Bison hits Chun-Li with the Psycho Crusher, but was there a lot of pomp and circumstance around his “Tuesday” homage to Raul Julia as he walks from her?
paras.zh: 在野牛用精神粉碎机击中春丽后，你可能没有在场观看大卫·达斯马奇安的报道，但是当他从劳尔·朱莉娅身边走开时，他在“星期二”向劳尔·朱莉娅致敬时是否有很多排场和场面？

paras.en: Oh my gosh, absolutely. It’s the most iconic line ever. Even before filming started, we were all saying, “We’ve got to put that line in there somehow. We’ve got to find the right moment.” Then I saw the dailies where he delivered that line, and I was like, “Damn, that’s the one.” It was so satisfying to watch, and then it became a thing the rest of the shoot. He shot the line earlier on in the filming process, and every day afterwards, whenever we’d see each other, I’d be like, “Yeah, I’m going to kill you today.” I was just gearing up to fight him. But David was like, “Hey, it’s just a Tuesday for me.” So that iconic line became an ongoing joke between us.
paras.zh: 天哪，绝对是。这是有史以来最具标志性的线条。甚至在拍摄开始之前，我们都在说，“我们必须以某种方式把这条线放在那里。我们必须找到正确的时刻。”然后我看到他发表这句话的日报，我当时想，“该死，就是这个。”观看起来非常令人满意，然后它就成为了拍摄的其余部分的事情。他在拍摄过程的早期就拍摄了这句台词，之后的每一天，每当我们见面时，我都会说，“是的，今天我要杀了你。”我正准备和他战斗。但大卫说，“嘿，这对我来说只是星期二。”所以那句标志性的台词成了我们之间持续不断的笑话。

paras.en: Decades from now, when you look back on this experience, what day will you likely recall first?
paras.zh: 几十年后，当你回顾这段经历时，你最先想起的可能是哪一天？

paras.en: The one day that always stands out to me was when we filmed on that beautiful cliffside in Sydney. Chun-Li invites Dhalsim to the tournament, and it was just truly so beautiful. I could not believe we were filming at a location like that.
paras.zh: 对我来说总是印象深刻的一天是我们在悉尼美丽的悬崖边拍摄的那一天。春丽邀请达尔西姆参加比赛，这真是太美妙了。我简直不敢相信我们在这样的地方拍摄。

paras.en: After the part on the rocks, where Dhalism and his soldiers are doing their thing, we moved on to another oceanside cliff where the chopper is. Chun-Li has this crazy fight sequence with three of her Interpol bosses, and then kicking [Kyle Mooney’s] Marvin in the balls was the end of that day.
paras.zh: 在达尔里斯和他的士兵们在岩石上做事的部分结束后，我们前往另一个海边悬崖，直升机所在的地方。春丽与她的三位国际刑警老板进行了疯狂的打斗，然后踢了[凯尔·穆尼的]马文的蛋蛋，这一天就结束了。

paras.en: So it was such a beautiful day. I got to fight three guys, kick another one in the balls and drive off in a van. It was a great day. I’ll never forget it.
paras.zh: 这真是美好的一天。我必须和三个人打架，踢另一个人的蛋蛋，然后开着一辆货车离开。这是美好的一天。我永远不会忘记它。

paras.en: Street Fighter is now playing in movie theaters.
paras.zh: 《街头霸王》现在正在电影院上映。

articles.title: Hannah Einbinder Says Speaking Out for Palestine Is “the Bare Minimum”
articles.author: Hilary Lewis

paras.en: As she became increasingly well-known during her acclaimed five-season run alongside Jean Smart in HBO Max’s Hacks, Hannah Einbinder has used her time in the spotlight to speak out on various political and social issues she’s passionate about from climate change to AI to, most prominently in recent years, the fate of the Palestinian people amid the Israel-Gaza war.
paras.zh: 汉娜·艾因宾德 (Hannah Einbinder) 在 HBO Max 的《Hacks》中与吉恩·斯马特 (Jean Smart) 一起出演了广受好评的五季节目，知名度越来越高，她利用在聚光灯下的时间就她热衷的各种政治和社会问题发表看法，从气候变化到人工智能，再到近年来最突出的以色列-加沙战争中巴勒斯坦人民的命运。

paras.en: She famously called for a “free Palestine” at the end of her 2025 Emmys acceptance speech and was arrested last month, along with other pro-Palestinian Hollywood activists like Susan Sarandon, as part of a protest ahead of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu‘s United Nations address.
paras.zh: 她在 2025 年艾美奖获奖感言结束时呼吁“自由巴勒斯坦”，并在上个月与苏珊·萨兰登等其他亲巴勒斯坦好莱坞活动人士一起被捕，作为以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡联合国演讲前抗议的一部分。

paras.en: While some celebs might choose to stay silent about their political views, for Einbinder, there’s no alternative.
paras.zh: 虽然一些名人可能会选择对自己的政治观点保持沉默，但对于艾因宾德来说，别无选择。

paras.en: “I see it as the bare minimum,” Einbinder said at The New Yorker Festival on Friday of the “responsibility” she feels to speak out about her beliefs. “I think we are living in a time that is perhaps the worst point in human history. I think the threat of AI and climate [change] push us into that territory. And I know how many eyes I have on me. I know that difference that it can make. I know it from a financial perspective. I know that I can raise money. I have done it, and so I know that folks like myself and folks with even larger platforms can make tangible difference in the world. And for me, that’s been very specific to Palestine, and so knowing that, I don’t really see any other option.”
paras.zh: “我认为这是最低限度，”艾因宾德在周五的《纽约客节》上谈到她认为说出自己的信仰的“责任”时说道。 “我认为我们生活在一个可能是人类历史上最糟糕时期的时代。我认为人工智能和气候[变化]的威胁将我们推向了这个领域。我知道有多少双眼睛在注视着我。我知道它可以带来的改变。我从财务角度知道这一点。我知道我可以筹集资金。我已经做到了，所以我知道像我这样的人和拥有更大平台的人可以为世界带来切实的改变。对我来说，这是巴勒斯坦特有的，所以知道那个，我真的看不到任何其他选择。”

paras.en: Einbinder, who has previously spoken about how her views on Israel and Palestine have evolved since the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas attack on Israel, shared more about her recent education and perspective on the Israel-Gaza war at the New Yorker Festival event.
paras.zh: 艾宾德此前曾谈到自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击以色列以来她对以色列和巴勒斯坦的看法如何演变，她在纽约客节活动上分享了更多关于她最近的教育和对以色列-加沙战争的看法。

paras.en: “I started to attend IfNotNow vigils with my friends who were going, who were already anti-Zionists, and I found this amazing Jewish community and these Jewish spaces for me to go on a journey of unlearning the propaganda that we’re fed systemically,” Einbinder told The New Yorker‘s Rachel Syme. “And once I unlearned all of that, I realized I had to arm myself with a lot of knowledge and really go through, yeah, sort of a relearning period, and when I felt equipped, you know, I started to speak because I think when you see this for what it is, you cannot help — well, some people can, I guess. But I think that it was just so intrinsically tied to my values and my sense of justice, and I felt like I have to make up for lost time because I was complicit and unconscious in this system for so long, and I have to change my mind and I have to learn and grow, and so that’s what I’ve tried to do.”
paras.zh: 艾因宾德告诉《纽约客》的雷切尔·赛姆：“我开始和我的朋友一起参加 IfNotNow 守夜活动，他们本来就是反犹太复国主义者，我发现了这个令人惊叹的犹太社区和这些犹太空间，让我可以踏上一段忘却我们系统性灌输的宣传的旅程。” “一旦我忘记了所有这些，我意识到我必须用大量的知识武装自己，并真正经历，是的，有点重新学习的时期，当我感觉装备好了时，你知道，我开始说话，因为我认为当你看到它的本质时，你无能为力——好吧，我猜有些人可以。但我认为这与我的价值观和正义感有着内在的联系，我觉得我必须弥补失去的时间，因为我是同谋和无意识的这个系统已经存在这么久了，我必须改变主意，我必须学习和成长，所以这就是我一直在努力做的事情。”

paras.en: And Einbinder praised the “amazing new voices” she’d been exposed to coming out of Palestine, specifically citing Al Jazeera journalist Anas al-Sharif, who was killed in an Israeli air strike in August of 2025.
paras.zh: 艾宾德赞扬了她从巴勒斯坦听到的“令人惊叹的新声音”，特别引用了半岛电视台记者阿纳斯·谢里夫的话，他在 2025 年 8 月的以色列空袭中丧生。

paras.en: “There are these scenes that I think of that I saw happen when I think of him,” Einbinder recalled to a silent, sold-out audience at Manhattan’s Webster Hall who seemed to be listening intently as she spoke about her views on the conflict in the Middle East. “I feel like I watched this man’s life unfold, and Israel assassinated him. They knew that he and other journalists were sleeping in a tent, and they killed him because his voice was so powerful, and he had a beautiful daughter and a newborn son, and he risked his life to tell the truth about Israel’s crimes, and he was killed for that, and he was killed for being Palestinian.”
paras.zh: “当我想起他时，我就会想起那些发生过的场景，”艾宾德向曼哈顿韦伯斯特大厅里座无虚席、座无虚席的观众回忆道，当她谈到自己对中东冲突的看法时，观众们似乎都在专心地听着。 “我感觉我亲眼目睹了这个人的一生，以色列暗杀了他。他们知道他和其他记者睡在帐篷里，他们杀了他，因为他的声音如此有力，他有一个漂亮的女儿和一个刚出生的儿子，他冒着生命危险讲述了以色列罪行的真相，他因此而被杀，他因为是巴勒斯坦人而被杀。”

paras.en: In light of what happened to al-Sharif, Einbinder says any loss or “sacrifice” that she would experience for speaking out in support of Palestine pales in comparison.
paras.zh: 鉴于谢里夫的遭遇，艾因宾德表示，相比之下，她因公开支持巴勒斯坦而遭受的任何损失或“牺牲”都显得相形见绌。

paras.en: “When I speak about Palestine, when I say it’s the bare minimum, there is nothing on earth that I could ever lose or ever sacrifice. It would be a drop in the bucket to measure up to the most incredible human beings I have ever witnessed in my life and the sacrifices that they have made, so I want to draw attention to journalists like Anas and so many like him who were silenced. We are still here, and we have an obligation to tell their stories,” Einbinder said. “All of us have a responsibility, especially as Americans who are complicit as taxpayers whose money goes to fund the genocide. We have a responsibility to speak and not to stop until the genocide is ended.”
paras.zh: “当我谈到巴勒斯坦时，当我说这是最低限度时，地球上没有什么是我可以失去或牺牲的。与我一生中见过的最不可思议的人以及他们所做出的牺牲相比，这只是九牛一毛，所以我想提请大家注意像阿纳斯这样的记者以及许多像他一样被压制的人。我们仍然在这里，我们有义务讲述他们的故事，”艾因宾德说。 “我们所有人都有责任，特别是作为纳税人的同谋，他们的钱被用来资助种族灭绝。我们有责任发声，在种族灭绝结束之前不要停止。”

paras.en: Einbinder’s remarks were greeted with enthusiastic applause, including at least one person in the audience standing up after her “genocide” comment.
paras.zh: 艾宾德的言论赢得了热烈的掌声，观众中至少有一人在她发表“种族灭绝”言论后站了起来。

paras.en: Earlier in the event, Einbinder spoke about discovering comedy (and competitive cheerleading) as she grew up in Los Angeles and her breakout role in Hacks, offering some constructive criticism as the festival audience watched her memorable Branzino meltdown during the fourth season of the comedy, when she served as head writer for Smart’s Deborah Vance-hosted Late Night. She also got emotional watching a more dramatic scene between Ava and Deborah near the end of the final season.
paras.zh: 活动早些时候，艾宾德谈到了她在洛杉矶长大时发现的喜剧（和啦啦队竞技）以及她在《Hacks》中的突破性角色，当节日观众观看了她在喜剧第四季中令人难忘的布兰齐诺崩溃时，艾宾德提出了一些建设性的批评，当时她担任斯马特的黛博拉·万斯主持的《深夜秀》的首席编剧。在最后一季接近尾声时，她还看到艾娃和黛博拉之间更加戏剧化的场景，情绪激动。

paras.en: Einbinder also spoke about her recent role opposite Gillian Anderson in Jane Schoenbrun’s Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma.
paras.zh: 艾宾德还谈到了她最近在简·美泉宫的《瘴气营的青少年性与死亡》中与吉莲·安德森演对手戏的情况。

articles.title: Trump's executive order targets mortgage insurance, refinance costs. What it means for borrowers

paras.en: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order that aims to reduce mortgage costs as rising interest rates and inflation make homeownership less affordable.
paras.zh: 唐纳德特朗普总统签署了一项行政命令，旨在降低抵押贷款成本，因为利率上升和通货膨胀使房屋所有权变得不那么实惠。

paras.en: The order, titled "Decreasing Housing Costs for the American People," directs federal agencies to proactively cancel mortgage insurance on eligible future loans and expand a program to make refinancing cheaper, among other actions.
paras.zh: 该命令题为“降低美国人民的住房成本”，指示联邦机构主动取消符合条件的未来贷款的抵押贷款保险，并扩大一项降低再融资成本的计划等。

paras.en: In an X post on Thursday, Federal Housing Finance Agency director Bill Pulte said "millions of Americans will save thousands and thousands of dollars."
paras.zh: 联邦住房金融局局长比尔·普尔特在周四的 X 帖子中表示，“数百万美国人将节省数千美元。”

paras.en: But it's difficult to know the future consumer impact without more details, according to Keith Gumbinger, vice president of mortgage website HSH.
paras.zh: 但抵押贷款网站 HSH 副总裁 Keith Gumbinger 表示，如果没有更多细节，很难了解未来对消费者的影响。

paras.en: Trump's executive order comes less than two weeks before the Nov. 3 midterm elections, with rising costs and housing affordability a major concern among voters. It builds on previous orders to restrict Wall Street firms from buying single-family homes, among other actions.
paras.zh: 特朗普的行政命令是在距离 11 月 3 日中期选举还有不到两周的时间发布的，成本上升和住房负担能力是选民的主要担忧。它是建立在之前限制华尔街公司购买单户住宅等命令的基础上的。

paras.en: Homeownership has become less affordable in recent years. In 2025, the monthly payment for a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage on a median-priced home was roughly 33% of the median family's income, up from 26% in 2022, according to the Federal Reserve's latest Survey of Consumer Finances published in early October.
paras.zh: 近年来，买房变得越来越难以负担。根据美联储 10 月初发布的最新消费者财务调查显示，到 2025 年，中等价格房屋的 30 年期固定利率抵押贷款每月支付额约为中等家庭收入的 33%，高于 2022 年的 26%。

paras.en: Whether you're a current homeowner or future buyer, here are some of the key things to know about the new executive order.
paras.zh: 无论您是当前的房主还是未来的买家，以下是有关新行政命令的一些关键事项。

paras.en: Conventional loans — mortgages not insured or backed by U.S. government programs — typically require private mortgage insurance, or PMI, when a down payment is less than 20% of the home's purchase price. By contrast, Federal Housing Administration mortgages require mortgage insurance on all loans.
paras.zh: 当首付低于房屋购买价格的 20% 时，传统贷款（未受美国政府计划保险或支持的抵押贷款）通常需要私人抵押贷款保险 (PMI)。相比之下，联邦住房管理局抵押贷款要求所有贷款都购买抵押贷款保险。

paras.en: Trump's executive order directs the FHFA to create a pilot program that cancels eligible borrowers' mortgage insurance "proactively" once their home equity reaches a certain threshold, according to the White House. This would apply to mortgages originated after the pilot program launches.
paras.zh: 据白宫称，特朗普的行政命令指示 FHFA 制定一项试点计划，一旦符合条件的借款人的房屋净值达到一定阈值，就“主动”取消他们的抵押贷款保险。这适用于试点计划启动后发放的抵押贷款。

paras.en: Currently, conventional loan borrowers can generally remove PMI once their loan balance is below 80% of the purchase price or once they have reached 20% equity, according to Fannie Mae. Once your balance reaches 80% of the original value, you can ask your loan servicer if you're eligible to remove PMI, or they may remove it automatically when your balance reaches 78% of the original value.
paras.zh: 据房利美称，目前，传统贷款借款人通常可以在贷款余额低于购买价格的 80% 或资产达到 20% 时取消 PMI。一旦您的余额达到原始值的 80%，您可以询问贷款服务机构您是否有资格删除 PMI，或者当您的余额达到原始值的 78% 时，他们可能会自动删除 PMI。

paras.en: In a statement Thursday, Seth Appleton, president of U.S. mortgage insurers, an industry trade organization, said: "We commend the President's focus on lowering costs for future homeowners, and the private mortgage insurance industry is proud to already be delivering on that goal."
paras.zh: 行业贸易组织美国抵押贷款保险公司总裁塞思·阿普尔顿(Seth Appleton)在周四的一份声明中表示：“我们赞扬总统对降低未来房主成本的关注，私人抵押贷款保险行业很自豪能够实现这一目标。”

paras.en: Typically, the cost of PMI can be 0.2% to 2% of the loan annually, but varies based on your down payment size, credit score, amount borrowed and other factors, according to Fannie Mae.
paras.zh: 房利美 (Fannie Mae) 表示，通常情况下，PMI 的成本可能是每年贷款的 0.2% 至 2%，但会根据您的首付规模、信用评分、借款金额和其他因素而有所不同。

paras.en: For example, if you purchased a $600,000 home with a 10% down payment and a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage at 7.3%, your monthly mortgage insurance could be $351, according to a private mortgage calculator from Freddie Mac.
paras.zh: 例如，根据房地美 (Freddie Mac) 的私人抵押贷款计算器，如果您以 10% 的首付购买了一套价值 60 万美元的房屋，并以 7.3% 的利率购买了 30 年期固定利率抵押贷款，那么您每月的抵押贷款保险可能为 351 美元。

paras.en: "Most mortgages ... are carrying PMI at this point in time, especially with the way home prices have been and down payments being as small as they've been in recent years," Gumbinger said.
paras.zh: Gumbinger 表示：“目前大多数抵押贷款......都带有 PMI，特别是考虑到房价的走势以及近年来的首付规模。”

paras.en: During the second quarter of 2026, the median home down payment was 13.7% of the home's purchase price, or $27,100, according to a September report from Realtor.com.
paras.zh: 根据 Realtor.com 9 月份的一份报告，2026 年第二季度，房屋首付中位数为房屋购买价格的 13.7%，即 27,100 美元。

paras.en: Trump's executive order also aims to reduce mortgage refinancing costs by making permanent the FHFA's pilot program that waives the lender's title insurance policy and allows "cost-friendly alternatives," according to the White House.
paras.zh: 据白宫称，特朗普的行政命令还旨在通过永久化 FHFA 的试点计划来降低抵押贷款再融资成本，该计划放弃贷方的产权保险政策并允许“成本友好的替代方案”。

paras.en: "I don't know that it's necessarily a game-changer in terms of the cost of housing, which is dictated by home price and mortgage rates at the moment," Gumbinger said. "But you know, every little bit certainly helps."
paras.zh: 甘宾格说：“我不知道这是否一定会改变住房成本，因为住房成本目前由房价和抵押贷款利率决定。” “但你知道，每一点肯定都有帮助。”

paras.en: As of Oct. 23, mortgage interest rates for 30-year fixed-rate mortgages were 7.32%, according to Freddie Mac, and refinance demand was down 59% in mid-October, compared with the same week the previous year.
paras.zh: 据房地美称，截至 10 月 23 日，30 年期固定利率抵押贷款利率为 7.32%，10 月中旬再融资需求较去年同期下降 59%。

paras.en: Originally planned through November 2027, the FHFA pilot was "limited in scope," for refinances with a loan-to-value ratio below 80%, in a handful of states, former FHFA director Sandra Thompson said during a congressional hearing in April 2024.
paras.zh: FHFA 前局长桑德拉·汤普森 (Sandra Thompson) 在 2024 年 4 月的国会听证会上表示，FHFA 试点最初计划在 2027 年 11 月结束，但“范围有限”，仅适用于少数几个州贷款价值比低于 80% 的再融资。

paras.en: Thompson estimated that consumers could save $500 to $1,500 in closing costs for loans sold under the pilot program.
paras.zh: 汤普森估计，根据试点计划出售的贷款，消费者可以节省 500 至 1,500 美元的结账成本。

paras.en: Making the program permanent could save borrowers because the lender's title insurance policy, which is usually required for new loans and refinances, "has always been fairly pricey," Gumbinger said.
paras.zh: 古宾格说，使该计划永久化可以拯救借款人，因为新贷款和再融资通常需要贷款人的产权保险保单“一直相当昂贵”。

paras.en: The lender's fees related to title and title insurance generally make up the largest share of mortgage closing costs, according to a 2025 Urban Institute report.
paras.zh: 根据城市研究所 2025 年的一份报告，贷方与产权和产权保险相关的费用通常占抵押贷款过户成本的最大份额。

articles.title: Moody's holds steady on France's credit rating as country grapples with turmoil and higher yields

paras.en: Moody's opted to maintain its credit rating on France as the country contended with a week of civil unrest and rising political risk.
paras.zh: 穆迪选择维持法国的信用评级，因为该国正面临一周的内乱和不断上升的政治风险。

paras.en: The agency kept France's credit rating at Aa3, a level Moody's still deems "high grade," but it also maintained its negative outlook on the nation.
paras.zh: 该机构将法国的信用评级维持在 Aa3，穆迪仍认为该评级为“高等级”，但也维持对该国的负面展望。

paras.en: "The negative outlook reflects the increased risk that the fragmentation of France's political landscape will continue to impair the functioning of the country's legislative institutions," Moody's said in its report.
paras.zh: 穆迪在报告中表示：“负面前景反映出法国政治格局的分裂将继续损害该国立法机构运作的风险增加。”

paras.en: Moody's noted that it could return France's outlook to stable if its institutions can narrow the deficit.
paras.zh: 穆迪指出，如果法国机构能够缩小赤字，法国的前景可能会恢复稳定。

paras.en: Investors were anticipating Moody's rating decision as France, the second-largest economy in the euro zone, grappled with protests and a sharp surge in bond yields.
paras.zh: 由于欧元区第二大经济体法国正面临抗议活动和债券收益率大幅飙升，投资者正在等待穆迪的评级决定。

paras.en: "This political instability, also visible in the current social tensions, risks hampering the French government's ability to address key policy challenges such as an elevated fiscal deficit, rising debt burden, and durable increase in borrowing costs, thus leading to a more rapid weakening in the sovereign's key credit metrics than we currently expect," Moody's said in its report Friday.
paras.zh: 穆迪在周五的报告中表示： “这种政治不稳定性在当前的社会紧张局势中也很明显，有可能妨碍法国政府应对财政赤字增加、债务负担加重和借贷成本持续上升等关键政策挑战的能力，从而导致主权国家的关键信贷指标比我们目前的预期更快地减弱。”

paras.en: This week, the nation's 10-year bond yield surpassed 5% for the first time since 2002. The spread against German bunds is also at a 15-year peak.
paras.zh: 本周，该国10年期国债收益率自2002年以来首次超过5%。兑德国国债的利差也创15年新高。

paras.en: Currently, France's deficit-to-GDP ratio is at roughly 5.5% of its GDP, sharply above the 3% limit for member nations in the European Union. The country faces more than $1 trillion of debt that will mature by 2030. Just a month ago, the French finance ministry warned that the nation's debt-to-GDP ratio is expected to hit 121.7% in 2027.
paras.zh: 目前，法国的赤字占GDP的比例约为GDP的5.5%，远高于欧盟成员国3%的上限。该国面临超过1万亿美元的债务，这些债务将于2030年到期。就在一个月前，法国财政部警告称，该国债务与GDP之比预计将在2027年达到121.7%。

paras.en: At the same time, France has been rocked by protests. Last weekend, more than 500,000 people marched to express their frustration against declining public services and high costs of living.
paras.zh: 与此同时，法国也因抗议活动而震动。上周末，超过50万人举行游行，表达对公共服务下降和生活成本高昂的不满。

paras.en: S&P Global and Fitch cut their ratings on France in 2025.
paras.zh: 标准普尔全球和惠誉将于 2025 年下调法国评级。

articles.title: Turmoil hits AI buildout as neoclouds face pressure, credit risks mount and Solidigm pulls IPO

paras.en: Neoclouds tanked. Credit default swaps soared. Meta turned cash flow negative. And SK Hynix's Solidigm unit canceled plans for its initial public offering.
paras.zh: Neoclouds 陷入困境。信用违约互换飙升。 Meta 的现金流为负。 SK 海力士旗下的 Solidigm 部门取消了首次公开募股计划。

paras.en: It's been a rocky week for the AI infrastructure trade.
paras.zh: 对于人工智能基础设施行业来说，这是艰难的一周。

paras.en: The Nasdaq followed Thursday's beating with an additional drop on Friday to end the week down 0.7%. Among the hyperscalers, the worst performer was Alphabet, shares of which sank 6% ahead of the internet giant's third-quarter earnings report next week. Microsoft and Amazon are also on the docket, and they each saw shares fall less than 1%.
paras.zh: 纳斯达克指数继周四的上涨之后，周五进一步下跌，本周收盘下跌 0.7%。在超大规模企业中，表现最差的是 Alphabet，在这家互联网巨头下周发布第三季度财报之前，其股价下跌了 6%。微软和亚马逊也在考虑之中，它们的股价均下跌了不到 1%。

paras.en: While the tech market has thus far avoided a dramatic across-the-board sell-off, the artificial intelligence build-out is showing signs of strain.
paras.zh: 尽管科技市场迄今为止避免了大规模的全面抛售，但人工智能的扩张却显示出紧张的迹象。

paras.en: Shares of neoclouds CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN all fell sharply this week, bringing their losses for October to well over 30% each. CoreWeave, the leader of the pack, has seen spreads on its CDS widen past 11%, generally viewed as a distress level, as investors have to pay up for protection against default.
paras.zh: Neoclouds CoreWeave、Nebius 和 IREN 的股价本周均大幅下跌，导致 10 月份的跌幅均远超 30%。该领域的领头羊 CoreWeave 的 CDS 利差已扩大至 11% 以上，通常被视为陷入困境，因为投资者必须支付违约保护费用。

paras.en: Meanwhile, yields on the company's 2031 and 2032 unsecured notes topped 15%.
paras.zh: 与此同时，该公司 2031 年和 2032 年无抵押票据的收益率高达 15%。

paras.en: "What investors are doing is throwing every baby out with the bathwater and saying anyone who is a neocloud" will be devalued, Roundhill Investments CEO Dave Mazza told CNBC's "Squawk on the Street" on Thursday.
paras.zh: Roundhill Investments 首席执行官戴夫·马扎 (Dave Mazza) 周四在 CNBC 节目《Squawk on the Street》中表示，“投资者所做的就是把所有婴儿和洗澡水一起倒掉，并说任何新云”都将贬值。

paras.en: Fears aren't limited to the U.S. market. Shares of Elice Group, a South Korean cloud provider, dropped 30% in their market debut on Tuesday, and shares of Australia's NextDC plunged 39.5% on Wednesday after the data center operator slashed its annual earnings forecast.
paras.zh: 担忧不仅限于美国市场。周二，韩国云提供商 Elice Group 的股价在首次上市时下跌了 30%，澳大利亚数据中心运营商 NextDC 大幅下调年度盈利预期后，其股价周三暴跌 39.5%。

paras.en: AI optimism has been the major market driver for the past couple of years, as unrelenting demand for new models and services pushes the world's biggest tech companies to spend on infrastructure at historic rates. However, skeptics are getting more vocal in their concerns that returns on AI investment won't justify the capital expenditures.
paras.zh: 过去几年，人工智能的乐观情绪一直是市场的主要推动力，因为对新模式和服务的持续需求推动全球最大的科技公司以历史性的速度在基础设施上进行支出。然而，怀疑论者越来越担心人工智能投资的回报无法证明资本支出的合理性。

paras.en: Analysts at research and advisory firm Gartner predict that 80% of neocloud companies will either cease operations or be absorbed by 2030.
paras.zh: 研究和咨询公司 Gartner 的分析师预测，到 2030 年，80% 的 Neocloud 公司将停止运营或被吸收。

paras.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, perhaps the leading AI evangelist remains bullish. Huang said this week at a company conference in Berlin that "demand for the neoclouds is off the charts."
paras.zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）也许是领先的人工智能布道者，他仍然看好这一点。黄本周在柏林举行的一次公司会议上表示，“对 Neocloud 的需求超出了预期。”

paras.en: "The demand of the capital is much greater than the availability of the capital," Huang told CNBC's Arjun Kharpal. "That's going to get solved."
paras.zh: 黄告诉 CNBC 的阿琼·卡帕尔（Arjun Kharpal）：“资本的需求远远大于可用的资本。” “这件事会得到解决的。”

paras.en: Wall Street isn't convinced. On Thursday, South Korean memory giant SK Hynix, one of the biggest winners in the AI boom, said it's pulling an IPO for its U.S.-based Solidigm unit, citing market volatility. SK Hynix purchased Solidigm, which makes NAND and SSD storage for data centers, from Intel in 2021.
paras.zh: 华尔街并不相信。周四，人工智能热潮中的最大赢家之一韩国存储巨头 SK 海力士表示，以市场波动为由，将取消其美国子公司 Solidigm 的 IPO。 SK 海力士于 2021 年从英特尔收购了为数据中心生产 NAND 和 SSD 存储的 Solidigm。

paras.en: "While an IPO was expected to ease investment burdens and expand capacity for shareholder returns, the review has been discontinued in light of market conditions and share price trends," SK Hynix said in a release.
paras.zh: SK海力士在一份新闻稿中表示：“虽然预计首次公开募股将减轻投资负担并扩大股东回报能力，但鉴于市场状况和股价趋势，审查已停止。”

paras.en: Despite the turmoil, all of tech's mega-caps have maintained their investment-grade rating even as they've opened their wallets to fuel their build-outs, including through debt. Even with that group of companies, the market is showing some jitters.
paras.zh: 尽管出现动荡，所有科技巨头都维持了投资级评级，尽管它们已经打开钱包来推动其扩张，包括通过债务。即使有这样一批公司，市场也表现出了一些不安。

paras.en: Meta saw its stock plunge 7% on Thursday after the company reported negative free cash flow in the third quarter of over $2 billion while raising the floor of its full-year capex to $135 billion from $130 billion. Meta also said it plans to spend about $825 billion over the coming years on various leases and contracts, with over $450 billion of those leases being non-cancellable take-or-pay agreements.
paras.zh: Meta 周四股价暴跌 7%，此前该公司报告第三季度自由现金流为负，超过 20 亿美元，同时将全年资本支出下限从 1,300 亿美元提高至 1,350 亿美元。 Meta还表示，计划在未来几年在各种租赁和合同上花费约8250亿美元，其中超过4500亿美元的租赁是不可取消的照付不议协议。

paras.en: Spreads on Meta's five-year CDS reached all-time highs of over 124 basis points. CDS on Nvidia and Oracle also touched records, with their spreads hitting 126 basis points and 343 basis points, respectively, this week. Oracle's stock has lost over one-third of its value this year, and now the company faces risks of a credit rating downgrade.
paras.zh: Meta 的五年期 CDS 利差达到超过 124 个基点的历史新高。 Nvidia 和 Oracle 的 CDS 也创下历史新高，本周利差分别达到 126 个基点和 343 个基点。甲骨文股价今年已下跌超过三分之一，目前该公司面临信用评级下调的风险。

paras.en: John Williams, who leads the derivatives practice at law firm Milbank LLP, says investors are seeking numerous ways beyond buying CDS to hedge their bets with respect to the AI trade.
paras.zh: Milbank LLP 律师事务所衍生品业务负责人 John Williams 表示，除了购买 CDS 之外，投资者还在寻求多种方式来对冲人工智能交易的赌注。

paras.en: "There's so much investment going into it that it's just very appropriate to look for risk management tools, completely regardless of whether you're bullish or bearish," Williams said. "It would be crazy for people not to be looking for appropriate risk management tools for it."
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯说：“有如此多的投资投入，因此寻找风险管理工具是非常合适的，完全不管你是看涨还是看跌。” “如果人们不为此寻找合适的风险管理工具，那就太疯狂了。”

paras.en: Brian Stutland, portfolio manager at Equity Armor Investments, told CNBC's "SquawkBox Asia" last week that it's "all kind of tied together," referring to AI's impact on the whole market.
paras.zh: Equity Armor Investments 的投资组合经理 Brian Stutland 上周在 CNBC 的“SquawkBox Asia”节目中表示，“一切都是紧密相连的”，指的是人工智能对整个市场的影响。

paras.en: "Can you drop a bowling ball in one part of the pool and not get any waves downstream to the rest of the Nasdaq?" he said. "I don't know. I have some concern about that."
paras.zh: “你能把一个保龄球扔进泳池的一个部分，而不让下游的任何波浪传到纳斯达克的其他部分吗？”他说。 “我不知道。我对此有些担心。”

paras.en: — CNBC's Katie Tarasov contributed to this report
paras.zh: — CNBC 的凯蒂·塔拉索夫 (Katie Tarasov) 对本报告做出了贡献

paras.zh: 观察：对数据中心扩建中 CDS 利差不断上升的担忧
